༄7//bod kyi dpal 'byor lo rgyas mdor bsdus//0 7 ༅ 59 0/ lngaldong ka tshang dge shis chos grags/ltor cha.orshamoddha nub mi rigs slob chen bod rig pa'i slob gling /za cha cha ce

sngon 'gro'i gtam/bod gangs can gyi yul ljongs 'dir 'gro ba mi'i rigs byung ba nas bzung srid 'byor rig gsum gyi myu gu 'bus yod nges yin/ yin na yang bod kyi lo rgyus la phyir lta zhig byas tshe/ bod mi dmangs ni rig gnas dang chos luṭa la ha cang dga' zhen yod mod/ srid 'dzin dang dpal 'byor gyi riṭa pa'i gzhung lugs thog la do snang dang gal chen che po byed kyi med pa 'dra/ deng dus spyi tshoṭa 'tsho gnas thad kyi srid 'byor rig gnas 'phel tshad mgyogs po bya 'phur ba ltar bltas na/ rang re'i bod kyi spyi tshoṭa dar rgyas gtong byed kyi stobs shugs te thon skyed nus shuṭa kyi 'phel tshad ches dal ba'i tshul du mchis/ bod rigs mi dmangs tshos spyi tshoṭa 'tsho gnas nang dpal 'byor kun gyi gzhi rtsa yin pa'i nges don gyi go ba yag po len thub kyi med pa 'dra/ mar khe sis〈ma rtsa'i rnam bshad〉las cadapal 'byor ni rmang gzhi yin〉〉zhes gsung don ni/ dpal 'byor ram rgyu nor longs spyod ni bya ba thams cad 'grub byed rgyu rkyen las med du mi rung ba'i srog shing lta bu yin pa gsungs/ 'jig rten thog gi mtho po bla ma dpon po nas dma' sa mi ser sprang bo tshang mas zas gos 'gro 'dug la mi brten mkhan gcig kyang med/ de la brten dgos na nges par du dpal 'byor la do snang dang dam 'dzin zhe drag byed dgos/bod mi dmangs kyi 'du shes las/ rgyu mi rtag rdza 'go'i zil ba 'dra/ 'jig sla ba nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra/ tshong ba tshang ma mgo bskor gtong mkhan yin pa dang / tshong rgyag na ngo tsha ba/ chos rdzas kyi tshong rgyag mi rung / phyugs btsong ba'i tshong rgyag mi rung sogs kyi 'du shes rtsa ba nas bsgyur bcos byas te deng rabs khrom ra'i dpal 'byor nang du 'gran rtsod kyi rnam pa 'dzin dgos kyi 'dug bod 1

sngon 'gro'i gtam/ bod gangs can gyi yul ljongs 'dir 'gro ba mi'i rigs byung ba nas bzung srid 'byor rig gsum gyi myu gu 'bus yod nges yin/ yin na yang bod kyi lo rgyus la phyir lta zhig byas tshe/ bod mi dmangs ni rig gnas dang chos luṭa la ha cang dga' zhen yod mod/ srid 'dzin dang dpal 'byor gyi riṭa pa'i gzhung lugs thog la do snang dang gal chen che po byed kyi med pa 'dra/ deng dus spyi tshoṭa 'tsho gnas thad kyi srid 'byor rig gnas 'phel tshad mgyogs po bya 'phur ba ltar bltas na/ rang re'i bod kyi spyi tshoṭa dar rgyas gtong byed kyi stobs shugs te thon skyed nas shuṭa kyi 'phel tshad ches dal ba'i tshul du mchis/ bod rigs mi dmangs tshos spyi tshoṭa 'tsho gnas nang dpal 'byor kun gyi gzhi rtsa yin pa'i nges don gyi go ba yag po len thub kyi med pa 'dra/ mar khe sis ma rtsa'i rnam bshad〉las dpal 'byor ni rmang gzhi yin zhes gsung don ni/ dpal 'byor ram rgyu nor longs spyod ni bya ba thams cad 'grub byed rgyu rkyen las med du mi rung ba'i srog shing lta bu yin pa gsungs/ 'jig rten thog gi mtho po bla ma dpon po nas dma' sa mi ser sprang bo tshang mas zas gos 'gro 'dug la mi brten mkhan gcig kyang med/ de la brten dgos na nges par du dpal 'byor la do snang dang dam 'dzin zhe drag byed dgos/bod mi dmangs kyi 'du shes las/ rgyu mi rtag dzra 'go'i zil ba 'dra/ 'jig sla ba nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra/ tshong ba tshang ma mgo bskor gtong mkhan yin pa dang / tshong rgyag na ngo tsha ba/ chos rdzas kyi tshong rgyag mi rung / phyugs btsong ba'i tshong rgyag mi rung sogs kyi 'du shes rtsa ba nas bsgyur bcos byas te deng rabs khrom ra'i dpal 'byor nang du 'gran rtsod kyi rnam pa 'dzin dgos kyi 'dug sdud

mi dmangs tshang ma la bde skyid dang phyug po yong dgos pa'i kun slong rnam dag bzung nas〈bod kyi dpal 'byor lo rgyus mdor bsdus〉zhes pa 'di 'bri ba'i mgo brtsams pa lags/ bod kyi dpal 'byor lo rgyus ni/ bod kyi lo rgyus 'phel ba'i go rim ltar bris pa yin/ lo rgyus kyi ring byung ni ya thog spyi tshoṭa nas bcings 'grol gtong ba'i bar du yin/ dpe cha 'di lho nub mi riṭa slob grwa chen mo'i bod kyi shes rig slob gling gi bod yig dang / srid 'dzin/ yul skor/ dpal 'byor do dam 'dzin grwa'i slob mar 'tshams pa'i slob gzhir btsams pa yin/dpe cha 'di 'bri dus/ 〈bod kyi lo rgyus g.yu yi phreng ba〉dang / 〈bod kyi lo rgyus pad ma ra ga〉 〈bod kyi lo rgyus dris lan brgya ba〉 〈bod kyi lo rgyus gleng ba'i gtam〉〈bod kyi lo rgyus ti se'i 'od〉nam mkha' nor bu'i〈byang 'brog gi lam yig〉 〈bod kyi lo rgyus blo gsar 'jug pa'i 'bab stegs〉 〈bod kyi lo rgyus deb ther kun gsal me long 〉 〈bod kyi lo rgyus kun dga'i me long 〉 〈bod kyi lo rgyus gzhon nu dga' ba'i gtam phreng 〉 rgya yig gi〈bod kyi dpal 'byor lo rgyus bsdus pa〉sogs dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha gtso gas byas nas brtsams pa yin/ 'di na rtsom de dag gi rtsom pa po dang dpe skrun khang soṭa la bka' drin yang yang zhu ba lags/ gzhan yang dpe cha 'di 'bri bar rogs ram che po bzo mkhan grogs po rnams dang sdong ka tshang gis dngul gyis rogs byas par ched du bka' drin zhu ba lags/ dpe cha 'di'i nang la skyon dang nor 'khrul mi zhung ba yod nges yin pas dpyod ldan rnam pas dgag dpyod yong re zhu/de ltar byed po ni mdo smad zung chu shar dung ri'i nye 'dabs su chags pa'i ldong spel grong sde'i ldong ka tshang ngam lho nub mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i bod kyi shes rig slob gling gi dge ming pa ldong ka dge shes chos grags kyis/ spyi lo1999lo'i zla3tshes28nyin khreng tu'u nas zhu ba'o/ /2

mi dmangs tshang ma la bde skyid dang phyug po yong dgos pa'i kun slong rnam dag bzung nas〈bod kyi dpal 'byor lo rgyus mdor bsdus〉zhes pa 'di 'bri ba'i mgo brtsams pa lags/ bod kyi dpal 'byor lo rgyus ni/ bod kyi lo rgyus 'phel ba'i go rim ltar bris pa yin/ lo rgyus kyi ring thung ni ya thog spyi tshoṭa nas bcings 'grol gtong ba'i bar du yin/ dpe cha 'di lho nub mi riṭa slob grwa chen mo'i bod kyi shes rig slob gling gi bod yig dang / srid 'dzin/ yul skor/ dpal 'byor do dam 'dzin grwa'i slob mar 'tshams pa'i slob gzhir brtsams pa yin/dpe cha 'di 'bri dus/ 〈bod kyi lo rgyus g.yu yi phreng ba〉dang / 〈bod kyi lo rgyus pad ma ra ga〉 〈bod kyi lo rgyus dris lan brgya ba〉 〈bod kyi lo rgyus gleng ba'i gtam〉〈bod kyi lo rgyus ti se'i 'od〉nam mkha' nor bu'i〈byang 'brog gi lam yig〉 〈bod kyi lo rgyus blo gsar 'jug pa'i 'bab stegs〉 〈bod kyi lo rgyus deb ther kun gsal me long 〉 〈bod kyi lo rgyus kun dga'i me long 〉 〈bod kyi lo rgyus gzhon nu dga' ba'i gtam phreng 〉 rgya yig gi〈bod kyi dpal 'byor lo rgyus bsdus pa〉sogs dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha gtso gas byas nas brtsams pa yin/ 'di na rtsom de dag gi rtsom pa po dang dpe skrun khang soṭa la bka' drin yang yang zhu ba lags/ gzhan yang dpe cha 'di 'bri bar rogs ram che po bzo mkhan grogs po rnams dang ldong ka tshang gis dngul gyis rogs byas par ched du bka' drin zhu ba lags/ dpe cha 'di'i nang la skyon dang nor 'khrul mi nyung ba yod nges yin pas dpyod ldan rnam pas dgag dpyod yong re zhu/de ltar byed po ni mdo smad zung chu shar dung ri'i nye 'dabs su chags pa'i ldong spel grong sde'i ldong ka tshang ngam lho nub mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i bod kyi shes rig slob gling gi dge ming pa ldong ka dge shis chos grags kyis/ spyi lo1999lo'i zla3tshes28nyin khreng tu'u nas zhu ba'o/ /2

dkar chag sngon 'gro'i gtam/le'u dang po/ bod khul ngo spyodamador bstan/ ( 7472bo/ 7) (1)gcig rang byung sa gshes dang thon khungs skor/ (1)gnyis/ bod kyi srid 'dzin sa khul gyi dbye mtshams ngo sprod/ (6)le'u gnyis pa/ ya thog bodaspyi dpal 'byor ra bshad/ (7lha sgo lko17)(12)gcig bod kyi gdod ma'i spyi tshoṭa mdor bstan/ (12)gnyis/ bod gdod ma'i zhing las skor brjod pa/ (19)gsum/ bod kyi gdod ma'i phyugs las skor brjod pa/ (24)le'u gsum pa/ sru la skabs su bod dpal 'byor skor/ (4rsā77༅lko yizacho 414—6174) (30)gcig spu rgyal thog ma gnya' khri btsan po'i dus su dpal 'byor skor/(30)gnyis/ spu rgyal pu de gung rgyal dus kyi dpal 'byor skor/ (rdo1)

dkar chag sngon 'gro'i gtam/le'u dang po/ bod khul ngo sprod mdor bstan/ (malolom7/ 7) (1)gcig rang byung sa gshis dang thon khungs skor/ (1)gnyis/ bod kyi srid 'dzin sa khul gyi dbye mtshams ngo sprod/ (6)le'u gnyis pa/ ya thog bodakyi dpal 'byor sbyir bshad/ (༅ོ༅ཿ༅cholkom)(12)gcig bod kyi gdod ma'i spyi tshoṭa mdor bstan/ (12)gnyis/ bod gdod ma'i zhing las skor brjod pa/ (19)gsum/ bod kyi gdod ma'i phyugs las skor brjod pa/ (24)le'u gsum pa/ spu rgyal skabs su bod kyi dpal 'byor skor/ (loḥlo70chonyayiza/1 1414———617411) (30)gcig spu rgyal thog ma gnya' khri btsan po'i dus su dpal 'byor skor/(30)gnyis/ spu rgyal pu de gung rgyal dus kyi dpal 'byor skor/ (31)1

gsum/ sa yi legs drug dus kyi dpal 'byor skor/ (32)bzhi/ spu rgyal stag ri snya gzigs dus kyi dpal 'byor skor/ (33)le'u bzhi pa/ bod btsan bo dus kyi dpal 'byor skor/ (4 cha tsho〉༅lko 617—846lho) (35)gcig spu rgyal srong btsan sgam pos mtha' bzhi'i rgyal phran dbang du sdud tshul skor/ (35)gnyis/ bod kyi mdzangs mi bdun gyi bzhi ba dang lnga ba gnyis kyi mdzangs pa'i skor/ (36)gsum/ spu rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i ring la srid 'dzin lam luṭa kyi sgrig gzhi'i skor/ (37)bzhi/ spu rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i ring la dmag dpung sgrig 'dzuṭa gtan la phab pa'i skor/ (38) lnga/ spu rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i ring khrims yig gtan la phab pa'i skor/(41)drug spu rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i ring bod kyi spyi tshoṭa gong du 'phel thub pa'i skor/ (42)bdun/ spu rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i mdzad rjes gtso bo skor/ (43)brgyad/ bod btsan po'i dus su dpal 'byor dar spel spyir bshad/ (44)le'u lnga pa/ bod sil bu dus kyi dpal 'byor skor ( sgo107spyardzorngam 846wa 2 1253lho) (53)

gcig bod chen po sil bur 'thor tshul gyi lo rgyus/ (53)gnyis/ bod sil bu dus su bod yul du yod pa'i rgyal phran skor/ (54)gsum/ bod sil bu dus su dpal 'byor gong 'phel phyin tshul/ (56)le'u drug pa/ sa skya ba'i dus dpal 'byorakkor/ (cha 71ma7༅༅lko 1251wa 1354midza) (59)gcig dpal ldan sa skya ba'i skabs bod kyi dpal 'byor yar rgyas byung tshul/ (59)gnyis/ yon gong mas bod du sa mi dud rtsis byas pa'i skor/ (61)gsum/ chol kha gsum gyi sa ris dbye ba dang 'ja' mo btsugs pa/ (66)bzhi/ sa skya pa'i dbang 'dzin dus rabs su bod kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas skor/ (70)le'u bdun pa/ phag gru'i dus su dpal 'byor skor/ ( tshelkolkoṣṭha7707 1354—1618midza) (77)gcig phag gru sde srid kyi srid dbang dngos su btsugs pa/ (77)gnyis/ phag gru skabs su dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas skor/ (80)gsum/ bod khams 'dzugs skrun gyi skor/ (83)bzhi/ bzo skrun mkhas dbang thang stong rgyal po'i rnam thar/ (95)

le'u dang po/ bod khul ngo spyod mdor bstan/ gcig rang byung sa gshis dang thon khungs skor/bod 'di ni sa rgya che zhing thon khungs phun sum tshogs pa dang / yul kyi ba dang ljongs kyi bkod par thun mong min pa'i khyad chos ldan pa zhig yin/ las la brtson zhing gzhung drang ba dang / blo gros ldan zhing / dpa' ngar che ba'i bod rigs mi dmangs tshos dus yun ring po'i lo rgyus 'phel rim nang mi rigs rang nyid kyi thun mong min pa'i rig gnas phun sum tshogs pa bskrun yod pas mi tshad/spun zla mi rigs khag dang mnyam du rlabs chen mes rgyal gsar skrun dang gong du spel ba'i bya rim nang gzi brjid ldan pa'i 'os 'gan bsgrubs yod pa rede/bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun pa'i〈bod kyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus〉rgya yig ma'i bod khul ngo sprod mdor bsdus nang du/ bod yongs kyi spyi'i sa khyon rgyal yongs kyi bzhi cha gcig zin pa'i sa cha che bo yod ces 'dug bod kyi cha snyoms mtho tshad ni rgya mtsho'i ngos las spyi khre bzhi stong lhag tsam yod pas 'dzam gling gi yang rtse zhes 'jig rten na grags shin tu che/ gangs ri'i rwa bas bskor ba dang / brjid chags lta na sdug pa'i ljongs 'dir bod rigs dang / rgya rigs/hu'e rigs/ mon pa rigs/ cha'ang rigs/ lho pa rigs bcas dang / de bzhin steng pa shar pa sogs mdza' mthun mnyam gnas kyi 'tsho ba skyel bzhin gnas/

spyir bod kyi sa cha ni chags snga zhing sa'i go la 'grub byed kyi thog ma'i rgyu gtso bo zhig yin par su zhig gis kyang bston par mi nus pa dang / bod yul skam sar gyur ba'i nyin de nas dbu brtsams te rgya bskyed pa las stod mnga' ris skor gsum/bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad mdo khams sgang drug sogs kyi sa spyi'i ming la bod ces zer ba'i bod yul stod smad bar gsum lhun gyis grub/ de ltar na bod kyi sa cha sa mtho zhing ri mang ba/ btsan zhing nam zla bsil ba la sogs pa'i khyad chos thun mong min pa ldan pa'i yul khyad du 'phags pa zhig yin pa ni〈rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long〉las/ slobod ces bya ba khyad du 'phags pa'i yul/ / ri mtho sa gtsang gangs ri gnyan gyi mgul/ / bsil la mdzes pa lha gnas gzhal yas khang / / ngo mtshar rmad byung phan bde 'byung bas gzhi/ / chu bo bzhi 'bab rtsi shing nags kyis mdzes/ / 'bru sna lnga 'khrungs rin chen sna tshoṭa —— 'byung / / rkang bzhi kun khyab rtsi thog mar la spyod/〉 ces 'byung ba dang chos mthun pa zhig yin pa de ni bod kyi phyi snod kyi chags lugs dngos yin zhing / de'i bkod pa ji lta bu zhig yin snyam na bka' gdams glegs bam 〉las/ 4shar rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs na/ / gnas pur rgyal bod ces bya ba yod/ / ri mthon po gnam gyi ka ba yod/ / mtsho dma' mo g.yu yi maṇḍal yod/ / gangs dkar po shel gyi mchod rten yod/ / spang ser po gser gyi lhun po yod/’ ches gsungs pa lta bu yin te/ gnyan chen thang lha dang / lha ri rtse lnga/ rta khyung gdong lha/ bar ri btsa' khyer/ dug ri mdzo gdang / byang ri dmar khra/smug dkar rgod po/ nor bu mched brgyad/ g.ya' lung se lung / rgyab sgo brag dkar/ bstan ma bcu gnyis/ grod pu gnam btags/ gnas ri rab dga'/blon po rgyal gdong / dpa' khyung ham mo/ ba yan ha ri sogs ri mthon po ga/ma gyi ka ba lta bu dang / ma pham g.yu mtsho/ khri shor rgyal mo/ stong lu mtsho

las la brtson pa ni shin tu rigs pa nyid do/bod kyi yul ni skyes dngos sna tshogs pa'i bang mdzod lta bu zhig yin pa'i mtshan snyan phyogs kyi 'khor lor rdzogs shing / skyes dngos 'byung ba'i dus dang bskal ba ni sa chags pa'i dus dang mnyam pa ste/ mkhas pa kha cig gis sngar kha ba'i ljongs chus gang ba kong chu lag tu song nas mtsho bri shul du shug pa sogs kyi nags dang bya ri dwags chags zhes gsungs pa dang rnam par mtshungs pa'i phyir/de ltang byung ba'i skyes dngos bod yul du khri phrag gi grangs la nye ba mchis shing /khyad par du me tog rdzong dang / rdza yul/ lho yul sogs su sa cha gzhan du rnyed dka' deng mthong dkon pa'i skyes dngos rin po che brgya phrag gi grangs las brgal ba yod/ gzhan yang skyes dngos byung nas lo dang dus kyi yun tshad ring zhig 'das pa na srog chags byung zhing / srog chags la'ang bye brag gi rigs shin tu mang ba dang / thams cad 'dzam bu gling gi khyad nor kho na nyid yin/ skyes dngos kyi rigs dang srog chags kyi rigs mtshon byed tsam 'og tu 'god par bya ste/gsom sdong / shug sdong / lcang ma/ kon pa gab skyes/ kyi lce nag po/ bkra shis dgu rtseg go snyod/ glang sna dkar po/ snog pa rug pa/ sgron me shing /sngo dug mo nyung / chu rtsi dkar po/ ja shing dbang phyug 'jib rtsi dkar po/rta smug g.yang ldum/ stag gzig me tog thang phrom nag po/ drang srong me togaldum nag dom mkhris/ spang rgyan khra bo/ spyang tsher dkar po/ phur mong gla rkang /bya rgod sug pa/ byang chub shing / 'bri ta sa 'dzin/ me tog gangs lha/ me tog glang sna/ rtsa mkhris ba mo kha/ rtswa a wa dman pa/ tshar bong / mdzo mo shing / zhim thig dkar po/ zangs rtsi dkar po/ zi ra dkar po/ gza' bdud dkar po/ gzi ma rwa mgo/ yu gu shing nag po/ g.yer ma/ lug mig shang mtsho nag po/ shug 'bru/ sro lo dmar po/ gser skud/ gsor ldem/4

utpal/ pad ma/ gro/ nas/ sran ma/ bra bo/ ske tshe/ 'bras/ tshod dkar/ btsong / sgogapa/ la phug chu ko/ sil ko/ ku shu/ sil nyogarman 'brum sogs mngadumachis/༄ bo gser dang dngal zangs lcags nyi ma — chathad /sdungaru thad /du / —ra༅ / / /de / lta chib/tsha la dkar po/ chushel sogs gang cir dgos mkho che zhing rin thang bral ba'i gter rigs brgyaphrag yod pas mes rgyal kyi gter rdzas nor bu'i bang mdzod cig yin/gzhan yang srog chags la'ang bye brag gi dbye ba du ma zhig yod de/ rkyang /kha zha grum pa/ rgo ba/ gla ba/ gnyan/ te lo/ stag dom/ dred mong / rna/ bong bu/ ra/ lug spyang ki/ sprel/ pha wang / phagaphag rgod/ 'phar ba/ 'phyi ba/ bya ma bye'u/ a bra/ 'brong / glang /mdzo/ g.yag 'bri/ rta/ drel/ gtsod/ wa/ gzig g.yi/ ri bong / sha ba/ sum/ sre mong sogs sug bzhi can/ skya ku skyar mo/ khwa ta/ khug rta/ khra/ khrung khrung dkar mo/ go bo/ gong mo/ glag ngang ba/ngur ba/ co ga lcung ga chu bye'u/ mchil ba/ ti ti/ mthing ril/khyim bya/ ne tso/ pu shud/ phug ron/ bya rgod/ bya rog 'ol ba/ bya glag thang dkar/ 'jol mo/ go bo ser mgo byi'u khra/ 'ug pa/ shing rta mo/ so bya/ sreg pa/ srin bya sogs 'dab chags kyi rigs/ sbrul/rmigs pa/ rtsangs pa sogs lto 'gro'i rigs/ sbal ba/ phag ri'i nya/gtsang nya/ gser nya sogs chu srin gyi rigs/ cha ga ba/ byang khra/ bye stag khra bo/ sbrang ma/ srin bu me khyer sogs srin bu'i rigs bcas mang du mchis pa rnams brjod kyis mi lang ba yod/ 〈bka' gdams glegs bam gyi dkon mchog 'badas kyi skyes rabs lung bstan 〉las/ ri padma stong ldan dbyibs legs pa5/ /

dus gsum dkar po shel gyi mdog/ dus gsum sngon po g.yu yi mdog/ dus gsum ser bo gser gyi mdog/ dus gsum khra bo gzi yi mdog/ ces gsungs pa lta bu yin zhing/ spyir bod yul 'di'i nags tshal shug pa'i sdong po tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i lding khang du gcan gzan ri dwags thams cad rgyun du 'khor/'dab chags kyis skad snyan sna tshogs lhang lhang sgrog ri zur gsum rtse mo gnam du mtho/ gangs ri shel dkar gyi bum pa las yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu mig 'bab/thang chen po gnam sngon sa la 'phos 'dra'i gzhi la ri chung nyal/ sa rtse brgyad lung pa phyogs su gyes pa ni 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad phab pa 'dra/ chu bo dwangs la bsil bas 'du ba rang bzhin gyis snyoms/ bsil drod kyi sngo sna tshang bas sman gyi sbyor sdeb 'jams/ bza' shing 'bras bu mang / dus bzhi'i rnam 'gyur gsal/sa gzhi kha rgya che/ lung pa'i phu thag ring / sa dpyad bzang dgu 'dzoms pa bcas khyad par 'phags pa'i mtshan ma yongs su bkra ste/ ji skad du/ khang sa zhing sa sa yi dge/ / 'thung chu yur chu chu yi dge/ / gam 'brog rgyang 'brog rtswa yi dge/ / khang shing bud shing shing gi dge/ / khang rdo thab rdo rdo yi dge/ /zhes pa ltar/ sa la dge ba bcu'i yon tan rtsol med rang bzhin lhun gyis grub cing / bar gyi ri la bkra shes rtags brgyad ma bcos rang byung du tshang ba dang /logs su padma 'dab brgyad skyes shing 'dzum dkar rgod pa la soṭa pa'i snod bcud kyi dpal yon ni bsam gyis mi khyab cing brjod kyis mi lang ba mchis so/gnyis/ bodatpa srid 'dzin sa khul gyi dbye mtshams ngo spyod/bod kyi srid 'dzin sa khul gyi dbye mtshams zhes pa ni/ krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dmangs srid pu'u yis bsgrigs shing / krung go sa khra dpe skrun kha~X nas bskrun pa'i〈krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab srid 'dzin sa khul gyi

nang chen rdzong / chu ma leb rdzong bcas rdzong drug yod/bya mtsho nub sog bod rang skyong khul/ khul de'i mnga' khongs su rdzong 'di dag yod de/ gor mo grong khyer dang / ti li hwa grong khyer/ wu lan rdzong /them rdzong / tu'u lan rdzong bcas lnga yod/ tsho6 mtsho shar sa khul/ khul de'i mnga' khongs su bod rigs dang mi rigs gzhan pa 'dres ma byas nas bsdad yod pa'i rdzong khag 'di dag yod de/ gro tshang rdzong dang / phing an rdzong / hwang krung rdzong / hwang yan rdzong / men ho hor riṭa hos riṭa rang skyong rdzong / hu tsu'u hor riṭa rang skyong rdzong / hwa lung rdzong /zhin hwa rdzong bcas rdzong brgyad yod/7 mtsho byang bod rigs rang skyong khul/ khul de'i mnga' khongs su rdzong 'di dag yod de/ he yan rdzong dang / chis lan rdzong / rkang tsha rdzong / smin yon hos riṭa rang skyong rdzong bcas bzhi yod/gsum pa/ yun nan zhing chen la/ bod rigs 'dus sdod byas yod pa'i rang skyong khul gcig la rdzong gsum yod de/ bde chen bod rigs rang skyong khul la rdzong 'di dag yod de/ bde chen rdzong dang / rgyal thang rdzong / na shes nis su'u rang skyong rdzong bcas gsum yod/bzhi pa/ kun su'u zhing chen la/ bod riṭa 'dus sdod byas yod pa'i khul gcig dang / rang skyong rdzong gcig yod/1 kan lho bod riṭa rang skyong khul/ khul de'i mnga' khongs su rdzong 'di dag yod de/ co ne rdzong dang / 'brug chu rdzong / the bo rdzong / rma chu rdzong /klu chu rdzong / bsang chu rdzong / ba rtse rdzong bcas rdzong bdun yod/2 rang skyong rdzong gcig yod de/ wu we sa khul dpa' ris bod riṭa rang skyong rdzong yin/9

lnga pa/ si khron zhing chen la/ bod rigs 'dus sdod byas yod pa'i sa cha la khul gnyis dang rang skyong rdzong gcig yod de/1 rnga ba bod rigs cha'ang riṭa rang skyong khul/ khul de'i mnga' khongs su rdzong 'di dag yod de/ rnga ba rdzong dang / hong yon rdzong / mdzod dge rdzong /zung chu rdzong / g.yi tsha sde dgu rdzong / khro chu rdzong / chu chen rdzong / btsan lha rdzong / 'bar khams rdzong / 'dzam thar rdzong / li rdzong / wun khron rdzong /ma'o rdzong bcas rdzong bcu gsum yod/2 dkar mdzes bod riṭa rang skyong khul/ khul de'i mnga' khongs su rdzong bco brgyad yod de/ dar mdo rdzong dang / dkar mdzes rdzong / brag 'go rdzong /nyag chu rdzong / dpal yul rdzong / phyag phreng rdzong / 'dab pa rdzong / gser thar rdzong / sde rong rdzong / rta'u rdzong / sde dge rdzong / lcaṭa zam rdzong /ser shul rdzong / li thang rdzong / 'ba' thang rdzong / nyag rong rdzong / brgyad zur rdzong / rong brag rdzong bcas rdzong bco brgyad yod/phyi rang skyong rdzong gcig ni/ la'ang hran dbyi riṭa rang skyong khul du yod pa'i mu li bod rigs rang skyong rdzong yin/gzhan yang / bod dang mi regs gzhan pa bsres sdod byas yod pa'i sa cha mang po zhig na rang skyong khul dang rang skyong rdzong du 'dus med pa'i bod rigs mang po zhig yod/ dper na/ si khron kyi phing wu rdzong dang pe khron rdzong na bod dmag bod rigs mang po zhig yod/ da dung g.yag rnga sa khul gyi po zhin rdzong dang then chan rdzong / hri sman rdzong du bod rigs las rgyal rong ba mang bo zhig der yod/da dung pe cin grong khyer gyi zhang hran ri bo thag nye sa na rgyal rong ba mang bo zhig yod ces pa〈rdza ba'i gsar 'gyur〉thog bkod myong / yang / kun su'u zhing chen wu wes khul gyi yun brten rdzong dang so nan sa char bod riṭa mang po yod/ go thos 10

lnga pa/ si khron zhing chen la/ bod rigs 'dus sdod byas yod pa'i sa cha la khul gnyis dang rang skyong rdzong gcig yod de/1 rnga ba bod rigs cha'ang riṭa rang skyong khul/ khul de'i mnga' khongs su rdzong 'di dag yod de/ rnga ba rdzong dang / hong yon rdzong / mdzod dge rdzong /zung chu rdzong / g.ye tsha sde dgu rdzong / khro chu rdzong / chu chen rdzong / btsan lha rdzong / 'bar khams rdzong / 'dzam thar rdzong / li rdzong / wun khron rdzong /ma'o rdzong bcas rdzong bcu gsum yod/2 dkar mdzes bod riṭa rang skyong khul/ khul de'i mnga' khongs su rdzong bco brgyad yod de/ dar mdo rdzong dang / dkar mdzes rdzong / brag 'go rdzong /nyag chu rdzong / dpal yul rdzong / phyag phreng rdzong / 'dab pa rdzong / gser thar rdzong / sde rong rdzong / rta'u rdzong / sde dge rdzong / lcaṭa zam rdzong /ser shul rdzong / li thang rdzong / 'ba' thang rdzong / nyag rong rdzong / brgyad zur rdzong / rong brag rdzong bcas rdzong bco brgyad yod/3 rang skyong rdzong gcig ni/ la'ang hran dbyi riṭa rang skyong khul du yod pa'i mu li bod rigs rang skyong rdzong yin/gzhan yang / bod dang mi regs gzhan pa bsres sdod byas yod pa'i sa cha mang po zhig na rang skyong khul dang rang skyong rdzong du 'dus med pa'i bod rigs mang po zhig yod/ dper na/ si khron kyi pheng wu rdzong dang pe khron rdzong na bod dmag bod rigs mang po zhig yod/ da dung g.yag rnga sa khul gyi po zhin rdzong dang then chan rdzong / hri sman rdzong du bod rigs las rgyal rong ba mang bo zhig der yod/da dung pe cin grong khyer gyi zhang hran ri bo thag nye sa na rgyal rong ba mang bo zhig yod ces pa rnga ba'i gsar 'gyur〉thog bkod myong / yang / kun su'u zhing chen wu we/ 0khul gyi yun brten rdzong dang so nan sa char bod riṭa mang po yod/ go thos

ltar na shin cang gi lho phyoṭa su bod ljongs kyi sa 'dres yod sa zhig na bod riṭa kyi zhang lta bu zhig yod ces pa soṭa go myong / mdor na/ spyi lo1994lor krung gos mi grangs zhib bsher thengs bzhi byas dus bod mi rigs kyi spyi'i mi grwangs 4593330yod zer 'dug bsdoms pas rang skyong ljongs gcig dang / rang skyong khul bcu/ rang skyong rdzong gnyis/ rang skyong zhang gcig gi sa gnas yod pa yin la/ bod ljongs dang zhing chen gzhan pa'i bod rigs rnams kyang spun zla mi rigs gzhan dag dang mtshungs par/ krung go'i khyad chos ldan pa'i spyi tshoṭa ring luṭa kyi mes rgyal khyim tshang chen po'i nang du mthun sgril dang yar thon gyi lam la zhugs te bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba la rnam par rol bzhin yod pa 'di lags so/ /

le'u gnyis pa/ ya thog bod kyi dpal 'byor sbyir bshad/(sbyi lo sngon414lo'i yan chad)༄gcig bod kyi gdod ma'i sbyi tshoṭamador bstan/gleng gzhi/ bod kyi lo rgyus ni/ dus yun ha cang ring zhing nang don yang phun sum tshogs po yod pa dang / de las bod kyi dpal 'byor la zhib 'jug byed rgyu ni/rin thang che zhing da lta'i dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas gtong ba la dngos yod kyi don snying che po yod pa zhig red/ der brten/ nga tshos nan tan gyis brtag dpyad dang zhib 'jug byed dgos la/ gsham du thog mar bod kyi gdod ma'i spyi tshogs mdor bsdus las bskal ba chags tshul nas sa'i go la/ bod kyi sa cha chags tshul dang / skyes dngos/ srog chags/ spra nas mi ru gyur tshul skor ngo sprod mdor bsdus shig byed rgyu yin/bod kyi gdod ma'i spyi tshogs dus yun ni/ thog mar bskal ba chags pa nas/de/gnya' khri btsan po byung ba'i bar/ spyi lo sngon thog ma med pa nas/de/spyi lo sngon414lo'i bar yin/12

1 bskalabajiltar chagasab/bod kyi lo rgyus las bskal ba ji ltar chags pa'i skor la/ 〈rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long 〉las/ 4phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'di nam mkha' stong pa mtha' las 'das zhig yod pa las/ phyogs bcu nas rlung g.yos te/ phan tshun du phul bas rlung rgya gram zhes pa/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor kha dog sngo skya shin tu sra ba/ rngams su dpag tshad sa ya drug 'bum dang / rgyar grangs med pa cig chags so/ de'i steng du chu'i phung bo la brten nas/ rgya mtsho chen po rngams su dpag tshad 'bum phrag bcu gcig dang stong nyi shu/ rgyar dpag tshad 'bum phrag bcu gnyis dang stong phrag sum brgya phrag phyed dang lnga'o/ de'i steng du gser gyi sa gzhi lag mthil ltar mnyam pa / dpag tshad sum 'bum bzhi khri/ de'i dbus rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i ri'i rgyal po ri rab ni/ rang 'thag gi lte ba lta bur lhun gyis grub ste/ shar dngul/ lho beeḍūrya/ nub pad ma rā ga byang gser las grub pa'o zhes 'jig rten stong gsum gyi stong khams chen mo las/bar snang khams dang / rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ nyi ma'i khyim rgyud/ zla ba'i gling /sa'i go la/ rgyu skar gyi rgya khyon/ gling bzhi gling phran/ lho 'dzam bu gling sogs kyi chags tshul skor la dngos gtso ring lugs kyi lta ba dang mthun pa'i tshan rig gi bsdoms tshig ste sa skya bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis lung drangs nas bzhag 'dugabod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang nas dpar ba'i〈g.yung drung bon gyi bstan 'byung phyogs bsdus〉las/ dzicung zad gleng na mi mjed 'jig rten khams/ / chags gnas 'jig stong bskal ba rnam bzhi la/ / thog mar rten pa snod ni mas nas yar/ / 'byung ba lnga la brten te rem par chags/ /〉/sdos

thog mar phyi snod kyi 'jig rten ni mas nas yar la 'byung ba 'di lta ste/ sa chu me rlung mkha' la brten nas rim par chags par 'dod/ 'dod tshul de ni bab chags kyi dngos gtso ring lugs kyi lta ba dang gcig tu mthun te/ 'byung ba lnga la brten nas phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'di rim pa bzhin du chags par bshad pa 'dis 'jig rten ni dngos pos grub pa'i 'jig rten zhig yin pa mngon par /tshon pa'i phyir/ 'dod tshul de ni tshan rig dang rnam par mthun pa zhig yin 2 sa'i khu/jiltar chagasab/bod kyi lo rgyus rgya mtsho las/ sa'i go la ji ltar chags tshul skor la mkhas pa so so'i bzhed tshul kha kha yod la/ khungs btsan zhing yid ches thub pa zhig ni/phag mo gru pa'i byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i〈rlangs kyi po ti bse ru rgyas pa〉las/ 4sgo nga chen po gcig yong pa/ phyi'i sgong shun la/ lha brag dkar po chags/ nang gi sgong chu la/ dung mtsho dkar mor 'khyil/ bar gyi sgo nga'i dar cha la/ rigs drug sems can kun tu grol/ sgo nga phrum gyi bco brgyad chags zhes bkod pa'i srid pa'i 'phrul gyi sgo nga zhes pa ni bya spu yod pa zhig gi mngal las skyes pa'i sgo nga zhes pa'i don ma yin te/ lha'am 'gro ba thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi 'phrul gyis gegs med bde blag tu legs par drangs pa'am rdul rdzas dang 'byung ba lnga soṭa rgyu rkyen du ma zhig gis grub pa'i sa'i go la zhes bya bar go dgos te/sa'i go la'i dbyibs sgo nga lta bu'i zlum po zhig yin pa'i cha nas sgo nga zhes ming btags pa'i phyir/ dpe can sa'i go la de nyid dpe sgo nga'i steng nas mtshon pa sha stag yin te/ sa'i go la'i phyi shun lta bur gyur ba'i sa la g.ya' brag gangs gsum 14

stod tsam(sprochirtse༅〈sda)la skam sar gyur/ bod kyi na gzhon mkhas pa reb gong rdo rje mkhar gyis lung drangs pa ltar/ phas dpyad mkhas pa krig zhang gis‘bod kyi gna' bo'i sa cha de nyid chags bskal dang po'i stod la sgang ba sna'i sa leb sil bu mtha' dag rim gyis lhan cig 'dres nas mtshams sbyar ba'i stobs kyis bskyed pa'i 'bras bu zhig yin/zhes gsungs shing / yar klung gtsang po'i rgyud kyi sa rnams chags bskal gsar pa'i bar dus(༈oṃ༅〈shā)skam sar gyur cing / hi ma sha ya sogs ni de'i rjes su skam sar gyur yod/〉〉 ces gsungs pa bden par grub ste/da lta'i sa shun dang 'gyur rdo'i ri mos mtshon thub/spyir bod kyi sa cha 'di chags snga zhing ri mtho ba/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi rkang rten/ rin po che'i gter mdzod lta bu yul khyad 'phags shig yin pa ni/ 〈rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long〉las/ phabod ces bya ba khyad du 'phags pa'i yul/ /ri mtho sa gtsang gangs ri gnyan gyi mgul/ / bsil la mdzes pa lha gnas gzhal yas khang / / ngo mtshar rmad byung phan bde 'byung ba'i gzhi/ / chu bo bzhi 'bab rtsi shing nags kyis mdzes/ / 'bru sna lnga 'khrungs rin chen sna tshogs 'byung / / rkang bzhi kun khyab rtsi thog mar la spyod/ /mi ces gsung ba de ni bod kyi sa cha chags lugs dngos lags so/ /4 bod kyi sa char skyesadangosadabasrog chags kyi byung ba brjod pa/bod kyi yul ni/ skyes dngos dang srog chags sna tshogs pa'i bang mdzod lta bu zhig yin la/ dang thog bod yul stod smad bar gsum thams cad chu yis yongs su gang ba'i rgya mtsho chen po zhig yin pa dang / de nas rim bzhin kong chu'i kha phye nas chu rnams der thim ste bod yul gyi rnam pa gsal bor byung nas mtsho bri shul du 16

stod tsam(576455)la skam sar gyur/ bod kyi na gzhon mkhas pa reb gong rdo rje mkhar gyis lung drangs pa ltar/ phas dpyad mkhas pa krig zhang gis bod kyi gna' bo'i sa cha de nyid chags bskal dang po'i stod la sgang ba sna'i sa leb sil bu mtha' dag rim gyis lhan cig 'dres nas mtshams sbyar ba'i stobs kyis bskyed pa'i 'bras bu zhig yin zhes gsungs shing / yar klung gtsang po'i rgyud kyi sa rnams chags bskal gsar pa'i bar dus( sgo 4khu)skam sar gyur cing / hi ma sha ya sogs ni de'i rjes su skam sar gyur yod/mi ces gsungs pa bden par grub ste/da lta'i sa shun dang 'gyur rdo'i ri mos mtshon thub/spyir bod kyi sa cha 'di chags snga zhing ri mtho ba/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi rkang rten/ rin po che'i gter mdzod lta bu yul khyad 'phags shig yin pa ni/ 〈rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long〉las/ 4bod ces bya ba khyad du 'phags pa'i yul/ /ri mtho sa gtsang gangs ri gnyan gyi mgul/ / bsil la mdzes pa lha gnas gzhal yas khang / / ngo mtshar rmad byung phan bde 'byung ba'i gzhi/ / chu bo bzhi 'bab rtsi shing nags kyis mdzes/ / 'bru sna lnga 'khrungs rin chen sna tshogs 'byung / / rkang bzhi kun khyab rtsi thog mar la spyod/ /〉 ces gsung ba de ni bod kyi sa cha chags lugs dngos lags so/ /4 bod kyis char skyesadangosadabasrog chags kyi byung ba brjodapa/bod kyi yul ni/ skyes dngos dang srog chags sna tshogs pa'i bang mdzod lta bu zhig yin la/ dang thog bod yul stod smad bar gsum thams cad chu yis yongs su gang ba'i rgya mtsho chen po zhig yin pa dang / de nas rim bzhin kong chu'i kha phye na/ 6chu rnams der thim ste bod yul gyi rnam pa gsal bor byung nas mtsho bri shul du

shug pa dang rtsi shing sogs kyi nags dang srin 'bu chu srin bya ri dwags gcan gzan sogs byung ba zhes lo rgyus deb ther〈chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉las/mamanga' risabaskor gsum shwa rkyang ri dwags gling / / bar gyi ru bzhi stag gzig gcan gzan gling / / smad kyi sgang drug 'dab chags bya yi gling / /〉〉zhes gsungs/ de'i don ni/ gdod ma'i dus su bod yul 'di la rtsi shing gis sa gzhi khebs/ nags tshal gyis tshang tshing 'khrigs/ dus bzhi yi rnam pa gsal/bza' shing gi 'bras bu mang / bsil drod kyi cha snyoms pa/ mdo dbus khams gsum du 'dab chags gcan gzan ri dwags yongs su 'khor ba'i gling du gyur zhes pa des bod yul du skyes dngos dang srog chags byung tshul mngon par mtshon thub pa'o/ /5 sgra nas mi ru gyur tshul bshadab/'di'i skor bod du yongs grags su/ pha sprel rgan byang chub sems dpa' dang ma brag srin mo gnyis kyi bu rgyud las mi'i rigs 'phel ba yin zer ba dang /〈mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉las/ phadang por mi ma yin gyi yul du gyur/ /gnod sbyin la sogs bcu yis dbang byas skad/〉〉ces pa las/ gdod ma'i spra yi spyi tshogs yin dus spra'i rgyal po re re ni/ gnod sbyin nag po dang / re te mgo g.yag bdud/ srin po gnya' rengs khrag mig dmar 'jam lha/ rmu rgyal kho rje/ krog krog 'dre/ ma sangs rus dag klu/ rgyal po/ 'gong po dbun dgu sogs mi ma yin la mi 'phel sa'i rtsa ba spra rigs kyis lo ngo khri phrag mang po la yul gyi kha lo bsgyur nas yod nges red/mi yi 'gro ba byung tshul ni/ 〈mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉las/ mde nas mi yi 17

shug pa dang rtsi shing sogs kyi nags dang srin 'bu chu srin bya ri dwags gcan gzan sogs byung ba zhes lo rgyus deb ther〈chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉las/phamanga' ris bskor gsum shwa rkyang ri dwags gling / / bar gyi ru bzhi stag gzig gcan gzanagling / / smad kyi sgang drug 'dab chags bya yi gling / /mi zhes gsungs/ de'i don ni/ gdod ma'i dus su bod yul 'di la rtsi shing gis sa gzhi khebs/ nags tshal gyis tshang tshing 'khrigs/ dus bzhi yi rnam pa gsal/bza' shing gi 'bras bu mang / bsil drod kyi cha snyoms pa/ mdo dbus khams gsum du 'dab chags gcan gzan ri dwags yongs su 'khor ba'i gling du gyur zhes pa des bod yul du skyes dngos dang srog chags byung tshul mngon par mtshon thub pa'o/ /du spra nas mi ru gyur tshul bshadab/'di'i skor bod du yongs grags su/ pha sprel rgan byang chub sems dpa' dang ma brag srin mo gnyis kyi bu rgyud las mi'i rigs 'phel ba yin zer ba dang /〈mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉las/ dzidang por mi ma yin gyi yul du gyur/ /gnod sbyin la sogs bcu yis dbang byas skad/mi ces pa las/ gdod ma'i spra yi spyi tshogs yin dus spra'i rgyal po re re ni/ gnod sbyin nag po dang / re te mgo g.yag bdud/ srin po gnya' rengs khrag mig dmar 'jam lha/ rmu rgyal kho rje/ krog krog 'dre/ ma sangs rus dgu glu/ rgyal po/ 'gong po dbun dgu sogs mi ma yin la mi 'phel sa'i rtsa ba spra rigs kyis lo ngo khri phrag mang po la yul gyi kha lo bsgyur nas yod nges red/mi yi 'gro ba byung tshul ni/ 〈mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉las/ 4de nas ༵ yi

'gro ba byung tshul ni/ / sprul ba'i spre'u brag srin 'dus pa las/ / rigs drug nas 'phos spre'u phug drug cig byung / / de kun pha yis shing tog gis gang ba/ /nags ma bya tshogs can zhes bya bar bskyal/ / lo 'ga' lon nas blta ru phyin pa'i tshe/ / de nas mi min spre'u min bzhi brgyar 'phel/ /mi zhes dang / 4lo tog zos pas de kun mi nyid gyur/ / ma rmos 'bru za gos su shing lo gyon/ /nags na ri dwags lta bur gnas pa yi/ / klo dang mon ltar spyod pas bod yul gang / /mi zhes gsung ba'i don rgyas par bkral na 'di lta ste/ spre'u byang chub sems dpa' dang brag srin mo zhes bya ba'i spra rigs rnams nags gseb tu shing 'bras sogs kyis 'tsho ba rol zhing / shing sdong la 'khyud nas shing thog gis lus 'tsho ba'i spra rigs rnams sa ru babs te 'tsho zhing gnas dgos par ma zad ri dwags sogs sems can gzhan gyi sha khrag longs su spyod pa'i skabs kyang yod/ de nas spra rigs rnams kyis shing thog btog pa dang / ma rmos lo tog 'thu ba /sdong mgor 'dzeg pa/ zas za ba/ ri dwags gsod pa bcas kyi ngal rtsol rigs sna tshogs don du gnyer bar brten nas rkang lag gnyis so sor gyes nas yar langs te 'gro thub pa byung la/ de nas rdo chas dang rus chas dbyug pa sogs kyi lag cha'i rigs bzos shing ngal rtsol gyi thabs shes mang po zhig khong du chud de blo gros ches cher rgyas par 'gyur/ skabs der spra khyu rnams khyu dang khyu byas te gnas shing / thun mong gi tshogs pa spyi'i stobs kyis srog 'tsho ba dang / spra rigs rnams lo tog zos pas tshim par gyur nas/ 4spu yang thung du song / mjug ma yang thung du song ste/ smra shes nas mir gyur to/ zas su ma rmos pa'i lo tog za zhing / gos su shing lo gon par gyur/ de ltar na bod kha ba can pa'i mi 'di rna/sna pha spre'u dang ma brag srin mo gnyis las chad pa yin pas rigs gnyis su phye

'gro ba byung tshul ni/ / sprul ba'i spre'u brag srin 'dus pa las/ / rigs drug nas 'phos spre'u phrug drug cig byung / / de kun pha yis shing tog gis gang ba/ /nags ma bya tshogs can zhes bya bar bskyal/ / lo 'ga' lon nas blta ru phyin pa'i tshe/ / de nas mi min spre'u min bzhi brgyar 'phel/ /〉〉zhes dang / phalo tog zos pas de kun mi nyid gyur/ / ma rmos 'bru za gos su shing lo gyon/ /nags na ri dwags lta bur gnas pa yi/ / klo dang mon ltar spyod pas bod yul gang / /〉〉zhes gsung ba'i don rgyas par bkral na 'di lta ste/ spre'u byang chub sems dpa' dang brag srin mo zhes bya ba'i spra rigs rnams nags gseb tu shing 'bras sogs kyis 'tsho ba rol zhing / shing sdong la 'khyud nas shing thog gis lus 'tsho ba'i spra rigs rnams sa ru babs te 'tsho zhing gnas dgos par ma zad ri dwags sogs sems can gzhan gyi sha khrag longs su spyod pa'i skabs kyang yod/ de nas spra rigs rnams kyis shing thog btog pa dang / ma rmos lo tog 'thu ba/sdong mgor 'dzeg pa/ zas za ba/ ri dwags gsod pa bcas kyi ngal rtsol rigs sna tshogs don du gnyer bar brten nas rkang lag gnyis so sor gyes nas yar langs te 'gro thub pa byung la/ de nas rdo chas dang rus chas dbyug pa sogs kyi lag cha'i rigs bzos shing ngal rtsol gyi thabs shes mang po zhig khong du chud de blo gros ches cher rgyas par 'gyur/ skabs der spra khyu rnams khyu dang khyu byas te gnas shing / thun mong gi tshogs pa spyi'i stobs kyis srog 'tsho ba dang / spra rigs rnams lo tog zos pas tshim par gyur nas/ sna‘spu yang thung du song / mjug ma yang thung du song ste/ smra shes nas mir gyur to/ zas su ma rmos pa'i lo tog za zhing / gos su shing lo gon par gyur/ de ltar na bod kha ba can pa'i mi 'di rnams pha spre'u dang ma brag srin mo gnyis las chad pa yin pas rigs gnyis su phye 18

yod do/ /mi ces〈rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long〉las gsungs/ mdor na/gcig ni/ spra'i rkang lag kha khar phye ba dang / gnyis ni/ smra shes shing don go ba/ gsum ni/ ngal rtsol la brten nas lag cha bzo ba/ de nas spra rigs rnams mi'i dbyibs can du 'gyur ba'i gnas tshul phyogs btus tsam ngo sprod rags bsdus shig byas pa yin/mdor na/ bod kyi gdod ma'i spyi tshogs ༷ rdor bstan la/ bskal ba ji ltar chags pa dang / sa'i go la'i byung tshul/ bod kyi sa cha'i byung ba/ bod kyi sa char skyes dngos dang srog chags kyi byung tshul/ spra nas mi ru gyur tshul bcas bod kyi gdod ma'i rnam pa rags bsdus sheg tshig nyung don gsal go bdes brjod pa re zhig rdzogs so/ / gnyis/ bod gdod ma'i zhing lasaskor brjod pa/gna' snga mo bskal ba ya thog dus su/ spra rnams mi ru gyur te 'gro ba mi'i rigs byung ba nas bzung / bod gangs can gyi yul ljongs 'di la bod kyi mes po yang byung ba'i lo rgyus dbu brtsams yod ces brjod na mi 'grig pa spu tsam yang med de/ lung dang rigs pa'i khungs btsan po gser gyi sa gzhi lta bu yod/bod kyi bskal ba ya thog gi spyi tshogs nang du/ mi rnams la za rgyu dang rgyan chas/ 'dug sa/ spyod chas/ 'gro byed sogs srog 'tsho ba'i bya ba gnyer dgos nges red/ de dag gnyer ba nas bzung bod kyi gdod ma'i dpal 'byor gyi 'tsho ba dngos 'go brtsams pa red/ de'i skor sgrub byed gang gang yod zer na/1 bod rigs kyi sa khul te mdo dbus khams su/ sa 'og nas gna' dus kyi dngos rigs mang po thon yod de/ dper na/ dbus gtsang gi nying khri steng /

yod do/ /〉 ces〈rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long〉las gsungs/ mdor na/gcig ni/ spra'i rkang lag kha khar phye ba dang / gnyis ni/ smra shes shing don go ba/ gsum ni/ ngal rtsol la brten nas lag cha bzo ba/ de nas spra rigs rnams mi'i dbyibs can du 'gyur ba'i gnas tshul phyogs btus tsam ngo sprod rags bsdus shig byas pa yin/ mdor na/ bod kyi gdod ma'i spyi tshogs 0 dor bstan la/ bskal ba ji ltar chags pa dang / sa'i go la'i byung tshul/ bod kyi sa cha'i byung ba/ bod kyi sa char skyes dngos dang srog chags kyi byung tshul/ spra nas mi ru gyur tshul bcas bod kyi gdod ma'i rnam pa rags bsdus shig tshig nyung don gsal go bdes brjod pa re zhig rdzogs so/ /gnyis/ bod gdod ma'i zhing las skor brjod pa/gna' snga mo bskal ba ya thog dus su/ spra rnams mi ru gyur te 'gro ba mi'i rigs byung ba nas bzung / bod gangs can gyi yul ljongs 'di la bod kyi mes po yang byung ba'i lo rgyus dbu brtsams yod ces brjod na mi 'grig pa spu tsam yang med de/ lung dang rigs pa'i khungs btsan po gser gyi sa gzhi lta bu yod/bod kyi bskal ba ya thog gi spyi tshogs nang du/ mi rnams la za rgyu dang gyon chas/ 'dug sa/ spyod chas/ 'gro byed sogs srog 'tsho ba'i bya ba gnyer dgos nges red/ de dag gnyer ba nas bzung bod kyi gdod ma'i dpal 'byor gyi 'tsho ba dngos 'go brtsams pa red/ de'i skor sgrub byed gang gang yod zer na/1 bod rigs kyi sa khul te mdo dbus khams su/ sa 'og nas gna' dus kyi dngos rigs mang po thon yod de/ dper na/ dbus gtsang gi nying khri dang /19

ding ri/ gnya' lam/ nag chu/ me tog spu hreng / shan rtsa/ lha sa'i chu kong sogs dang / khams phyogs kyi chab mdo'i mkhar ro dang / smar khams/a mdo'i phyogs su chab cha dang / rma chu'i rgyud/ hor yul/ ba yan sogs bod kyi sa khul mang po zhig nas rdo chas rnying pa dang rdo chas gsar ba/ lcags rdo zung 'brel skabs kyi gna' rdzas thon pa'i rigs mang po las/ gna' mi'i dpal 'byor gyi 'tsho ba rol stangs lung rigs kyi thog nas rtogs thub kyin 'dugadaper na/ bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis1986lor par ba'i〈bod kyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus〉kyi shog ngos10na/ mkhar ro dang nying khri'i gna' rdzas las/ rdo chas la bu ga brtol nas shing gi yu ba sprad de rdo'i tho ba dang /rdo'i sta re/ rdo'i 'jor/ rdo'i khem/ rdo mdung / rdo'i sbyar ma/ rdo 'bigardo gtun/ rus chas/ dbyug pa/ rgyan cha sogs dang / de min da dung ma rmos lo tog gi son yang ha cang mang po rnyed yod/mi ces par brtag na/ bod la gdod ma'i dus nas dpal 'byor 'tsho ba nang gi zhing las te 'tsho ba'i gtso bo zhig tu gyur yod par rtogs thub/ zhing las thon skyed la nges par dgos pa'i sa zhing ni thang dang spang rgod/ chu mtha'/ rdzo rtsa sogs sa bon 'debs sa'i zhing byed la/ 〈rgyal rab gsal me〉las de nas thang thams cad la zhing byas zhes 'duga'abru rigs kyi son ni ma rmos lo tog dang / shing tog gi 'bru/ rtswa'i rgyan bu sogs byed cing / zhing las kyi lag cha ni rdo 'jor dang / rdo 'big dbyug pardo khem sogs yin nges/ zhing 'debs dus rags rmo rags 'debs byed de/rdo 'jor gyis sa dong brkos shing de la son btabs rjes sa yis kha bsub la/ de nas ga 'dra byas nas skyes nas de 'dra byas nas 'bru rigs len pa ma gtogs sngon tho/ zhalag rtsal gyis zhing las gnyer thub rgyu ma red/ don du thang dang spang te

ding ri/ gnya' lam/ nag chu/ me tog spu hreng / shan rtsa/ lha sa'i chu kong sogs dang / khams phyogs kyi chab mdo'i mkhar ro dang / smar khams/a mdo'i phyogs su chab cha dang / rma chu'i rgyud/ hor yul/ ba yan sogs bod kyi sa khul mang po zhig nas rdo chas rnying pa dang rdo chas gsar ba/ lcags rdo zung 'brel skabs kyi gna' rdzas thon pa'i rigs mang po las/ gna' mi'i dpal 'byor gyi 'tsho ba rol stangs lung rigs kyi thog nas rtogs thub kyin 'dugadaper na/ bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis1986lor par ba'i〈bod kyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus〉kyi shog ngos10na/ mkhar ro dang nying khri'i gna' rdzas las/ rdo chas la bu ga brtol nas shing gi yu ba sprad de rdo'i tho ba dang /rdo'i sta re/ rdo'i 'jor/ rdo'i khem/ rdo mdung / rdo'i sbyar ma/ rdo 'big rdo gtun/ rus chas/ dbyug pa/ rgyan cha sogs dang / de min da dung4ma rmos lo tog gi son yang ha cang mang po rnyed yod/〉〉ces par brtag na/ bod la gdod ma'i dus nas dpal 'byor 'tsho ba nang gi zhing las te 'tsho ba'i gtso bo zhig tu gyur yod par rtogs thub/ zhing las thon skyed la nges par dgos pa'i sa zhing ni thang dang spang rgod/ chu mtha'/ rdza rtsa sogs sa bon 'debs sa'i zhing byed la/ 〈rgyal rab gsal me〉lasar de nas thang thams cad la zhing byas〉〉zhes 'duga'abru rigs kyi son ni ma rmos lo tog dang / shing tog gi 'bru/ rtswa'i rgun bu sogs byed cing / zhing las kyi lag cha ni rdo 'jor dang / rdo 'big dbyug pardo khem sogs yin nges/ zhing 'debs dus rags rmo rags 'debs byed de/rdo 'jor gyis sa dong brkos shing de la son btabs rjes sa yis kha bsub la/ de nas ga 'dra byas nas skyes nas de 'dra byas nas 'bru rigs len pa ma gtogs sngon thon lag rtsal gyis zhing las gnyer thub rgyu ma red/ don du thang dang spang te 20

brkos nas sa zhing du byas pa/2 bod rgya lo rgyus deb ther nang gi lung skor yang phun sum tshogs pa yod de/dper na/ 'bru rigs sna lnga'i byung tshul skor la/ 〈mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉las/phari rab zom nas 'bru sna lnga blangs te/ bod du gtor bas ma rmos lo tog byas/byang chub sems dpas rang gi rigs brgyud rnams/ khrid de ma rmos pa yi lo tog bstan/〉〉zhes pa las/ spra nas mi ru gyur ba'i byang chub sems dpas rang gi rigs brgyud de gdod ma'i mi rnams bkres skom sel ba'i slad du ri rab mtho po nas gro nas sran ma bra bo so ba rnams son blangs te/ sa la gtor bas yul der ngal rtsol byas nas 'bru rigs mang po skyes bas des 'tsho ba rol bzhin yod pa bstan yod/'bru rigs kyi sa bon 'debs nas zhing las las shes pa gyur ba'o/ /yang / rgyal yongs mtho rim slob gso pu'u yis rtsa 'dzugs byas nas bsgriṭa pa'i〈chab srid dpal 'byor rig pa'i rtsa ba'i rig pa〉shog ngos30na/ gdod ma'i mis4rtsi shing 'thu ba'i rmang gzhi thog nas gdod ma'i zhing las gnyer tshul grub yod/ phyugs las dang zhing las byung ba de ni spyi tshogs thon skyed nus shuṭa 'phel rgyas gsar ba zhig gi dus mtsha sa su slebs pa'i rtags mtshan red〉〉ces gsungs/yang de las/ 44pho rnams kyis ri dwags brngon pa dang / nya srin 'dzin pa/srog chags sogs kha lo sna lo btul zhing / mo rnams kyis rtsi shing dang shing tog gi 'bras bu 'tshol sdud dang / thags 'thag pa/ zas rigs bzo zhing bgo bsha'i bya ba gnyer ba/ lo lon tshos lag cha bzo skrun dang nyams gso byed pa/ phru gu tshos bud med la lag rogs byed pa'i bya ba gnyer ba sogs las bgo byas na ngal rtsol thon skyed kyi las chod je mthor gtong thub/〉〉ces gsungs yod/ de las zhing las dang phyugs las dar tshul shes thub ba red/21

brkos nas sa zhing du byas pa/2 bod rgya lo rgyus deb ther nang gi lung skor yang phun sum tshogs pa yod de/dper na/ 'bru rigs sna lnga'i byung tshul skor la/ 〈mkhas pa'i dga' ston〉las/4ri rab zom nas 'bru sna lnga blangs te/ bod du gtor bas ma rmos lo tog byas/byang chub sems dpas rang gi rigs brgyud rnams/ khrid de ma rmos pa yi lo tog bstan/mi zhes pa las/ spra nas mi ru gyur ba'i byang chub sems dpas rang gi rigs brgyud de gdod ma'i mi rnams bkres skom sel ba'i slad du ri rab mtho po nas gro nas sran ma bra bo so ba rnams son blangs te/ sa la gtor bas yul der ngal rtsol byas nas 'bru rigs mang po skyes bas des 'tsho ba rol bzhin yod pa bstan yod/'bru rigs kyi sa bon 'debs nas zhing las las shes pa gyur ba'o/ /yang / rgyal yongs mtho rim slob gso pu'u yis rtsa 'dzugs byas nas bsgriṭa pa'i〈chab srid dpal 'byor rig pa'i rtsa ba'i rig pa〉shog ngos30na/ gdod ma'i mis4rtsi shing 'thu ba'i rmang gzhi thog nas gdod ma'i zhing las gnyer tshul grub yod/ phyugs las dang zhing las byung ba de ni spyi tshogs thon skyed nus shuṭa 'phel rgyas gsar ba zhig gi dus mtsha sa su slebs pa'i rtags mtshan red ces gsungs/yang de las/ dzipho rnams kyis ri dwags brngon pa dang / nya srin 'dzin pa/srog chags sogs kha lo sna lo btul zhing / mo rnams kyis rtsi shing dang shing tog gi 'bras bu 'tshol sdud dang / thags 'thag pa/ zas rigs bzo zhing bgo bsha'i bya ba gnyer ba/ lo lon tshos lag cha bzo skrun dang nyams gso byed pa/ phru gu tshos bud med la lag rogs byed pa'i bya ba gnyer ba sogs las bgo byas na ngal rtsol thon skyed kyi las chod je mthor gtong thub/mi ces gsungs yod/ de las zhing las dang phyugs las dar tshul shes thub ba red/ 21

yang / bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang gis1988lor par ba'i dpal tshul gyis brtsams pa'i〈g.yung drung bon gyi bstan 'byung〉las/ phazas ni sar skyes ldum dang sha za las/〉〉zhes dang / phaspu breg thag tshem zhing 'debs sogs shes dus/ / 'brog dang yul pa zhes pa'i srid pa byung / /mi zhes pa sogs ni bod kyi sa char spu rgyal btsan po ma byon gong du rgyal phran sil bcu gnyis dus su za ma ni rang byung khams kyi sararang skyes kyi ldum bu ste rtsi shing gi 'bras bu dang shing tog yin zhing / rgyal phran bzhi bcu'i skabs su thon skyed nus pa je mthor song bas dpal 'ebyor gyi 'tsho ba'ang je mthor song yod de/ 'tshol sdud las zhing 'debs tshul gyi srol shes yod/ de las yul ba zhes pa ni zhing las byar rung ba'i sa char gzhis chags pa'i mi la yul pa zer/ deng sang kha skad du rong pa zer ba dang gcig pa gcig rkyang red/3 rigs pas dpyad nas go bder btang na 'di lta ste/ spra nas mi ru gyur/mi de yang pha rgyud dang ma rgyud gtso bo spel ba las byung ba'i tsho skor tsho skor du gyur/tsho skor nang nas yang rang rang gi gnyen tshan gyis thon skyed ngal rtsol byed pa'i thabs kyis rang kha rang gso byed pa'i srol byung / kho tsho 'dug sa ni〈bon gyi bstan 'byung〉las/ 6 mi yi khyim yang sa khung brag phug dang / / byung ba'i rdo khang brtsegs dbub byed pa las/ /〉〉zhes pa las/ 'dug sa ni sa yi khung ngam sa dong / brag khung dang brag phug rdo yis bzos ba'i brtsegs khang / de min da dung nags tshal dang / rtswa'i spyil bu/ shing lo'i gur sogs yin shas che/ kho tsho gtan sdod byas dus nags kyi shing tog dang rtsi shing gi rgun bu sdod sar khyer yong ste kho ra khor yug tu rtsi shing gi 'bras bu sa la lhung ba lo rjes mar slar yang skyes te rtsi shing du gyur ba mthong nas 'bras bu sa bon du 'debs pa'i srol byung stabs/ gro 22

dang / nas/ sran chen/ sran chung / bra bo/ zar ma/ so ba sogs kyang 'debs las kyis mi rnams kyi longs spyod du byung / de ni bod kyi dpal 'byor lo rgyus las zhing las thon skyed spel ba'i nang 'phur mchong gi bya ba che po zhig yin/bod du gtan sdod kyi gdod ma'i zhing las de nas dar 'go tshugs pa red/gna' mi bod kyi kha dpe la/ pho dpa' bo'i drin las 'brog sde byung / mo mdzangs ma'i drin las so nam byung / zhes grags pa ltar bod kyi gdod ma'i dus su/ pha rgyud gtso bzung gi dus rabs dang ma rgyud gtso bzung gi dus rabs zer ba sogs med pa/ de ni 'dzam gling spyi'i gdod ma'i spyi tshogs dang mi 'dra zhing /bod rang nyid kyi khyad chos ni/ pho rnams ri dwags rngon dus gson por bzung pa rnams gsog 'jog byas bas g.yag dang / ra ma/ rta/ lug ba glang /khyi/ phag sogs sgo phyugs su bkug pa dang / mo mdzangs ma rnams kyis rtsi shing dang shing tog ma rmos lo tog gi 'bras bu btus te rmo 'debs byas pa dag las bod kyi dpal 'byor 'tsho ba'i brten gzhi ni/ phyugs las dang zhing las kyi srol btod pa'o/ de nas 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen ni rgyun ldan can dang khag theg yod pa zhig tu gyur bar brten nas mi rnams kyis gtan sdod kyi 'tsho ba skyel 'go brtsams so/ /mjug mtshams su gtam/bod kyi dpal 'byor las/ zhing las ni gdod ma nas da bar 'tsho ba'i srog shing lta bur gyur yod pa bod kyi ser skya mi dmangs kyis mkhyen nges red/ bod kyi zhing las kyi lo rgyus ni bskal ba ya thog nas da bar yod kyang 'gyur ba che po byung med nas srol rgyun gyi thon skyed lta bu byas nas rang sar bsdad yod pa yang kun gyis gsal/ de la sdom zhig bzhag na/ 23

bod kyi zhing las thon skyed ni/ / lo rgyus ring zhing 'gyur ba med/ /zog gnyis gnya' shing khur ba dang / / sa rmo shul du son rnams gtor/ /myu gu ldum bu cha skyes nas/ / tsam pa'i nang du yug po gang / /zhing las gnyer ba'i sngon thon rtsal/ / sbyong mkhan med kyang zer mkhan med/ /de ni gangs can bod mi yis/ / zhing las gnyer ba'i sdom tshig yin/ /da lta de 'dra 'dug rgyu 'am/ / bod skad smra ba'i mgo nag mi/ /rtsam pa za ba'i bod pa rnams// / bsam blo mi gtong 'dug thub bam/ /gsum/ bod0 gdod ma'i phyugs las skor brjod pa/mdo dbus mtho sgang ni 'dzam gling gi sa'i rtse mo yin zhing / 'di nyid rang byung khams kyi 'gyur ba sna tshogs kyi dbang gis thog mar rgya mtsho nas skam sar gyur pa'i brgyud rim khrod srog chags sna mang byung yod pa'i thad la bod kyi yig tshang las/ / dzimanga' ris bskor gsum sha rkyang ri dwags gling / / bar gyi ru bzhi stag gzig gcan gzan gling / / smad kyi sgang drug 'dab chags bya yi gling / /〉 zhes dang / slobod khams gsum gling dgu bya ba na/ / rin po che 'od kyi gling dkar po/ / stod khams gsum gangs dang g.ya'i ra ba dzing 'dra ba na/ / sha ba dang dgo ba la sogs pa ri dwags kyis yul 'dzin/ / ru bzhi sog kha'i gling skad pa/ / bar khams gsum brag dang spang gi gshong yur ba 'dra ba na/ /spre'u dang brag srin la sogs pa gnas/ / rma bya 'od kyi gling skad pa/ / smad khams gsum nags kyi ljongs zhing dang 'dra ba na/ / glang po che dang 'dab cha/sdu la sogs pa las/ / 'gro ba mi bya ba gcig kyang med mi ces bkod

yod/ de min gzhan na'ang 'di ltar snang zhing / gang ltar gtso gal che ba zhig ni rgya mtsho rim bzhin bri ba dang lhan du de'i nang gi srog chags rnams skam sa'i srog chags su gyur te nags tshal stug pos khebs pa'i ri tshogs kyi stod smad bad gsum du gnas pa'i khrod/ da lta'i sgo phyugs 'di'ang gnas yod par tshan rig gis dpyad pa yod de/ phaskabs de shed du ri bo hi ma la ya da dung 'bur du thon med pas/ rgya gar phyogs kyi rgya mtsho chen po'i brlan gsher dang / drod khul tsha ba la sogs pa 'gog pa'i bkag rgya med stabs/ mtsho bod sa mtho'i yul khams 'di'i gnam gshis ni drod gsher nyis ldan gyi rang bzhin yod pa dang / lo hril po'i tsha grang cha snyoms byas na 10༷0yas mas yin la/ lo rer char chu 'bab tshad kyang ha'o hreng nying stong nas lnga stong bar yin te/ skabs der drod khul du ran pa'i skye dngos rigs mang po sa mtho 'di'i phyogs so sor yod pa ma zad/ skye dngos de dag gi khrod rtsa che'i rigs rnam grangs bzhi stong tsam yod cing / de lta bu'i yul khams 'dir sug ma gsum ldan gyi rkyang rgod kyang yod la/ des ma tshad khyi dang glang po/ ri bong / shā ba la sogs pa'i dbyibs gzugs dang 'dra ba'i ri dwags mang po yod pa dang mi zhes bstan yod pa dang / de minaslo1975lor/gna' bo'i sgal tshigs can gyi srog chags dang mi'i rigs zhib 'jug khang gi tshan rig zhib 'jug mi sna rnams shi sha sbang ma ri rtse'i byang ngos kyi skyid grong gshong sar brtag dpyad byas mthar/ rta rmig gsum pa/ bse ru/ shwa ba rked ring / khyi khra sogs kyi 'gyur rdo rnyed/ srog chags 'di dag ni tsha ba'i sa khul gyi srog chags te dus rabs gsar ma'i skabaṃs kyi srog chags 〉 yin par bstan pa las/ dus rabs gsar ma'i gong rol (lo ngo khri 1200sngon )te mi ma byung ba'i sngon nas srog chags sna tshogs yod pa'i gras su khyi yod pa dang / sgo khyi 'di yang ches thog mar 25

mtsho skyes srog chags shig yin shas che ste pharang rgyal gyi deng rabs lo rgyus gsar pa'isrol btod mkhan sku zhabs li krin dbyis〈krung go'i mi rigs lo rgyus bsdus pa〉yi nang gsal cha yod pa'i sgo nas bod rigs kyi bla'i skor 'chad skabs/slobod ljongs ni ches gna' bo'i dus su rgya mtsho yin pa dang / bod rigs kyi mes po ni mtsho mthil gyi mtsho khyi khyad mtshar can zhig yin zhes bkod yod/ dus rabs rnying mar rtsis pa'i skabs kyi thog ma'i dus dang bar ma'i dus skabs su mtsho bod sa mtho 'di ni ldem ldem du 'khyil ba'i rgya mtsho chen po zhig yin zhing dus rabs gsar ma'i 'go tshugs pa nas bzung da gzod rim bzhin skam sa'i yul byung ba dang / skabs der hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud da dung 'bur du thon med pas yul khamasa'adi'i gnam gshis dang mkha' rlung / drod grang gi tshad gzhi sogs ni rgya mtsho las skam sar bud pa'i srog chags rnams 'tsho 'phel yong bar ha cang 'tsham po yin pa dang / srog chags de rigs yun ring po'i nang gi 'gul skyod la brten nas rim bzhin 'o 'thung srog chags rigs du ma byung zhing 'phel/ deng skabs 'gyur rdo la zhib 'jug byas par gzhigs na mtsho skyes srog chags las skam sa'i srog chags kyi rigs su gyur pa dang / skam sa'i srog chags rnams rim 'gyur byung ba las 'o 'thung gi srog chags rigs mang po 'phel/ dus rabs gsar ma'i rjes nas/ ri bo hi ma la ya yar 'phags pa las yul khams 'di'i gnam gshes mkha' rlung la 'gyur ba byung ste rim bzhin je 'khyag tu song ba dang nags tshal nyung du phyin nas khyon yangs pa'i rtswa thang byung ba yin/de ltar srog chags de dag gi rang byung 'tsho rten rim bzhin je zhung du song ste gnam gshes dang rang byung gi cha rkyen rnams la khyon yongs nas 'gyur ldog rim ba/spya byung ba dang bstun nas sa mtho'i yul khams 'dir ches snga ba'i gdod ma'i

mtsho skyes srog chags shig yin shas che ste pharang rgyal gyi deng rabs lo rgyus gsar pa'i srol btod mkhan sku zhabs li krin dbyis〈krung go'i mi rigs lo rgyus bsdus pa〉yi nang gsal cha yod pa'i sgo nas bod rigs kyi bla'i skor 'chad skabs/44bod ljongs ni ches gna' bo'i dus su rgya mtsho yin pa dang / bod rigs kyi mes po ni mtsho mthil gyi mtsho khyi khyad mtshar can zhig yin zhes bkod yod/ dus rabs rnying mar rtsis pa'i skabs kyi thog ma'i dus dang bar ma'i dus skabs su mtsho bod sa mtho 'di ni ldem ldem du 'khyil ba'i rgya mtsho chen po zhig yin zhing dus rabs gsar ma'i 'go tshugs pa nas bzung da gzod rim bzhin skam sa'i yul byung ba dang / skabs der hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud da dung 'bur du thon med pas yul khamasa'adi'i gnam gshis dang mkha' rlung / drod grang gi tshad gzhi sogs ni rgya mtsho las skam sar bud pa'i srog chags rnams 'tsho 'phel yong bar ha cang 'tsham po yin pa dang / srog chags de rigs yun ring po'i nang gi 'gul skyod la brten nas rim bzhin 'o 'thung srog chags rigs du ma byung zhing 'phel/ deng skabs 'gyur rdo la zhib 'jug byas par gzhigs na mtsho skyes srog chags las skam sa'i srog chags kyi rigs su gyur pa dang / skam sa'i srog chags rnams rim 'gyur byung ba las 'o 'thung gi srog chags rigs mang po 'phel/ dus rabs gsar ma'i rjes nas/ ri bo hi ma la ya yar 'phags pa las yul khams 'di'i gnam gshes mkha' rlung la 'gyur ba byung ste rim bzhin je 'khyag tu song ba dang nags tshal nyung du phyin nas khyon yangs pa'i rtswa thang byung ba yin/de ltar srog chags de dag gi rang byung 'tsho rten rim bzhin je nyung du song ste gnam gshes dang rang byung gi cha rkyen rnams la khyon yongs nas 'gyur ldog rim bzhin byung ba dang bstun nas sa mtho'i yul khams 'dir ches snga ba'i gdod ma'i 26

spra rigs thon pa yin/ rang byung khams kyi mtho sar chags pa'i yul khams ni gdod ma'i dus su rgya mtsho'i ngos las ches thog mar 'bur du thon pa'i skam sa'i gling yin dgos pa dang / de min chu bo ni nam yang dma' sar bzhur ba ltar da lta'i yul khams 'di nas phyogs so sor bzhur bzhin yod pa'i chu klung dag gi rnam pa 'di las bod ljongs dang mtsho sngon gyi sa mtho sa 'di ni spyi yongs kyi sa khams las ches thog mar chags pa zhig yin pas na/ 'dzam gling gi ched las mkhas pa mang che bas mi'i rigs kyi 'byung khungs de yul khams 'ge nyid yin par zhal bzhes gnang bzhin yod pa dang / mi'i rigs kyi ches thog ma'i gyon chas de yang yul khams 'di nas byung bar 'dod tshul der gnas lugs ldan zhing yid rton 'pher ba rang yin pas/ rang re'i sgo khyi'i 'byung khungs kyang yul khams 'di nyid yin zhes smras na lo rgyus 'phel ba'i chos nyid dang mthun la rigs pas dpyad na yang mi 'gal bar snyam mo/ /gdod ma'i spra mi de dag rang byung gi 'gyur pa sna tshogs kyi 'og nas da lta'i mir gyur pa yin la/ de dag gis thon skyed nus/ shugs kyi chu tshad dma' ba dang /rang byung gyi snang tshul la ngos 'dzin byed pa'i chu tshad zhan stabs rang byung khams kyi snang tshul sna tshogs la 'thab 'dzing byas te 'tsho ba skyel ba'i dus rim nges can zhig gi rjes nas/ 'tsho bar dka' ngal byung ba'am yang na rang byung snang tshul gyi ngos 'dzin mtho ru phyin pa'i stabs kyis phyi rol yul gyi ri skyes srog zhags las du ma zhig rang gi sgo phyugs su bsgyur ba yin te/ phas gzhi chen po 'di'i steng na mi'i rigs kyis kha lo bsgyur thub la/ 'tsho skyong byed rung ba'i srog chags kyi rigs 1400lhag yod kyang / don dngos su sgo phyugs su bsgyur yod pa'i rigs 47ma gtogs med mi ces gsungs pa ltar gdod ma'i mi rnams kyis rang gi blo gros la brten 2)sa

spra rigs thon pa yin/ rang byung khams kyi mtho sar chags pa'i yul khams ni gdod ma'i dus su rgya mtsho'i ngos las ches thog mar 'bur du thon pa'i skam sa'i gling yin dgos pa dang / de min chu bo ni nam yang dma' sar bzhur bra ltar da lta'i yul khams 'di nas phyogs so sor bzhur bzhin yod pa'i chu klung dag gi rnam pa 'di las bod ljongs dang mtsho sngon gyi sa mtho sa 'di ni spyi yongs kyi sa khams las ches thog mar chags pa zhig yin pas na/ 'dzam gling gi ched las mkhas pa mang che bas mi'i rigs kyi 'byung khungs de yul khams 'gi nyid yin par zhal bzhes gnang bzhin yod pa dang / mi'i rigs kyi ches thog ma'i gyon chas de yang yul khams 'di nas byung bar 'dod tshul der gnas lugs ldan zhing yid rton 'pher ba rang yin pas/ rang re'i sgo khyi'i 'byung khungs kyang yul khams 'di nyid yin zhes smras na lo rgyus 'phel ba'i chos nyid dang mthun la rigs pas dpyad na yang mi 'gal bar snyam mo/ / gdod ma'i spra mi de dag rang byung gi 'gyur pa sna tshogs kyi 'og nas da lta'i mir gyur pa yin la/ de dag gis thon skyed nus/ shugs kyi chu tshad dma' ba dang /rang byung gyi snang tshul la ngos 'dzin byed pa'i chu tshad zhan stabs rang byung khams kyi snang tshul sna tshogs la 'thab 'dzing byas te 'tsho ba skyel ba'i dus rim nges can zhig gi rjes nas/ 'tsho bar dka' ngal byung ba'am yang na rang byung snang tshul gyi ngos 'dzin mtho ru phyin pa'i stabs kyis phyi rol yul gyi ri skyes srog zhags las du ma zhig rang gi sgo phyugs su bsgyur ba yin te/ sa gzhi chen po 'di'i steng na mi'i rigs kyis kha lo bsgyur thub la/ 'tsho skyong byed rung ba'i srog chags kyi rigs 1400lhag yod kyang / don dngos su sgo phyugs su bsgyur yod pa'i rigs 47ma gtogs med ri’ces gsungs pa ltar gdod ma'i mi rnams kyis rang gi blo gros la brten nas 27

ri skyes srog chags du ma sgo phyugs su bsgyur tshul ni/ bod rang gi lo rgyus kyi gzhung las kyang 'brong pho mo g.yag dang 'bri ru btul/ shwa ba pho mo ni ba glang du btul/dgo ba pho mo ni lug tu btul/ gla ba pho mo ni ra la btul/ rkyang pho mo rtar btul/ spyang pho mo khyir btul/〉〉zhes bkod yod/ 'dir gong gi 'dod tshul dang mi mthun pa zhig byung yod pa ni so so'i ngos 'dzin 'grel tshul mi gcig pa tsam las don la 'gal ba cher med par snyam ste/ skye dngos rig pa'i thad nas spyang ki dang khyi gnyis rigs tshan gcig tu bkar te phan tshun la mthun pa'i khyad chos mang du yod par gsal ba dang / gzhan du na ri skyes srog chags yin min dang 'tsho ba spyod stangs tsam las phan tshun la yan gar ba'i rang chos thun mong ma yin pa byung bas khyad par tsam phyes pa yin pas so/ / yang 4sgo phyugs g.yag rta khyi lug phag rnams 'tsho〉〉zhes dang / de min dge chos kyi gsung pod gsum par4sgo phyugs g.yag dang rta bzang po/ lug khyi/ phag rnga mong 'gros rgyugs can yod 〉’ces rang re'i lo rgyus smra ba rnams kyis de ltar gsungs yod pa las skabs de shed nas sgo phyugs khyi yod par ma zad/ de ni ches thog mar sgo phyugs su btul ba'i srog chags kyi gras shig yin pa dang mi dang ches 'dris che ba zhig yin pa rtogs thub ste/ 'jar man gyi mkhas pa chen po mu'u li lis bshad pa ltar na/ ra khyi ni ches thog ma'i sgo phyugs yin pa dang / gna' nas da lta'i bar du/ mi'i rigs kyis 'dul ba'i srog chags kyi nang nas khyi ni mi'i rigs dang ches 'dris che bzhig yin 〉〉zhes gsungs gnang yod pa dang / gna' snga mo nas bzung khyi ni mi'i rigs dang 'dris che ba'i srog chags shig yin pa ma zad/ gdod ma'i mi rnams rang stobs kyi nus pa zhan pa dang ri dwags rngon pa'i dus skabs su mi rnams la thun mong ma yin pa'i nus pa mkho 'don byas yod pas na/ ches snga 4mo zhig nas khyi de mi'i rigs kyi 28

ri skyes srog chags du ma sgo phyugs su bsgyur tshul ni/ bod rang gi lo rgyus kyi gzhung las kyang 4'brong pho mo g.yag dang 'bri ru btul/ shwa ba pho mo ni ba glang du btul/dgo ba pho mo ni lug tu btul/ gla ba pho mo ni ra la btul/ rkyang pho mo rtar btul/ spyang pho mo khyir btul/mi zhes bkod yod/ 'dir gong gi 'dod tshul dang mi mthun pa zhig byung yod pa ni so so'i ngos 'dzin 'grel tshul mi gcig pa tsam las don la 'gal ba cher med par snyam ste/ skye dngos rig pa'i thad nas spyang ki dang khyi gnyis rigs tshan gcig tu bkar te phan tshun la mthun pa'i khyad chos mang du yod par gsal ba dang / gzhan du na ri skyes srog chags yin min dang 'tsho ba spyod stangs tsam las phan tshun la yan gar ba'i rang chos thun mong ma yin pa byung bas khyad par tsam phyes pa yin pas so/ / yang 4sgo phyugs g.yag rta khyi lug phag rnams 'tshomi zhes dang / de min dge chos kyi gsung pod gsum par sgo phyugs g.yag dang rta bzang po/ lug khyi/ phag rnga mong 'gros rgyugs can yod mi ces rang re'i lo rgyus smra ba rnams kyis de ltar gsungs yod pa las skabs de shed nas sgo phyugs khyi yod par ma zad/ de ni ches thog mar sgo phyugs su btul ba'i srog chags kyi gras sheg yin pa dang mi dang ches 'dris che ba zhig yin pa rtogs thub ste/ 'jar man gyi mkhas pa chen po mu'u li lis bshad pa ltar na/ 1khyi ni ches thog ma'i sgo phyugs yin pa dang / gna' nas da lta'i bar du/ mi'i rigs kyis 'dul ba'i srog chags kyi nang nas khyi ni mi'i rigs dang ches 'dris che bzhig yin 〉 zhes gsungs gnang yod pa dang / gna' snga mo nas bzung khyi ni mi'i rigs dang 'dris che ba'i srog chags shig yin pa ma zad/ gdod ma'i mi rnams rang stobs kyi nus pa zhan pa dang ri dgas rngon pa'i dus skabs su mi rnams la thun mong ma yin pas /sa pa mkho 'don byas yod pas na/ ches snga lo zhig nas khyi de mi'i rigs kyi

sgo khyi ru gyur pa yin no/ /gdod ma'i mi rnams kyis rang byung khams gyi snang tshul sna tshogs la 'thab rtsod yun ring byas pa'i khrod/ ri skyes srog chags gang mang rang gi sgo phyugs su bsgyur ba'i khrod khyi ni cung snga mo nas rang gi sgo phyugs su bsgyur ba'i srog chags kyi gras shig yin/ de yang yul khams kyi gnam gshes dang mkha' dbugs kyi 'gyur ba la brten nas khyi'i rigs la'ang mang po yod de/ da snga rgyal spyi'i thog kun gyis khas len pa'i khyi'i rigs bzang gras 137yod pa la so so'i khyab bkol gyi yul mi 'dra ba yod/ nged cag 'brog khul du song na 'jigs snang bskyed pa dang gzab dgos pa ni 'brog khyi yin la/ gang du 'brog pa yod na de ru 'brog khyi ma mthar yang gcig med pa ni mi srid/ de bas 'brog khyi zhes 'brog pa rnams kyis rang la med du mi rung ba zhig tu brtsi ba yin/

sgo khyi ru gyur pa yin no/ /gdod ma'i mi rnams kyis rang byung khams gyi snang tshul sna tshogs la 'thab rtsod yun ring byas pa'i khrod/ ri skyes srog chags gang mang rang gi sgo phyugs su bsgyur ba'i khrod khyi ni cung snga mo nas rang gi sgo phyugs su bsgyur ba'i srog chags kyi gras shig yin/ de yang yul khams kyi gnam gshis dang mkha' dbugs kyi 'gyur ba la brten nas khyi'i rigs la'ang mang po yod de/ da snga rgyal spyi'i thog kun gyis khas len pa'i khyi'i rigs bzang gras 137yod pa la so so'i khyab bkol gyi yul mi 'dra ba yod/ nged cag 'brog khul du song na 'jigs snang bskyed pa dang gzab dgos pa ni 'brog khyi yin la/ gang du 'brog pa yod na de ru 'brog khyi ma mthar yang gcig med pa ni mi srid/ de bas 'brog khyi zhes 'brog pa rnams kyis rang la med du mi rung ba zhig tu brtsi ba yin/29

le'u gsum pa/ sru rgyal skabs su bod kyi dpal 'byor skor/(spyi lo sngon414—617)gcig spu0la thog ma gnya'akhri btsan po'i dus su dpal 'byor skor/bod kyi rgyal po'i thog ma ni gnya' khri btsan po yin/ spyir rgyal po 'di nyid thog mar yul gang nas byung ba'i 'byung khungs thad la gna' rabs bon gzhung dag tu gnam gyi lha las mi'i rje bor phebs pa yin zer ba 'di yongs grags su byed pa dang / dus phyis bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs nas bzung 'phags yul shākya'i rigs kyi rgyal rgyud 'di dang de'i sras bod du 'khyar ba yin zer/ yang rgya nag gi yig tshang rnams su rgyal nang nas nub phyogs su yul byar ba'i 'phan myi zer ba zhig byung ba de yin zer ba sogs bzhed tshul mang mod kyang / rang lugs la〈lde'u'i chos 'byung 〉du/ yul spu bo'i (spo bo)yul nas/ spu'i mi mo mo btsun bya ba'i rum nas the brang spun dgu skyes pa'i chung dag the rang ma snya u be ra bya ba/ lces gdong gi dkyil 'khor khebs pa/ phyag sor dra bas 'brel ba/ gdug rtsub dang nus mthu shin tu che ba gcig byung bas/ 'di thu drags bshug dgos zer nas/ spu bo'i (spo bo)yul gyi ban bon nus mthu can rnams kyis the brang skyas 'debs byas naX0/ bod du bshugs (sgyugs)pa la/ der bod kyis mi rje 'tshol ba dang phrad

le'u gsum pa/ spu rgyal skabs su bod kyi dpal 'byor skor/(sbyi lo sngon414—617)gcig spu rgyal thog ma gnya'akhi btsan po'i dus su dpal 'byor skor/bod kyi rgyal po'i thog ma ni gnya' khri btsan po yin/ spyir rgyal po 'di nyid thog mar yul gang nas byung ba'i 'byung khungs thad la gna' rabs bon gzhung dag tu gnam gyi lha las mi'i rje bor phebs pa yin zer ba 'di yongs grags su byed pa dang / dus phyis bstan pa phyi dar gyi skabs nas bzung 'phags yul shākya'i rigs kyi rgyal rgyud 'di dang de'i sras bod du 'khyar ba yin zer/ yang rgya nag gi yig tshang rnams su rgyal nang nas nub phyogs su yul gyar ba'i 'phan myi zer ba zhig byung ba de yin zer ba sogs bzhed tshul mang mod kyang / rang lugs la〈lde'u'i chos 'byung 〉du/ yul spu bo'i (spo bo)yul nas/ spu'i mi mo mo btsun bya ba'i rum nas the brang spun dgu skyes pa'i chung dag the rang ma snya u be ra bya ba/ lces gdong gi dkyil 'khor khebs pa/ phyag sor dra bas 'brel ba/ gdug tsub dang nus mthu shin tu che ba gcig byung bas/ 'di thu drags bshug dgos zer nas/ spu bo'i (spo bo)yul gyi ban bon nus mthu can rnams kyis the brang skyas 'debs byas nas/ bod du bshugs (spyugs)pa la/ der bod kyis mi rje 'tshol ba dang phrad 30

nas khyod ci 'dra zhig yin byas pas/ nga spo bo'i yul gyi mi gcig yin zer bas/'o na phyag sor dang lce ngo mtshar che ba gcig 'dug pa/ khyod la nus mthu 'dra ba ci yod byas pas/ kho na re nus mthu dang rdzu 'phrul che grags (drags)pas bshugs pa yin zer/ 'o na nged rnams kyi rje bcol lo byas nas gnya' ba'i khri la blangs/'di rje gnya' khri btsan po yin byas nas rje bcol ba'i lo rgyus gda' ste/ de ni rje'i rngan nam 'tshang (mtshang)lags so/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin 'dod la/da rung 'di'i rting snon du de phyis lcang gling pa rol ba'i do rjes mdzad pa'i yum bu bla sgang gi dkar chag tu'ang gong dang mtshungs pa'i lta tshul gsal bar bkod yod/mdor na/ rje gnya' khri btsan po ni ha lam spyi lo sngon gyi lo414(kha cig spyi lo sngon gyi lo126lo yin zer)lo yas mas su spu bo'i yul nas thon te bod btsan po'i rgyal khab kyi rgyal po'i thog mar bskos pa yin snyam/btsan po 'di nyid bod spyi mthun gyi rgyal por bzhugs pa nas spu rgyal gyi gdung rabs dbu brnyes shing / rgyal phran bcu gnyis dbang du bsdus/ bod 'bangs bde la bkod/ dpal 'byor gong 'phel du btang / mi rnams dmag 'khrug dang mu ge'i sdug bsngal las skyob/ sku mkhar gyi thog ma yum bu bla sgang brtsigs/ bon gyi lo rgyus la lar gsas mkhar g.yung drung lha rtse bya ba dang / sku mkhar phying ba stag rtse yang btsan po 'di'i sku ring du brtsigs par bshad/ bon bsgyur nas skabs de'i shes rigs gong du spel pa sogs bka' drin che'o/ /gnyis/ spru rgyal lu de gung rgyal dusatpa dpal 'byor skor/mdzangs mi mi bdun gyi thog ma ni blon po ru las skyes yin/ de ni bod rgyal pu de gung rgyal gyi ring gi blon po zhig lags/ blon po 'di'i blo gros la brten 3snyis

nas khyod ci 'dra zhig yin byas pas/ nga spo bo'i yul gyi mi gcig yin zer bas/'o na phyag sor dang lce ngo mtshar che ba gcig 'dug pa/ khyod la nus mthu 'dra ba ci yod byas pas/ kho na re nus mthu dang rdzu 'phrul che grags (drags)pas bshugs payin zer/ 'o na nged rnams kyi rje bcol lo byas nas gnya' ba'i khri la blangs/'di rje gnya' khri btsan po yin byas nas rje bcol ba'i lo rgyus gda' ste/ de ni rje'i rngan nam 'tshang (mtshang)lags so/ / zhes gsungs pa bzhin 'dod la/da rung 'di'i rting snon du de phyis lcang gling pa rol ba'i do rjes mdzad pa'i yum bu bla sgang gi dkar chag tu'ang gong dang mtshungs pa'i lta tshul gsal bar bkod yod/mdor na/ rje gnya' khri btsan po ni ha lam spyi lo sngon gyi lo114(kha cig spyi lo sngon gyi lo126lo yin zer)lo yas mas su spu bo'i yul nas thon te bod btsan po'i rgyal khab kyi rgyal po'i thog mar bskos pa yin snyam/btsan po 'di nyid bod spyi mthun gyi rgyal por bzhugs pa nas spu rgyal gyi gdung rabs dbu brnyes shing / rgyal phran bcu gnyis dbang du bsdus/ bod 'bangs bde la bkod/ dpal 'byor gong 'phel du btang / mi rnams dmag 'khrug dang mu ge'i sdug bsngal las skyob/ sku mkhar gyi thog ma yum bu bla sgang brtsigs/ bon gyi lo rgyus la lar gsas mkhar g.yung drung lha rtse bya ba dang / sku mkhar phying ba stag rtse yang btsan po 'di'i sku ring du brtsigs par bshad/ bon bsgyur nas skabs de'i shes rigs gong du spel pa sogs bka' drin che'o/ /gnyis/ spu rgyal pu de gung rgyal dus kyi dpal 'byor skor/mdzangs mi mi bdun gyi thog ma ni blon po ru las skyes yin/ de ni bod rgyal pu de gung rgyal gyi ring gi blon po zhig lags/ blon po 'di'i blo gros la brten nas 31

gnas bab de dus su spang brkos nas zhing kha bzo ba dang / chu bed kyi las ka rgya cher spel nas phu chu mda' la drangs/ shing bsregs nas sol ba bzos/ gter rdo bzhus te gser dang / dngul/ zangs/ lcags sogs 'don pa'i rig pa rnyed/ shing la dmig phug ste gshol dang gnya' shing bzos shing / rmon pa dor 'debs spang thang zhing du rmos pa dang / brjid nyams kyi mchog gyur 'bying ba stag rtse pho brang bzhengs/ grong la snga ba 'phying ba stag rtse zhes pa bzhin/ 'bying yul du klung la grong rdal chags su bcug chu chen gyi thog tu zam pa thog mar btsugs pa sogs mdor na chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston du/ mdzangs pa'i las su shing bsreg sol ba byung / / de yis rdo bzhu gser dngul zangs lcags phyung / / shing la mig phug gshol dang gnya' shing byas/ / sa gzhi bskos nas phu chu yur du drangs/ / rmon pa dor sdebs spang thang zhing du rmos/ / brgal bas mi thar chu la zam pa btsugs/ / rmos pa'i lo tog thog mar 'di nas byung / / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ skabs de ga'i bod kyi chab dpal rig gsum sngar las gong du spel ba'i mdzangs pa'i las sus kyang 'gran dka' ba mdzad par brten mdzangs blon gyi gras su bzhan pa yin no/ /gsum/ sa yi legs drug dus kyi dpal 'byor skor/bod kyi lo rgyus steng bar gyi legs drug tu 'bod pa ni/ e sho legs/ de sho legs/ thi sho legs/ gu ru legs/ 'brong zhi legs dang yi sho legs bcas yin no/ /btsan po de rnams kyi dus su brtsigs pa'i 'ching nga rtse drug ni stag rtse dang /rgod 2rtse/ yang rtse/ khri rtse/ rtse ma khyung rgyal/ khri brtsigs 'bum gdugs

bcas lags so/ /mdzangs blon gnyis pa lha bu mgo dkar zer ba btsan po pu de gung rgyal dang btsun mo 'om thang sman mtsho'i sras legs drug gi thog ma e sho legs zhes bya ba'i ring gi blon po yin/khong mdzangs blon gyi gras su bgrang dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston du/ de yi blon po lha bu mgo dkar zhes/ / khu khu ru las skyes kyi bu yis byas/ / 'phrul blon mdzangs mi bdun gyi gnyis pa yin/ /mdzangs pa'i las su zhing la dor kha brtsis/ / 'brog la thul rtsis phu cha yur du drangs/ / mda' la chu ma rmo ba 'di nas dar/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/blon po 'dis bod kyi zhing las dang 'brog las sogs gnas bab der yar rgyas gong 'phel du 'gro bzhin pa'i dgos mkho dang bstun nas zhing la dor kha dang /'brog la thul brtsi ba'i srol dar spel bgyis pa ma zad/ phu chu mda' la 'dren pa dang / mda' la chu ma rmo ba'i lugs srol ches cher spel ba sogs mdzangs pa'i las mang du bgyis pas so / bzhi/ spu0la stag ri snya gzigs dusaspyi dpal 'byor skor/mdzangs mi mi bdun gyi gsum pa ni khri dor snang btsun mong gi bu yin/ de ni btsan po stag ri gnyan gzigs su grags pa'i skabs kyi blon po yin/ khong mdzangs blon gyi gras su 'jog dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston du/ 'di nas khri dor snang btsun mong gi bus/ / bre phul srang bcos 'bru mar tshad kyi phul/ / dga' gnyis tshong las mthun gnyis la lung bsdebs/ / de gong bod na tshong dang bre srang med/ / de phyir mdzanga~X 3mi

bdun gyi gsum par grags/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gnas bab der spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi dgos mkho dang bstun nas mdzangs blon de nyid kyis bre dang srang bcos 'bru mar 'jal byed bzos/ las sdeb dang tshong las sogs dar rgyas su btang ba sogs bod kyi chab dpal rig gsum gong du spel bar mdzad rjes gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa zhig bzhag pa'i rkyen gyis yin no/ /

bdun gyi gsum par grags/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gnas bab der spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi dgos mkho dang bstun nas mdzangs blon de nyid kyis bre dang srang bcos 'bru mar 'jal byed bzos/ las sdeb dang tshong las sogs dar rgyas su btang ba sogs bod kyi chab dpal rig gsum gong du spel bar mdzad rjes gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa zhig bzhag pa'i rkyen gyis yin no/ /

le'u bzhi pa/ bod btsan bo dus kyi dpal 'byor skor/—(sbyi lo617—846)gcig spu rgyal srong btsan sgam pos mtha' bzhi'i rgyal phran dbang du sdud tshul skor/spyir gangs can gyi yul gru chen po 'di gcig gyur gyi las la mes stag ri gnyan gzigs kyi dus nas bzung 'bad pa byas myong zhing / de las kyang yab gnam ri srong btsan gyi ring zhang zhung dang / gru gu/ sum pa/ mon/ nyag rong sogs mtha' bzhi'i rgyal phan dag mnga' 'og tu bsdus te yul gru gcig gyur gyi rting gzhi brtsigs na'ang / rgyal po 'di'i sku dus su lo rgyus yig rnying dag tu/yayab 'bangs n-i 'khus/ yum 'bangs n-i log gnyen zhang zhung / mdzo sum pa/ nyag ny-i dgas po/ kong po/ myang po kun kyang log 〉 ces gsungs pa ltar/dbang sgyur gral rim nang khul du stobs shugs gsar rnying bar dbang cha 'phrog res byed pa'i 'thab rtsod dza drag tu gyur pa la brten nas/ zhang zhung dang / kong po/myang po sogs ngo log ste dmag 'khrug bslangs/ skabs der rgyal po srong btsan sgam po rang nyid kyis mdzangs blon rnams rang gi grogs su bkug nas g.yo byus 'don mkhan dang yab la dug 'dren mkhan rnams tshar bcad pa dang / myang po rje zhang snang mngags te sum pa'i yul la dmag 'dren ma dgos par 'bangs su 35
