bkug de'i rjes btsan po sku dngos kyis dmag dpung byang rgyud phyogs su drangs nas rgya dang 'a zha la dpung 'jug bgyis shing dpya khral 'jal du bcug pas khyim mtshes kyi rgyal khab gzhan pas kyang bod kyi zil ma bzod par gong du bkur ba dang /mi ring bar zhang zhung dang gnyen mdzad pa'i thabs la brten nas zhang zhung yongs rdzogs kyang dbang 'og tu bsdus pa sogs sa khul mtha' dag zhod 'jags su btang zhing / rgyal sa'ang lha sar spos te mnga' thang stobs 'byor ldan pa'i bod gcig gyur gyi rgyal khab cig dngos su 'dzugs thub pa byung la/ de nas btsan pos rang rang so so'i byas rjes la gzhigs nas bka' yi blon po sum brgya lhag bsko bzhag gnang / shar phyogs rgya dang mi nyag nas bzo dang rtsis kyi dpe rnams blangs pa dang / lho phyogs rgya gar yul nas dam pa'i chos kyi sgra bsgyur/ nub phyogs bal po dang stag gzig(sog po'ang zer)nas zas nor longs spyod kyi gter kha phyes/byang phyogs hor dang yu gur nas khrims dang las kyi dpe blangs so/ / gnyis/ bod kyi mdzangs mi bdun gyi bzhi ba dang lnga ba gnyis kyi mdzangs pa'i skor/ mdzangs mi mi bdun gyi bzhi ba dang lnga ba gnyis kyi mtshan la rim bzhin 'phrul blon chen po thon mi sasto ṭa dang khro bzang yang ston snyags kyi bu zhes zer/de gnyis mdzangs mi'i gras su 'jog dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'phrul blon thon mi sam bho ṭas mdzangs pa'i las su bod rang gi skad kyi steng nas yi ge 'bri ba'i srol btod/ brda sprod pa'i gzhung 'gran pa'i do zla dang bral ba gtan la phab/ yul gru gzhan gyi chos dang rig pa'i gnas du ma bod skad du bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs su bka' drin gzhal du med pas so/ / mdzangs blon khri bzang yang ston snyags kyi bus ni/ mdzangs pa'i las su sngar bod mi'i khang khyim /)() /sdo

bkug de'i rjes btsan po sku dngos kyis dmag dpung byang rgyud phyogs su drangs nas rgya dang 'a zha la dpung 'jug bgyis shing dpya khral 'jal du bcug pas khyim mtshes kyi rgyal khab gzhan pas kyang bod kyi zil ma bzod par gong du bkur ba dang /mi ring bar zhang zhung dang gnyen mdzad pa'i thabs la brten nas zhang zhung yongs rdzogs kyang dbang 'og tu bsdus pa sogs sa khul mtha' dag nod 'jags su btang zhing / rgyal sa'ang lha sar spos te mnga' thang stobs 'byor ldan pa'i bod gcig gyur gyi rgyal khab cig dngos su 'dzugs thub pa byung la/ de nas btsan pos rang rang so so'i byas rjes la gzhigs nas bka' yi blon po sum brgya lhag bsko bzhag gnang / shar phyogs rgya dang mi nyag nas bzo dang rtsis kyi dpe rnams blangs pa dang / lho phyogs rgya gar yul nas dam pa'i chos kyi sgra bsgyur/ nub phyogs bal po dang stag gzig(sog po'ang zer)nas zas nor longs spyod kyi gter kha phyes/byang phyogs hor dang yu gur nas khrims dang las kyi dpe blangs so/ /pa'i sko nyi/ sa/ bod skyu mdzangs mi bdun gyi bzhi ba dang lnga ba gnyis kyi mdzangs mdzangs mi mi bdun gyi bzhi ba dang lnga ba gnyis kyi mtshan la rim bzhin 'phrul blon chen po thon mi sasgo ṭa dang khro bzang yang ston snyags kyi bu zhes zer/de gnyis mdzangs mi'i gras su 'jog dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'phrul blon thon mi sam bho ṭas mdzangs pa'i las su bod rang gi skad kyi steng nas yi ge 'bri ba'i srol btod/ brda sprod pa'i gzhung 'gran pa'i do zla dang bral ba gtan la phab/ yul gru gzhan gyi chos dang rig pa'i gnas du ma bod skad du bsgyur ba sogs kyis bsil ldan kha ba'i ljongs su bka' drin gzhal du med pas so/ / mdzangs blon khri ba~X yang ston snyags kyi bus ni/ mdzangs pa'i las su sngar bod mi'i khang khyim ne

mang che ba ri la yod pa la 'dis klungs su phab/ mkhar brtsigs nas grong khyer du bcos par bshad pas yin 'dug go/ 'di'i thad chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston du'ang / gzhan yang khri bzang yang ston snyags kyi bus/ / mdzangs pa'i las su ri khyim klungs su phab/ / spo mtho mkhar du brtsigs nas grong khyer bcos/ / 'di yan bod kyi khang khyim ri la yod/ / de'i phyir bod kyi mdzangs mi lnga ba yin/ / zhes 'khod pas kyang gsal bar nges nus snyam mo/ /gzhi'i snam/ / spu rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i ring la srid 'dzin lam lus kyi sgrig spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun pa'i 'go brtsams pa tsam nas rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos bod kyi yul gru mtha' dag gcig gyur mdzad de bod chen po'i rgyal khab 'di btsugs la/ de nas rim gyis phyi nang gi rkyen mang po la brten nas srid 'dzin lam lugs kyi sgrin gzhi zhig gtan la phab thub par nges shing / de yang /srid 'dzin gyi thad bod chen po'i rgyal khab tu go gnas ches mtho ba ni btsan po yin pa dang / btsan po'i dbang cha gcig sdud kyi 'og tu da dung bod chen po'i dbang bsgyur gral rim gyi grub char gyur pa'i rim pa so so'i dpon rigs rnams mchis te/mkhas pa'i dga' ston du/ dgung blon dang nang blon/ bka' yo gal 'chos pa bcas dbye rim gsum du bgos te so sor nang gses che 'bring chung gsum gtan la phab te sdom pa'i blon po che dgu yod pa bshad cing / da rung de nyid du dgung blon gyi las thabs khyo ba dang 'dra bar phyi rgya rlabs kyis gcod/ nang blon gyis bud med mdzes ma ltar nang gi tshis byed/ bka' yo gal 'chos pas legs na dgra'i bus legs kyang bya dga' gsol/ nyes na rang gi bus nyes kyang chad pas ga'od ces pa sogs mchis pa la gzhigs na/ dgung blon gyis ni gtso bo 3ltad

mang che ba ri la yod pa la 'dis klungs su phab/ mkhar brtsigs nas grong khyer du bcos par bshad pas yin 'dug go/ 'di'i thad chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston du'ang / gzhan yang khri bzang yang ston snyags kyi bus/ / mādzangs pa'i las su ri khyim klungs su phab/ / spo mtho mkhar du brtsigs nas grong khyer bcos/ / 'di yan bod kyi khang khyim ri la yod/ / de'i phyir bod kyi mdzangs mi lnga ba yin/ / zhes 'khod pas kyang gsal bar nges nus snyam mo/ /gsum/ spu rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i ring la srid 'jin lam luṭa kyi sgrig gzhi'i skor/spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun pa'i 'go brtsams pa tsam nas rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos bod kyi yul gru mtha' dag gcig gyur mdzad de bod chen po'i rgyal khab 'di btsugs la/ de nas rim gyis phyi nang gi rkyen mang po la brten nas srid 'dzin lam lugs kyi sgrin gzhi zhig gtan la phab thub par nges shing / de yang /srid 'dzin gyi thad bod chen po'i rgyal khab tu go gnas ches mtho ba ni btsan po yin pa dang / btsan po'i dbang cha gcig sdud kyi 'og tu da dung bod chen po'i dbang bsgyur gral rim gyi grub char gyur pa'i rim pa so so'i dpon rigs rnams mchis te/mkhas pa'i dga' ston du/ dgung blon dang nang blon/ bka' yo gal 'chos pa bcas dbye rim gsum du bgos te so sor nang gses che 'bring chung gsum gtan la phab te sdom pa'i blon po che dgu yod pa bshad cing / da rung de nyid du dgung blon gyi las thabs khyo ba dang 'dra bar phyi rgya rlabs kyis gcod/ nang blon gyis bud med mdzes ma ltar nang gi tshis byed/ bka' yo gal 'chos pas legs na dgra'i bus legs kyang bya dga' gsol/ nyes na rang gi bus nyes kyang chad pas gcod ces pa sogs mchis pa la gzhigs na/ dgung blon gyis ni gtso bo srid 37

gros/ bya ba thag gcod dmag spyi'i 'gan 'khru bcas pas go rim gsum pa'i nang nas go gnas mtho shos shig yin zhing btsan po la'ang 'brel ba ches zab pa'i gras yin/ nang gses su dgung blon che ba/ dgung blon 'bring dang dgung blon chung ba bcas yod la/ nang blon gyis ni btsan po'i bka' lag len bstar ba dang /nor srid / rtsis grangs/ rtsod don dang btsan po'i pho brang gi 'tsho ba'i 'gro gron sogs gnyer/ gtso bo srid 'dzin gyi dbang cha dam 'dzin byed kyin yod/nang gses 'di la nang blon chen po/ nang blon 'bring po dang nang blon chung ba bcas 'dug pa dang / dka' yo gal 'chos pas ni gros rtog zhib gsher dang khrims 'dzin gyi las gnyer gtso bo zhib dpyod kyi dbang cha bzung yod/ dbye na yo gal 'chos pa chen po/ yo gal 'chos pa 'bring po dang yo gal 'chos pa chung ba bcas gsum mchis pa ma zad/ dpon gnas gzhan gyi skor yang gtan la phab 'dug par mngon no/ /gzhan btsan po 'di nyid kyi ring dpon rigs kyi dma' mtho mtshon byed rim pa bzhin rab gser dang / g.yu/ 'bring dngul dang phra men/ tha ma zangs yig dang lcags yig bcas drug po re re la che chung gnyis phye bas bcu gnyis yod par bshad de/ de yang / gong du gleng ma thag pa'i dgung blon chen po la g.yu yig chen po gnang ba dang / dgung blon 'bring dang nang blon chen po la g.yu yig chung ngu/ dgung blon tha chung dang nang blon 'bring bka' yo gal 'chos pa chen po gsum la gser yig chen po/ nang blon tha chung dang bka' blon 'bring la gser yig chung ngu / bka' blon tha chung la phra men gyi yi ge gnang ba sogs go rim ldan pa zhig mchis mod re re bzhin 'dir ma bris la rigs mtshungs kyis shes sla'o/ /bzhi/ spu rgyalapong btsan sgam po'i ring la dmag dpung sgrig 'dzuṭa gtan la phab pa'i skor/ 38

gros/ bya ba thag gcod dmag spyi'i 'gan 'khru bcas pas go rim gsum pa'i nang nas go gnas mtho shos shig yin zhing btsan po la'ang 'brel ba ches zab pa'i gras yin/ nang gses su dgung blon che ba/ dgung blon 'bring dang dgung blon chung ba bcas yod la/ nang blon gyis ni btsan po'i bka' lag len bstar ba dang /nor srid / rtsis grangs/ rtsod don dang btsan po'i pho brang gi 'tsho ba'i 'gro gron sogs gnyer/ gtso bo srid 'dzin gyi dbang cha dam 'dzin byed kyin yod/nang gses 'di la nang blon chen po/ nang blon 'bring po dang nang blon chung ba bcas 'dug pa dang / dka' yo gal 'chos pas ni gros rtog zhib gsher dang khrims 'dzin gyi las gnyer gtso bo zhib dpyod kyi dbang cha bzung yod/ dbye na yo gal 'chos pa chen po/ yo gal 'chos pa 'bring po dang yo gal 'chos pa chung ba bcas gsum mchis pa ma zad/ dpon gnas gzhan gyi skor yang gtan la phab 'dug par mngon no/ /gzhan btsan po 'di nyid kyi ring dpon rigs kyi dma' mtho mtshon byed rim pa bzhin rab gser dang / g.yu/ 'bring dngul dang phra men/ tha ma zangs yig dang lcags yig bcas drug po re re la che chung gnyis phye bas bcu gnyis yod par bshad de/ de yang / gong du gleng ma thag pa'i dgung blon chen po la g.yu yig chen po gnang ba dang / dgung blon 'bring dang nang blon chen po la g.yu yig chung ngu/ dgung blon tha chung dang nang blon 'bring bka' yo gal 'chos pa chen po gsum la gser yig chen po/ nang blon tha chung dang bka' blon 'bring la gser yig chung ngu / bka' blon tha chung la phra men gyi yi ge gnang ba sogs go rim ldan pa zhig mchis mod re re bzhin 'dir ma bris la rigs mtshungs kyis shes sla'o/ /bzhi/ sru rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i ring la dmag dpung sgrig 'dzuṭa gtan la stub pa'i skor/

rgyal po 'di'i ring bod gcig gyur gyi rgyal khab chen po btsugs rjes dmag dpung gi sgrig 'dzugs zhib cing phra ba zhig gtan la phab thub par gyur ba las thog mar ru chen lnga ru phye tshul ni/ 1 dbu ru/ lte ba lha sa'i ra mo cher brtsis shing /shar 'ol kha'i shug pa dpun bdun dang / lho rma la la brgyud/ nub gzhu snye mo/byang prags kyi glang ma gur phub bcas yin pa dang / 2 g.yo ru ni/ lte ba yar lung khra 'brug tu bgyid/ shar kong yul bres sna dang / lho sha zhug stan sgo/nub kha rag gangs rtse/ byang rma la la brgyud bcas dang / 2 g.yas ru ni/shangs kyi zhong ba tshal lte bar brtsis/ shar prags kyi glang ma gur phub dang / lho gnya' nam g.yag po'i sna/ nub bye ma la dgu/ byang smri ti chu nag bcas yin/4 du lag ni/ lte ba brang gi dur ba sna la brtsis/ shar 'jam nee bkra dang /lho bal po glang sna/ nub la kem g.yag mig byang bye ma la sngon bcas lags/ga sum pa'i ru ni/ lte ba tshang rgya shod stag pa tshal la brtsis/ shar gnye yul bum nag dang / lho smri ti chu nag nub yel zhabs sdings po che/ byang nags shod gzi 'phrang bcas so/ /bod kyi 'khos drug ni/ zhang gsum blon dang bcas pas yul dbus kyi gdan sa 'dzin/ dpa' sne gsum gyis mtha' yi so mtshams srung / de drug la bod kyi 'khos drug zer/ zhes grags pa ltar nges so/ / yang / rgod kyi stong sde drug cu re gcig tu phyes shing / rgod ces pa ni 'bangs rab tshan dmag gi las byed mkhan zhig gi ming yin par bshad/ de la stong dpon tu'ang 'bod zer/'o na/ stong sde drug cu re gcig po gang yin zhe na/ 1 dbu ru'i stong sde bcu/2 g.yo ru'i stong sde bcu/ 2 g.yas ru'i stong sde bcu/ ( ru lag gi stong sde bcu/ ga zhang zhung stod kyi stong sde lnga/ zhang zhung smad kyi stong ༵ lnga

rgyal po 'di'i ring bod gcig gyur gyi rgyal khab chen po btsugs rjes dmag dpung gi sgrig 'dzugs zhib cing phra ba zhig gtan la phab thub par rgyur ba las thog mar ru chen lnga ru phye tshul ni/ 1 dbu ru/ lte ba lha sa'i ra mo cher birtsis shing /shar 'ol kha'i shug pa dpun bdun dang / lho rma la la brgyud/ nub gzhu snye mo/byang prags kyi glang ma gur phub bcas yin pa dang / 2 g.yo ru ni/ lte ba yar lung khra 'brug tu bgyid/ shar kong yul bres sna dang / lho sha zhug stan sgo/nub kha rag gangs rtse/ byang rma la la brgyud bcas dang / 2 g.yas ru ni/shangs kyi zhong ba tshal lte bar brtsis/ shar prags kyi glang ma gur phub dang / lho gnya' nam g.yag po'i sna/ nub bye ma la dgu/ byang smri ti chu nag bcas yin/4 ru lag ni/ lte ba brang gi dur ba sna la brtsis/ shar 'jam ne bkra dang /lho bal po glang sna/ nub la kem g.yag mig byang bye ma la sngon bcas lags/5 sum pa'i ru ni/ lte ba tshang rgya shod stag pa tshal la brtsis/ shar gnye yul bum nag dang / lho smri ti chu nag nub yel zhabs sdings po che/ byang nags shod gzi 'phrang bcas so/ /bod kyi 'khos drug ni/ zhang gsum blon dang bcas pas yul dbus kyi gdan sa 'dzin/ dpa' sne gsum gyis mtha' yi so mtshams srung / de drug la bod kyi 'khos drug zer/ zhes grags pa ltar nges so/ / yang / rgod kyi stong sde drug cu re gcig tu phyes shing / rgod ces pa ni 'bangs rab tshan dmag gi las byed mkhan zhig gi ming yin par bshad/ de la stong dpon tu'ang 'bod zer/'o na/ stong sde drug cu re gcig po gang yin zhe na/ 1 dbu ru'i stong sde bcu/2 g.yo ru'i stong sde bcu/ 2 g.yas ru'i stong sde bcu/ u ru lag gi stong sde bcu/ ga zhang zhung stod kyi stong sde lnga/ zhang zhung smad kyi stong sde lnga 39

dang sum pa'i ru stod khyab rgya ldan gyi stong sde bcu gcig bcas lags so/ /gong gi stong sde de rnams kyi ru dpon dang / ru dar/ dpal dar/ rta'i kha mdog sogs kyang mi 'dra ste/ dper na/ dbu ru stod smad la mtshon na/dmag dpon sna nam rgyal rgan dang / gos skyes bzang stag sna/ de'i dpa' zla gnon 'phan gsum dang shod bu khong btsan/ ru rta ze dkar rta skya dang mtshal bu gzig ring / ru dar dmar po lce khra dang dpal dar dmar po/ dmag gi bzhed ni mtsho la gangs bab bzhin yin par bshad/ g.yo ru stod smad la mtshon na/ ru dpon myang stag gzig g.yu btsan dang mchims rgyal gzigs shud ring /dpa' zla g.yas mang bzher dang so gad gnyan bzher/ ru rta mog ro bun mtshal bu rting dkar/ ru dar seng ge dmar po dang dar dkar snying nag mtsho la sbrang char bab pa bzhin du 'grim skad/ ru lag stod smad la mtshon na/ ru dpon 'bro rgyal mtshan seng ge dang khyung po'i g.yu'i zur phung / dpa' zla gnam sde gur tshab dang mchims btsan zhir lha gzigs/ ru dar seng dkar gnam 'phyong dang dpal nag po/ ru rta ngang ba phung dmar dang rag pa rngog nag gangs la ser ba 'grim pa bzhin du 'gro bar bshad/ g.yas ru stod smad la mtshon na/ ru dpon khyung bo stag bzang stong dang mgos khri gnyen g.yang 'phyos/ dpa' zla ba tshab mtsho zher tsang long dang lang ba mgon rna/ ru rta mtshal bu me stag dang sngon po g.yu rta/ru rta dar nag snying dkar bya khyung bris pa dang skyer kha gong khra/ spang la me mched pa lta bur 'grim pa'i tshul deb ther kun gsal me long ltar 'khod pa yin la/gzhan gnas bab de lta de'i dus su sum pa'i ru ma brtsis pa'i ru bzhi'i dmag gi grangs la bzhi 'bum nyis stong bzhi brgya yod ces bod kyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus zhes bya bar 'khod mod da dung dpyad rgyu yod snyam/ mdor na/ rgyal po srong btsan sga/ 0po'i ring bod kyi dmag dpung rnams ru chen lnga dang / khos drug ru rta

dang sum pa'i ru stod khyab rgya ldan gyi stong sde bcu gcig bcas lags so/ /gong gi stong sde de rnams kyi ru dpon dang / ru dar/ dpal dar/ rta'i kha mdog sogs kyang mi 'dra ste/ dper na/ dbu ru stod smad la mtshon na/dmag dpon sna nam rgyal rgan dang / rgas skyes bzang stag sna/ de'i dpa' zla gnon 'phan gsum dang shod bu khong btsan/ ru rta ze dkar rta skya dang mtshal bu gzig ring / ru dar dmar po lce khra dang dpal dar dmar po/ dmag gi bzhed ni mtsho la gangs bab bzhin yin par bshad/ g.yo ru stod smad la mtshon na/ ru dpon myang stag gzig g.yu btsan dang mchims rgyal gzigs shud ring /dpa' zla g.yas mang bzher dang so gad gnyan bzher/ ru rta sog ro bun mtshal bu rting dkar/ ru dar seng ge dmar po dang dar dkar snying nag mtsho la sbrang char bab pa bzhin du 'grim skad/ ru lag stod smad la mtshon na/ ru dpon 'bro rgyal mtshan seng ge dang khyung po'i g.yu'i zur phung / dpa' zla gnam sde gur tshab dang mchims btsan zhir lha gzigs/ ru dar seng dkar gnam 'phyong dang dpal nag po/ ru rta ngang ba phung dmar dang rag pa rngog nag gangs la ser ba 'grim pa bzhin du 'gro bar bshad/ g.yas ru stod smad la mtshon na/ ru dpon khyung bo stag bzang stong dang mgos khri gnyen g.yang 'phyos/ dpa' zla ba tshab mtsho zher tsang long dang lang ba mgon ne/ ru rta mtshal bu me stag dang sngon po g.yu rta/ru rta dar nag snying dkar bya khyung bris pa dang skyer kha gong khra/ spang la me mched pa lta bur 'grim pa'i tshul deb ther kun gsal me long ltar 'khod pa yin la/gzhan gnas bab de lta de'i dus su sum pa'i ru ma brtsis pa'i ru bzhi'i dmag gi grangs la bzhi 'bum nyis stong bzhi brgya yod ces bod kyi lo rgyus mdor bsdus zhes bya bar 'khod mod da dung dpyad rgyu yod snyam/ mdor na/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i ring bod kyi dmag dpung rnams ru chen lnga dang / khos drug ru rta 40

bcas kyi mdog dang dbyibs sogs zhib par gtan la phab tshul gong gsal ltar yin no/ /lnga/ spu lacang btsanasnam po'i ringasamasayig gtan la phab pa'i skor/de yang rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos gsar du btsugs pa'i srid dbang sra brtan zhi 'jags gtong pa dang / phyi nang gi dgra bo'i gnod 'tshe bzlog pa'i phyir thog mar khrims srol gtan la 'bebs dgos par dgongs nas/ btsan po rang nyid kyis khrims yig cheg po drug mi chos sogs blang dor gyi tshad dang bcas pa gtan la phab pa las/ khrims yig chen po drug gi dang po ni khri rtse 'bum bzhir gyi khrims yig yin zhing / 'di'i nang bka' gros drug yig tshangs drug phyag rgya drug rkyen drug dpa' mtshan drug bcas 'dus par kun dga'i me long du gsungs/ spyir 'di dag gi steng khrims yig chen po drug bsnan pas bod kyi 'khos sum cu so drug ces zer/ gnyis pa 'bum gyi gser thog sha ba can zhes pa'i nang du/ bre srang phul khyor zho se sran rnams gtan la phab yod/ gsum pa rgyal khab dper blangs kyi khrims zhes pa'i nang rgyal khrims bco lnga/ khrims chen bdun/mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug tu grags pa bcas sogs kyi don gtan la phab 'dugabazhi ba mdo lon zhu chad kyi khrims yig ni/ kha drag zhan gnyis rtson na bden brdzun brtags pa'i mthar kha drag pa ma skyengs shing / zhan pa yid mi chad par gcod pa'i khrims srol zhig yin zhing / mdor na bden brdzun gyi zhal lce gcod tshul gyi khrims yin no/ / lnga ba dbang chen bcad kyi khrims zhes pa ni/ nyes mi gnyis ka lan pa la gnyis nar chad pa mnyam du gcod pa'i khrims yig cig yin par mngon/ drug pa khab so nang ba'i khrims yin ni/ btsan po'i khab so ste bang mdzod kyi dkor nor gsog 'jog dang / srung 'doms sogs pho brang 〈snying

bcas kyi mdog dang dbyibs sogs zhib par gtan la phab tshul gong gsal ltar yin no/ /lnga/ spurgulapong btsan sgam po'i ring khrims yig gtan la phab pa'i skor/de yang rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos gsar du btsugs pa'i srid dbang sra brtan zhi 'jags gtong pa dang / phyi nang gi dgra bo'i gnod 'tshe bzlog pa'i phyir thog mar khrims srol gtan la 'bebs dgos par dgongs nas/ btsan po rang nyid kyis khrims yig cheg po drug mi chos sogs blang dor gyi tshad dang bcas pa gtan la phab pa las/ khrims yig chen po drug gi dang po ni khri rtse 'bum bzhir gyi khrims yig yin zhing / 'di'i nang bka' gros drug yig tshangs drug phyag rgya drug rkyen drug dpa' mtshan drug bcas 'dus par kun dga'i me long du gsungs/ spyir 'di dag gi steng khrims yig chen po drug bsnan pas bod kyi 'khos sum cu so drug ces zer/ gnyis pa 'bum gyi gser thog sha ba can zhes pa'i nang du/ bre srang phul khyor zho se sran rnams gtan la phab yod/ gsum pa rgyal khab dper blangs kyi khrims zhes pa'i nang rgyal khrims bco lnga/ khrims chen bdun/mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug tu grags pa bcas sogs kyi don gtan la phab 'dugabazhi ba mdo lon zhu chad kyi khrims yig ni/ kha drag zhan gnyis rtsod na bden brdzun brtags pa'i mthar kha drag pa ma skyengs shing / zhan pa yid mi chad par gcod pa'i khrims srol zhig yin zhing / mdor na bden brdzun gyi zhal lce gcod tshul gyi khrims yin no/ / lnga ba dbang chen bcad kyi khrims zhes pa ni/ nyes mi gnyis ka lan pa la gnyis kur chad pa mnyam du gcod pa'i khrims yig cig yin par mngon/ drug pa khab so nang ba'i khrims yin ni/ btsan po'i khab so ste bang mdzod kyi dkor nor gsog 'jog dang / srung 'doms sogs pho brang nang 41

khul gyi byed sgo'i sdom khrims shig yin nam snyam zhes g.yu phreng du mchis so/ /gzhan khri rtse 'bum bzher gyi khrims kyi char gtogs bka' gros chen po drug gi drug pa lha chos dge bcu sgrub cing mi dgos pa bcu spong zhes pa dang / rgyal khab dper blangs kyi khrims kyi khongs gtogs mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi khrims 'di gnyis ni mi spyod pa bzang po kho nar ltos te smos pa zhig las bka' khrims su brtsi mi rung yang / legs nyes blang dor gyi ngos nas bshad na mi rnams de dag las 'gal na mi 'grig pa dang / gal te 'gal na mi'i spyod bzang las 'das ba'i tshad gzhi bstan pa yin zhes na 'grig gam snyam mo/ /pa'i bsdig/ spu rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i ring bod kyi byu chos gong du 'phel thub rang cag bod mi rigs kyi lo rgyus steng rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i dus su rgyal khab gcig gyur mdzad nas spyi tshogs gong 'phel gtong ba'i nus pa ches cher brtas shing / stobs 'byor mnga' thang sogs phyogs gang thad du gzhan gyis 'gran mi bzod pa lta bur son pas gnas bab der e sha ya'i gling chen 'dir snyan grags kyi ba dan lhab lhub tu g.yo myang ba ma zad/ da lta'ang lo rgyus kyi mtshan snyan 'dzam gling du gsal ba zhig byung thub par 'dug pa 'dir rgyu rkyen mang po zhig yod na'ang / gtso bo ni btsan po khong nyid kyis skabs de dus kyi yul gzhan gang zhig dang mi rigs gzhan gang zhig la ma ltos par chab srid kyi gtsug lag dang /dpal 'byor gyi thabs lam/ rig gnas kyi gzhung lugs/ bzo rig gi lag rtsal/ khrims srol dang kun spyod/ thon skyed kyi las rigs la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi bya bzhag gang dang gang gi thad phyogs ris med par legs cha mtha' dag la slo/ 2sbyong ngam bcud len byas te/ bod mi rigs rang nyid stobs 'byor dang

dpal yon phun sum tshogs pa'i sngon bskyod kyi mi rigs phul byung zhig tu 'gyur bar 'bad brtson chen po mdzad pa de yin snyam mo/ / bdun/ sru rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i mdzadarjes gtso boskor/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam po ni bod kyi lo rgyus steng khyad par du 'phags pa'i chab srid mkhas chen zhig dang / phul du byung ba'i mi rigs kyi dpa' bo/ drag rtsal 'gran du med pa'i dmag thabs pa zhig yin stabs snyan pa'i grags pa'ang srid gsum gyi khyon la rgyas bzhin yod pa ni bshad ma dgos la/ khong gis yab rgyal po'i bya bzhag rgyud 'dzin gnang ste mtha' bzhi'i rgyal phran sum pa dang zhang zhung sogs mnga' dbang du bsdus te/ bod gcig gyur gyi rlabs chen bya bzhag legs 'grub gnang ba ma zad dmag don lam lugs gsar du btsugs pa dang / chab srid kyi thad thabs gsar ba mang po tsam zhig lag len bstar/ dpal 'byor lam lugs thad la'ang bsgyur bcos mang du gnang bas bod mi rigs rang nyid kyi khyad chos lda na pa'i bzo las kyi skor dper na/ 'khal 'thag dang / mdzes rigasbyar brkos/ gshangs bskos/ gser tshag dngul tshag lcags tshagashog bu bzo ba sogs kyi lag rtsal gong 'phel che cher 'gro thub pa byung zhing / tshong las phyogs su thang rgyal rabs dang / stag gzig rgya gar/ bal po sogs mtha' bzhi'i rgyal khab khag la tshong 'brel btsugs stabs bod kyi tshong las gong 'phel shugs chen du song ba dang / rig gnas kyi thad la'ang sngar byung ma myong pa'i 'phel rgyas phyin/ dus der lo rgyus dang / rtsom rig glu gar/ lus rtsal/ ar las lag rtsal/ brkos rig mdzes rig sman rtsis/ chos lugs sogs nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong spel/ sngar med gsar bsu bcas kyi thabs lam la brten nas phyogs gang ci'i thad 'phel rgyas shugs chen 1sbyong

dpal yon phun sum tshogs pa'i sngon bskyod kyi mi rigs phul byung zhig tu 'gyur bar 'bad brtson chen po mdzad pa de yin snyam mo/ / bdun/ spu rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i mdzad rjes gtso bo skor/ rgyal po srong btsan sgam po ni bod kyi lo rgyus steng khyad par du 'phags pa'i chab srid mkhas chen zhig dang / phul du byung ba'i mi rigs kyi dpa' bo/ drag rtsal 'gran du med pa'i dmag thabs pa zhig yin stabs snyan pa'i grags pa'ang srid gsum gyi khyon la rgyas bzhin yod pa ni bshad ma dgos la/ khong gis yab rgyal po'i bya bzhag rgyud 'dzin gnang ste mtha' bzhi'i rgyal phran sum pa dang zhang zhung sogs mnga' dbang du bsdus te/ bod gcig gyur gyi rlabs chen bya bzhag legs 'grub gnang ba ma zad dmag don lam lugs gsar du btsugs pa dang / chab srid kyi thad thabs gsar ba mang po tsam zhig lag len bstar/ dpal 'byor lam lugs thad la'ang bsgyur bcos mang du gnang bas bod mi rigs rang nyid kyi khyad chos lda na pa'i bzo las kyi skor dper na/ 'khal 'thag dang / mdzes rigasbyar brkos/ gshangs brkos/ gser tshag dngul tshag lcags tshagashog bu bzo ba sogs kyi lag rtsal gong 'phel che cher 'gro thub pa byung zhing / tshong las phyogs su thang rgyal rabs dang / stag gzig rgya gar/ bal po sogs mtha' bzhi'i rgyal khab khag la tshong 'brel btsugs stabs bod kyi tshong las gong 'phel shugs chen du song ba dang / rig gnas kyi thad la'ang sngar byung ma myong pa'i 'phel rgyas phyin/ dus der lo rgyus dang / rtsom rig glu gar/ lus rtsal/ ar las lag rtsal/ brkos rig mdzes rig sman rtsis/ chos lugs sogs nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong spel/ sngar med gsar bsu bcas kyi thabs lam la brten nas phyogs gang ci'i thad 'phel rgyas shugs chen byung 43

bar brten rin thang gzhal du med pa'i bod kyi gna' rabs rig gnas gong du spel bar rmang gzhi sra brtan zhig btang ba red/de mtshungs 'dir gling 'os pa zhig ni gnas bab de dus su rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos rgyal khab mang po zhig la chab srid kyi phyi 'brel 'jog myong mod kyang /de dag las khong gis thang rgyal rabs nas rgya bza' kong jo bod du bsus pas bod rgya mi rigs gnyis kyi bar mdza' mthun gyi 'brel ba sngar byung ma myong ba zhig bzhag pa dang / de nas bzung bod mi mang po khrang an phyogs su rgya'i rig gnas slob sbyong byed du btang ba ma zad/ btsan po rang nyid kyis kyang rgya rigs kyi rig gnas la sbyong ba legs po gnang zhing / thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas thang rgyal rabs kyi sngon thon rig gnas kyi nying khu rnams tshur bsus te bod la khyab gdal btang / mdor na/ rgyal po 'di nyid kyis gnas bab de ga'i lo rgyus kyi 'phel phyogs dang bstun nas srid 'byor rig gsum sogs phyogs gang thad la bsgyur bcos dang byus bkod gang legs mdzad de bod kyi spyi tshogs gong du spel ba dang /bod rgya mi rigs bar mdza' zhing brtse ba'i mthun lam bskrun pa sogs mdzad rjes ha cang mang pas bka' grin shin tu che'o/ /brgyad/ bod btsan po'i dus su dpal 'byor daraspel spyir bshad/btsan po srong btsan sgam po ni dgongs pa zab cing yangs la shin tu dkyil che ba zhig yin pas/ gal te mi rigs gcig dar rgyas phun sum tshogs pa'i 'phel lam du bskyod dgos na/ nges par du 'jig rten thog gi sngon thon bya gzhag kun gyi snying bcud bsdu len byas te rang nyid stobs dang ldan pa zhig tu 'gyur dgos pa de gzigs yod/ bod yongs gcig gyur dang mnga' khongs rgya che/ 4bskyed pa'i cha rkyen 'og mtha' bzhi'i rgyal khams rnams dang 'brel ba rgya

bar brten rin thang gzhal du med pa'i bod kyi gna' rabs rig gnas gong du spel bar rmang gzhi sra brtan zhig btang ba red/de mtshungs 'dir gleng 'os pa zhig ni gnas bab de dus su rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos rgyal khab mang po zhig la chab srid kyi phyi 'brel 'jog myong mod kyang /de dag las khong gis thang rgyal rabs nas rgya bza' kong jo bod du bsus pas bod rgya mi rigs gnyis kyi bar mdza' mthun gyi 'brel ba sngar byung ma myong ba zhig bzhag pa dang / de nas bzung bod mi mang po khrang an phyogs su rgya'i rig gnas slob sbyong byed du btang ba ma zad/ btsan po rang nyid kyis kyang rgya rigs kyi rig gnas la sbyong ba legs po gnang zhing / thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas thang rgyal rabs kyi sngon thon rig gnas kyi nying khu rnams tshur bsus te bod la khyab gdal btang / mdor na/ rgyal po 'di nyid kyis gnas bab de ga'i lo rgyus kyi 'phel phyogs dang bstun nas srid 'byor rig gsum sogs phyogs gang thad la bsgyur bcos dang byus bkod gang legs mdzad de bod kyi spyi tshogs gong du spel ba dang /bod rgya mi rigs bar mdza' zhing brtse ba'i mthun lam bskrun pa sogs mdzad rjes ha cang mang pas bka' grin shin tu che'o/ / brgyad/ bod btsan po'i dus su dpal 'byor dar spel sbyir bshad/btsan po srong btsan sgam po ni dgongs pa zab cing yangs la shin tu dkyil che ba zhig yin pas/ gal te mi rigs gcig dar rgyas phun sum tshogs pa'i 'phel lam du bskyod dgos na/ nges par du 'jig rten thog gi sngon thon bya gzhag kun gyi snying bcud bsdu len byas te rang nyid stobs dang ldan pa zhig tu 'gyur dgos pa de gzigs yod/ bod yongs gcig gyur dang mnga' khongs rgya cher bskyed pa'i cha rkyen 'og mtha' bzhi'i rgyal khams rnams dang 'brel ba rgya 44

chera'agugs pa'i thabs shes la brten nas gcig gyur byung ma thag pa'i bod kyi chab srid/ rig gnas/ dmag don tsam du ma zad/ lhag par spyi tshogs kyi dpal 'byor sra brtan dang 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i thad la'ang mdzad rjes rlabs po che zhig 'jog gnang mdzad yod/ bod kyi chos 'byung lo rgyus las 'byung ba ltar na/ 44shar phyogs rgya dang mi nyag nas/ / bzo dang rtsis kyi dpe rnams len/ /lho phyogs dkar po'i rgya gar nas/ / dam pa'i chos kyi sgra rnams bsgyur/ / nub phyogs sog po bal po nas/ / zas nor longs spyod gter kha 'byed/ /byang phyogs hor dang yu gur nas/ / khrims dang las kyi dpe rnams len/ /de ltar phyogs bzhir dbang sgyur nas/ / mtha' yi longs spyod dbang du sdud/ /〉〉ces sogs 'khod pa ni chos kyi 'byung tshul gtso bor ston pa'i deb ther nang zhor 'phros su dpe mtshon tsam tshigs su bcad pa'i lam nas mdor bsdus su bshad pa las/ zhib phra'i nges tig ma gsal mod/ 'on kyang de'i thog nas mthong thub pa ni/ btsan po srong btsan sgam po blon 'khor dang bcas pas skabs de dus kyi yul gzhan gang zhig dang mi rigs gzhan gang zhig la cha ma ltos par chab srid kyi gtsug lag dang / dpal 'byor gyi thabs lam/ rig gnas kyi gzhung lugs/ bzo rig gi lag rtsal/ khrims srol dang kun spyod/ thon skyed kyi las rigs la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi bya gzhag gang dang gang gi thad sngon thon dang /bod la phan pa'i dge mtshan gyi rigs shig yin phyin phyogs ris med par legs cha mtha' dag bsdu len dang slob sbyong byas te/ bod mi rigs rang nyid stobs 'byor dang dpal yon phun sum tshogs pa'i sngon bskyod kyi mi rigs phul byung zhig tu 'gyur bar 'bad brtson chen po ci 'dra zhig mdzad tshul mtshon gyin yod/rgya bal nas btsun mo bsus shing / bzo rig mkhas pa mang po bskongs nas lha khang bzhengs pa brgyud bod kyi gna' rabs 'dzugs skrun gyi bya gzhag gong mthor 45

chera'agugs pa'i thabs shes la brten nas gcig gyur byung ma thag pa'i bod kyi chab srid/ rig gnas/ dmag don tsam du ma zad/ lhag par spyi tshogs kyi dpala'abyor sra brtan dang 'phel rgyas gtong ba'i thad la'ang mdzad rjes rlabs po che zhig 'jog gnang mdzad yod/ bod kyi chos 'byung lo rgyus las 'byung ba ltar na/ 4shar phyogs rgya dang mi nyag nas/ / bzo dang rtsis kyi dpe rnams len/ /lho phyogs dkar po'i rgya gar nas/ / dam pa'i chos kyi sgra rnams bsgyur/ /nub phyogs sog po bal po nas/ / zas nor longs spyod gter kha 'byed/ /byang phyogs hor dang yu gur nas/ / khrims dang las kyi dpe rnams len/ /de ltar phyogs bzhir dbang sgyur nas/ / mtha' yi longs spyod dbang du — glu sdud/ /mi ces sogs 'khod pa ni chos kyi 'byung tshul gtso bor ston pa'i deb ther nang zhor 'phros su dpe mtshon tsam tshigs su bcad pa'i lam nas mdor bsdus su bshad pa las/ zhib phra'i nges tig ma gsal mod/ 'on kyang de'i thog nas mthong thub pa ni/ btsan po srong btsan sgam po blon 'khor dang bcas pas skabs de dus kyi yul gzhan gang zhig dang mi rigs gzhan gang zhig la cha ma ltos par chab srid kyi gtsug lag dang / dpal 'byor gyi thabs lam/ rig gnas kyi gzhung lugs/ bzo rig gi lag rtsal/ khrims srol dang kun spyod/ thon skyed kyi las rigs la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi bya gzhag gang dang gang gi thad sngon thon dang /bod la phan pa'i dge mtshan gyi rigs sheg yin phyin phyogs ris med par legs cha mtha' dag bsdu len dang slob sbyong byas te/ bod mi rigs rang nyid stobs 'byor dang dpal yon phun sum tshogs pa'i sngon bskyod kyi mi rigs phul byung zhig tu 'gyur bar 'bad brtson chen po ci 'dra zhig mdzad tshul mtshon gyin yod/rgya bal nas btsun mo bsus shing / bzo rig mkhas pa mang po bskongs nas lha khang bzhengs pa brgyud bod kyi gna' rabs 'dzugs skrun gyi bya gzhag gong /rdor

btang ba dang / rgya gar nas yi ge'i dpe blangs te bod yig gi srol btod pa/phyogs bzhi nas dam chos sogs kyi gzhung lugs bsgyur cing bod kyi rig gnas rgya cher spel ba/ lhag par chen po thang gi rgyal khams dang mdza' 'brel rgya che gting zab cig btsugs te bod kyi chab srid dang dmag don sogs 'jig rten lugs kyi gtsug lag yar rgyas mdzad pa sogs le tshan zur du 'khod pa rnams 'dir bskyar zlos ma dgos shing / gong gsal tshigs su bcad pa'i nang nasaphanub phyogs sog po ri zhes pa ni skabs 'dir ta zig la go dgos pa dang / nor dang longs spyod kyi gter kha 'byed ces pa de yang dpya' dang skyes 'bul ba tsam ma zad/ gtso bo bod dang 'brel yod mtha' bzhi'i rgyal khams gzhan dag thams cad kyi bar thon zog brje len byed pa'i dpal 'byor gyi tshong lam rgya cher phye ba de yin/ 'on kyang tshong lam gyi 'brel ba de ni nub phyogs kho na tsam ga la yin te/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du yangs por phye yod/ 'di'i skor lde'u chos 'byung las 'byung ba ltar/ srong btsan gyi mdzad pa mdor bstan pa'i nang gsesaphal brgyad dang khe brgyad mi ces 'khod pa'i 'grel bshad du/ khe brgyad ni/ 4stod na khrom kha chen po gsum ste/ gru zha'i rgyal khams (kasmir )dang / dru gu dang / bal po'o/smad kyi khrom kha gsum la/ gar log dang / rong rong / ldan ma'o/ dbus kyi khrom kha gnyis ni stong stong gnyis so mi’zhes gsal ba'i khrom kha chen po zhes pa ni/bod dang yul khams gzhan dag dbar thon zog brje len byed pa'i tshong 'dus chen po la zer ba yin/ dbus kyi khrom kha stong stong gnyis zhes pa ni lho dang byang gi tshong 'dus la zer bar snang / de dag ni nye 'dabs kyi mang tshogs rnams phan tshun rang mos kyi thon zog brje tshong byed pa'i tshong 'dus yin cing / la brgyad kyi 'grel bshad ni/ 4la sgo chen po bzhi la mnga' mdzad pa ste/ 'bri rje khri gsum rje stag snang gis/ shar dar dang zas kyi la sgo phye ste mnga' mdzad/ 'gos khri 46

btang ba dang / rgya gar nas yi ge'i dpe blangs te bod yig gi srol btod pa/phyogs bzhi nas dam chos sogs kyi gzhung lugs bsgyur cing bod kyi rig gnas rgya cher spel ba/ lhag par chen po thang gi rgyal khams dang mdza' 'brel rgya che gting zab cig btsugs te bod kyi chab srid dang dmag don sogs 'jig rten lugs kyi gtsug lag yar rgyas mdzad pa sogs le tshan zur du 'khod pa rnams 'dir bskyar zlos ma dgos shing / gong gsal tshigs su bcad pa'i nang nas nub phyogs sog po mi zhes pa ni skabs 'dir ta zig la go dgos pa dang / nor dang longs spyod kyi gter kha 'byed ces pa de yang dpya' dang skyes 'bul ba tsam ma zad/ gtso bo bod dang 'brel yod mtha' bzhi'i rgyal khams gzhan dag thams cad kyi bar thon zog brje len byed pa'i dpal 'byor gyi tshong lam rgya cher phye ba de yin/ 'on kyang tshong lam gyi 'brel ba de ni nub phyogs kho na tsam ga la yin te/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du yangs por phye yod/ 'di'i skor lde'u chos 'byung las 'byung ba ltar/ srong btsan gyi mdzad pa mdor bstan pa'i nang gsesaphal brgyad dang khe brgyad me ces 'khod pa'i 'grel bshad du/ khe brgyad ni/ dzistod na khrom kha chen po gsum ste/ gru zha'i rgyal khams (kasmir )dang / dru gu dang / bal po'o/smad kyi khrom kha gsum la/ gar log dang / rong rong / ldan ma'o/ dbus kyi khrom kha gnyis ni stong stong gnyis so mi zhes gsal ba'i khrom kha chen po zhes pa ni/bod dang yul khams gzhan dag dbar thon zog brje len byed pa'i tshong 'dus chen po la zer ba yin/ dbus kyi khrom kha stong stong gnyis zhes pa ni lho dang byang gi tshong 'dus la zer bar snang / de dag ni nye 'dabs kyi mang tshogs rnams phan tshun rang mos kyi thon zog brje tshong byed pa'i tshong 'dus yin cing / la brgyad kyi 'grel bshad ni/ phal sgo chen po bzhi la mnga' mdzad pa ste/ 'bri rje khri gsum rje zlog snang gis/ shar dar dang zas kyi la sgo phye ste mnga' mdzad/ 'gos khri

snyen 'ol mas/ lho 'bras dang khre'i la sgo phye ste mnga' mdzad/ 'brong chung gza' 'or mas/ nub ram dang rgya skyeg gi la sgo phye ste mnga' mdzad/ khyung po spungs stangs kyis/ byang tshwa dang mdzo'i la sgo phye ste mnga' mdzad/ la sgo bzhi la le chung bzhi btags pa'i brgyad la/ bod thams cad khe la zhugs pas khe brgyad ces bya'o 〉〉zhes gsal 'dug pa ltar shar phyogs thang gi rgyal khams nas dar gos dang /zas kyi bye brag sna tshogs 'byung ba'i tshong sgo phye ba dang / lho phyogs mon rgya gar gyi yul nas 'bras dang khre sogs bod na med pa'i 'bru rigs dang 'bras bu'i rigs 'byung ba'i tshong sgo phye ba/ nub phyogs ta zig dang / bal po/ la dwaṭa sogs nas bod kyi snam chas la med du mi rung ba'i tshos rigs ram dang / rgya skyeg ste rgya tshos sogs gtso bor byas pa'i stod zog sna tshogs 'byung ba'i tshong sgo phye ba/ byang phyogs li yul dang sog po sogs nas tshwa dang / 'brog las kyi thon zog 'byung ba'i tshong sgo bcas phye ba ma zad/ phyi phyogs kyi tshong sgo chen po de dag la mtha' mtshams so sor gnas pa'i 'bro dang / 'gos/ khyung po la sogs pa'i sde tsho'i 'go pa tshos do dam byed kyi yod pa bcas mtshon pa dang / le chung zhes pa ni la sgo chen po de dag gi le lag gam la sgo chung ba gzhan yang yod par bstan cing / bod thams cad khe la zhugs pa zhes pa ni stod smad lho byang gi bod mi rnams kyang tshong zog brje res byed pa'i khe las kyi bya bar zhugs pas khe brgyad ces grags pa yin/ de ltar tshig bsdus che ba'i lo rgyus nyung shas de dag la zhib par dpyad na/ skabs de dus bod kyi stobs 'byor dar zhing rgyas pas phyogs dang phyogs mtshams kun tu dngos zog brje len gyi tshong lam rgya cher btod pa dang brje tshong 'phel rgyas la brten nas slar yang bod kyi zhing 'brog thon skyed nus shugs la skul 'ded dang /mi rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i longs spyod sngar dang mi 'dra bar gra rgyas phun sum tshogs su gtong ba bcas bod kyi spyi tshogs dpal 'byor gong spel 'gro rgyur dus rabs gsar 47

pa zhig phye ba mthong thub kyi yod/mdor na rang cag bod mi rigs kyi lo rgyus thog btsan po srong btsan sgam po'i dus rabs nas bzung lo ngo brgya phrag gi ring stobs shugs dang dar 'phel che shos kyi skabs sheg tu son te e sha ya'i gling chen 'dir snyan grags kyi ba dan lhab lhub tu g.yo bas ma tshad/ skabs de'i lo rgyus kyi mtshan snyan da lta'ang 'dzam gling du gsal ba zhig ni yul khams gzhan dang mi rigs gzhan gyi sngon thon yin pa'i legs cha mtha' dag slob sbyong ngam/ bcud len byas te rang gi mi rigs 'byor stobs dang dpal yon 'bar ba zhig tu 'gyur bar mdzad pa de yin/ 'di yang gna' bzang dengaspyod kyi bslab bya'i don snying chen po ldan pa zhig lags so/mtha' bzhir 'brel lam rgya che 'gugs pa dang chab cig bod nang khul gyi thon skyed la'ang bcos sgrig dang skul 'ded chen po zhig gnang yod/dper na tun hong gi yig rnying las byung ba'i btsan po srong btsan sgam po'i mdzad rjes mdor bstan du bkod pa 'di ltar/ 4bla na rje sgam na/ khri srong brtsan/ 'og na blon mdzangs na/ stong rtsan yul zung mi zhes pa'i dum bu de'i nang nas bod kyi khod sum cu so drug sogs kyi nang gong du song zin pa rnams bskyar zlos mi byed cing / de min thon skyed dang 'brel ba yod pa'i gnad don gal che ba 'ga' shas la tshig 'grel tsam zhu na/ ma 'bangs mgo nag po yang mtho dman ni snyams/ dpya' sgyu ni bskyungs zhes pa'i don ni/ 'bangs mgo nag po zer ba gna' rabs kyi shod srol la/ mgo nag mi zhes 'bangs mi spyi yongs kyi don yin cing / mtho dman ni snyams zer ba/ mi yod tshad mtho dman gyi khyad med par snyoms pa'i don ma yin la/ skabs der de lta bu yong yang ga la srid/ don dngos ni sngon chad bran g.yog bdag po tshos sa zhing ngam phyugs ri/sdu sogs mang che ba rang gir bzung ste/ gzhung phyogs kyi dpya' khral yongs

pa zhig phye ba mthong thub kyi yod/mdor na rang cag bod mi rigs kyi lo rgyus thog btsan po srong btsan sgam po'i dus rabs nas bzung lo ngo brgya phrag gi ring stobs shugs dang dar 'phel che shos kyi skabs shig tu son te e sha ya'i gling chen 'dir snyan grags kyi ba dan lhab lhub tu g.yo bas ma tshad/ skabs de'i lo rgyus kyi mtshan snyan da lta'ang 'dzam gling du gsal ba zhig ni yul khams gzhan dang mi rigs gzhan gyi sngon thon yin pa'i legs cha mtha' dag slob sbyong ngam/ bcud len byas te rang gi mi rigs 'byor stobs dang dpal yon 'bar ba zhig tu 'gyur bar mdzad pa de yin/ 'di yang gna' bzang deng spyod kyi bslab bya'i don snying chen po ldan pa zhig lags so/mtha' bzhir 'brel lam rgya che 'gugs pa dang chab cig bod nang khul gyi thon skyed la'ang bcos sgrig dang skul 'ded chen po zhig gnang yod/dper na tun hong gi yig rnying las byung ba'i btsan po srong btsan sgam po'i mdzad rjes mdor bstan du bkod pa 'di ltar/ phabla na rje sgam na/ khri srong brtsan/ 'og na blon mdzangs na/ stong tsan yul zung 〉〉zhes pa'i dum bu de'i nang nas bod kyi khod sum cu so drug sogs kyi nang gong du song zin pa rnams bskyar zlos mi byed cing / de min thon skyed dang 'brel ba yod pa'i gnad don gal che ba 'ga' shas la tshig 'grel tsam zhu na/ ma 'bangs mgo nag po yang mtho dman ni snyams/ dpya' sgyu ni bskyungs〉〉zhes pa'i don ni/ 'bangs mgo nag po zer ba gna' rabs kyi shod srol la/ mgo nag mi zhes 'bangs mi spyi yongs kyi don yin cing / mtho dman ni snyam sa zer ba/ mi yod tshad mtho dman gyi khyad med par snyoms pa'i don ma yin la/ skabs der de lta bu yong yang ga la srid/ don dngos ni sngon chad bran g.yog bdag po tshos sa zhing ngam phyugs rigs sogs mang che ba rang gir bzung ste/ gzhung phyogs kyi dpya' khral yongs 48

rdzogs 'bangs mi ser rnams 'jal du 'jug pa la/ thengs 'dir btsan pos thon skyed rgyu chas bdag gir bzung mang nyung la gzhigs nas che thob chung thob kyi dpya' /khral tshad gzhi ltar so sos 'bul dgos pa gtan la phab ste/ gasprong khral 'jal rgyur gnas bab dang go sa mtho dman gyi dbye ba med pa snyoms par bzos pa'i don yin cing / der brtenamadapya' sgyu ni bskyungs〉〉zhes pa dpya' khral 'jal sgrub thad kyi de snga'i g.yo sgyu sbug 'dren rnams med par bzos pa'i don yin/de bzhin/phadal du ni mchis/ /ston dpyid ni bskyal/ /'khor bar ni spyad/ /〉 ces pa'i don ni/ sngon chad bod 'bangs rnams rgyal phran nam/ rus tsho phan tshum dus rtag tu 'thab 'khrug brgyab nas mi thams cad bag phebs bde lhod kyi skabs med par gsod brdung 'phrog bcom soṭa kyis mnar ba las/ da lta ni bod gcig gyur btsan po'i bka' khrims kyi 'og 'bangs rnams blo bde bag phebs ngang rang rang zhing 'brog thon skyed rgyun gtan ngang byed rgyu byung bas naphadal du ni mchis 〉〉bod 'bangs phal pa rnams sngon chad ston dus bza' bca' cung zad 'bel rung / dpyid kur rgyu rdzogs pa'i gnas tshul de da cha med pa chaṭa nas ston dus ltar dpyid ka yang 'khyol bas na 4ston dpyid ni bskyal 〉〉snga lo'i zas lhag gis 'di lo'i ston 'bras ma blangs bar 'dang bas na lo8 'khor bar ni spyad 〉〉ces pa'i don te mdor na bod 'bangs phal pa kun kyang bkres ltogs kyi sdug bsdal las thar ba de mtshon pa yin / de'i gsham du/ pha'adod pa ni byin/ / gnod pa ni phye/ / btsan pa ni btsugs/ /sdo ba ni smad/ / 'jigs pa ni mnan/ / bden pa ni bsnyen/ / dpa' bo 49

rdzogs 'bangs mi ser rnams 'jal du 'jug pa la/ thengs 'dir btsan pos thon skyed rgyu chas bdag gir bzung mang nyung la gzhigs nas che thob chung thob kyi dpya'akhral tshad gzhi ltar so sos 'bul dgos pa gtan la phab ste/ gzhung khral 'jal rgyur gnas bab dang go sa mtho dman gyi dbye ba med pa snyoms par bzos pa'i don yin cing / der brten dpya' sgyu ni bskyungs zhes pa dpya' khral 'jal sgrub thad kyi de lnga'i g.yo sgyu yug 'dren rnams med par bzos pa'i don yin/de bzhin/phadal du ni mchis/ /ston dpyid ni bskyal/ /'khor bar ni spyad/ /mi ces pa'i don ni/ sngon chad bod 'bangs rnams rgyal phran nam/ rus tsho phan tshum dus rtag tu 'thab 'khrug brgyab nas mi thams cad bag phebs bde lhod kyi skabs med par gsod brdung 'phrog bcom soṭa kyis mnar ba las/ da lta ni bod gcig gyur btsan po'i bka' khrims kyi 'og 'bangs rnams blo bde bag phebs ngang rang rang zhing 'brog thon skyed rgyun gtan ngang byed rgyu byung bas na dal du ni mchis mi bod 'bangs phal pa rnams sngon chad ston dus bza' bca' cung zad 'bel rung / dpyid kur rgyu rdzogs pa'i gnas tshul de da cha med pa chaṭa nas ston dus ltar dpyid ka yang 'khyol bas na ston dpyid ni bskyal mi snga lo'i zas lhag gis 'di lo'i ston 'bras ma blangs bar 'dang bas na lo 'khor bar ni spyad me ces pa'i don te mdor na bod 'bangs phal pa kun kyang bkres ltogs kyi sdug bsdal las thar ba de mtshon pa yin / de'i gsham du/ pha'adod pa ni byin/ / gnod pa ni phye/ / btsan pa ni btsugs/ /sdo ba ni smad/ / 'jigs pa ni mnan/ / bden pa ni bsnyen/ / dpasdu bo

ni bkur/ / smon par ni bkol/ / chos bzang srid mtho ste/ / myi yongs kyi skyid do/ /mi zhes 'khod pa las sdo ba ni smad 7zer ba btsan po'i bka' dang khrims lugs la do sdo ba ste mi brtsi mkhan rnams ni cham la 'bebs pa'i don yin cing /gzhan rnams go bde bas 'brel bshad ma dgos so/ yig rnying de'i mjug tu da dung gal che ba zhig ni zhing 'brog gi thul ka dang dor ka dang / srungs kyi go bar bsnyams mi zhes pa de yin te sa zhing gi rgya khyon 'jal thabs dor ka brtsi ba ni/rmod phyugs cha gcig gis nyin gcig la rmo thub pa'i sa zhing gi rgya khyon la dor gcig gi tshad bzos pa dang / phyugs rigs che chung la bul ka brtsi stangs ni/ mi gzugs tshad ldan gcig gi gyon thul 'dang ba'i pags pa la bul ka gcig zer zhing de ltar rtsis gzhir bzung nas sgo phyugs che byung gi bsdur grangs bzos pa'i don yin pa dang / dzisrungs kyi go bar bsnyams ① zhes pa ni thon skyed byas pa'i thon rdzas rnams bgo bsha' cha snyoms brgyab pa'i don yin par bshad 'dug pa de ltar na/ skabs de'i lam lugs 'og sngon chad bran g.yog bdag po tshos thon skyed kyi yong 'bab tshang ma rang gis blangs nas bran g.yog 'chi gson la mi lta ba de ltar mi chog par bran g.yog rnams la'ang thon rdzas kyi thog nas thob cha 'os mtshams shig sprod dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs gnang ba'i don yin dgos snyam/ 'on kyang skabs de'i bod kyi dpal 'byor skor yid rton rung ba'i dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs gzhan dag ma rnyed khar/ tun hong gi yig rnying dum bu 'di'i tshig sna ha cang bsdus drags pa dang brda rnying re zung go dka' ba bcas la brten 'dir tshig 'grel byas pa la la don dang mthun min cha ma 'tshal rung / nang don rnams ha cang gal che bas 'dor bar phangs nas thengs dang po'i dpyad gzhi tsam yong ched spyi shārtol bskyed de bris pa yin/ yig rnying dum bu de'i mjug bsdoms su'ang

ni bkur/ / smon par ni bkol/ / chos bzang srid mtho ste/ / myi yongs kyi skyid do/ /〉〉zhes 'khod pa las4sdo ba ni smad ’ zer ba btsan po'i bka' dang khrims lugs la do sdo ba ste mi brtsi mkhan rnams ni cham la 'bebs pa'i don yin cing /gzhan rnams go bde bas 'brel bshad ma dgos so/ yig rnying de'i mjug tu da dung gal che ba zhig ni zhing 'brog gi thul ka dang dor ka dang / slungs kyi go bar bsnyams 〉〉zhes pa de yin te sa zhing gi rgya khyon 'jal thabs dor ka brtsi ba ni/rmod phyugs cha gcig gis nyin gcig la rmo thub pa'i sa zhing gi rgya khyon la dor gcig gi tshad bzos pa dang / phyugs rigs che chung la thul ka brtsi stangs ni/ mi gzugs tshad ldan gcig gi gyon thul 'dang ba'i pags pa la thul ka gcig zer zhing de ltar rtsis gzhir bzung nas sgo phyugs che byung gi bsdur grangs bzos pa'i don yin pa dang / dzislungs kyi go bar bsnyams me zhes pa ni thon skyed byas pa'i thon rdzas rnams bgo bsha' cha snyoms brgyab pa'i don yin par bshad 'dug pa de ltar na/ skabs de'i lam lugs 'og sngon chad bran g.yog bdag po tshos thon skyed kyi yong 'bab tshang ma rang gis blangs nas bran g.yog 'chi gson la mi lta ba de ltar mi chog par bran g.yog rnams la'ang thon rdzas kyi thog nas thob cha 'os mtshams shig sprod dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs gnang ba'i don yin dgos snyam/ 'on kyang skabs de'i bod kyi dpal 'byor skor yid rton rung ba'i dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs gzhan dag ma rnyed khar/ tun hong gi yig rnying dum bu 'di'i tshig sna ha cang bsdus drags pa dang brda rnying re zung go dka' ba bcas la brten 'dir tshig 'grel byas pa la la don dang mthun min cha ma 'tshal rung / nang don rnams ha cang gal che bas 'dor bar phangs nas thengs dang po'i dpyad gzhi tsam yong ched spyi brtol bskyed de bris pa yin/ yig rnying dum bu de'i mjug bsdoms su'ang50

pha bod kyi chos kyi gzhung bzang po kun/ btsan po khro srong brtsan gyi ring las byungango/ myi yongs kyis bka' drin dran zhing tshor bas/ srong brtsan sgam po zhes mtshan gsol to/ri zhes 'khod yod/ chos kyi gzhung 〉〉zhes pa sangs rgyas chos lugs rkyang pa'i go don ma yin par lam lugs bzang po kun zer ba'i don yin no/gzhan yang chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston las 'byung ba ltar na btsan po 'di'i sku dus su bod kyi mdzangs mi bdun gyi lnga pa snyags khri bzang yang ston byung bar bshad pa 'di ltar/phagazhan yang khri bzang yang ston snyags kyi bus/ / mdzangs pa'i las su ri khyim klungs su phab/ / spo mtho mkhar du brtsigs nas grong khyer bcos/ /'di yan bod kyi khang khyim ri la yod/ / de'i phyir bod kyi mdzangs mi lnga pa yin/ /〉〉zhes gsal ba bzhin btsan po srong btsan gyi yan du bod kyi khang khyim ri la bcas yod ces pa 'di ni shas che ba'i dbang du byas pa yin snyam zhing / de yang phyogs gcig nas sngon chad rang gar thor ba'i tsho pa so so'i dbar rtag tu phan tshun 'thab 'khrug dang / gsod rdung / 'phrog bcom soṭa dpung pa su bzang gis rang snang gang dran byed pa la gcig gyur khrims lugs kyi 'gan srung sogs med par brten/ mi tshang mas rang gi lus srog longs spyod srung ba'i phyir ri la 'khras nas btsan sa zhig ma bzung ka med byung ba dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas de sngon bod kyi thon skyed gtso bo ri dwags brngon pa dang / 'brog las byed pa yin pas dbyar dus ri bo mtho sa dang / dgun dus ri bo'i 'dabs sogs rtswa chu gang bzang du 'pho skyas byas nas sdod kyi yod pa mtshon/ skabs 'dir slebs dus btsan po'i bka' khrims kyi gdugs dkar gcig gi grib bsil 'og bod 'bangs drag zhan tshang ma bde 'jags 'khos su phebs pas mi 'jigs pa'i skyabs 51

pha bod kyi chos kyi gzhung bzang po kun/ btsan po khro srong btsan gyi ring las byungango/ myi yongs kyis bka' drin dran zhing tshor bas/ srong btsan sgam po zhes mtshan gsol to/me zhes 'khod yod/ mchos kyi gzhung mi zhes pa sangs rgyas chos lugs rkyang pa'i go don ma yin par lam lugs bzang po kun zer ba'i don yin no/gzhan yang chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston las 'byung ba ltar na btsan po 'di'i sku dus su bod kyi mdzangs mi bdun gyi lnga pa snyags khri bzang yang ston byung bar bshad pa 'di ltar/phagazhan yang khri bzang yang ston snyags kyi bus/ / mdzangs pa'i las su ri khyim klungs su phab/ / spo mtho mkhar du brtsigs nas grong khyer bcos/ /'di yan bod kyi khang khyim ri la yod/ / de'i phyir bod kyi mdzangs mi lnga pa yin/ /mi zhes gsal ba bzhin btsan po srong btsan gyi yan du bod kyi khang khyim ri la bcas yod ces pa 'di ni shas che ba'i dbang du byas pa yin snyam zhing / de yang phyogs gcig nas sngon chad rang gar thor ba'i tsho pa so so'i dbar rtag tu phan tshun 'thab 'khrug dang / gsod rdung / 'phrog bcom soṭa dpung pa su bzang gis rang snang gang dran byed pa la gcig gyur khrims lugs kyi 'gan srung sogs med par brten/ mi tshang mas rang gi lus srog longs spyod srung ba'i phyir ri la 'khras nas btsan sa zhig ma bzung ka med byung ba dang / phyogs gzhan zhig nas de sngon bod kyi thon skyed gtso bo ri dwags brngon pa dang / 'brog las byed pa yin pas dbyar dus ri bo mtho sa dang / dgun dus ri bo'i 'dabs sogs rtswa chu gang bzang du 'pho skyas byas nas sdod kyi yod pa mtshon/ skabs 'dir slobs dus btsan po'i bka' khrims kyi gdugs dkar gcig gi grib bsil 'og bod 'bangs drag zhan tshang ma bde 'jags 'khos su phebs pas mi 'jigs pa'i /sdus

sbyin thob pa dang / dus mtshungs spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas song ba'i dbang gis zhing 'brog gi las bgos rgya cher gyur nas gang sar zhing las cher gnyer byed pa'i mtho rlabs shig 'phyur ba dang / de dus blon po snyags khri bzang yang ston ni gtso bo zhing las gong spel dang / zhing grong 'dzugs skrun gyi las 'gan 'khur mkhan zhig yin pa gsal por mtshon zhing / khong gi bkod 'doms 'og sa rgyu gshin pa'i klung thang mang po gsar sbol byed bcug pa dang chabs cig gang du zhing thang chags pa de gar zhing dud kyi sdod khang gsar du brtsigs pa mngon/ gang sa gang du de lta bu'i grong tsho che chung mang po rim bzhin thon pa'i bya gzhag nang khri bzang yang ston gyis thabs dang byus bkod sogs byas rjes gzengs su thon pa zhig bzhag par brten khong la bod blon mdzangs pa'i mi bdun gyi lnga par grags pa'i mtshan snyan thob pa'o/gong du drangs pa'i lo rgyus kyi dpyad gzhi de dag gi thog nas/ btsan po srong btsan sgam pos skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi lam lugs 'og bod kyi thon skyed 'brel ba'i phyogs 'ga' zhig gi thad la bod 'bangs mang tshogs kyi re ba dang mthun pa'i phan yod kyi bcos sgrig dang / legs bcos nges can zhig gnang ba brgyud ngal rtsol pa'i hur brtson rang bzhin la skul 'ded byung bas bod yongs kyi thon skyed nus shugs gong du spel bar nus pa che tsam thon pa dang / rmang gzhi'i dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas byung ba de la brten nas spyi tshogs hril po'i phyogs gang ci'i thad sngon chad byang ma myong ba'i yar rgyas gzengs sa thon pa'i mdzad rjes phal ri ri rigi rgya sa sko༅du byung ba ci 'dra zhig 'jog gnang mdzad yod pa rang res mthong thub kyi yod/52

sbyin thob pa dang / dus mtshungs spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas song ba'i dbang gis zhing 'brog gi las bgos rgya cher gyur nas gang sar zhing las cher gnyer byed pa'i mtho rlabs shig 'byur ba dang / de dus blon po snyags khri bzang yang ston ni gtso bo zhing las gong spel dang / zhing grong 'dzugs skrun gyi las 'gan 'khur mkhan zhig yin pa gsal por mtshon zhing / khong gi bkod 'doms 'og sa rgyu gshin pa'i klung thang mang po gsar sbol byed bcug pa dang chabs cig gang du zhing thang chags pa de gar zhing dud kyi sdod khang gsar du brtsigs pa mngon/ gang sa gang du de lta bu'i grong tsho che chung mang po rim bzhin thon pa'i bya gzhag nang khri bzang yang ston gyis thabs dang byus bkod sogs byas rjes gzengs su thon pa zhig bzhag par brten khong la bod blon mdzangs pa'i mi bdun gyi lnga par grags pa'i mtshan snyan thob pa'o/gong du drangs pa'i lo rgyus kyi dpyad gzhi de dag gi thog nas/ btsan po srong btsan sgam pos skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi lam lugs 'og bod kyi thon skyed 'brel ba'i phyogs 'ga' zhig gi thad la bod 'bangs mang tshogs kyi re ba dang mthun pa'i phan yod kyi bcos sgrig dang / legs bcos nges can zhig gnang ba brgyud ngal rtsol pa'i hur brtson rang bzhin la skul 'ded byung bas bod yongs kyi thon skyed nus shugs gong du spel bar nus pa che tsam thon pa dang / rmang gzhi'i dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas byung ba de la brten nas spyi tshogs hril po'i phyogs gang ci'i thad sngon chad byung ma myong ba'i yar rgyas gzengs su thon pa'i mdzad rjes phul du byung ba ci 'dra zhig 'jog gnang mdzad yod pa rang res mthong thub kyi yod/52

le'u lnga pa/ bod sil bu dus kyi dpal 'byor skor/ (spyi lo 846—1253)gcig bod chen po sil bur 'thor tshul gyi lo rgyus/rgyal po 'u dum btsan nam glang dar mar grags pa de nyid lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes bod me stag(846)lor bkrongs pa'i dus de nas bzung btsun mo che chung gi sras gnyis srid dbang gzung rgyur kha ma 'chams par btsun mo gnyis dang blon po rnams nang khul mi mthun pa'i phyogs khag gnyis su gyur/ la las mnga' bdag 'od srung la rgyab skyor byas te srid dbang 'dzin pa'i re ba bcangs/ la las mnga' bdag yum brtan gyi rgyab langs bgyis nas srid dbang bzung thub pa'i 'dun pa bcangs/ mnga' bdag yum brtan gyi phyogs khag gis dbu ru bzung zhing / 'od srung kyi shog khas g.yo ru bzung nas bod me byi(856)lo nas bzung shog kha gnyis kyi dbar g.yul 'thab lo bcu gnyis tsam langs/ mthar yum brtan gyis 'od srung gi gdung rgyud rnams pham te mnga' ris kyi phyogs su bros/de'i blon 'bangs mang che ba lho mon gyi phyogs su bros shing / de gzhan rnams bod kyi yul gru phal mo cher khyab ste yul gru so sor che srid dang chung srid/ mang tshan dang nyung tshan/ gser ba dang g.yu ba/ sha zan dang rtsam zan zhes zer ba'i phyogs khag gnyis su gyes shing phan tshun bar nang 'khrug gi rgyun ma chad par byung dang 53

le'u lnga pa/ bod sil bu dus kyi dpal 'byor skore/(spyi lo 846—1253)gcig bod chen po sil bur 'thor chul gyi lo rgyas/rgyal po 'u dum btsan nam glang dar mar grags pa de nyid lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes bod me stag(846)lor bkrongs pa'i dus de nas bzung btsun mo che chung gi sras gnyis srid dbang gzung rgyur kha ma 'chams par btsun mo gnyis dang blon po rnams nang khul mi mthun pa'i phyogs khag gnyis su gyur/ la las mnga' bdag 'od srung la rgyab skyor byas te srid dbang 'dzin pa'i re ba bcangs la las mnga' bdag yum brtan gyi rgyab langs bgyis nas srid dbang bzung thub pa'i 'dun pa bcangs/ mnga' bdag yum brtan gyi phyogs khag gis dbu ru bzung zhing / 'od srung kyi shog khas g.yo ru bzung nas bod me byi(856)lo nas bzung shog kha gnyis kyi dbar g.yul 'thab lo bcu gnyis tsam langs/ mthar yum brtan gyis 'od srung gi gdung rgyud rnams pham te mnga' ris kyi phyogs su bros/de'i blon 'bangs mang che ba lho mon gyi phyogs su bros shing / de gzhan rnams bod kyi yul gru phal mo cher khyab ste yul gru so sor che srid dang chung srid/ mang tshan dang nyung tshan/ gser ba dang g.yu ba/ sha zan dang rtsam zan zhes zer ba'i phyogs khag gnyis su gyes shing phan tshun bar nang 'khrug gi rgyun ma chad par byung 5tāng

'byung mus kyi skabs/ gzhi rgya che shos kyi 'bangs gyen log rim par byung zhing /de'ang thog mar mdo khams phyogs nas dba'as kho bzher legs stong gis sde khrid byas nas gyen log byung la/ de nas rim bzhin dbu rur 'bro dang sbas 'khrugs pa byas pa la brten nas dba'as lo pho lo chung gis 'go khrid de gyen langs bgyis/de'i rjes lho kha dang / dwags po/ kong po bcas su mchims kong mi drug dang /shud phu stag rtse gnyags kyis 'go khrid gnang nas 'bangs gyen log byung ba sogs sa gnas so sor gcig rjes gnyis mthud kyis gyen log gi rlabs phreng g.yo bar gyur/ thengs 'di'i 'bangs gyen log ni bod kyi lo rgyus steng gzhi rgya che zhing dus yun ring ba/ sgrig 'dzugs ldan pa zhig yin stabs skabs de'i dbang bsgyur gral rim la rdung rdeg tsha nan zhig btang bar brten/ rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po dang /srong btsan sgam po'i gdung rgyud kyis bod spyi la dbang bsgyur ba'i dus rabs mjug sgril ba zhig bzos shing rje dpon tshan pa khag mang po byung nas bod sil bur gyur to/ /gnyis/ bod sil bu dus su bod yul du yod pa'icul phran skor/de ni bod me stag spyi lo846lor rgyal po 'u dum btsan nam glang dar ma zhes bya ba lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes bkrongs rjes sras 'od srung dang yum brtan gnyis bod chen po'i rgyal khab kyi rgyal rgyud 'dzin par kha ma 'chams nas srid dbang 'phrog rtsod kyi las su zhugs shing blon 'khor rnams kyang phyogs gnyis su gyes/ de ltar lo mang du phan tshun g.yul 'khrug bgyis pa dang bstun sngar bod kyi lo rgyus thog byung ma myong ba'i 'bangs gyen log gi rlabs phreng yul gru so so nas rim gyis g.yo bar gyur stabs/ btsan po'i gdung rgyud kyis bod la dbang bsgyur ba'i rnam pa 'thor zhig tu song / sa gnas so sor rje dpon mang du byung zhing yul gru bcad bzung gi 54

tshul gyis gcig 'og gcig tu mi gtogs pa'i rgyal phran sil mang po bzos ba'i dus skabs te/ dpal ldan sa skya bas bod chol ga gsum la dbang yongs su bsgyur ba'i dus kyi bar la bod sil ba'i dus skabs zhes brjod do/ / de skabs bod kyi yul du rgyal phran sil ma ha cang mang po btsugs yod kyang /de rnams kyi nang nas dbus gtsang dang stod mnga' ris phyogs su srid dbang che khag ni khri dar ma'i sras rtsod med 'od srung gi gdung rgyud kyis mnga' ris phyogs su btsugs pa'i la dwags rgyal rabs/ gu ge rgyal rabs/ spu rangs rgyal rabs dang ya tse rgyal rabs/ da rung yar lung 'phying ba stag rtse nas gzhi byas pa'i yar lung rgyal rgyud dang / dar ma'i gdung rgyud rdzun mar grags pa'i mnga' bdag yum brtan gyi gdung rgyud kyis btsugs pa'i lha sa'i rgyal rgyud sogs mang zhing / dus skabs der mdo phyogs su mtshon na'ang / gnam lde 'od srung gi rgyud pa khri lde bya ba 'di phyogs su byon nas tsong kha sde khams su btsugs pa'i tsong kha'i rgyal rgyud/dpa' ris bod lung drug sogs rgyal phran mang tsam chags yod la/ de bzhin du khams rgyal rong sogs su'ang rgyal phran mang po byung mod kyang 'dir dpe mtshon tsam mo/ /bod sil bu'i dus dkyil du bod khams yongs su zhing 'brog thon skyed la gong 'phel che tsam byung ba dang chabs cig sa gnas kyi lag shes bzo las dang / tshong las kyang 'phel rgyas che tsam byung ste gtsang gi tshong 'dus mgur mo dang / ding ri/gnya' nang bcas su tshong rwa chags 'go tshugs shing / stod mnga' ris kyi gu ge dang / byang gi lo rdeng khul du gser gyi gter kha thon pa/ lho kha dang ngam ring gnyis su dkar yol bzo ba'i lag rtsal dar ba bcas dpal 'byor gyi gnas tshulalegs pa'i phyogs 'gros 'go tshugs pa bcas so /55

gsum/ bod sil bu dus su dpal 'byor gong 'phel phyin tshul/bod sil bur 'thor te sa gnas srid dbang sil ma du ma byung zhing rang rang gi mtshan snyan dang srid dbang srung skyob byed phyir dus rabs bcu ba nas bcu gcig pa'i bar bod kyi chos lugs mi sna la gser mang po bskur te rgya gar sogs su btang nas paṇa grub bsten pa dang nang ba'i chos lugs bod du bsgyur shing dgon sde mang du btsugs pa dang / de dag kyang phan tshun 'gran rtsod kyis bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas spel te yul khams bde 'jags byung bas zhing 'brog thon skyed gong 'phel du phyin pa dang mnyam du lag shes bzo las dang gter las/ bzo bkod mdzes rtsal sogs ma nyams gong 'phel du phyin yod de/ mnga' ri'i gu ge dang /byang gi lo rdeng zeng zer ba'i sa nas gser kyi gter kha thon pa rgya che ste/ mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan gyis sman lung la sogs pa'i lha khang brgyad bzhengs pa dang / de'i sras nyi ma mgon gyis mnga' ris su byon nas srid dbang btsugs te spu ring sku mkhar nyi bzung brtsigs/de nas brgyud pa'i mnga' bdag lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi mtho lding dpal gyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs shing / gser nga bo bsags nas lo tsā ba rin bzang sogs bod phrug rig pa can dag rgya gar du btang ba dang paṇa grub gdan 'dren zhus pa/ khyad par lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyis gser mi'i lus bong gi tshad longs pa tsam bsags pa sogs kyis lha bla ma ye shes 'od gar log gi btson las grol bar mdzad kyang ma 'grub par jo bo a ti sha gdan 'dren mdzad yon du sbyar te bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mdzad pa dang / ya tshe'i rgyal rabs gsum pa grags ldes gser phye bre bdun cu tham pas 'jam dbyangs kyi sku dang / gser bre nyi shu rtsa bzhis mchod rten/ dngul dkar lnga brgya las phag mo dang lhan skyes/ dngul dkar 56

stong phrag las byams pa bcas bzhengs shing dam pa'i gsungs rab mang du bzhengs/de'i sras a so lde yis 'phags yul rdo rje gdan du ma chod pa'i rgyun btsugs/de'i sras 'dzi dar rmal gyis dngul gyi dgyes rdor bzhengs pa dang sras a nan rmal rdo rje gdan gsos shing gser gyi bka' 'gyur bzhengs/de'i sras re'u rmal gyis dngul dkar bzhi bcu las sman bla mched brgyad bzhengs shing lha sar jo bo'i dbu thog tu gser thog phub/ de'i sras 'dzi dar rmal dang a 'dzid rmal gyis gser bre bcu gcig las sgrol ma'i sku bzhengs/ de nas pri ti rmal dang blon po dpal ldan grags pas sa skya'i chos khri dang lha sa'i bcu gcig zhal la gser thog phub pa bcas yar lung gi rgyal rabs rnams dang skyid shod lha sa'i btsan po rnams kyis dbus gtsang gi mi bcu mdo smad du btang nas bstan pa'i me ro gsos nas dbus gtsang khams gsum la dgon sde khag bskrun cing bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mdzad / dus skabs der phyi rgyal la slob gnyer du song ba'i lo tsā ba brgya dang lnga bcu lhag byung ba de tshos rgya gar sogs su lo gsum nas nyi shu'i bar slob gnyer byed dgos pas/ slob yon dang rang nyid kyi 'gro song gser srang brgyad cu nas sum brgya lhag dgos pa'i dbang du btang na bsdom pas gser srang 'bum phrag gnyis tsam song bar grags pa dang / phyi phyogs nas paṇa grub bod du gdan drangs pa sdom pas mi grangs don sum son yod par gser gyi 'bul ba gong gsal ltar yin/ lho kha dang ngam ring gnyis su dkar yol sogs bzo ba'i lag rtsal thon yod ba bcas la dpags na bod sil bur 'thor ba'i dus skabs de nyid kyi dus dkyil nas dus smad tsam la bod kyi dpal 'byor ches 'phel rgyas su phyin yod pa shes thub la/ khyad par gser dngul phon chen po byung ba bcas kyi steng nas gter las dang btso sbyong gi lag rtsal tshad mthon por son cing lag shes bzo las dang bzo skrun/ mdzes rtsal sogs kyang khyab gdal du spel yod 57

stong phrag las byams pa bcas bzhengs shing dam pa'i gsungs rab mang du bzhengs/de'i sras a so lde yis 'phags yul rdo rje gdan du ma chod pa'i rgyun btsugs/de'i sras 'dzi dar rmal gyis dngul gyi dgyes rdor bzhengs pa dang sras a nan rmal rdo rje gdan gsos shing gser gyi bka' 'gyur bzhengs/de'i sras re'u rmal gyis dngul dkar bzhi bcu las sman bla mched brgyad bzhengs shing lha sar jo bo'i dbu thog tu gser thog phub/ de'i sras 'dzi dar rmal dang a 'dzin rmal gyis gser bre bcu gcig las sgrol ma'i sku bzhengs/ de nas pri ti rmal dang blon po dpal ldan grags pas sa skya'i chos khri dang lha sa'i bcu gcig zhal la gser thog phub pa bcas yar lung gi rgyal rabs rnams dang skyid shod lha sa'i btsan po rnams kyis dbus gtsang gi mi bcu mdo smad du btang nas bstan pa'i me ro gsos nas dbus gtsang khams gsum la dgon sde khag bskrun cing bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mdzad / dus skabs der phyi rgyal la slob gnyer du song ba'i lo tsā ba brgya dang lnga bcu lhag byung ba de tshos rgya gar sogs su lo gsum nas nyi shu'i bar slob gnyer byed dgos pas/ slob yon dang rang nyid kyi 'gro song gser srang brgyad cu nas sum brgya lhag dgos pa'i dbang du btang na bsdom pas gser srang 'bum phrag gnyis tsam song bar grags pa dang / phyi phyogs nas paṇa grub bod du gdan drangs pa sdom pas mi grangs don sum son yod par gser gyi 'bul ba gong gsal ltar yin/ lho kha dang ngam ring gnyis su dkar yol sogs bzo ba'i lag rtsal thon yod ba bcas la dpags na bod sil bur 'thor ba'i dus skabs de nyid kyi dus dkyil nas dus smad tsam la bod kyi dpal 'byor ches 'phel rgyas su phyin yod pa shes thub la/ khyad par gser dngul phon chen po byung ba bcas kyi steng nas gter las dang btso sbyong gi lag rtsal tshad mthon por son cing lag shes bzo las dang bzo skrun/ mdzes rtsal sogs kyang khyab gdal du spelabya sbyad

pa mtshon/ tshong zog gi thad la/ mnga' ris ding ri dang gnya' nang / gtsang gi lha rtse sogs dbus gtsang mdo khams khul du tshong 'dus tshugs nas sa khul so sos tshong zog brje re byung ba dang / song gong ma'i dus nas bzung rgya bod bar la tshong ra tshugs te rta dang ja brje res byas pa rim gyis gong 'phel phyin nas nyo tshong gi 'brel lam zab mo byung bas rgya bod mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba legs bcos dang thon skyed gong 'phel du phyin par shugs rkyen chen po thebs/ dus skabs der rta gcig gi rin thang 'bru khal bzhi dang / gser dngul gyi brjid tshad thang ni/ ba sran(dmar ru mgo nag ste rtswa'i 'bru gcig gi bajig tshad)gcig gi brjid tshad la se ba gang dang / se ba brgyad la zho gang / zho brgyad la srang gang / gser srang gang la dngul srang do/ gser sung bzhi la dngul srang brgyad/ de la dngul bre gang yin zhing / gser srang bcu drug la gser bre gang yin/ de la dngul bre do zer /dngul srang rnga bcu la dngul bre chen gcig bcas gtan 'khel byung yod/ de ltar 'bru rigs la 'jal byed bre sogs spen tshan rim pa mang du byung bas nyo tshong gi thad la gong 'phel byung ba de dag ni chos lugs khag gong 'phel du phyin pas/ spyi tshogs kyi bde 'jags la phan pas dpal 'byor gong du 'phel/58

pa mtshon/ tshong zog gi thad la/ mnga' ris ding ri dang gnya' nang / gtsang gi lha rtse sogs dbus gtsang mdo khams khul du tshong 'dus tshugs nas sa khul so sos tshong zog brje re byung ba dang / song gong ma'i dus nas bzung rgya bod bar la tshong ra tshugs te rta dang ja brje res byas pa rim gyis gong 'phel phyin nas nyo tshong gi 'brel lam zab mo byung bas rgya bod mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba legs bcos dang thon skyed gong 'phel du phyin par shugs rkyen chen po thebs/ dus skabs der rta gcig gi rin thang 'bru khal bzhi dang / gser dngul gyi brjid tshad thang ni/ ba sran(dmar ru mgo nag ste rtswa'i 'bru gcig gi brjig tshad)gcig gi brjid tshad la se ba gang dang / se ba brgyad la zho gang / zho brgyad la srang gang / gser srang gang la dngul srang do/ gser srang bzhi la dngul srang brgyad/ de la dngul bre gang yin zhing / gser srang bcu drug la gser bre gang yin/ de la dngul bre do zer /dngul srang rnga bcu la dngul bre chen gcig bcas gtan 'khel byung yod/ de ltar 'bru rigs la 'jal byed bre sogs spen tshan rim pa mang du byung bas nyo tshong gi thad la gong 'phel byung ba de dag ni chos lugs khag gong 'phel du phyin pas/ spyi tshogs kyi bde 'jags la phan pas dpal 'byor gong du 'phel/58

le'u drug pa/ sa skya ba'i dus kyi dpal 'byor skor/(1251—1354)gcig dpal ldan sa skya ba'i skabs bodakyi dpal 'byor yarargus byung tshul/spyir dpal ldan sa skya bas bod spyi la bgrang bya brgyar nye ba'i ring dbang 'dzin byas pa'i ring bod kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas 'gro bar phan nus nges can zhig bton pa yin te/ de'ang rgyal po glang dar gyi rjes bod sil bar thor rjes rgyal rgyud kyi dbar dbang cha rtsod slong gi nang 'khrug lo mang du langs pa dang /bod khams yongs la gcig gyur gyi dbang sgyur mkhan med pa'i rkyen gyis dpal 'byor sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad nyams rgud chen po thebs pa ni bshad ma dgos shing / lo rgyus kyi gnas bab de lta bu'i 'og hor gyi jing gir rgyal po'i stobs shugs bod du slebs te dus yun thung ngu'i nang hor khrims kyi nus pa la brten nas bod khams gcig gyur mdzad cing zhi bde'i khor yug cig bskrun thub pa byung /dus phyis mu mthud du hor se chen han gyi ring 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa gtsos ba'i sa skya ba bod kyi dbang 'dzin du bskos nas snga phyir dud tshang zhib bsher mdzad cing spyi tshogs kyi sgrig gzhi gtan phab gnang ba sogs kyi dbang gis rim 59

le'u drug pa/ sa skya ba'i dus kyi dpal 'byor skor/(1251—1354)gcig dpal ldan sa skya ba'iskabs bodakyi dpal 'byor yarasgyugazung tshul/spyir dpal ldan sa skya bas bod spyi la bgrang bya brgyar nye ba'i ring dbang 'dzin byas pa'i ring bod kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas 'gro bar phan nus nges can zhig bton pa yin te/ de'ang rgyal po glang dar gyi rjes bod sil bar thor rjes rgyal rgyud kyi dbar dbang cha rtsod slong gi nang 'khrug lo mang du langs pa dang /bod khams yongs la gcig gyur gyi dbang sgyur mkhan med pa'i rkyen gyis dpal 'byor sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad nyams rgyad chen po thebs pa ni bshad ma dgos shing / lo rgyus kyi gnas bab de lta bu'i 'og hor gyi jing gir rgyal po'i stobs shugs bod du slebs te dus yun thung ngu'i nang hor khrims kyi nus pa la brten nas bod khams gcig gyur mdzad cing zhi bde'i khor yug cig bskrun thub pa byung /dus phyis mu mthun du hor se chen han gyi ring 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa gtsos ba'i sa skya ba bod kyi dbang 'dzin du bskos nas snga phyir dud tshang zhib bsher mdzad cing spyi tshogs kyi sgrig gzhi gtan phab gnang ba sogs kyi dbang gis bya/ma

gyis nang 'khrug dang jag rkun gyi nyer 'tshe med par gyur te spyi tshogs brtan snying byung ba ltar yul so so nas sa zhing 'debs bkol lam 'brog las thon skyed slar gso thub pa byung zhing / dus mtshungs si khron kyi te'o med dang li kra'o gnyis su rgya bod mi rigs dbar thon rdzas brje res kyi tshong lam spel sa'i gzhi tshugs pa sogs bgyis pas tshong las yar rgyas su phyin pa des zhing 'brog thon skyed dang / mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho sngar lhag bskong ba ma zad/ bod kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas 'gro bar yang phan nus chen po zhig thon nges pa ni bshad ma dgos la/de ltar mi rigs bar gyi 'brel lam je zab tu song bar bstun nas kyang bod yul du hor dkar dang / hor gos/ hor sbub sogs kyis mtshon pa'i thon rdzas grags can mang po dang / lag shes bzo rtsal dper na dkar yol brtag thabs sogs sngar bas khyab cher dar tshul rgya bod yig tshang chen mor gsal/ gzhan yang go dan sogs kyi skabs bod kyi sde tshan so sos 'dab nor zhes pa'i 'bul rten lo shas ring sprod dgos byung na'ang / se chen han gong ma'i khri la bzhugs 'phral 'gro mgon 'phags pa dbu blar bkur ba nas bzung bla ma'i ngor dpal 'byor gong du 'phel pa'i phyir khral dang 'dab nor sogs mi dgos par byas shing / skabs de dag cig tu rgya khyon sngar byung ma myong pa'i sa skya'i lha khang chen mo lcags ri dang bcas pa gsar bskrun dang / nang gi sku gsung thugs rten sogs blo yul las 'das pa ches mang po 'dzugs skrun thub par bsam na skabs de'i bod kyi dpal 'byor sngar las 'phel rgyas su phyin yod pa ha cang gsal la/ mdor na/ dus skabs de lta de'i dus kyi nang bod yongs gcig gyur byung ba'i thog mes rgyal nang khul dang 'a~X ba'i sgo yongs su phye ba ma zad/ gzhan bal po dang / lho mon/ 'brug

gyis nang 'khrug dang jag rkun gyi nyer 'tshe med par gyur te spyi tshogs brtan lhing byung ba ltar yul so so nas sa zhing 'debs bkol lam 'brog las thon skyed slar gso thub pa byung zhing / dus mtshungs si khron kyi te'o med dang li kra'o gnyis su rgya bod mi rigs dbar thon rdzas brje res kyi tshong lam spel sa'i gzhi tshugs pa sogs bgyis pas tshong las yar rgyas su phyin pa des zhing 'brog thon skyed dang / mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho sngar lhag bskong ba ma zad/ bod kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas 'gro bar yang phan nus chen po zhig thon nges pa ni bshad ma dgos la/de ltar mi rigs bar gyi 'brel lam je zab tu song bar bstun nas kyang bod yul du hor dkar dang / hor gos/ hor sbub sogs kyis mtshon pa'i thon rdzas grags can mang po dang / lag shes bzo rtsal dper na dkar yol brtag thabs sogs sngar bas khyab cher dar tshul rgya bod yig tshang chen mor gsal/ gzhan yang go dan sogs kyi skabs bod kyi sde tshan so sos 'dab nor zhes pa'i 'bul rten lo shas ring sprod dgos byung na'ang / se chen han gong ma'i khri la bzhugs 'phral 'gro mgon 'phags pa dbu blar bkur ba nas bzung bla ma'i ngor dpal 'byor gong du 'phel pa'i phyir khral dang 'dab nor sogs mi dgos par byas shing / skabs de dag cig tu rgya khyon sngar byung ma myong pa'i sa skya'i lha khang chen mo lcags ri dang bcas pa gsar bskrun dang / nang gi sku gsung thugs rten sogs blo yul las 'das pa ches mang po 'dzugs skrun thub par bsam na skabs de'i bod kyi dpal 'byor sngar las 'phel rgyas su phyin yod pa ha cang gesal la/ mdor na/ dus skabs de lta de'i dus kyi nang bod yongs gcig gyur byung ba'i thog mes rgyal nang khul dang 'brel ba'i sgo yongs su phye ba ma zad/ gzhan bal po dang / lho mon/ 'brug 60

yul sogs phyogs mtha'i rgyal khab dag la'ang 'brel lam gang mthun gyis phyes par brten gnas bab bod kyi dpal 'byor gong 'phel gyi tshad nges can zhig tu slebs par sus kyang bsnyon ga la nus snyam mo/ / gnyis/ yon gong mas bod du sa mi dud rtsis byas pa'i skor/'di stag tshang dpal 'byor bzang po'i mdzad pa'i〈rgya bod yig tshang〉dang /lo rgyus gsar pa〈g.yu yi phreng ba〉sogs su gsal ba ltar na/ hor jing gi rgyal rgyud kyi stobs shugs la brten nas bod khams gcig 'gyur byung ba'i rjes su bod du sa rtsi/ dud bgrang byas/ rab byung bzhi pa'i lcab/sa sprel spyi lo1260lor mi chen dar sman gyis bod chol kha gsum la 'ja' mo 'dzugs skabs sa 'jal dud bgrang thengs gcig byas pa dang / rab byung lnga pa'i sa 'brug spyi lo1268lor se chen gong ma'i lung gis mngags pa'i dpon chen a kon dang / mi lin sogs kyis sa skya'i dpon chen shākya bzang po dang mnyam 'brel byas thog bod dbus gtsang mnga' ris dang bcas pa sa 'jal dud rtsis zhib cha byas te khri skor bcu gsum gyi sa ris phyes pa ni thengs gnyis pa dang / rab byung lnge pa'i me phag spyi lo1287lor yon gong mas mngags pa'i tho shu a bu gan dang / geb chag ta'i pheb chang sogs kyis sa skya'i dpon chen gzhon nu dbang phyug dang mnyam du them dud bskyar rtsis zhib gsher dang / 'ja' mo bskyar sgrig sogs byas te〈phye gsal chen mo〉zhes pa'i deb ther gsar 'god byas pa ni thengs gsum pa yin/ 'dir them dud zhib bsher byed pa'i skabs kyi rtsis gzhi hor dud zhes pa ni〈rgya bod yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed chen mo〉las/ hor rgyal po tho gan the mur rgyal sar phebs 61

yul sogs phyogs mtha'i rgyal khab dag la'ang 'brel lam gang mthun gyis phyes par brten gnas bab bod kyi dpal 'byor gong 'phel gyi tshad nges can zhig tu slebs par sus kyang bston ga la nus snyam mo/ / gnyis/ yon gong mas bod du sa mi dud rtsis byas pa'iskor/'di stag tshang dpal 'byor bzang po'i mdzad pa'i〈rgya bod yig tshanganyidang /lo rgyus gsar pa〈g.yu yi phreng ba〉sogs su gsal ba ltar na/ hor jing gi rgyal rgyud kyi stobs shugs la brten nas bod khams gcig 'gyur byung ba'i rjes su bod du sa rtsi/ dud bgrang byas/ rab byung bzhi pa'i lcab/sa sprel spyi lo1260lor mi chen dar sman gyis bod chol kha gsum la 'ja' mo 'dzugs skabs sa 'jal dud bgrang thengs gcig byas pa dang / rab byung lnga pa'i sa 'brug spyi lo1268lor se chen gong ma'i lung gis mngags pa'i dpon chen a kon dang / mi lin sogs kyis sa skya'i dpon chen shākya bzang po dang mnyam 'brel byas thog bod dbus gtsang mnga' ris dang bcas pa sa 'jal dud rtsis zhib cha byas te khri skor bcu gsum gyi sa ris phyes pa ni thengs gnyis pa dang / rab byung lnge pa'i me phag spyi lo1287lor yon gong mas mngags pa'i tho shu a bu gan dang / geb chag ta'i pheb chang sogs kyis sa skya'i dpon chen gzhon nu dbang phyug dang mnyam du them dud bskyar rtsis zhib gsher dang / 'ja' mo bskyar sgrig sogs byas te phye gsal chen mo〉zhes pa'i deb ther gsar 'god byas pa ni thengs gsum pa yin/ 'dir them dud zhib bsher byed pa'i skabs kyi rtsis gzhi hor dud zhes pa ni〈rgya bod yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed chen mo〉las/ hor rgyal po tho gan the mur rgyal sar ༷sdus

nas/ tho zhu a na khan bya ba dang / geb chag ta'i pheng chang mngags nas/dbus dpon chen gzhon nu bskyar ma'i skabs/ mi rtsis/ dud bgrangs/ hor dud bcas pa na 'di ltar snang ngo / / khang ba ka ba drug gi khyon gcig hor son khal bcu gnyis kyi sa/ mi bza' mi bu tsha/ bran 'khor pho mo dang bcas drug phyugs 'gel rmod bzhon gsum('gel ni rta bong dang / rmod ni mdzo g.yag glang / bzhon ni ba phyugs mdzo mo sogs la zer/) ra lug mgo chen gnyis la/ mgo se nyi shu rtsa bzhir yod pa/ de 'dra gcig la hor dud tshang gcigahor dud lnga bcu la rta mgo gcig de gnyis la brgya skor gcig de bcu la stong skor gcig de bcu la khri skor gcig khri skor lugs can tshang ma la lha sde stong skor bzhi dang / mi sde stong skor drug dgos pa yin 'dug khri skor gcig la klu gcig de bcu la zhing gcig zer ro/ / 'di bzhin brtsis pa'i zhing bcu gcig hor se chen rgyal po'i dus su mnga' 'og tu bcug pa yin 'dug cing /zhing gi ming ni/ ta'i tu mkhar nang na/ cong zhi zhing / (krung hu'u zhing) spyi so na ho nam zhing / (ho nan) zhing pi zhing / (ling sbas zhing) kas zu'i zhing / (kan su'u)si chon zhing / (si khron) g.yu nam zhing / (yun nan) gyang si zhing / (cang shis) gyang ca'i zhing / (cang kre'i) gu rum zhing / (dukong zhib)le'i yang zhing / bod chol kha gsum gyis zhing gcig ma longs na'ang / bla ma bzhugs gnas dang / sangs rgyas bstan pa dar pa'i sa phyogs yin pas zhing gcig tu bgrangs pas bcu gcig yin/ zhes gsungs/khri skor bcu gsum gsal bshad kyi skor la/ 〈g.yu yu phreng ba〉las/ yig rigs tha dad pa'i nang khri skor bcu gsum gyi ming 'dren tshul mi 'dra ba re zung yang 62

nas tshugs shog bla ma 'phags pa yar phebs dus/ 'byon lam bde dgos pa yin/ yang don gcig la/ khyod son jing dpon du bskos pa la/ bod kyi gnas lugs rnams zhib par go na/ gan pa'i bya ba chen po byed pa dang / mi mang po la phan pa yin pas song zhis gsungs nas/ bla ma'i bka' shog dang /rgyal po'i 'ja' sa dgos pa rnams gnang / das sman 'khor mang po dang bcas pa'i yar phyir gyis chas/ bod kyi ban skya rgan mgo drag rim/ spyir dgos la gnang sbyin gyi cha rkyen bzang po dang bcas pa/ gan mdzod che chung nas bskur te yar 'ong /thog mar bod du bstan pa phyi dar gyi chos byung sa yin pas/ mdo smad kyi sa dan tig shel gyi lha khang dang / mdo stod gtso mdo bas 'grub/ gtsang dpal ldan sa skya rnams su rim par/ mi mang por bsags/ gang la gang 'os kyi gnang sbyin sprad/ bka' lung rnams bsgrags shing / rgya bod kyi so mtshams nas/sa skya man la 'jam chen kun dril ba nyi shu rtsa bdun btsugs/ so sor phye na/mdo smad pa 'jam pas/ 'ja' mo bdun/ mdo stod la 'ja' mo dgudabus gtsang la 'ja' mo bcu gcig de'i nang nas kyang dbus pa 'ja' mo 'dzin dgos pa la/ shag rtsi ba/ sha pho/ rkong / dgon gsar/ gya ba dang bdun/ gtsang pas 'dzin dgos la/ stag tshong 'dus/ dar lung /grom mda' rong dang bzhi btsugs/ so so'i khri skor rnams kyis/ 'jam skyor 'dab pa'i bkod pa byas/ bod byings po la/ rgyal po yon mchod kyi bka' lung 'phrod/ sa skya 'khor/ bod spyi sgos kyi gnas lugs thams cad khong du zug nas/rgya~X 8po'i drung du slebs/ rgyu mtshan rnams zhus pas/ go chod 'dug gsungs/
