gsol ras dang / gnang sbyin bzang po byin/ son bying dben gyi khrims dar/rtsa ba'i dpon chen la bskos/ bod kyi 'ja' mo rnams gsar btsugs yin pas/'jags par byed pa'i mi gcig dgos par yod zhus pas/ mi chen i ji lag zer ba la/ bod 'jam shes pa'i 'ja' pa yin/ thong ji'i las kha byin nas yar la btang / de nas bzung ste/ hor sa skya pa yon du ji tsam 'brel gyi bar la/bod 'jam nyi shu rtsa bdun po bde mor 'jags pas/ bla ma dpon chen/ bod hor gyi gser yig pa rnams/ 'a byon lam bde zhing / bod 'bangs byings po skyid por byung skad/ 'di ni se chen rgyal pos/ sa skyar gser yig pa mngags pa'i sngon ma yin cing / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang / sa skya pa la shin tu dad pa'i mi dpon bzang po gcig byung 'dug pas/ rnam thar zur tsam bris pa yin/thong ji i ji lag gis/ bod 'jam thog tu ma slebs gong du/ hor rgyal pos/ljang yul la dmag thog byon dus/ mdo smad kyi 'ja' mo gnyis/ rgya 'jam gyi zhor la/ mar bsdus pa'i rim shugs rgyab pas/ mdo stod ga re go pa'i 'ja' mo gnyis/ dbus gtsang la drin che bar byung gda' 'o/ / hor se chen rgyal po'i dus/ bod khams chen po la/ mi rtsis dud bgrang byung ba'i dus/ mdo smad nas phar rtsis par 'dug pas/ ga chu rab kha na/ nang so la gtogs pa'i gzhis dang / gyang ga'i rtsa na/ bla ba mkhar dang / de'i 'og na/ dem khang gzhis bya ba yod pa/ de rnams bla ma 'phags pa la/ sa phud dang / lung gis phul nas/ gan 'jam la sogs rgya bod kyi khral dud gang yang mi 'khri ba gtsang mar yod pa la/ hor son lnga brgya'i sa yin par 'dugaces gsal ba 'di ni yon gong ma'i thugs khur dang gzigs skyong 'og 60gro

mgon chos rgyal 'phags pas bod yongs la dbang sgyur byed thub par byung ba dang /sa khul so sor bde 'jags kyi las tshan gsar 'dzugs byed thub par byung ba'i skor gyi lo rgyus rags rim tsam shes thub/bzhi/ sa skya pa'i dbang 'dzin dus rabs su bod kyi dpal 'byora'aphel rgyas skor/spyir na sa skya pas bod sa gnas kyi dbang 'dzin mi lo brgya la nye ba zhig byas pa de'i ring / bod kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas 'gro bar phan nus nges can zhig byung yod pa ma zad/ lhag par du bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas dar 'phel yong bar grub 'bras gzengs su thon pa zhig bzhag yod/thog mar bod kyi dpal 'byor thad skabs de'i spyi tshogs kyi 'du shes 'dzin stangs dbang gis lo rgyus yig cha khag gi nang / dpal 'byor 'phel 'grib kyi gnas tshul skor 'khod rigs ma rnyed stabs 'dir yang grangs tshad nges gtan gyi sgo nas gsal bshad zhu thabs bral mod/ 'on kyang dus skabs der bod kyi rig gnas la 'phel rgyas ha cang chen po zhig byung yod pa de'i thog nas/ spyi tshogs kyi dpal 'byor rmang gzhir 'phel rgyas byung med pa yin na/ rig gnas dar 'phel gyi 'phur mtshong 'byung mi srid pa de ni spyi tshogs 'phel tshul gyi rgyun shes yin pas de dus dpal 'byor la 'phel rgyas nges can zhig byung yod pa mtshon thub kyi yod/de yang bod sil bu'i dus yun ring po de'i stod char dang thog btsan po 'od srung dang yum brtan rgyal rgyud kyi dbar nang 'khrug lo bcu phrag ring brgyab pa dang /de rjes 'bangs gyen log gi 'khrug long langs pa/ mjug tu zhing pa bran bdag gsar rnying sogs che btsan dbar mi sde 'phrog res dang yul gru bcad bzung gi sde ga~X bcas zam mi 'chad pa byung bar brten rgya che'i zhing 'brog mang tshogs rnams

rgyun ldan gyi thon skyed bya rgyur bar chad yang yang 'phrad pa dang / g.yas bros g.yon byol mi byed thabs med kyis zhing pa rnams sa zhing dang kha bral zhing /'brog pa'i phyugs zog la'ang jag rkun gyi 'tshe ba rtag tu phog pa sogs bod kyi dpal 'byor la gtor bshig dang nyams gud tshabs chen byung ba ni g.yol thabs ga la yod/ de rjes bod sil bu'i smad char sangs rgyas chos lugs rim bzhin sa khyab rdo khyab gyur pa des phyogs gcig nas nang 'khrug sde gzar gyi dus zing de rim 'jags su 'gyur bar phan pa nges can zhig thob yod mod/ 'on kyang sde srid so sos thon skyed kyi cha rkyen bzang sar do dam byed pa tsam las/ rgya khyab kyi zhing 'brog thon skyed la skul 'ded dang / srung skyong sogs gcig gyur khrims srol gyi 'gan len gang yang med pa'i thog 'go gtsos gang 'dod de len gyi khral 'ul dang / chom rkun ar jag gi 'tshe ba sogs kyis mnar ba bcas la brten zhing 'brog mang tshogs rnams je dbul du gyur pas thon skyed kyi spro sems spu tsam med par gyur cing / khyu dang khyu byas te gang sar 'khyams nas lto bskor gnas bskor sprang slong gi 'tsho ba skyel rgyu'i dar srol rgya cher khyab stabs/ lo re nas lo re bzhin sa zhing mang po thal ba skya chags su lus pa dang / 'brog zog 'phro lus rnams bsad de za ba'am pham tshong rgyag pa sogs byas rkyen bod kyi dpal 'byor rmang gzhi yin pa'i zhing 'brog thon skyed de mu mthud je zhan je sdug tu 'gro bar su zhig gis kyang do 'khur byed mkhan med la/ byed thub thabs kyang med pa'i gnas su gyar yod/lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul de lta bu'i skabs hor jing gir rgyal rgyud kyi stobs shugs bod du slebs te yun thung nas hor khrims kyi 'og tu gcig gyur bzos nas zhi bde'i khor yug cig bskrun thub pa byung / de rjes yon gong mas bod sa gnas kyi dbang 'dzin sa skyar bar bskos nas snga phyir sa mi zhib bsher gyis hor dud 71

gtan 'bebs dang 'brel bod chol kha gsum du phye thog khri skor dang / stong skor/ brgya skor/ rta mgo sogs spyi tshogs kyi sgrig gzhi gtan la phab cing /bdag dbang dang 'gan 'khri/ 'bab 'os kyi pra/ la rigs sgrub rgyugs sogs gcig gyur gyi lam lugs bzos pa brgyud/ rim pa nas rim pas bdag gnyer dang / 'tsho skyong / skul 'ded bcas ma byas mthu med chags pa dang / dus mtshungs nang 'khrug 'jags shing jag rkun gyi nyer 'tshe med pa sogs spyi tshogs brtan lhing byung ba ltar bod kyi sa zhing 'debs bkol lam 'brog las thon skyed gang sar slar gso dang rim bzhin 'phel rgyas nges can zhig byung yod/dus mtshungs mes rgyal nang sa dang bod sa gnas dbar gyi 'brel lam gser zam rgya cher phye bar brten mi rigs phan tshun dbar thon rdzas brje res kyi tshong lam yang sngar bas gra rgyas su gyur yod/ yon rabs kyi yig rigs las drangs pa ltar na krung dbyang gong ma'i srid gzhung gis si khron gyi4te'o men 〉 dang4li kra'o 〉’sa gnas gnyis su rgya bod mi rigs dbar thon zog brje res byed sa'i ched gnyer gyi tshong ra yang btsugs par grags/ de ltar thon zog brje res dar rgyas su phyin pa des zhing 'brog thon skyed dang / mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho sngar lhag bskong ba ma zad/ bod kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas 'gro bar yang phan nus chen po zhig thon yod pa ni smos ci dgos/ mi rigs kyi 'brel ba dang 'gro 'ong dar 'phel byung bar brten nang sa'i thon rdzas grags can mang po dang / lag shes bzo rtsal sogs kyang bod du khyab myong ba ste dper na/ 〈rgya bod yig tshang〉nang dkar yol brtag pa bshad pa las 'byung ba ltar/6‘grags 'od ma zhes zer ba'i dkar yol ni/ / nang la pad brtsegs kha la pha gus bskor/ / ti shri grags pa 'od zer dus su byung / / rgyal bzang ma zhes bya ba'i dkar yol ni/ / yu ba dkar gzugs bzhin du ring ba la/ /72

gtan 'bebs dang 'brel bod chol kha gsum du phye thog khri skor dang / stong skor/ brgya skor/ rta mgo sogs spyi tshogs kyi sgrig gzhi gtan la phab cing /bdag dbang dang 'gan 'khri/ 'bab 'os kyi /bral rigs sgrub rgyugs sogs gcig gyur gyi lam lugs bzos pa brgyud/ rim pa nas rim pas bdag gnyer dang / 'tsho skyong / skul 'ded bcas ma byas mthu med chags pa dang / dus mtshungs nang 'khrug 'jags shing jag rkun gyi nyer 'tshe med pa sogs spyi tshogs brtan lhing byung ba ltar bod kyi sa zhing 'debs bkol lam 'brog las thon skyed gang sar slar gso dang rim bzhin 'phel rgyas nges can zhig byung yod/dus mtshungs mes rgyal nang sa dang bod sa gnas dbar gyi 'brel lam gser zam rgya cher phye bar brten mi rigs phan tshun dbar thon rdzas brje res kyi tshong lam yang sngar bas gra rgyas su gyur yod/ yon rabs kyi yig rigs las drangs pa ltar na krung dbyang gong ma'i srid gzhung gis si khron gyi te'o men mi dang4li kra'o ’ sa gnas gnyis su rgya bod mi rigs dbar thon zog brje res byed sa'i ched gnyer gyi tshong ra yang btsugs par grags/ de ltar thon zog brje res dar rgyas su phyin pa des zhing 'brog thon skyed dang / mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho sngar lhag bskong ba ma zad/ bod kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas 'gro bar yang phan nus chen po zhig thon yod pa ni smos ci dgos/ mi rigs kyi 'brel ba dang 'gro 'ong dar 'phel byung bar brten nang sa'i thon rdzas grags can mang po dang / lag shes bzo rtsal sogs kyang bod du khyab myong ba ste dper na/ 〈rgya bod yig tshang〉nang dkar yol brtag pa bshad pa las 'byung ba ltar/mgrags 'od ma zhes zer ba'i dkar yol ni/ / nang la pad brtsegs kha la pha gus bskor/ / ti shri grags pa 'od zer dus su byung / / rgyal bzang ma zhes 2bya ba'i dkar yol ni/ / yu ba dkar gzugs bzhin du ring ba la/ /

srab cing yang la dang ba gzhan las 'dren/ / sngo khra 'brug gis brgyan pa dag kyang yod/ / dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po dben shri yis/ / son jing dben gyi khrims ra bzung dus bzos/ /〉mizhes pa de tsho bla dpon so sos mngags bzo byas nas thon pa'i ming can gyi dkar yol du grags pa ma zad/ de min gyi hor dkar dang / hor gos/ hor spub ces pa la sogs pa rin thang che ba'i hor dus kyi dngos po rnying ma sna tshogs gang sar yod pa de dag thams cad kyang dus rabs de'i nang bod du khyab pa yin/ da dung bla ma 'phags pas nang sa nas bod du dkar yol bzo mi ched gnyer gnang ste sa skya'i nye 'dabs ga ra zhes pa'i lung par bzos pa'i thengs gnyis bod dkar yang byung ba yin te yig tshang nang / phas rtse zhes byar grags pa'i dkar yol ni/ / dpal ldan sa skya'i ga rar bzos pa yin/ / dkyil du yi ge sa gcig nges par yong / /ri zhes gsal ba dang / de bzhin gdung rabs las mi chen sam gha sa skyar slebs dus/ phabacags chung brang khang shar 'di khong gis bzhengs/ sgo'i g.yang tshe(bzo lta )yang rgya lugs su yod/〉 ces pa sogs zur tsam gsal ba de dag gi thog nas kyang skabs der nang sa nas 'dzugs skrun dang bzo rtsal sna tshogs bod du dar 'phel byung ba mthong thub pa yin/gzhan yang go dan sogs kyi skabs bod kyi sde tshan so sos sog por 'dab nor zhes pa'i 'bul rten lo shas ring sprod dgos byung rung / se chen han gong ma'i khri la 'khod nas bla ma 'phags pa ni ti shrir bkur ba dang bod 'di mes rgyal gyi gcig gyur mnga' khongs su gtogs pa nas bzung bla ma'i gsung ngor sa gnas kyi dpal 'byor tshags su tshud pa yong ched khral dang 'dab nor sogs rgyal khab la 'bul ma dgos pa gnang ba ste yig tshang las/73

srab cing yang la dang ba gzhan las 'dren/ / sngo khra 'brug gis brgyan pa dag kyang yod/ / dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po dben shri yis/ / son jing dben gyi khrims ra bzung dus bzos/ /7zhes pa de tsho bla dpon so sos mngags bzo byas nas thon pa'i ming can gyi dkar yol du grags pa ma zad/ de min gyi hor dkar dang / hor gos/ hor spub ces pa la sogs pa rin thang che ba'i hor dus kyi dngos po rnying ma sna tshogs gang sar yod pa de dag thams cad kyang dus rabs de'i nang bod du khyab pa yin/ da dung bla ma 'phags pas nang sa nas bod du dkar yol bzo mi ched gnyer gnang ste sa skya'i nye 'dabs ga ra zhes pa'i lung par bzos pa'i thengs gnyis bod dkar yang byung ba yin te yig tshang nang /phas rtse zhes byar grags pa'i dkar yol ni/ / dpal ldan sa skya'i ga rar bzos pa yin/ / dkyil du yi ge sa gcig nges par yong / /mi zhes gsal ba dang / de bzhin gdung rabs las mi chen sam gha sa skyar slebs dus/ rdzobacags chung brang khang shar 'di khong gis bzhengs/ sgo'i g.yang tshe(bzo lta )yang rgya lugs su yod/ mices pa sogs zur tsam gsal ba de dag gi thog nas kyang skabs der nang sa nas 'dzugs skrun dang bzo tsal sna tshogs bod du dar 'phel byung ba mthong thub pa yin/gzhan yang go dan sogs kyi skabs bod kyi sde tshan so sos sog por 'dab nor zhes pa'i 'bul rten lo shas ring sprod dgos byung rung / se chen han gong ma'i khri la 'khod nas bla ma 'phags pa ni ti shrir bkur ba dang bod 'di mes rgyal gyi gcig gyur mnga' khongs su gtogs pa nas bzung bla ma'i gsung ngor sa gnas kyi dpal 'byor tshags su tshud pa yong ched khral dang 'dab nor sogs rgyal khab la 'bul ma dgos pa gnang ba ste yig tshang las/ 73

ma bla ma de yi 'phrin las kyis/ / bod khams gangs ris bskor 'di la/ / rgyal po'i mdzod du 'dab nor dang / / khral dmag las gsum len pa med/ /mi ces gsal ba ltar yin cing / de las ldog ste yon gong mas bla ma la chos kyi 'bul ba thengs gcig kho nar gser bre brgya lhag pa dang / dngul bre stong ra can/gos dar bzhi khri la sogs phul bar grags pa ltar de 'dra'i 'bul chen lan mang gnang ba gdung rabs nang gsal ba ma zad/ da dung bod kyi dgon sde khag la bsten bkur dang / khral mi nyams thag rnams la rgud skyob sogs longs spyod kyi phan bde yang mi nyung ba zhig thob yod de yang spyir na yig tshang las/ /6 mi dbang rgyal po'i pho brang nas/ / bla ma'i gdan sa sa skya'i bar/ /ma dros pa nas chu bo bzhi/ / rgya mtsho chen por 'jug pa ltar/ /〉〉zhes gsal ba las mtshon zhing / bye brag zhib phra'i dpe mtshon tsam lo rgyus nang nas kyang mthong thub pa ste/ 〈rgya bod yig tshang〉las 'byung ba ltar na bla ma 'phags pa bod du phebs thengs snga maraphachu mig ring mor/ dbus gtsang mnga' ris dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun khri phrag 'ga' shas 'dus par chos 'khor bskor ba'i chas la/ gser srang 963 3dngul bre chen 9zab chen yug 41dar gos yug 838dar yug 5858ja sig chen 12)sbrang bur 603mar khal 13728nas khal 37018rtsam khal 8600gzhan yang phran tshes grangs med pa dang bcas bsnyen bkur ro/〉〉zhes gsal ba dang / de bzhin 'phags pa rin po che bod phebs thengs rjes ma'i skabs te me glang(1270)lo'i chu mig chos 'khor chen mo'i skabs su skye bo ser skya 'bum phrag longs pa la gza' 'khor gnyis kyi ring bsnyen bkur gzab rgyas gnang ba ma zad/ dge 'dun khri phrag bdun brgal ba la dge 'dun rer sku 'gyed gser zho gang re dang / snam bu sum snam re'i 'gyed gtong mdzad pa 74

pha bla ma de yi 'phrin las kyis/ / bodakhams gangs ris bskor 'di la/ / rgyal po'i mdzod du 'dab nor dang / / khral dmag las gsum len pa med/ /mi ces gsal ba ltar yin cing / de las ldog ste yon gong mas bla ma la chos kyi 'bul ba thengs gcig kho nar gser bre brgya lhag pa dang / dngul bre stong ra can/gos dar bzhi khri la sogs phul bar grags pa ltar de 'dra'i 'bul chen lan mang gnang ba gdung rabs nang gsal ba ma zad/ da dung bod kyi dgon sde khag la bsten bkur dang / khral mi nyams thag rnams la rgud skyob sogs longs spyod kyi phan bde yang mi nyung ba zhig thob yod de yang spyir na yig tshang las/ /sna mi dbang rgyal po'i pho brang nas/ / bla ma'i gdan sa sa skya'i bar/ /ma dros pa nas chu bo bzhi/ / rgya mtsho chen por 'jug pa ltar/ /〉 zhes gsal ba las mtshon zhing / bye brag zhib phra'i dpe mtshon tsam lo rgyus nang nas kyang mthong thub pa ste/ 〈rgya bod yig tshang〉las 'byung ba ltar na bla ma 'phags pa bod du phebs thengs snga mar chu mig ring mor/ dbus gtsang mnga' ris dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun khri phrag 'ga' shas 'dus par chos 'khor bskor ba'i chas la/ gser sung 963 3dngul bre chen 9zab chen yug 41dar gos yug 838dar yug 5858ja sig chen 120zang bur 603mar khal 13728nas khal 37018tsam khal 8600gzhan yang phran tshes grangs med pa dang bcas bsnyen bkur ro/〉 zhes gsal ba dang / de bzhin 'phags pa rin po che bod phebs thengs rjes ma'i skabs te me glang(1270)lo'i chu mig chos 'khor chen mo'i skabs su skye bo ser skya 'bum phrag longs pa la gza' 'khor gnyis kyi ring bsnyen bkur gzab rgyas gnang ba ma zad/ dge 'dun khri phrag bdun brgal ba la dge 'dun rer sku 'gyu/ gser zho gang re dang / snam bu sum snam re'i 'gyed gtong mdzad pa

bcas grwa grangs 'bor chen de lta bur gser zho'i 'gyed thob pa bod kyi lo rgyus snga phyi bar gsum du ma grags pa dang / dus mtshungs snam bu phon chen de tsam sdebs gcig la thon thub pa'i thog nas kyang skabs de'i bod kyi snam chas 'thag las 'phel rgyas chen po byung yod pa mthong thub/ de min skabs der gzhi rkye sngar byung myo nga med pa'i sa skya'i lha khang che mo lcags ri dang bcas pa gsar du bskrun cing /nang gi sku gsung thugs rten sogs bsam yul las 'das pa 'di dag gis gtso bor byas pa'i dpal ldan sa skya lho byang gi 'dzugs skrun mi rnams hang sangs dgos pa zhig byung ba bcas rlabs po che'i mdzad 'phrin de dag las kyang dus mtshams de'i bod kyi dpal 'byor sngar las 'phel rgyas byung ba mtshon thub pa yin/yon gong ma'i srid gzhung gis bla ma dang dgon sder rgyab skyor byas pa tsam du ma zad/ bod kyi khral mi nyams thag la rgud skyob gun gsab kyi lta skyong yang nges can zhig byas yod par grags/ yon rgyal rabs kyi yig rigs las drangs pa ltar na(spyi lo 1292bod rab byung lnga pa'i chu 'brug lo ) kri yon khri lo 29pa'i zla dgu pa'i nang / dbus gtsang gi zhon we hres snyan zhu 'byor par/ 'bri gung gling log byung rkyen bod 'bangs rnams dka' sbyong chen po 'phrad pas 'ja' mo lnga'i 'khri cha sgrub mi thub pa 'dug zhus par gong ma'i srid gzhung nas 'ja' mo lnga so sor rta brgya re dang / g.yag nyis brgya re/ ra lug lnga brgya re bcas rtsis pa'i rin thang dngul bsgyur gyi dngul sprod rgyu dang / dmag 'jam dud tshang bdun brgya sum cu so drug la dud tshang rer dngul srang lnga bcu re sprod ces bka' phab 〉’ pa dang / de rjes mdo smad dang mdo khams khul gyi 'ja' mo'i mi ser nyams thag rnams la'ang gong bzhin gyi rgud skyob sprad tshul gsal yod/de bzhin(spyi lo 1330bod rab byung drug pa'i lcags rta lo ) kri hrun khri lo dang por bod dang mdo smad kyi 'bangs rnams la lo nyes mu ge byung bar gong mas 75

bcas grwa grangs 'bor chen de lta bur gser zho'i 'gyed thob pa bod kyi lo rgyus snga phyi bar gsum du ma grags pa dang / dus mtshungs snam bu phon chen de tsam sdebs gcig la thon thub pa'i thog nas kyang skabs de'i bod kyi snam chas 'thag las 'phel rgyas chen po byung yod pa mthong thub/ de min skabs der gzhi rgya sngar byung myo nga med pa'i sa skya'i lha khang che mo lcags ri dang bcas pa gsar du bskrun cing /nang gi sku gsung thugs rten sogs bsam yul las 'das pa 'di dag gis gtso bor byas pa'i dpal ldan sa skya lho byang gi 'dzugs skrun mi rnams hang sangs dgos pa zhig byung ba bcas rlabs po che'i mdzad 'phrin de dag las kyang dus mtshams de'i bod kyi dpal 'byor sngar las 'phel rgyas byung ba mtshon thub pa yin/yon gong ma'i srid gzhung gis bla ma dang dgon sder rgyab skyor byas pa tsam du ma zad/ bod kyi khral mi nyams thag la rgyad skyob gun gsab kyi lta skyong yang nges can zhig byas yod par grags/ yon rgyal rabs kyi yig rigs las drangs pa ltar na(spyi lo 1292bod rab byung lnga pa'i chu 'brug lo ) kri yon khri lo 29pa'i zla dgu pa'i nang / dbus gtsang gi zhon we hres snyan zhu 'byor par/ 'bri gung gling log byung rkyen bod 'bangs rnams dka' sbyong chen po 'phrad pas 'ja' mo lnga'i 'khri cha sgrub mi thub pa 'dug zhus par gong ma'i srid gzhung nas 'ja' mo lnga so sor rta brgya re dang / g.yag nyis brgya re/ ra lug lnga brgya re bcas rtsis pa'i rin thang dngul bsgyur gyi dngul sprod rgyu dang / dmag 'jam dud tshang bdun brgya sum cu so drug la dud tshang rer dngul srang lnga bcu re sprod ces bka' phab mi pa dang / de rjes mdo smad dang mdo khams khul gyi 'ja' mo'i mi ser nyams thag rnams la'ang gong bzhin gyi rgud skyob sprad tshul gsal yod/de bzhin(spyi lo 1330bod rab byung drug pa'i lcags rta lo ) kri hrun khri lo dang por bod dang mdo smad kyi 'bangs rnams la lo nyes mu ge byung bar gong 3sdus

'brel yod kyi dpon rigs tshor bka' phab nas 'bru rigs kyi skyob gso gnas /mi zhes 'khod yod pa bcas ni dpe mtshon tsam yin/ gzhan yang yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed nang 'khod pa ltar yon gong ma se chen rgyal po dang / bla ma 'phags pa'i sku drin las dbus gtsang mdo khams thams cad mnga' zhabs su chug na'ang /lho mon gyi sa mi rnams ji bzhin rang ma chug pa ma zad/ shar dung dang lho dung zer ba'i dung rengs mang pos bod lho rgyud kyi yul pa bcom 'phrog yang yang yong gi yod pa de dag kyang / spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu bzhi pa'i dus 'gor sa skya'i bla chen bzang po dpal ba'i sku dus su khams pa dge 'dun rgyal mtshan dang / dpon yig 'phags pa dpal sogs sa skya'i drung 'khor mi bdun gyis 'go byas khri stong so so nas yul dmag bskongs te zhi drag thabs mkhas kyis thog mar lho mon khul shar dung gang yod dbang du bsdus/ de nas phag ri phyogs gye sgar spos nas lho dung gi 'go pa drag tshad brgya dang drug cu tsam tshar bcad nas lho 'brug gi yul dbang du bsdus pa bcas kyi lo rgyus zhib pa rgya bod yig tshang nang gsal ba dang / de nas bzung bod yul bde 'jags su 'khod nas zhing 'brog gi thon skyed las sgo rnams blo bde bag phebs kyis 'phel rgyas su 'gro thub pa byung yod/ mdor na dus skabs de'i nang bod yongs gcig gyur byung ba'i thog mes rgyal nang sa dang 'brel ba'i rgyal sgo chen po phye ba dang / de bzhin bal yul dang / lho mon/'brug yul sogs phyogs mtha'i 'brel sgo dag kyang phye ba bcas la brten bod sa gnas kyi dpal 'byor dar zhing gra rgyas kyi phyogs su 'phel rgyas nges can zhig byung ba lags so/76

'brel yod kyi dpon rigs tshor bka' phab nas 'bru rigs kyi skyob gso gnas /mi zhes 'khod yod pa bcas ni dpe mtshon tsam yin/ gzhan yang yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed nang 'khod pa ltar yon gong ma se chen rgyal po dang / bla ma 'phags pa'i sku drin las dbus gtsang mdo khams thams cad mnga' zhabs su chug na'ang /lho mon gyi sa mi rnams ji bzhin rang ma chug pa ma zad/ shar dung dang lho dung zer ba'i dung rengs mang pos bod lho rgyud kyi yul pa bcom 'phrog yang yang yong gi yod pa de dag kyang / spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu bzhi pa'i dus 'gor sa skya'i bla chen bzang po dpal ba'i sku dus su khams pa dge 'dun rgyal mtshan dang / dpon yig 'phags pa dpal sogs sa skya'i drung 'khor mi bdun gyis 'go byas khri stong so so nas yul dmag bskongs te zhi drag thabs mkhas kyis thog mar lho mon khul shar dung gang yod dbang du bsdus/ de nas phag ri phyogs sum̐ sgar spos nas lho dung gi 'go pa drag tshad brgya dang drug cu tsam tshar bcad nas lho 'brug gi yul dbang du bsdus pa bcas kyi lo rgyus zhib pa rgya bod yig tshang nang gsal ba dang / de nas bzung bod yul bde 'jags su 'khod nas zhing 'brog gi thon skyed las sgo rnams blo bde bag phebs kyis 'phel rgyas su 'gro thub pa byung yod/ mdor na dus skabs de'i nang bod yongs gcig gyur byung ba'i thog mes rgyal nang sa dang 'brel ba'i rgyal sgo chen po phye ba dang / de bzhin bal yul dang / lho mon/'brug yul sogs phyogs mtha'i 'brel sgo dag kyang phye ba bcas la brten bod sa gnas kyi dpal 'byor dar zhing gra rgyas kyi phyogs su 'phel rgyas nges can zhig byung ba lags so/76

le'u bdun pa/ phag gru'i dus su dpal 'byor skor/(1354—1618)gcig phag gru sdebadami srid dbang dngos su btsugs pa/yon gong ma'i lung rtags thob pa'i khri dpon ni yon chen sangs rgyas skyabs kyi sras grags pa brtson 'grus yin zhing / 'di gdan sa ba yin skabs ldan ma sgom brtson spyi dpon byas na'ang de 'dra legs po ma byung stabs rdo rje dpal khri dpon du bskos/ rgyal sa sne gdong du brtsigs shing gzhis rdzong bcu gsum brtsigs pa sogs dar rgyas che bar grags/ de'i rjes gzhon nu rgyal mtshan dang / rin rgyal/byang gzhon/ gzhon nu yon tan sogs rim pas khri dpon byas dus glu bro dang nag chang la g.yeng nas srid kyi bya bzhag shor pas yul sde mang bo lag nas shor/de nas mi drug gis re zhig khri dpon gyi tshab byas/ de'i rjes grags pa rin chen thil gyi gdan sar phebs te bla dpon sbrags ma mdzad/ thabs mkhas kyis gzhan la shor ba'i yul sde phyir blangs/ phag grur bka' drin che bar grags/ de'i rjes rgyal mtshan bzang bo dang rgyal mtshan skyabs gnyis rim par khri dpon byas kyang /'jon thang zhan stabs yul sde mang bo g.ya' bzang ba sogs kyis 'phrog de'i rjes byang chub rgyal mtshan(1302—1364)gyis khri dpon mdzad/ chung stes

le'u bdun pa/ phag gru'i dus su dpal 'byor skor/(1354—1618) gcig phab gru sde srid kyi srid dbang dngos su btsugs pa/yon gong ma'i lung rtags thob pa'i khri dpon ni yon chen sangs rgyas skyabs kyi sras grags pa brtson 'grus yin zhing / 'di gdan sa ba yin skabs ldan ma sgom brtson spyi dpon byas na'ang de 'dra legs po ma byung stabs rdo rje dpal khri dpon du bskos/ rgyal sa sne gdong du brtsigs shing gzhis rdzong bcu gsum brtsigs pa sogs dar rgyas che bar grags/ de'i rjes gzhon nu rgyal mtshan dang / rin rgyal/byang gzhon/ gzhon nu yon tan sogs rim pas khri dpon byas dus glu bro dang nag chang la g.yeng nas srid kyi bya bzhag shor pas yul sde mang bo lag nas shor/de nas mi drug gis re zhig khri dpon gyi tshab byas/ de'i rjes grags pa rin chen thil gyi gdan sar phebs te bla dpon sbrags ma mdzad/ thabs mkhas kyis gzhan la shor ba'i yul sde phyir blangs/ phag grur bka' drin che bar grags/ de'i rjes rgyal mtshan bzang bo dang rgyal mtshan skyabs gnyis rim par khri dpon byas kyang /'jon thang zhan stabs yul sde mang bo g.ya' bzang ba sogs kyis 'phrog de'i rjes byang chub rgyal mtshan(1302—1364)gyis khri dpon mdzad/ chung dus 77

gzhung rig gnas la sbyangs/ dgung lo bcu bzhi'i steng sa skyar phebs te bla ma mang bo bsten nas chos srid gnyis kur slob gnyer mthar phyin pa mdzad/ sa skya bas khong la gong ma'i bka' them stag mgo ma gnang ste chu khyi lor(1322)khri dpon du bskos nas sne gdong rtsis blangs/ srid bzung ste mnga' khongs kyi gzhis ka nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams pa gong 'phel btang / yul gru so sor skye shing 'dzugs pa dang / chu rjen la zam pa skrun pa/ sne gdong pho brang rgya bskyed btang zhing 'bangs sde tshul bzhin bskyangs pas mnga' thang dar bar gyur/ khri dpon snga ma'i dus shor ba'i yul sde rnams tshur blangs pas g.yang bzang ba ma dga' nas dmag thengs mang drangs shing kha mchu gtugs bsher byas kyang / g.ya' bzang ba'i rgyab tu tshal ba dang 'bri gung khri dpon yod pa dang / sa skya'i dpon chen rnams kyang g.ya' bzang ba'i phyogs su langs stabs kha mchu thag ma bcad par dmag 'khrug byung skabs phag gru pham/ de nas sa skya'i dpon chen dbang phyug dpal ba'i drung du g.ya' phag gnyis gtugs bsher byas/ phag gru bar bden che tsam yod kyang phyogs 'then gyis g.ya' bzang ba rgyal/ de nas sa skyas rang gi nang tshan pa'i gas bsod nams rgyal mtshan phag gru'i khri dpon du bskos nas sne gdong la song yang byang chub rgyal mtshan ston thog la bos nas bzang btson la bcug ste zhi drag bya thabs gang mang spyad de khri dpon len rtsis byas kyang byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis go sa ma sprad pas sa skya'i dpon chen dbang brtson gyis byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis ngas sa skya gong ma dang skya ser la gnod pa'i bya ba ma byas pas khri dpon gyi las ka mi sprod ces bshad mthar dbang brtson thabs zad nas phyir btang / de rjes lcags yos(1351)lor g.ya' phag slar 'khrug ste phag gru rgyal na/ 8g.ya' bzang dgon dang gzhis ka rtsis blangs/ sa skya'i dpon chen rgyal

gzhung rig gnas la sbyangs/ dgung lo bcu bzhi'i steng sa skyar phebs te bla ma mang bo bsten nas chos srid gnyis kur slob gnyer mthar phyin pa mdzad/ sa skya bas khong la gong ma'i bka' them stag mgo ma gnang ste chu khyi lor(1322)khri dpon du bskos nas sne gdong rtsis blangs/ srid bzung ste mnga' khongs kyi gzhis ka nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams pa gong 'phel btang / yul gru so sor skye shing 'dzugs pa dang / chu rjen la zam pa skrun pa/ sne gdong pho brang rgya bskyed btang zhing 'bangs sde tshul bzhin bskyangs pas mnga' thang dar bar gyur/ khri dpon snga ma'i dus shor ba'i yul sde rnams tshur blangs pas g.ya' bzang ba ma dga' nas dmag thengs mang drangs shing kha mchu gtugs bsher byas kyang / g.ya' bzang ba'i rgyab tu tshal ba dang 'bri gung khri dpon yod pa dang / sa skya'i dpon chen rnams kyang g.ya' bzang ba'i phyogs su langs stabs kha mchu thag ma bcad par dmag 'khrug byung skabs phag gru pham/ de nas sa skya'i dpon chen dbang phyug dpal ba'i drung du g.ya' phag gnyis gtugs bsher byas/ phag gru bar bden che tsam yod kyang phyogs 'then gyis g.ya' bzang ba rgyal/ de nas sa skyas rang gi nang tshan pa'i gras bsod nams rgyal mtshan phag gru'i khri dpon du bskos nas sne gdong la song yang byang chub rgyal mtshan ston thog la bos nas bzang btson la bcug ste zhi drag bya thabs gang mang spyad de khri dpon len rtsis byas kyang byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis go sa ma sprad pas sa skya'i dpon chen dbang brtson gyis byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis ngas sa skya gong ma dang skya ser la gnod pa'i bya ba ma byas pas khri dpon gyi las ka mi sprod ces bshad mthar dbang brtson thabs zad nas phyir btang / de rjes lcags yos(1351)lor g.ya' phag slar 'khrug ste phag gru rgyal nas g.ya' bzang dgon dang gzhis ka rtsis blangs/ sa skya'i dpon chen rgyal 78

bzang yar lung du phebs nas rgyad bshad rgyu byas kyang byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis thel tshe mer bsregs pas len rgyu ma byung ba dang / khong gi bka' bzhin blon rnams kyis sne gdong ma sprad pas byang chub rgyal mtshan sa skyar btson la bcugaskabs der dbang brtson gyis hor rgyal la 'brel ba byas te rgyal bzang gi dbang cha 'phrog rtsis yod pa rgyal bzang gis shes nas lkog tu byang chub rgyal mtshan shor ba ltar btang / chu 'brug(1352)lor phag grus dmag btegs te g.ya' bzang pa yongs su blangs/ de nas dbang brtson gyis glo bur rgyal bzang btson la bcug cing dmag khrid nas sne gdong du song ba dang / byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis kyang dmag bsdus nas 'thab pas phag gru rgyal/ skabs der sa skya'i bla ma dam pa dang dbus gtsang gi mi chen tshos bar 'dum byas pa dang rgyal bzang btang pas re zhig bde la bab/ lo shas song rjes rgyal bzang 'das pa dang sa phag bar slar dmag 'thab byung zhing phag gru'i dpung stobs kyis sa skya ba yongs su blangs te dpon chen bzung zhing las rogs pa tshang ma khrims la sbyar nas phag grus bod chol kha gsum la dbang bsgyur to/ / de ltar sa skya'i srid dbang mjug sgril nas yon gyis gnang ba'i gna' rdzas dang dngos rigs gal che ba rnams 'phrog shing rta(1354)lor drung chen shes rab bkra shes gong ma'i mdun du btang zhing / yon gong ma tho bkan the mur la gnas tshul ji bzhin zhus mthar gong mas kyang dngos yod gnas tshul la gzhigs shing dus bde zhod 'jags yong ba'i ched du khri dpon byang chub rgyal mtshan la ta si tu gong ma'i las rogs pa chen mo'i go gnas dang bod yongs la dbang sgyur chog pa'i bka' shog dang tham ga bcas gnang zhing phag gru'i srid dbang dngos su btsugs so/ /khong gis srid bzung ma thag srid 'dzin gyi sgrig gzhi dang khrims srol /sdus

gsar bcos mdzad/ sngon gyi dpon chen gyi go gnas med par btang ste sde srid btsugs/ khri skor gyi lugs med par bzos nas gzhis ka dang / rdzong rnams nyams gso mdzad de rdzong bcu gsum btsugs/ zhing 'brog gi khral 'os 'bebs shig las hor ltar khral chen bsdu mi chog par mdzad/ sngon sa skya'i khrims lugs la hor gyi shan zhugs nas sdig pa'i las shos che bas gsar du khrims yig zhal lce bco lnga sogs gtan la phab/ stong 'jal lugs la mi rab 'bring tha gsum su dbye nas bud med dang / mgar ba/ bshan pa/ rdza mkhan rnams tha mar brtsis te bsad kyang stong dres thag gcig 'bul ba'am stong 'jal srang bcu nas bco lnga bar gtan 'bebs gnang yod pa des skabs de'i bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi khrims srol mngon gsal du bud kyang gang ltar bka' khrims zhib pas spyi tshogs bde 'jags yin stabs rgan mo gser khur gyi dus zhes grags/gnyis/ phag gru skabs su dpal 'byor 'phelacus skor/bod kyi dpal 'byor dang rig gnas yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel rgyas 'gro ba'i lo rgyus kyi dus mtshams shig yin/ de yang phag gru ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis lo rgyus thog gi srid dbang 'dzin mkhan mang po'i chab srid skyong stangs kyi lo rgyus la phyogs bsdoms nan tan mdzad de rang gi sde srid skyong stangs kyi bya thabs gsar pa dang / srid 'dzin gyi sgrig gzhir bsgyur bcos byas yod/ ta'i si tu'i gtan 'bebs de dag nas dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi skabs rdzong gzhis kha 'dzin gtan 'jags sprod pa'i lam lugs sogs phyis kyi sde srid rim pas skabs so so'i dngos yod gnas tshul la gzhigs pa'i 'gyur ldog che chung ci rigs byung yod kyang / rtsa ba'i cha nas ta'i si tu'i bka' chems nang gtan la phab pa rnams ni 80

skabs de'i spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi chos nyid dang cung 'tshams thub pa byung ba des bod kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas 'gro bar nus pa chen po thon yod/ dper na/sa skya pas bod la dbang bsgyur byed skabs khri dpon gyi lam lugs de ni bla ma dang /mi dpon che khag gis dbang ris bcad bzung mi mus rgyud bcas sger 'dzin chog pa des rang rang gi zhe 'khon phra mo la brten nas phan tshun dbang ris 'phrog res dang / yul gru yas mas du mar sde gzar mang po byung ba ma zad/ skabs de'i bod khams spyi la dbang sgyur mkhan sa skya par bltos na'ang bla brang khag mang por gyes pa dang / dpon chen dbar gyi 'gal ba la sogs pa'i rgyu mtshan sne mang gis gsham 'og gi zir bun sa skya pas gcun 'doms mi thub pa sogs kyi rgyu rkyen la brten nas zhing 'brog mang tshogs kyi thon skyed rgyun gtan ltar byed mi thub pas 'tsho bar shugs ma thub kyis gnod skyon yong rgyu g.yol thabs med pa bcas rmang gzhi dpal 'byor dang steng gi bkod pa 'tsham po ma byung bas srid dbang yang lo grangs bdun cu brgal tsam ma gtogs rgyun 'khyongs ma thub cing / ta'i si tu nas dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan bar mi lo sum cu lhag ring rdzong gzhis khag gi sne mo ba res bskor/ gnas skabs kyi kha 'dzin tsam med pas spyi tshogs brtan snying byung ba des zhing 'brog mang tshogs kyi thon skyed gong 'phel gtong ba'i go skabs bzang po thob par brten mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba yar rgyas byung yod/ 'on kyang dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi sku dus rdzong gzhis khag gcig kha 'dzin gtan 'jags byed pa'i lam srol du 'gyur ba byung ba des khong gi srid dbang skyong ring phag gru'i blon po rnams gzhung sems dag pa la sogs pa'i rkyen gyis phan pa'i cha las gnod pa'i phyogs mngon gsal mi che yang dbang graṭa pa 'byung gnas kyi skabs nas bzung sa skya pa'i dus kyi nad ro bskyar ldang lta bus rdzong gzhis sger bzung byas pa tshang 8/ra

skabs de'i spyi tshogs 'phel rgyas kyi chos nyid dang cung 'tshams thub pa byung ba des bod kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas 'gro bar nus pa chen po thon yod/ dper na/sa skya pas bod la dbang bsgyur byed skabs khri dpon gyi lam lugs de ni bla ma dang /mi dpon che khag gis dbang ris bcad bzung mi mus rgyud bcas sger 'dzin chog pa des rang rang gi zhe 'khon phra mo la brten nas phan tshun dbang ris 'phrog res dang / yul gru yas mas du mar sde gzar mang po byung ba ma zad/ skabs de'i bod khams spyi la dbang sgyur mkhan sa skya par bltos na'ang bla brang khag mang por gyes pa dang / dpon chen dbar gyi 'gal ba la sogs pa'i rgyu mtshan sne mang gis gsham 'og gi zir bun sa skya pas gcun 'doms mi thub pa sogs kyi rgyu rkyen la brten nas zhing 'brog mang tshogs kyi thon skyed rgyun gtan ltar byed mi thub pas 'tsho bar shugs ma thub kyis gnod skyon yong rgyu g.yol thabs med pa bcas rmang gzhi dpal 'byor dang steng gi bkod pa 'tsham po ma byung bas srid dbang yang lo grangs bdun cu brgal tsam ma gtogs rgyun 'khyongs ma thub cing / ta'i si tu nas dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan bar mi lo sum cu lhag ring rdzong gzhis khag gi sne mo ba res bskor/ gnas skabs kyi kha 'dzin tsam med pas spyi tshogs brtan lhing byung ba des zhing 'brog mang tshogs kyi thon skyed gong 'phel gtong ba'i go skabs bzang po thob par brten mang tshogs kyi 'tsho ba yar rgyas byung yod/ 'on kyang dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi sku dus rdzong gzhis khag gcig kha 'dzin gtan 'jags byed pa'i lam srol du 'gyur ba byung ba des khong gi srid dbang skyong ring phag gru'i blon po rnams gzhung sems dag pa la sogs pa'i rkyen gyis phan pa'i cha las gnod pa'i phyogs mngon gsal mi che yang dbang graṭa pa 'byung gnas kyi skabs nas bzung sa skya pa'i dus kyi nad ro bskyar ldang lta bus rdzong gzhis sger bzung byas pa tshang mar 81

rang rang gi dbang ris srung skyob byed pa'i ched da dung dmag go hrag mang nyung la ma bltos pa re sger nyar bya rgyu khrims mthun can du gyur pa de la/ phag gru sde srid phyogs nas the jus gang yang byed thub med pas phyis sde dpon so so'i dpung stobs je che gyur thog kar dge grub mtha'i phyogs lhung dang 'grogs pa sogs dbus gtsang gang sar sde gzar gyi me lce 'bar ba'i khrod nas phag gru'i srid dbang yang yam yom ngang mthar ming tsam du gyur pa bcas phag gru sde srid kyi ngos nas bshad nas gnas kyi drag dpung la gcig gyur gyi do dam ma thub pas gsham 'og sde dpon gyi dpung stobs nges can byung ba'i mtshams sde srid kyi bkod 'og mi 'du ba ma zad/kha gtad gcog pa'i gnas tshul du 'phel rgyas byung ste mthar rang gi srid dbang mi gnas pa'i rgyu rkyen du gyur yod/ 'on kyang chab 'babs mi ser gyi ngos nas bshad na phag gru sde srid kyi dus su sa gnas drag dpung la brten pa'i chab 'bangs mi ser tshor lag 'don gyi 'khri cha med pa dang / phag gru rang gi gzhung 'dzin byed pa tshud pa'i sger drag phan tshun sde gzar skabs bsdu rub bya dgos pa'i dmag 'gro rnams la'ang sgor khag so so nas 'tsho ba'i thad 'os 'tshams bkod sgrig ma byas mthu med dang bcas phag gru'i dus der chab 'bangs mi ser la rgyun gtan rkang 'gro lag 'don gyi khral rigs las/ dmag don la bsnyad pa'i khral rigs gsar 'gol gyi gtser bsun che ba med 'dra ba bcas gang ltar phag mo gru pa'i dus ni spyir btang nas bshad na bod kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang / mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba yar rgyas kyi skabs shig red ces bshad na mi rung ba med/ 'on kyang skabs de'i dpal 'byor grangs 'bor 'khod pa'i yig lam dkon pas bsdur tshad nges gtan brjod mi spobs kyang / skabs de'i bod kyi rig gnas dang / 'dzugs skrushā sdu sogs pa'i gnas tshul nas gnad don de ltar yin pa'i gsal bshad thub

rang rang gi dbang ris srung skyob byed pa'i ched da dung dmag go hrag mang nyung la ma bltos pa re sger nyar bya rgyu khrims mthun can du gyur pa de la/ phag gru sde srid phyogs nas the jus gang yang byed thub med pas phyis sde dpon so so'i dpung stobs je che gyur thog kar dge grub mtha'i phyogs lhung dang 'grogs pa sogs dbus gtsang gang sar sde gzar gyi me lce 'bar ba'i khrod nas phag gru'i srid dbang yang yam yom ngang mthar ming tsam du gyur pa bcas phag gru sde srid kyi ngos nas bshad nas gnas kyi drag dpung la gcig gyur gyi do dam ma thub pas gsham 'og sde dpon gyi dpung stobs nges can byung ba'i mtshams sde srid kyi bkod 'og mi 'du ba ma zad/kha gtad gcog pa'i gnas tshul du 'phel rgyas byung ste mthar rang gi srid dbang mi gnas pa'i rgyu rkyen du gyur yod/ 'on kyang chab 'bangs mi ser gyi ngos nas bshad na phag gru sde srid kyi dus su sa gnas drag dpung la brten pa'i chab 'bangs mi ser tshor lag 'don gyi 'khri cha med pa dang / phag gru rang gi gzhung 'dzin byed pa tshud pa'i sger drag phan tshun sde gzar skabs bsdu rub bya dgos pa'i dmag 'gro rnams la'ang sger khag so so nas 'tsho ba'i thad 'os 'tshams bkod sgrig ma byas mthu med dang bcas phag gru'i dus der chab 'bangs mi ser la rgyun gtan rkang 'gro lag 'don gyi khral rigs las/ dmag don la bsnyad pa'i khral rigs gsar 'gel gyi gtser bsun che ba med 'dra ba bcas gang ltar phag mo gru pa'i dus ni spyir btang nas bshad na bod kyi dpal 'byor 'phel rgyas dang / mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba yar rgyas kyi skabs shig red ces bshad na mi rung ba med/ 'on kyang skabs de'i dpal 'byor grangs 'bor 'khod pa'i yig lam dkon pas bsdur tshad nges gtan brjod mi spobs kyang / skabs de'i bod kyi rig gnas dang / 'dzugs skrun la sogs pa'i gnas tshul nas gnad don de ltar yin pa'i gsal bshad thub 82

bo/gsum/ bodakhams 'dzugs skrun gyi skor/1 lha khangadang rtenagasumagasar bzhengs byung tshul/bod kyi ljongs 'di yul gru rgya che zhing / srid 'dzin sa khongs gu yangs pa'i stabs kyis yul gang skyid dang / lung ba gang bde la/ so so'i 'dod mos ltar skyas 'pho byed cing / rang dang mthun pa'i dud tshang bcu skor yas mas ru skor byas nas sdod srol yod pa las/ grong sde chen po gcig tu 'tshogs nas sde spungs byed pa'i lugs srol de sngon dus su cher ma dar/ des na sde 'bangs thams cad phyogs gcig tu 'dzoms nas lo ston lta bu'i spro gseng gtong yul gtso bo yul so so'i dgon pa rnams yin stabs/ dgon pa gsar 'debs dang / rten gsum gsar bzhengs byed pa'i las ka de ni yul mi rnams kyis rang 'khris 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis nas ma bskul dang len du sgrub kyin yod pa de ni chos la dad pa dang /rig gnas kyi 'tsho ba la dga' zhen che ba'i rkyen gyis yin/ phag gru sde srid kyi skabs su bod kyi sa gnas khag gi bla ma dang mi dpon rnams kyi dbu mdzad nas sde 'bangs mi ser gyi nus shugs dang / lag rtsal la brten nas lha khang dang rten gsum mang po bzhengs nas bod yul gyi 'dzugs skrun la sngar med pa'i yar rgyas chen po thob par ma zad/ chos dang rig gnas kyi phyogs la'ang gom gang mdun spos dang / bod mi rigs kyi mtshan snyan kun khyab tu 'gro ba'i mthun rkyen gyi rmang gzhi bting yod/ skabs der bod yul stod smad bar gsum du gsar bzhengs byung ba'i dgon pa dang / rten gsum grangs las 'das pa zhig las/ lo rgyus 83

kyi don snying che ba dang / deng dus grags che po rtsed thang / ri bo dge ldan/'bras spungs chos sde/ se ra theg chen gling / ngor e waṃ chos sde/ 'phan yul na len dra/ chab mdo chos 'khor gling / rgyal rtse dpal 'khor mchod rten/ sde dge thang rgyal lha khang / gtsang bkra shes lhun po/ rta nag thub bstan gling /gdan sa chen po yangs can dgon/ tre hor dar rgyas dgon pa/ sku 'bum byams pa gling mdo khams li thang dgon chen/ jo nang rtag brtan gling / rdo brag e waṃ lcog sgar la sogs pa ris su ma chad pa'i dgon sde rnams gsar du bzhengs pa dang / ra sa 'phrul snang dang / bsam yas sogs btsan po'i sku dus su bskrun pa'i lha khang rnams bar skabs su nyams rgud song ba rnams nyams gso rgya cher byas pa de dag red/sku rten gyi skor la che chung ma nges pa'i gser sku dang zangs sku/ 'dag sku/shing sku la sogs pa sgyu rtsal khyad du 'phags shing rin thang gzhal bar dka' ba'i sku rten grangs las 'das pa zhig gsar du bzhengs pa las/ skad grags dang sku tshad che shos dper na/ ngam ring byams chen dang / rong byams chen/ 'bras spungs dgon gyi byams pa mthong grol ma la sogs pa rnams ni phag gru sde srid kyi dus rabs su bzhengs pa sha stag yin no/ /gsung rten gyi skor la/ rgyal ba'i bka' dang de'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos rnams sde tshan du bsgrigs nas gsung rab kyi glegs bam mang po bshu 'bri byed cing 'phel rgyas btang yod pa dang / lhag par du kurma pa'i chos tshogs sgar chen 'dzam gling rgyan zhes pa'i chos tshogs de byung ba nas bzung rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur klog 'don byed pa dang / rang rang gi 'byor ba'i 'khos dang bstun pa'i ga~X dngul mtshal snag sogs kyis bris pa'i bka' 'gyur gyi glegs bam gsar

bzhengs byed pa'i las ka de dar khyab chen por phyin yod pa dper na/ tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis bod khams yongs la dbang sgyur byed du nye ba'i dus su tshal pa kun dga' rdo rjes gser dngul gyi zhun khu bsres ma'i bka' 'gyur cha tshang zhig bzhengs pa'i zhus chen pa bu ston rin po che lags shing / de'i dkar chag〈deb ther dmar po〉zhes pa tshal pa kun dga' rdo rje rang nyid kyis btsams pa dang /bka' 'gyur de la pod grangs nyis brgya drug cu yod par grags shing / yongs grags su tshal pa'i bka' 'gyur zhes bya ba de ni phag gru'i rgyal rabs kyi dus stod la bzhengs pa'i bka' 'gyur skad grags can zhig yin/ tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis chos grwa chen po rtsed thang bzhengs pa dang / bshad grwa btsugs pa/rtsed thang dang thel gyi sgom grwar phun sum tshogs pa'i mthun rkyen sbyar pa dang /dus mtshungs su gser gyi bka' 'gyur zhig kyang gsar du bzhengs/ wang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis srid skyong ba'i skabs su bka' 'gyur gser bris ma cha tshang gnyis dang / gser dngul 'dres ma gcig skya bris tshar gcig bcas gsar bzhengs gnas yod/ sde srid grags pa 'byung gnas kyi skabs su bzhengs pa'i 'phyong rgyas 'bying ba stag rtse'i bka' 'gyur zhengs pa de ni/ 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal dang / dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba/ zhwa dmar chos grags ye shes sogs mkhas pa mang pos zhu dag byas stabs bod du bzhugs pa'i bka' 'gyur thams cad las dag cha che shos yin par grags shing / 'jang rgyal po bsod nams rab brtan gyis sbyin bdag mdzad de ngo da yul du rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur shing par la thog mar brko ba'i phyi mo yang 'di yin/ rab byung bdun pa'i lcags phag spyi lo1431lor rgyal rtse rab brtan kun bzang 'phags kyis snar thang gi bka' 'gyur ma dper gnang ste bka' 'gyur gser bris cha tshang bzhengs pa de la/ rgyal rtse 8byem

bzhengs byed pa'i las ka de dar khyab chen por phyin yod pa dper na/ tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis bod khams yongs la dbang sgyur byed du nye ba'i dus su tshal pa kun dga' rdo rjes gser dngul gyi zhun khu bsres ma'i bka' 'gyurwa cha tshang zhig bzhengs pa'i zhus chen pa bu ston rin po che lags shing / de'i dkar chag〈deb ther dmar po〉zhes pa tshal pa kun dga' rdo rje rang nyid kyis brtsams pa dang /bka' 'gyur de la pod grangs nyis brgya drug cu yod par grags shing / yongs grags su tshal pa'i bka' 'gyur zhes bya ba de ni phag gru'i rgyal rabs kyi dus stod la bzhengs pa'i bka' 'gyur skad grags can zhig yin/ tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis chos grwa chen po rtsed thang bzhengs pa dang / bshad grwa btsugs pa/rtsed thang dang thel gyi sgom grwar phun sum tshogs pa'i mthun rkyen sbyar pa dang /dus mtshungs su gser gyi bka' 'gyur zhig kyang gsar du bzhengs/ wang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis srid skyong ba'i skabs su bka' 'gyur gser bris ma cha tshang gnyis dang / gser dngul 'dres ma gcig skya bris tshar gcig bcas gsar bzhengs gnas yod/ sde srid grags pa 'byung gnas kyi skabs su bzhengs pa'i 'phyong rgyas 'phying ba stag rtse'i bka' 'gyur zhengs pa de ni/ 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal dang / dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba/ zhwa dmar chos grags ye shes sogs mkhas pa mang pos zhu dag byas stabs bod du bzhugs pa'i bka' 'gyur thams cad las dag cha che shos yin par grags shing / 'jang rgyal po bsod nams rab brtan gyis sbyin bdag mdzad de ngo da yul du rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur shing par la thog mar brko ba'i phyi mo yang 'di yin/ rab byung bdun pa'i lcags phag spyi lo1431lor rgyal rtse rab brtan kun bzang 'phags kyis snar thang gi bka' 'gyur ma dper gnang ste bka' 'gyur gser bris cha tshang bzhengs pa de la/ rgyal rtse them 85

spang mar grags pa dang / de nas bzung lo ltar bka' bstan gsar bzhengs kyi rgyun btsugs pa'i skor/ 〈rab brtan kun bzang 'phags kyi rnam thar〉las/dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe gsum bzheng pa lcags mo phag gi lo'i zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bcu bzhi skar ma rgyal la bab pa'i nyin nas bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung gi rten bka' bod yul 'dir 'gyur ro cog dang / de'i 'grel byed bstan pa de 'dzin pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi mdzad pa rnams thugs dam du bzhengs pa'i khrigs su mdzad/ snye mo nas yi ge'i mkhan po dpon po che sa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan dpon slob rnams kyis thog mar dam pa'i chos dkon mchog brtsegs pa dang / yum bar ma nyi khri bzhengs pa rnams nas bzung / chos rgyal nyid kyi sku thog la/ bka' 'gyur gser bris ma tshar gcig dang / dkar po tshar gcig bstan 'gyur gser bris ma tshar gcig bcas bzhengs grub/ de'i rgyun ni ji srid bskal pa ma stongs kyi bar du mi chad par mthun rkyen dang ldan te mkhas grub 'chi med grub pas〈skye dgu mdzes par par byed pa'i mgul rgyan〉du/phabaka' bstan bzhengs pa'i mthun rkyen lo re bzhin/ / gser zho sum brgya bdun cu don gsum dang / / shog rin ṭam kha brgya dang sum cu re/ /nas khal brgyad brgya bzhi bcu zhe gsum nyid/ / ston chas sha khog bzhi brgya nyi shu gnyis/ / mar khal sum brgya lnga bcu nga bdun dang / / bur khal bdun cu don gsum khor yug nyid/ / zho grangs brgyad brgya nyi shu rtsa gsum lon/ /mi ces sogs gsal ba ltar skabs der bod kyi yul du bka' bstan gsar bzhengs byed pa'i las ka la mi dngos 'byor gsum gyi nus shugs rgya chen por bton yod pa shes thub/86

2 khorachagalegs bcosaskor/sde srid phag gru'i dus rabs su sdong phran 'dzugs rgyu dang / zam pa 'phen pa/ gru shan bzo ba sogs khor yug legs bcos skor la sngar ma byung bo'i yar thon byung yod de/ 〈g.yu yi phreng ba〉las/ phag gru sde srid kyis yul lung dar rgyas yong ba'i ched du sdong 'dzugs nags bzo'i bya ba de gtsigs cher bzung bas skabs der bod yongs kyi sa khul tshang mar ljon myug 'dzugs pa'i bya ba gong 'phel byung stabs yul lung nyams dga' ba'i rnam pa sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i 'gyur ldog byung bar ma zad/ sdong 'dzugs bya bzhag 'phel rgyas kyi 'bras bu mi rabs rjes mar shing cha'i dge bed thad mi 'dzad pa'i gter lta bur 'gyur ba/ de bzhin de'i dus mi rigs pho mo'i chas gos dang / rin po che'i rgyan spras pa la yang dang zhen chen po byung ba'i lo rgyus yod pa bcas de dag las phag mo gru pa'i dus skabs spyi dang / lhag par phag gru'i dus stod ni bod kyi dpal 'byor dang / rig gnas 'phel rgyas chen po byung ba nus ldan gyis gsal bshad byed thub pa yin no/ /zhes gsal ba ltar ro/ /'grim 'grul gyi skor la/ 〈deb ther kun gsal me long〉las/ skabs der thang stong rgyal pos kyi sa gnas khag la lcags zam lnga bcu nga brgyad dang / gru shan brgya dang bco brgyad/ shing zam drug cu tsam btsugs shing bzos/ dkar mdzes khul du yang yun ring bzhugs/ da lta sde dger thang stong rgyal po'i mtshams khang dngos su mjal rgyu yod cing / lcags zam rdzong gi lcags zam yang thang stong rgyal pos skrun gnang mdzad pa yin skad/ gong du smos pa'i lcags zam de dag mang che ba 'jig tshar na'ang / la la da lta dngos su mthong rgyu yod la/ bod kyi 87

khyad chos ldan pa'i gru shan rta mgo can bcings 'grol btang ba'i rjes su yang lha sa'i skyid chu'i thog tu mthong rgyu yod/ thang stong rgyal po ni bzo rig la mkhas pa zhig yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / gzhan yang grub chen 'di yis lcags zam 'phen pa'i thugs 'dun 'khrungs rkyen dang / thabs shes sna tshogs kyis lcags rgyu btsal tshul/ kong po'i yul du lcags zam rdung ba'i bzo grwa bskrun par gnang nas rje nyid lcags zam gyi las grwa'i nang du dngos zhugs kyis phyag las gnang tshul sogs〈thang stong rgyal po'i rnam thar nor bu'i me long〉na gsal ba rnams phyogs bsdus byas nas bkod pa'o/ /lha sar 'khor te skyid chu'i gru khar phebs/ gru nang du bzhugs pas/mnyan pa mi gzhan la tshig zos te nga la ma dris par shan du zhugs pa ci yin/ mi drag pa tsho chu la lhung na khyod kyis khag theg gam zer/ khong gi dbu la shan skya lan gsum brgyab/ shan nang nas chu la skyur byung bas/ grub thob chen po'i dgongs pa la/ kha drag cing nor yod pa rnams kyi dbang du song / gnyom chung rnams gru la mi 'jug chu la brgal yang mi nus pa snying rje/ da ni/ o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po sogs rgya bod kyi bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams kyis rin chen lcags kyi zam pa gzugs par yang yang bskul pa ltar thog mar skyod chu la lcags zam gzugs pa'i lcags 'tshol ba dang / kla klo 'dul ba la 'gro dgongs pa shar/zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ lha sa'i khrom dkyil du sku sa'i khung bu brus pa'i nang du bcug dbu bton nas bzhugs pas/ lha sa'i gzhis byes kun gyis mos gus dang zhabs tog chen po byas/ sngar ni lkog tu chos zhu ba las ma byung /da dngos su thog mar chos gang zhu dang / 'bul ba gang byed kyi rten 'brel las/kha ba can 'dir 'khor lo gsum dang yi dam gyi lha gang la brten nas 'gro don byed 88

brtag dgos dgongs pa'i tshe/ sku drung du btsun ma gsum byung nas/ smyung gnas kyi sdom pa dang / ma ṇi'i lung zhu zer ba la/ khong rnams la 'bul ba che yodachung yod dad pa dang 'byor ba'i khyad par yin/ rang rang gi sems la ci dran gyi 'bul ba re khyer shog gsungs pas/ gcig gis shing rdum gcig rnyed byung ba phul/ gcig gis rdo legs po zhig rnyed byung ba phul/ gcig gis 'bul ba ci yang ma khyer bar lus ngag yid gsum 'bul zer ba la/ ngas rgya gar dang bod kyi mkhas grub rig 'dzin rnams las zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu thob pas/ gangs ri'i ljongs kyi dben pa'i ri sul thams cad dgon pas bkang /sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sa gsum na 'gran zla med pa zhig gzugs bsam pa yin te/ da lam chos 'brel dang 'bul ba'i rten 'brel ni/ ngas gsung mchog yi ge drug pa la brten nas/ mthong thos dran reg gi sems can gnas skabs mngon mtho'i dpal la sbyor zhing / mthar thug nges par legs pa bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi lam la 'god pa'i phyir/ sa rdo shing gsum la las ka byas nas kha ba can pa la phan bde 'byung ba'i sa'i me btsa'/ lam 'phrang dang chu 'phrang lha 'dre mi gsum rgyu ba'i sar chom rkun dang / jag pa/ lha 'dre'i tso 'jigs pa las skyob pa'i dgon gnas rnams su gtsug lag khang dang sku gsung thugs rten ji snyed bzhengs shing / chu klung chen po rnams la gru shan dang rin chen lcags kyi zam pha brtan po las skye rgu ci bder rgyu ba'i rten 'brel dang / lus ngag yid gsum 'bul zer ba ni/ nga'i rjes 'jug bu slob rnams kyis 'dus byas kyi dge ba la brten/ 'dus ma byas chos nyid kyi don rtogs pa'i rten 'brel 'grig go/ zhes lcags zam gzugs pa'i thugs 'dun 'khrungs rkyen dang / rten 'brel brtag pa'i tshul bcas gsal ba dang / de nas lcags rigs bsdus te
