lcags zam dngos su mgar ba'i skor〈rnam thar nor bu'i me long〉las/ tsa ri la sogs gnas mang por phebs te kong yul steng tsha la mi mang pos lcags kyi las byed sar phebs nas rten 'brel brtag pa sogs mdzad/ skabs der mi zhig ga4 lcags thag ya gcig phul nas nga'i khyi yag ma rang zhig yod pa shi song bas bsngo ba gnang rogs zhes zhus pa bzhig bsngo ba mdzad/ lcags thag bzhes/ kong po bha khar phebs/ lcags kyi 'bul ba mang po byung / zhes dang / yang / de nas khong gnyis(rigs gsum mgon po dang / zangs ri lba ba can)kyi sdod sa der gzims khang dang tshogs khang ka ba bcu gnyis la mi nyis stong shong ba zla ba gcig la grub nas lcags kyi gter stobs che ba bton/ kong po rnams kyis phul pa la dmigs rten byas/ tshogs khang 'dir mgar ba mang po bsags nas lcags zam brdung dgos dgongs pa'i tshe/ kong po 'byor ba can don grub rgyal pos lcags kyi khur bcu gsum phul/ bla ma des nga'i pha shi ba de ngan song du mi skye ba zhig dgos zer/ de nas mi zhig byung ba la/ mgar pa kun dga' byon pa legs gsungs/bu mo zhig byung ba la bu mo bkra shis byon pa rten 'brel bzang gsungs/ khong gsum gyi ming su yis bshad dam zer/ sus kyang ma bshad byas pas mngon mkhyen thogs med yod pa shes nas dad pa skyes/ bu mo bkra shis kyis lcags sgor lnga phul/gzhan yang lcags 'bul mkhan stobs che ba byung / mgar pa gnyis kyis kyang lcags brdung ba'i phyag g.yog rtse gcig tu byas/ grub thob chen bo rang gis gter nas bton pa dang / mi rnams kyis phul pa'i lcags mgar pa mang pos brdungs pas/ zhag bco brgyad la lcags kyi rkang bu 'dom bco brgyad yod pa bzhi grub/ces sogs kong yul du lcags zam bzo skrun gyi las grwa 'dzugs pa dang / grub chen rang nyid kyis kyang lcags zam mgar ba'i las grwa'i nang phyag las gnang ba 90

lcags zam dngos su mgar ba'i skor〈rnam thar nor bu'i me long〉las/ tsa ri la sogs gnas mang por phebs te kong yul steng tsha la mi mang pos lcags kyi las byed sar phebs nas rten 'brel brtag pa sogs mdzad/ skabs der mi zhig gigolcags thag ya gcig phul nas nga'i khyi yag ma rang zhig yod pa shi song bas bsngo ba gnang rogs zhes zhus pa bzhig bsngo ba mdzad/ lcags thag bzhes/ kong po bha khar phebs/ lcags kyi 'bul ba mang po byung / zhes dang / yang / de nas khong gnyis(rigs gsum mgon po dang / zangs ri lnga ba can)kyi sdod sa der gzims khang dang tshogs khang ka ba bcu gnyis la mi nyis stong shong ba zla ba gcig la grub nas lcags kyi gter stobs che ba bton/ kong po rnams kyis phul pa laṅkadamigs rten byas/ tshogs khang 'dir mgar ba mang po bsags nas lcags zam brdung dgos dgongs pa'i tshe/ kong po 'byor ba can don grub rgyal pos lcags kyi khur bcu gsum phul/ bla ma des nga'i pha shi ba de ngan song du mi skye ba zhig dgos zer/ de nas mi zhig byung ba la/ mgar pa kun dga' byon pa legs gsungs/bu mo zhig byung ba la bu mo bkra shes byon pa rten 'brel bzang gsungs/ khong gsum gyi ming su yis bshad dam zer/ sus kyang ma bshad byas pas mngon mkhyen thogs med yod pa shes nas dad pa skyes/ bu mo bkra shes kyis lcags sgor lnga phul/gzhan yang lcags 'bul mkhan stobs che ba byung / mgar pa gnyis kyis kyang lcags brdung ba'i phyag g.yog rtse gcig tu byas/ grub thob chen bo rang gis gter nas bton pa dang / mi rnams kyis phul pa'i lcags mgar pa mang pos brdungs pas/ zhag bco brgyad la lcags kyi rkang bu 'dom bco brgyad yod pa bzhi grub/ces sogs kong yul du lcags zam bzo skrun gyi las grwa 'dzugs pa dang / grub che/ 0rang nyid kyis kyang lcags zam mgar ba'i las grwa'i nang phyag las gnang ba

gsal ba dang / de rjes 'brug pa gro la phebs nas mtshan mo chos khri'i steng bzhugs nas chos gsungs pa dang / nyin mo dge skul mdzad de lcags sol gyi 'bul ba bsdus nas lcags kyi rkang bu rdung ba'i mgar pa dang mnyam du bzo las mdzad pas dor po phu/ gdung kha/ bya'u skal phu/ lho gling khar bcas sa gnas mang por lcags zam mgar ba'i las grwa 'dzugs pa dang / rje nyid kyi zhal bkod ltar lcags kyi rkang bu bco lnga ri la dos tshad byas pa'i lcags kyi khur po stong phrag gcig dang bzhi brgya/ shog bu snag tsha sogs lho zong gi khur po bdun brgya rnams/pa gro'i dgon pa gsar 'debs kyi grwa pa dang / yon bdag rnams kyis dad blangs kyis phag ri kha la bskyal pa de nas rim bzhin lcags zam 'dzugs yul so sor dbor 'dren gnang ste thog mar skyid chu la lcags zam 'phangs pa'i skor〈rnam thar nor bu'i me long〉las/ dgung lo bdun cur bzhes pa(spyi lo1430)rab byung bdun pa'i lcags khyi lor skyid chu la lcags zam gzugs dgongs/ chu 'gram du bzhugs pas/ mda' gsum dang gzhu gcig khyer ba'i mi zhig slebs byung /nga la mda' gzhu 'di g.yar na e yong gsungs pas/ phyag tu phul byung /mda' gcig gnang ba chu lar shor/ yang gcig gnang ba ri 'gor bud/ yang gcig gnang ba brag la zug pas rtags legs byung gsungs/ lcags zam tshugs pa'i rten 'brel 'grig sne pa dpon g.yog dang / skyid shod kyi skya ser kun la nged kyis chu sngon mo 'di la/ lcag sa 'di la(yis)/ lcags kyi zam pa gzugs pas/ khyed rnams kyis rdo gsog byed dgos gsungs pas/ mi kun las ka byed mi 'dod pa'i zer lugs sna tshogs byung yang / bsam pa che ba tshos gsung lugs lcags zam ma tshugs kyang / byang du bsags pa jo bo'i chu rags la phan/ lhor bsags na neng ser gyi rka sgo la phan zer/ sne pa dpon g.yog gis 91

gsal ba dang / de rjes 'brug pa gro la phebs nas mtshan mo chos khri'i steng bzhugs nas chos gsungs pa dang / nyin mo dge skul mdzad de lcags sol gyi 'bul ba bsdus nas lcags kyi rkang bu rdung ba'i mgar pa dang mnyam du 9bzo las mdzad pas dor po phu/ gdung kha/ bya'u smal phu/ lho gling khar bcas sa gnas mang por lcags zam mgar ba'i las grwa 'dzugs pa dang / rje nyid kyi zhal bkod ltar lcags kyi rkang bu bco lnga ri la dos tshad byas pa'i lcags kyi khur po stong phrag gcig dang bzhi brgya/ shog bu snag tsha sogs lho zong gi khur po bdun brgya rnams/pa gro'i dgon pa gsar 'debs kyi grwa pa dang / yon bdag rnams kyis dad blangs kyis phag ri kha la bskyal pa de nas rim bzhin lcags zam 'dzugs yul so sor dbor 'dren gnang ste thog mar skyid chu la lcags zam 'phangs pa'i skor〈rnam thar nor bu'i me long〉las/ dgung lo bdun cur bzhes pa(spyi lo1430)rab byung bdun pa'i lcags khyi lor skyid chu la lcags zam gzugs dgongs/ chu 'gram du bzhugs pas/ mda' gsum dang gzhu gcig khyer ba'i mi zhig slebs byung /nga la mda' gzhu 'di g.yar na e yong gsungs pas/ phyag tu phul byung /mda' gcig gnang ba chu lar shor/ yang gcig gnang ba ri 'gor bud/ yang gcig gnang ba brag la zug pas rtags legs byung gsungs/ lcags zam tshugs pa'i rten 'brel 'grig sne pa dpon g.yog dang / skyid shod kyi skya ser kun la nged kyis chu sngon mo 'di la/ lcag sa 'di la(yis)/ lcags kyi zam pa gzugs pas/ khyed rnams kyis rdo gsog byed dgos gsungs pas/ mi kun las ka byed mi 'dod pa'i zer lugs sna tshogs byung yang / bsam pa che ba tshos gsung lugs lcags zam ma tshugs kyang / byang du bsags pa jo bo'i chu rags la phan/ lhor bsags na neng ser gyi rka sgo la phan zer/ sne pa dpon g.yog 9snyis

zhal ta mdzad/ rdo bsags nas chu byang du zam rngur brtsigs/ lho phyogs su phyag mda' zug pa'i brag la lcags phur mda' gang pa gnyis brgyab nas lcags zam gyi sne gnyis brag la bkal/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig song ba dang / yon bdag ma skal bzang sogs kyis zhal ta mdzad nas/ skya btsun sum brgya tsam gyis lcags la thag pa btags nas 'then pas/ res thag pa chad/ res 'then mi rnams 'gyel/mi mang yang stobs ma thon par gyes so/ / zhes dang / yang / de nas grub chen nyid kyis thabs jus 'don gnang gis lha sa'i lcags zam tshugs par mdzad pa de nas bzung 'dzam gling gi yang rtse dbus gtsang mdo khams lho mon dang bcas pa'i srid pa'i chu klung chen po rnams la lcags zam gyi dra ba gsar 'dzugs mdzad pa —bsdoms na lcags zam lnga bcu nga brgyad/ shan chen dang gru shan lhan du brgya dang bco brgyad/ shing zam drug cu tham pa/ zhes sogs gsal 'di dag ni thang stong rgyal po'i rnam thar na 'khod pa'i lcag sa zam 'dzugs skrun byasatshul gyi lo rgyus yin zhing / de dag las gcung ri bo che'i lcag sa zam dang / lha rtse'i lcags kha lcags zam lta bu ni da lta yang bod mi rnams 'grim bzhud byed kyin yod/khams dar rtse mdo'i mnga' khongs kyi lcags zam kha'i lcags zam ni bod kyi lo rgyus nang du thang stong rgyal pos btsus/sa par bshad cing / phyogs de'i bod rigs rnams de la dad pas gnas mjal 'gro srol deng dus bar yod kyang / rgya yig nang du spyi lo'i dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i dus dkyil du man ja'i gong ma khang shi'i dus su btsugs par bshad na'ang de gnyis mi 'gal snyam rga sngon thang stong rgyal pos btsugs pa'i lcags zam 'jig pa'i shul du slar yang lcags zam 'di btsugs pa 'dra/ ))92

zhal ta mdzad/ rdo bsags nas chu byang du zam rngur brtsigs/ lho phyogs su phyag mda' zug pa'i brag la lcags phur mda' gang pa gnyis brgyab nas lcags zam gyi sne gnyis brag la bkal/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig song ba dang / yon bdag ma skal bzang sogs kyis zhal ta mdzad nas/ skya btsun sum brgya tsam gyis lcags la thag pa btags nas 'then pas/ res thag pa chad/ res 'then mi rnams 'gyel/mi mang yang stobs ma thon par gyes so/ / zhes dang / yang / de nas grub chin nyid kyis thabs jus 'don gnang gis lha sa'i lcags zam tshugs par mdzad pa de nas bzung 'dzam gling gi yang rtse dbus gtsang mdo khams lho mon dang bcas pa'i srid pa'i chu klung chen po rnams la lcags zam gyi dra ba gsar 'dzugs mdzad pa bsdoms na lcags zam lnga bcu nga brgyad/ shan chen deng gru shan lhan du brgya dang bco brgyad/ shing zam drug cu tham pa/ zhes sogs gsal 'di dag ni thang stong rgyal po'i rnam thar na 'khod pa'i lcag sa zam 'dzugs skrun bya4tshul gyi lo rgyus yin zhing / de dag las gcung ri bo che'i lcag sa zam dang / lha rtse'i lcags kha lcags zam lta bu ni da lta yang bod mi rnams 'grim bzhud byed kyin yod/khams dar rtse mdo'i mnga' khongs kyi lcags zam kha'i lcags zam ni bod kyi lo rgyus nang du thang stong rgyal pos btsugs par bshad cing / phyogs de'i bod rigs rnams de la dad pas gnas mjal 'gro srol deng dus bar yod kyang / rgya yig nang du spyi lo'i dus rabs bco brgyad pa'i dus dkyil du man ja'i gong ma khang shi'i dus su btsugs par bshad na'ang de gnyis mi 'gal snyam tshe sngon thang stong rgyal pos btsugs pa'i lcags zam 'jig pa'i shul du slar yang lcags zam 'di btsugs pa 'dra/ )ri92

3 bar 'debasaltag rtsaladar spelabyasaba'isgor/phag gru sde srid kyi dus rabs 'dir bod du gsung rab par shing du brko rgyu'i las ka de phyogs mtha' dag la dar srol chen po byung yod/ dgon pa khog gi rang rang gi cho ga chos spyod dang / bla ma'i gsung chos shing par la brko rgyur brtson pa ma zad/ da dung 'byor ldan gyi sbyin bdag btsal nas/ rgyal bstan gyi snying po rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur chen mo dang / de'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos rnams par shing la dgod pa'i re ba dang / thugs brtson chen po gnang yod/ de yang rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur chen mo ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i rang lugs 'dzin pa rnams kyi lta sgom spyod gsum gyi khungs gtugs sa yin zhing / de yang lo tsā pa chen po thu mi sam bho ṭa nas ka cog zhang gsum gyi bar lo tsā pa brgya lhag byung ba de dag gis rgya gar dang / rgya nag li yul/ bal po/ kha che/ o rgyan bcas kyi yul nas mdo sngags kyi gzhung dang / lugs pa de dag dus rabs dgu pa'i stod tsam du/rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i dkar chag gi thog ma〈dkar chag ldan dkar ma〉gsar du bris pa dang / de nas rim bzhin dkar chag〈'phang thang ma〉dang / 〈mchims phu ma〉gsum rim gyis byung ba de ni bka' bstan phyogs bsdus byas pa'i dpe tshogs thog ma red/ bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur zhes pa'i dbye ba dang / tha snyad ni spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i nang du bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gri dang / dbus pa blo gsal byang chub ye shes/ lo tsā pa bsod nams 'od zer/ rgyang ro byang chub 'bum sogs kyis dbus gtsang gi dgon sde rnams nas bka' dang bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog gi ma dpe 'tshol sdud byas shing / bka' tshang ma phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa la 93

3 par 'debasa'ag rtsaladar labyasaba'iskar/phag gru sde srid kyi dus rabs 'dir bod du gsung rab par shing du bsko rgyu'i las ka de phyogs mtha' dag la dar srol chen po byung yod/ dgon pa khag gi rang rang gi cho ga chos spyod dang / bla ma'i gsung chos shing par la bko rgyur brtson pa ma zad/ da dung 'byor ldan gyi sbyin bdag btsal nas/ rgyal bstan gyi snying po rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur chen mo dang / de'i dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos rnams par shing la dgod pa'i re ba dang / thugs brtson chen po gnang yod/ de yang rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur chen mo ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i rang lugs 'dzin pa rnams kyi lta sgom spyod gsum gyi khungs gtugs sa yin zhing / de yang lo tsā pa chen po thu mi sam bho ṭa nas ka chog zhang gsum gyi bar lo tsā pa brgya lhag byung ba de dag gis rgya gar dang / rgya nag li yul/ bal po/ kha che/ o rgyan bcas kyi yul nas mdo sngags kyi gzhung dang / lugs pa de dag dus rabs dgu pa'i stod tsam du/rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i dkar chag gi thog ma dkar chag ldan dkar ma〉gsar du bris pa dang / de nas rim bzhin dkar chag〈'phang thang ma〉dang / 〈mchims phu ma〉gsum rim gyis byung ba de ni bka' bstan phyogs bsdus byas pa'i dpe tshogs thog ma red/ bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur zhes pa'i dbye ba dang / tha snyad ni spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i nang du bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gri dang / dbus pa blo gsal byang chub ye shes/ lo tsā pa bsod nams 'od zer/ rgyang ro byang chub 'bum sogs kyis dbus gtsang gi dgon sde rnams nas bka' dang bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog gi ma dpe 'tshol sdud byas shing / bka' tshang ma phyogs gcig tu bsdus ༵ la

bka' 'gyur dang / bstan bcos tshang ma phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa la bstan 'gyur zhes mtshan gsol nas dpal snar thang gi 'dzam lha khang du bzhugs su gsol pa de ni da lta'i bka' bstan kun gyi phyi mo yin par grags/de nas bzung bod yul 'dir bka' 'gyur gsar bzhengs byed pa dang /lta klog byed pa'i tsha rlabs gsar pa zhig 'phyur yod stabs/ kurma pa'i chos tshogs sgar chen 'dzam gling rgyan zhes pa de'i nang du'ang bka' 'gyur bshu 'bri byed pa dang / klog 'don byed rgyu dar srol chen por byung / spyi lo1407lor kurma pa de bzhin gshegs pa rgya nag tu phebs nas gong ma yung lor dge skul gnang bltar gong ma chen pos rab byung bdun pa'i lcags stag ste spyi lo1410lo rgya nag nan cin du bka' 'gyur gyi par bzhengs pa 'di ni/ 'jig rten 'dir bod yig gi bka' 'gyur par du bskrun pa'i thog ma yin/ spyi lo1594lor ta ming wan li(7lo)rgyal pos pe cin du bka' 'gyur gyi par bzhengs pa de yang kurma pa zhwa dmar nag gnyis kyis re 'dun ltar thugs bzhed bskangs pa yin la/ skabs der par shing bzhengs dus zhu dag gi 'gan zhwa dmar sku phreng drug pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis gtso bor bzhes par grags/bod kyi yul du bka' 'gyur gyi par shing thog mar byung ba ni/ kurma pa sku phreng dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje'i skabs su gtsang pa sde srid kyis zhwa dmar nag gnyis ka dang sgar chen khongs kyi dge 'dun pa khri lnga lhag dang bcas pa gdan 'dren zhus te gtsang du bzhugs pa'i skabs su/ 'jang rgyal po bsod nams rab brtan gyis 'bul ba dang bcas te gdan zhu pa mngags/ dus der kurma pas rang nyid kyi sku tshab tu grub thob chen po kurma pakṣi'i gdung rigs las byung ba'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi bla ma kurma lhun grub dang / zhwa dmar chos kyi dbang phyug rnam gnyis 94

bka' 'gyur dang / bstan bcos tshang ma phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa la bstan 'gyur zhes mtshan gsol nas dpal snar thang gi 'dzam lha khang du bzhugs su gsol pa de ni da lta'i bka' bstan kun gyi phyi mo yin par grags/de nas bzung bod yul 'dir bka' 'gyur gsar bzhengs byed pa dang /lta klog byed pa'i tsha rlabs gsar pa zhig 'phyur yod stabs/ kurma pa'i chos tshogs sgar chen 'dzam gling rgyan zhes pa de'i nang du'ang bka' 'gyur bshu 'bri byed pa dang / klog 'don byed rgyu dar srol chen por byung / spyi lo1407lor kerma pa de bzhin gshegs pa rgya nag tu phebs nas gong ma yung lor dge skul gnang bltar gong ma chen pos rab byung bdun pa'i lcags stag ste spyi lo1410lo rgya nag nan cin du bka' 'gyur gyi par bzhengs pa 'di ni/ 'jig rten 'dir bod yig gi bka' 'gyur par du bskrun pa'i thog ma yin/ spyi lo1594lor ta ming wan li(77)rgyal pos pe cin du bka' 'gyur gyi par bzhengs pa de yang kurma pa zhwa dmar nag gnyis kyis re 'dun ltar thugs bzhed bskangs pa yin la/ skabs der par shing bzhengs dus zhu dag gi 'gan zhwa dmar sku phreng drug pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis gtso bor bzhes par grags/bod kyi yul du bka' 'gyur gyi par shing thog mar byung ba ni/ kurma pa sku phreng dgu pa dbang phyug rdo rje'i skabs su gtsang pa sde srid kyis zhwa dmar nag gnyis ka dang sgar chen khongs kyi dge 'dun pa khri lnga lhag dang bcas pa gdan 'dren zhus te gtsang du bzhugs pa'i skabs su/ 'jang rgyal po bsod nams rab brtan gyis 'bul ba dang bcas te gdan zhu pa mngags/ dus der kurma pas rang nyid kyi sku tshab tu grub thob chen po korma pakṣi'i gdung rigs las byung ba'i mkhas grub gnyis lda/ 4gyi bla ma kurma lhun grub dang / zhwa dmar chos kyi dbang phyug rnam gnyis ske

mngags/ rab byung bcu pa'i sa bya ste spyi lo1609lor zhwa dmar chos kyi dbang phyug gi gsung bskul 'og 'jang sa thang rgyal po mi pham tshe dbang bsod nams rab brtan gyis 'phying ba stag rtse'i bka' 'gyur ba phyir byas nas bka' 'gyur gyi par gsar skrun gnang / zhwa dmar chos kyi dbang phyug gis zhu dag gnang / spyi lo1614pa'i shing stag lor dkar chag bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' gangs can gyi brdas 'dren pa ci snyed pa'i phyi mo par gyi tshogs su 'khod pa'i byung ba gsal bar brjod pa legs byas kyi rang gzugs kun nas snang ba nor bu rin po che'i me long〉zhes pa de btsams/ par shing cha tshang rmu gling sa khul du bzhugs kyang phyis su dus 'gyur gyi dbang gis khams li thang dgon par gdan drangs pa der rjes su li thang bka' 'gyur zer/ de ltar 'jang sa thang rgyal pos bka' 'gyur par du bzhengs pa'i bdag rkyen byas tshul/ sta gon dang 'gro song gang byas/ ma phyi gang la byas pa/ zhu dag dang rab gnas kyi cho ga ji ltar mdzad tshul rgyas pa gong gsal dkar chag gi nang du bzhugs stabs 'dir zur tsam las ma smras/ bod kyi par 'debs dar ba las shuṭa su dpal 'byor dar yod pa shes thub/bzhi/ bzo skrun mkhas dbang thang stong rgyal po'irnam thar/grub chen thang stong rgyal po ni/ yab spyi 'bras lung pa dpon po rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / yum rgya gar lha mo gnyis la sras se ro dpal dang / slob dpon dpal tshul/ khro bo dpal ldan/ 'phan po lnga dar/ lcam mo dpal 'dzin dang /rdo rje ma bcas lcam sring drug yod pa'i gsum par spyi lo 1361bod rab byung drug pa'i lcags glang lo rin chen sdings dang nye ba'i 'o bar 'khrungs/ thog ma'i mtshan la khro bo dpal ldan zhes bya ba gsol/ 95

mngags/ rab byung bcu pa'i sa bya ste spyi lo1609lor zhwa dmar chos kyi dbang phyug gi gsung bskul 'og 'jang sa thang rgyal po mi pham tshe dbang bsod nams rab brtan gyis 'bying ba stag rtse'i bka' 'gyur ba phyir byas nas bka' 'gyur gyi par gsar skrun gnang / zhwa dmar chos kyi dbang phyug gis zhu dag gnang / spyi lo1614pa'i shing stag lor dkar chag〈bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' gangs can gyi brdas 'dren pa ci snyed pa'i phyi mo par gyi tshogs su 'khod pa'i byung ba gsal bar brjod pa legs byas kyi rang gzugs kun nas snang ba nor bu rin po che'i me long〉zhes pa de brtsams/ par shing cha tshang rmu gling sa khul du bzhugs kyang phyis su dus 'gyur gyi dbang gis khams li thang dgon par gdan drangs pa der rjes su li thang bka' 'gyur zer/ de ltar 'jang sa thang rgyal pos bka' 'gyur par du bzhengs pa'i bdag rkyen byas tshul/ sta gon dang 'gro song gang byas/ ma phyi gang la byas pa/ zhu dag dang rab gnas kyi cho ga ji ltar mdzad tshul rgyas pa gong gsal dkar chag gi nang du bzhugs stabs 'dir zur tsam las ma smras/ bod kyi par 'debs dar ba las shuṭa su dpal 'byor dar yod pa shes thub/bzhi/ bzo skrun mkhas dbang thang stong rgyal po'i rnam thar/grub chen thang stong rgyal po ni/ yab spyi 'bras lung pa dpon po rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / yum rgya gar lha mo gnyis la sras se ro dpal dang / slob dpon dpal tshul/ khro bo dpal ldan/ 'phan po lnga dar/ lcam mo dpal 'dzin dang /rdo rje ma bcas lcam sring drug yod pa'i gsum par spyi lo 1361bod rab byung drug pa'i lcags glang lo rin chen sdings dang nye ba'i 'o bar 'khrungs/ thog ma'i mtshan la khro bo dpal ldan zhes bya ba gsol/ 95

dgung lo lnga bzhes pa'i tshe yab yum gyis ra lug 'tsho bar btang bas kun spangs don yod rgyal mtshan gyi chos rar byon te/ dbang khrid rjes gnang mang po gsan pas chos nyan pa rnams kyis bu chung 'dis chos mi shes zer ba la/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ byis pa 'di ngo mtshar ba zhig yod pas chos kyis phan pa srid gsung zhing / ra lug rnams kyang bor brlag med pa 'phel che bar byung /de nas dgon pa byang sdings su bla ma chos skyong dpal ba la klog yig bslabs pa bde blag tu mkhyen/de rjes yab yum gnyis kyis rnga dkar gla rtsi mang po bskur nas 'dol khar tshong la btang bar/ 'dol kha rgyal pos khrims las 'gal ba'i gnyi shangs pa mi bdun la sdong po sha 'gyed byed grabs 'dug pa thugs kyis ma bzod nas tshong zog rnga dkar dang gla rtsi mi khur gcig phul nas nyes can de dag gi srog bla mdzad de rang yul du phebs/ yab dang mched zla rnams kyis rnga dkar dang gla rtsis ci khug gsungs par mi bdun gyi srog khug gsungs par grags/de nas yul 'dzin pa la bu su 'os yab yum gnyis gros mdzad pas yab kyis khro bo dpal ldan 'di spyod pa hur la blo rig dwangs pa zhig 'dug pas 'di 'os gsungs shing / yum gyis mi rgod la chos rgod pas khro bo dpal ldan chos la 'jug gsung te gros ma mthun par gus gum rin chen rgyal mtshan la zhus pas bu khro bo dpal ldan chos la chug gsungs pa bzhin dgon pa byang sdings su bla ma nyi ma seng ge'i drung nas rab byung gi sdom pa bzhes pa'i mtshan la brtson 'grus seng ge zhes gsol/ mkhan chen de'i drung nas don yod zhags pa'i sgrub thabs dang / rgyud kyi lung sogs dang / ngam ring chos sde'i mkhas pa blo gros rdo rje dang / dkon mchog dar las rnam 'grel dang mngon rtogs rgyan sogs gsan te dpal ldan sa 96

dgung lo lnga bzhes pa'i tshe yab yum gyis ra lug 'tsho bar btang bas kun spangs don yod rgyal mtshan gyi chos rar byon te/ dbang khrid rjes gnang mang po gsan pas chos nyan pa rnams kyis bu chung 'dis chos mi shes zer ba la/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ byis pa 'di ngo mtshar ba zhig yod pas chos kyis phan pa srid gsung zhing / ra lug rnams kyang bor brlag med pa 'phel che bar byung /de nas dgon pa byang sdings su bla ma chos skyong dpal ba la klog yig bslabs pa bde blag tu mkhyen/de rjes yab yum gnyis kyis rnga dkar gla rtsi mang po bskur nas 'dol khar tshong la btang bar/ 'dol kha rgyal pos khrims las 'gal ba'i gnyi shangs pa mi bdun la sdong po sha 'gyed byed grabs 'dug pa thugs kyis ma bzod nas tshong zog rnga dkar dang gla rtsi mi khur gcig phul nas nyes can de dag gi srog bla mdzad de rang yul du phebs/ yab dang mched zla rnams kyis rnga dkar dang gla rtsis ci khug gsungs par mi bdun gyi srog khug gsungs par grags/de nas yul 'dzin pa la bu su 'os yab yum gnyis gros mdzad pas yab kyis khro bo dpal ldan 'di spyod pa hur la blo rig dwangs pa zhig 'dug pas 'di 'os gsungs shing / yum gyis mi rgod la chos rgod pas khro bo dpal ldan chos la 'jug gsung te gros ma mthun par gus gum rin chen rgyal mtshan la zhus pas bu khro bo dpal ldan chos la chug gsungs pa bzhin dgon pa byang sdings su bla ma nyi ma seng ge'i drung nas rab byung gi sdom pa bzhes pa'i mtshan la brtson 'grus seng ge zhes gsol/ mkhan chen de'i drung nas don yod zhags pa'i sgrub thabs dang / rgyud kyi lung sogs dang / ngam ring chos sde'i mkhas pa blo gros rdo rje dang / dkon mardo/ dar las rnam 'grel dang mngon rtogs rgyan sogs gsan te dpal ldan sa

skyar bka' bzhi'i grwa skor la byon/ skabs der grwa skor ba grogs mched gzhan gyis mkhas par rlom pa'i gzhung bshad rgyas par byed pa dag ni kha mkhas kyang don ma go ba rang rgyud gyong po mi thul bar dgongs te chos brgyad mgo snyoms kyi brtul zhugs lhur bzhes te gzhan gyis 'phya ba sogs la'ang ji mi snyam par bzhugs pas brtson 'grus smyon par grags/de nas rang yul la log 'byon pa'i lam khar sa skya bdag po bsod nams bkra shes kyis rgyang 'bum mo che bzhengs pa'i mdzad spyod la thugs phrogs nas yab dang gcen por longs spyod nas cha shas sheg mchod rten gyi zhal 'debs su phul na legs pa'i rgyu mtshan gsung ba khong tshos dang len ma mdzad kyang / rgyud las/ma byin par yang khyod kyis slang / / zhes rdo rje'i tshig gi don smyon pa'i zol gyis phyag bzhes mdzad de bdag chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams bkra shes mchod rten gyi mthun rkyen du gser zho bcu dang nas khal nyis brgya tham pa phul/de rjes mdo stod skya ra'i dgon pa na bzhugs pa bka' lnga pa dpal 'byor shes rab kyis mkhan po mdzad pa'i las slob dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs bzhes pa'i mtshan brtson 'grus bzang por gsol/ re zhig mkhan po de'i drung du bzhugs nas phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan/ lhan cig skyes sbyor la sogs pa'i dbang khrid bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan/ gzhan yang chos rje lha gdong pa bsod nams mchog pa dang / kun spangs don yod rgyal mtshan pa las zab chos ci rigs gsan/de nas bal yul du phebs nas bha ro ma nu dha ras gser dngul sogs phul ba cha rkyen du mdzad nas 'phags pa shing kun la sku dkar gsol zhing / bya rung kha shor la nyams gso legs po mdzad pa dang / paṇḍi ta ma hā bo rnyi'i drung nas /ltar

skyar bka' bzhi'i grwa skor la byon/ skabs der grwa skor ba grogs mched gzhan gyis mkhas par rlom pa'i gzhung bshad rgyas par byed pa dag ni kha mkhas kyang don ma go ba rang rgyud gyong po mi thul bar dgongs te chos brgyad mgo snyoms kyi brtul zhugs lhur bzhes te gzhan gyis 'phya ba sogs la'ang ji mi snyam par bzhugs pas brtson 'grus spyon par grags/de nas rang yul la log 'byon pa'i lam khar sa skya bdag po bsod nams bkra shis kyis rgyang 'bum mo che bzhengs pa'i mdzad spyod la thugs phrogs nas yab dang gcen por longs spyod nas cha shas shig mchod rten gyi zhal 'debs su phul na legs pa'i rgyu mtshan gsung ba khong tshos dang len ma mdzad kyang / rgyud las/ma byin par yang khyod kyis slang / / zhes rdo rje'i tshig gi don spyon pa'i zol gyis phyag bzhes mdzad de bdag chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams bkra shis mchod rten gyi mthun rkyen du gser zho bcu dang nas khal nyis brgya tham pa phul/de rjes mdo stod skya ra'i dgon pa na bzhugs pa bka' lnga pa dpal 'byor shes rab kyis mkhan po mdzad pa'i las slob dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs bzhes pa'i mtshan brtson 'grus bzang por gsol/ re zhig mkhan po de'i drung du bzhugs nas phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan/ lhan cig skyes sbyor la sogs pa'i dbang khrid bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan/ gzhan yang chos rje lha gdong pa bsod nams mchog pa dang / kun spangs don yod rgyal mtshan pa las zab chos ci rigs gsan/de nas bal yul du phebs nas bha ro ma nu dha ras gser dngul sogs phul ba cha rkyen du mdzad nas 'phags pa shing kun la sku dkar gsol zhing / bya rung kha shor la nyams gso legs po mdzad pa dang / paṇḍi ta ma hā bo dhi'i drung nas 'khor 97

lo sdom pa'i dbang dang rgyud mang po'i lung zhus/ de nas rgya gar dang / bal yul gyi sa mtshams g.ya' ri sgo lngar rig 'dzin chen po dharma ratna'i drung nas lo lnga'i ring zab chos mang po gsan pa bcas lo bco brgyad tsam ring bal yul dang rgya gar phyogs 'byon bzhud kyis slar rin chen sdings su phebs skabs mched zla dang yul mi tshos dge slong brtson 'grus bza nga po khyod lo bco brgyad tsam ring mig gis mthong sar ma byung / gar byon zhus par/ nga bal po dang rgya gar la phyin/ chos zab la rgyas pa thob/ nyams rtogs khyad par can rgyud la skyes lugs gsungs par smyon pa 'di sprang khyams la phyin/ yul du sleb pa dang rdzun kham sa can 'ba' zhig zer bar 'dug ces zhus par grags/de nas byang sems sbyin pa bzang po'i drung nas ni gu'i chos drug gsan te dben par nyams su bzhes pa dang / yum rgya gar ོlha mo chos sgor zhugs su bcug nas mtshan dpal mo mgon du btags pa nas mi ring bar sku bshegs rjes dgongs rdzoṭa yang dag pa bsgrubs/ gdung rus la sangs rgyas byang sems mang po'i sa par btab nas grub chen gcig pus phyag bstar nas mchod rten khang bu brtsegs pa dang / de bzhin gsung rten gser bris kyi mdo sdud pa/ sku rten la bde gshegs brgyad kyi bris thang bcas bzhengs pa ni rten bzhengs tho khog ma yin gsungs so/ yum 'das nas brtson 'grus spyon pa la chos 'jig rten gyi brda chad med zer te nye tshan kun gyis brnyas pa chen po byas par phu bo gnyis dang / pha spun mang po dang spyi sgos su kha mchu mdzad pas rgyal kha thob ste/ rang la dbang ba'i khang zhing sgo phyugs rnams mi gnyis gnyer du bskos nas 'bru rigs gsog gang thub dang / dud 'gro rnams byams pas skyongs shig pa'i zhal bkod mdzad nas/rang nyid 'khrungs yul gyi rgyab ri 'o ba lha rtse'i nub mgul gyi rdza khrod du sgrub pa rtse 98

lo sdom pa'i dbang dang rgyud mang po'i lung zhus/ de nas rgya gar dang / bal yul gyi sa mtshams g.ya' ri sgo lngar rig 'dzin chen po dharma ratna'i drung nas lo lnga'i ring zab chos mang po gsan pa bcas lo bco brgyad tsam ring bal yul dang rgya gar phyogs 'byon bzhud kyis slar rin chen sdings su phebs skabs mched zla dang yul mi tshos dge slong brtson 'grus bzang po khyod lo bco brgyad tsam ring mig gis mthong sar ma byung / gar byon zhus par/ nga bal po dang rgya gar la phyin/ chos zab la rgyas pa thob/ nyams rtogs khyad par can rgyud la skyes lugs gsungs par smyon pa 'di sprang khyams la phyin/ yul du sleb pa dang rdzun khams can 'ba' zhig zer bar 'dug ces zhus par grags/de nas byang sems sbyin pa bzang po'i drung nas ni gu'i chos drug gsan te dben par nyams su bzhes pa dang / yum rgya gar lha mo chos sgor zhugs su bcug nas mtshan dpal mo mgon du btags pa nas mi ring bar sku bshegs rjes dgongs rdzoṭa yang dag pa bsgrubs/ gdung rus la sangs rgyas byang sems mang po'i sa par btab nas grub chen gcig pus phyag bstar nas mchod rten khang bu brtsegs pa dang / de bzhin gsung rten gser bris kyi mdo sdud pa/ sku rten la bde — gshegs brgyad kyi bris thang bcas bzhengs pa ni rten bzhengs tho khog ma yin gsungs so/ yum 'das nas brtson 'grus smyon pa la chos 'jig rten gyi brda chad med zer te nye tshan kun gyis brnyas pa chen po byas par phu bo gnyis dang / pha spun mang po dang spyi sgos su kha mchu mdzad pas rgyal kha thob ste/ rang la dbang ba'i khang zhing sgo phyugs rnams mi gnyis gnyer du bskos nas 'bru rigs gsog gang thub dang / dud 'gro rnams byams pas skyongs sheg pa'i zhal bkod mdzad nas/rardo 8nyid 'khrungs yul gyi rgyab ri 'o ba lha rtse'i nub mgul gyi rdzo khrod du sgrub pa rtse

gcig tu mdzad/ gnas der lo bdun song nas sku mtshams grol nye'i mtshams lug rdzis ting shags kyi sgra thos pas phug sgor yong nas byin rlabs zhus te yul mi rnams la 'o ba lha rtse'i rdza khrod na rnal 'byor pa bzang po zhig bzhugs 'dug pa sngar nga tshos ma shes pas gsol chas dang gtor phye phul ba drag ces bskul ba ltar yul mi tshos phyag dang byin rlabs zhus shing / kho tshor skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang ma ṇi'i chos 'brel gnang bas kun dad/ 'on kyang yul de'i mi dpon seng ge bzang po bya ba zhig yod pas kyang phyag btsal byin rlabs zhu ba'i skabs grub chen gyis phyag brkyang ste byin rlabs mdzad par/ khos bla ma bzang po'i phyag min pa 'dugasmyon pa brtson 'grus kyi lag par 'dug rang re tsho klad pa chung / brtson 'grus kho dran rgya che/ kho shi ba mi bden par 'dug zer bas mi gzhan tshos kyang log lta byas par snang ba bden kyi dper dgongs so/de nas rang gi khang zhing sgo phyugs rnams bcol ba'i mi gnyis kyi sar byon/nas dang phyugs shin tu mang bar 'phel ba nas yum gyi dom bun rnams kyang bcal/ma ṇi dung phyur 'don pa'i bsnyen bkur dang 'bul ba bzang po mdzad/ mi gnyis po la'ang nor gang 'dod bstsal/ sngar bzhin rems gsung nas gzhis 'dzin la bzhag gser zho gang bsnams nas lha sa'i jo bo rin po che mjal ba dang / bla ma gang bzang la chos zhu ba la phebs dgongs te chas nas thog mar thar pa gling du mchog bzang legs pa'i blo gros kyi drung nas phyag rgya chen po gang ga ma dang / ga'u ma sogs dang / gangs bu le'i dbyi lung dga' ldan rtser rje btsun re mda' ba mjal bar byon nas gser thig po gcig sogs phul te gshin rje gshed dmar nag 'jigs gsum gyi dbang dang / gzhan yang skyes bu dam pa du ma nas zab chos mtha' yas pa gsan cing / dben gnas rnams su dka' thub/ dur khros la

gcig tu mdzad/ gnas der lo bdun song nas sku mtshams grol nye'i mtshams lug rdzis ting shags kyi sgra thos pas phug sgor yong nas byin rlabs zhus te yul mi rnams la 'o ba lha rtse'i rdza khrod na rnal 'byor pa bzang po zhig bzhugs 'dug pa sngar nga tshos ma shes pas gsol chas dang gtor phye phul ba drag ces bskul ba ltar yul mi tshos phyag dang byin rlabs zhus shing / kho tshor skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang ma ṇi'i chos 'brel gnang bas kun dad/ 'on kyang yul de'i mi dpon seng ge bzang po bya ba zhig yod pas kyang phyag btsal byin rlabs zhu ba'i skabs grub chen gyis phyag brkyang ste byin rlabs mdzad par/ khos bla ma bzang po'i phyag min pa 'dugasmyon pa brtson 'grus kyi lag par 'dug rang re tsho klad pa chung / brtson 'grus kho dran rgya che/ kho shi ba mi bden par 'dug zer bas mi gzhan tshos kyang log lta byas par snang ba bden kyi dper dgongs so/de nas rang gi khang zhing sgo phyugs rnams bcol ba'i mi gnyis kyi sar byon/nas dang phyugs shin tu mang bar 'phel ba nas yum gyi dom bun rnams kyang bcal/ma ṇi dung phyur 'don pa'i bsnyen bkur dang 'bul ba bzang po mdzad/ mi gnyis po la'ang nor gang 'dod bstsal/ sngar bzhin rems gsung nas gzhis 'dzin la bzhag gser zho gang bsnams nas lha sa'i jo bo rin po che mjal ba dang / bla ma gang bzang la chos zhu ba la phebs dgongs te chas nas thog mar thar pa gling du mchog bzang legs pa'i blo gros kyi drung nas phyag rgya chen po gang ga ma dang / ga'u ma sogs dang / gangs bu le'i dbyi lung dga' ldan rtser rje btsun re mda' ba mjal bar byon nas gser thig po gcig sogs phul te gshin rje gshed dmar nag 'jigs gsum gyi dbang dang / gzhan yang skyes bu dam pa du ma nas zab chos mtha' yas pa gsan cing / dben gnas rnams su dka' thub/ dur khrod la 99

sogs pa'i gnyan pa'i ri khrod du mar gsang ba'i spyod pas 'gro don mtha' yas pa mdzad/ de'i tshe gtsang rgyas sde'i thang khar mkha' 'gro ma lngas glu blangs te thang stong rgyal po dang / lung ston smyon pa/ zas bcud len mkhan/ rkyen ro snyoms mkhan/ chos rnams skyags gtad med pa bcas mtshan lnga gsol bar grags pa nas phyis yongs su grags pa'i mtshan la thang stong rgyal po zhes bya ba de'i mkha' 'gro ma'i glu tshig la/khyab gdal chen po'i thang chen na/ /stong nyid rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /'jigs med rgyal po lta bur bzhugs/ /de phyir thang stong rgyal por thogs/ /cizhes bya ba de yin par grags so/grom pa rgyang du phebs/ lha khang dmar po nas rang gi chos skal thugs sgrub yang gsang bla na med pa'i chos 'khor gter nas bzhes par grags/de nas dbus su jo bo rin po che mjal ba sogs dbus gtsang gnas nges med lta bur phebs bzhud mdzad/ sgos gzhis su lo legs kyi nas mang du byung bas yab yum gyi chad bun 'jal dgos pa rnams phal cher gzhal nas lhag ma la gser dang / tshwa sogs bsgrubs te lho rong du tshong la byon thog bu lon lhag ma yongs rdzogs bcal nas da ni pha ma'i bu lon 'jal dgos ni med/ tshong la —sogs pa'i bya ba ngan pa rnams spangs te sgrub pa snying por mdzad dgos dgongs nas dben gnas thar pa gling gi sgrub khang du lo drug sgrub pa mdzad pa dang / mon sogs su phebs shing / lha dang mkha' 'gros lung bstan dang bskul ma zhus par gra/sdu pa bzhin slar 'khrungs yul du phebs te bod dbus gtsang gi chu klung chen po

sogs pa'i gnyan pa'i ri khrod du mar gsang ba'i spyod pas 'gro don mtha' yas pa mdzad/ de'i tshe gtsang rgyas sde'i thang khar mkha' 'gro ma lngas glu blangs te thang stong rgyal po dang / lung ston spyon pa/ zas bcud len mkhan/ rkyen ro snyoms mkhan/ chos rnams skyags gtad med pa bcas mtshan lnga gsol bar grags pa nas phyis yongs su grags pa'i mtshan la thang stong rgyal po zhes bya ba de'i mkha' 'gro ma'i glu tshig la/khyab gdal chen po'i thang chen na/ / stong nyid rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ / 'jigs med rgyal po lta bur bzhugs/ /de phyir thang stong rgyal por thogs/ / zhes bya ba de yin par grags so/grom pa rgyang du phebs/ lha khang dmar po nas rang gi chos skal thugs sgrub yang gsang bla na med pa'i chos 'khor gter nas bzhes par grags/de nas dbus su jo bo rin po che mjal ba sogs dbus gtsang gnas nges med lta bur phebs bzhud mdzad/ sgos gzhis su lo legs kyi nas mang du byung bas yab yum gyi chad bun 'jal dgos pa rnams phal cher gzhal nas lhag ma la gser dang / tshwa sogs bsgrubs te lho rong du tshong la byon thog bu lon lhag ma yongs rdzogs bcal nas da ni pha ma'i bu lon 'jal dgos ni med/ tshong la sogs pa'i bya ba ngan pa rnams spangs te sgrub pa snying por mdzad dgos dgongs nas dben gnas thar pa gling gi sgrub khang du lo drug sgrub pa mdzad pa dang / mon sogs su phebs shing / lha dang mkha' 'gros lung bstan dang bskul ma zhus par grags pa bzhin slar 'khrungs yul du phebs te bod dbus gtsang gi chu klung chen po 100

rnams la lcags zam 'dzugs pa'i lcags kong yul nas 'tshol bar dgongs te phyag rdzas tshong bsgyur gnang bar gser zho brgya tham pa byung ba bsnams te dbus phyogs phebs/ tshal gung thang gi me tog mchod pa gzigs grub nas lha san log byon pas skyi chu'i gru khar phebs/ gru nang du bzhugs pas/ mnyan pa mi gzhan la tshig pa zos te nga la ma dris par shan du 'jug pa ci yin/ mi drag pa tsho chu la lhung na khyod kyis khag theg gam zer/ khong gi dbu la shan skya lan gsum brgyab/shan nang nas chu la skyur byung bas/ grub thob chen po'i dgongs pa la/ kha drag cing nor yod pa rnams kyi dbang du song / snyoms chung rnams gru la mi 'jugachu la brgal yang mi nus pa snying rje/ da ni/ u rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po sogs rgya bod kyi bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams kyi rin chen lcags kyi zam pa 'dzugs par yang yang bskul ba ltar thog mar skyi chu la lcags zam 'dzugs pa'i lcags 'tshol ba dang / kla klo 'dul ba la 'gro dgongs pa shar/7zhes 'khod pa ltar grub chen thang stong rgyal pos bod kyi chu klung chen po rnams la lcags zam 'dzugs pa'i dgongs pa snga mo nas yod khar skabs 'dir mnyan pas khong la 'o brgyal bzos pa bcas skye bo zas gos kyis phongs shing nyams thag pa rnams la de bas thugs brtse'i 'ching zhags dam pos slar yang bcings te 'phral ma nyid du lcargos zam bskrun pa'i 'du 'god mdzad dgongs nas dkon mchog la thugs smon bzang pos mtshams sbyar te lha sa'i khrom dkyil du sku sa'i khungs bu brus pa'i nang du bcug dbu bton nas bzhugs pas/ lha sa'i gzhis byes kun gyis mos gus dang zhabs tog chen po byas/sngar ni lkog tu chos zhu ba las ma byung / da dngos su thog mar chos gang zhu dang /'bul ba gang byed kyi rten 'brel las/ kha ba can 'dir 'khor lo gsum dang yi dam gyi lha gang la brten nas 'gro don byed brtag dgos dgongs pa'i tshe/101sku

rnams la lcags zam 'dzugs pa'i lcags kong yul nas 'tshol bar dgongs te phyag rdzas tshong bsgyur gnang bar gser zho brgya tham pa byung ba bsnams te dbus phyogs phebs/ tshal gung thang gi me tog mchod pa gzigs grub nasaphalha sar log byon pas skyi chu'i gru khar phebs/ gru nang du bzhugs pas/ mnyan pa mi gzhan la tshig pa zos te nga la ma dris par shan du 'jug pa ci yin/ mi drag pa tsho chu la lhung na khyod kyis khag theg gam zer/ khong gi dbu la shan skya lan gsum brgyab/shan nang nas chu la skyur byung bas/ grub thob chen po'i dgongs pa la/ kha drag cing nor yod pa rnams kyi dbang du song / snyoms chung rnams gru la mi 'jugachu la brgal yang mi nus pa snying rje/ da ni/ u rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po sogs rgya bod kyi bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams kyi rin chen lcags kyi zam pa 'dzugs par yang yang bskul ba ltar thog mar skyi chu la lcags zam 'dzugs pa'i lcags 'tshol ba dang / kla klo 'dul ba la 'gro dgongs pa shar/mi zhes 'khod pa ltar grub chen thang stong rgyal pos bod kyi chu klung chen po rnams la lcags zam 'dzugs pa'i dgongs pa snga mo nas yod khar skabs 'dir mnyan pas khong la 'o brgyal bzos pa bcas skye bo zas gos kyis phongs shing nyams thag pa rnams la de bas thugs brtse'i 'ching zhags dam pos slar yang bcings te 'phral ma nyid du lcagos zam bskrun pa'i 'du 'god mdzad dgongs nas dkon mchog la thugs smon bzang pos mtshams sbyar te4lha sa'i khrom dkyil du sku sa'i khungs bu brus pa'i nang du bcug dbu bton nas bzhugs pas/ lha sa'i gzhis byes kun gyis mos gus dang zhabs tog chen po byas/sngar ni lkog tu chos zhu ba las ma byung / da dngos su thog mar chos gang zhu dang /'bul ba gang byed kyi rten 'brel las/ kha ba can 'dir 'khor lo gsum dang yi dam gyi lha gang la brten nas 'gro don byed brtag dgos dgongs pa'i tshe sku 101

drung du btsun ma gsum byung nas/ smyung gnas kyi sdom pa dang / ma ṇi'i lung zhu zer ba la/ thong rnams la 'bul ba che yod chung yod dad pa dang 'byor pa'i khyad par yin/ rang rang gi sems la ci dran gyi 'bul ba re khyer shog gsungs pas/gcig gis shing rdum gcig rnyed byung ba phul/ gcig gis rdo legs po zhig rnye da byung ba phul/ gcig gis 'bul ba ci yang ma khyer bar lus ngag yid gsum 'bul zer ba la/ ngas rgya gar dang bod kyi malas grub rig 'dzin rnams las zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu thob pas/ gangs ri'i ljongs kyi dben pa'i ri sul thams cad dgon pas bkang / sgrub rgyud kyi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sa gsum na 'gran zla med pa zhig 'dzugs bsam pa yin te/ da lam chos 'brel dang 'bul ba'i rten 'brel ni/ ngas gsung mchog yi ge drug pa la brtenanas/ mthongathos dran reg gi sems can gnas skabs mngon mtho'i dpal la sbyor zhing / mthar thug nges par legs pa bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god pa'i phyir/ sa rdo shing gsum la las ka byas nas kha ba can pa la phan bde 'byung ba'i sa'i me btsa'/ lam 'phrang dang chu 'phrang lha 'dre mi gsum rgyu ba'i sar chom rkun dang / jag pa/ lha 'dre'i 'jigs pa pa las skyob pa'i dgon gnas rnams su gtsug lag khang dang sku gsung thugs rten ji snyed bzhengs shing / chu klung chen po rnams la gru shan dang rin chen lcags kyi zam pa brtan po las skye dgu ci bder rgyu ba'i rten 'brel dang / lus ngag yid gsum 'bul zer ba ni/ nga'i rjes 'jug bu slob rnams kyis 'dus byas kyi dge ba la brten/ 'dus ma byas chos nyid kyi don rtogs pa'i rten 'brel 'grig go〉〉〈thang stong rgyal po'i rnam thar nor bu me lor 〉las zhes gsungs pa ltar gsung mchog ma ṇi yig drug ma gtso bor gyur pa'i dam pa'i chos rgya cher spel ba dang / lcags zam 'dzugs pa'i dam bca' g.yo ba 102

sras rnam rgyal bzang pos lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje'i bla g.yu gnam sngo leb sogs rin po che du ma dang / gos dar rta drel ja sigs brgya phrag gnyis dang bcas pa phul lo/〉 zhes gsal ba'i gong mar bka' lan 'bul ba dang / sku brnyan gsar bzhengs rnams kyi na bza'i rgyur dar gos kyi gnang sbyin yong ba'i re ba zhu ba bcas su brgyad sde pa dge 'dun rgyal mtshan gcung ri bo che nas gong ma'i drung du gtong gnang mdzad pa'i skor yang rnam thar nang 'khor 'dug gzhan yang grub chen thang stong rgyal pos dbung gtsang dang / mnga' ris stod smad/ lho mon/ rgya gar dang bal yul sogs mang por phebs te skye 'gro'i don mdzad pa re re nas brjod kyis mi langs ba zhib par gzigs 'dod na bde chen 'gyur med kyis mdzad pa'i thang stong rgyal po'i rnam thar nor bu'i me long soṭa rnam thar khag la spyan ras g.yo par zhu zhing / skabs 'dir ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa'i cha shas kyi mtshon dpe dang / mdzad pa spyi'i sdom tshig lta bur zhu na/(1)mdzad pa cha shas kyi mtshon dpe ni/ thengs gcig 'bri gung nas lha sar byon pa'i lam bar bu mo gzhon nu gsum byung nas sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel 'od 'bar ba dang / g.yu nor bu'i dbyibs can bdun/ gzhan yang rin po che'i rigs mang po phul nas rin po che 'di rnams la rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i sku bzhengs bar bskul bar grags pa nas skyi shod 'phan yul sogs su gser g.yu dung mu men sogs rin po che'i 'bul ba byung ba rnams la sangs rgyas kyi sku bzheng rgyur thugs thag gcad nas/ yon bdag mo skal bzang la rin po che 'di rnams la sku sna tshogs bzhengs pa la/ khyed kyis bzo rigs pa gang yod la yoge thongs gsungs pas/ bzo bo lnga bcu tsam sang nyin nyi ma phyed gong yan la 'dzoms/grub thob chen pos rin po che 'di dag la khyed rnams kyis sku bzo rogs gyis 107

sras rnam rgyal bzang pos lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje'i bla g.yu gnam sngo leb sogs rin po che du ma dang / gos dar rta drel ja sigs brgya phrag gnyis dang bcas pa phul lo/ri zhes gsal ba'i gong mar bka' lan 'bul ba dang / sku brnyan gsar bzhengs rnams kyi na bza'i rgyur dar gos kyi gnang sbyin yong ba'i re ba zhu ba bcas su brgyad sde pa dge 'dun rgyal mtshan gcung ri bo che nas gong ma'i drung du gtong gnang mdzad pa'i skor yang rnam thar nang 'khor 'dugagazhan yang grub chen thang stong rgyal pos dbung gtsang dang / mnga' ris stod smad/ lho mon/ rgya gar dang bal yul sogs mang por phebs te skye 'gro'i don mdzad pa re re nas brjod kyis mi langs ba zhib par gzigs 'dod na bde chen 'gyur med kyis mdzad pa'i thang stong rgyal po'i rnam thar nor bu'i me long soṭa rnam thar khag la spyan ras g.yo par zhu zhing / skabs 'dir ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa'i cha shas kyi mtshon dpe dang / mdzad pa spyi'i sdom tshig lta bur zhu na/(1)mdzad pa cha shas kyi mtshon dpe ni/ thengs gcig 'bri gung nas lha sar byon pa'i lam bar bu mo gzhon nu gsum byung nas sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel 'od 'bar ba dang / g.yu nor bu'i dbyibs can bdun/ gzhan yang rin po che'i rigs mang po phul nas rin po che 'di rnams la rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i sku bzhengs bar bskul bar grags pa nas skyi shod 'phan yul sogs su gser g.yu dung mu men sogs rin po che'i 'bul ba byung ba rnams la sangs rgyas kyi sku bzheng rgyur thugs thag gcad nas/ phayon bdag mo skal bzang la rin po che 'di rnams la sku sna tshogs bzhengs pa la/ khyed kyis bzo rigs pa gang yod la yoge thongs — gsungs pas/ bzo bo lnga bcu tsam sang nyin nyi ma phyed gong yan la 'dzoms/grub thob chen pos rin po che 'di dag la khyed rnams kyis sku bzo rogs ༵༵

gsungs pas/ bzo rigs rnams gros byas/ rgya bod gang na'ang g.yu las bzos pa'i lha sku yod zer ba rna bas ma thos/ mig gis ma mthong bas/ g.yu dang rin po che mang po yod pa'i nor ngom mi mdzad par zhu zer ba la/ yang skyar bzo pa rnams la khyed rnams kyis skyes pa dang bud med kyi rgyan la rdo rje rgya gram nor bu sogs bzo shes/ sku mi shes zer ba nan tar ma 'os gsungs te g.yu rnying drug dkar dmar la grub thob chen po rang gis bcad gtubs dang brdar bsgrigs kyi zhal bkod mdzad pas g.yu'i rdo rje 'chang khru gang tshad ldan pa myur du grub 〉’pa de nas g.yu'i sangs rgyas sman bla/ don yod grub pa/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ dung las grub pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi sku che chung bdun/ byu ru las grub pa'i 'od dpag med dang / tshe dpag med kyi sku sogs bzhengs pa rnam thar nang zhib par 'khod pa'i sku brnyan 'ga' zhig de snga lcags po rir kun gyi 'dren byed kyi yul du gyur pa de dag gis mtshon nus/ — (2)mdzad pa spyi'i sdom tshig ni/ lcags zam dang gru shan gi grangs 'bor skor gong 'khod ltar dang / sku rten rgyab mtho sum cu so bdun che tshad dang /chung tshad mkhyid gang las byas pa'i rin po che gser dngul byu ru mu men spos shel dung sogs las grub pa brgya phrag du ma/ 'jim pa las grub pa rgyab mtho lnga bcu rtsa lnga nas mtho gsum ma'i bar stong phrag lnga/ gyang ris ras bris bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ 'du khang dang gtsug lag khang brgya dang nyi shu/ gsung gi rten gser las grub pa'i bka' 'gyur zhig gis mgo byas bka' 'gyur bco brgyad/ bstan 'gyur bco lnga/ thugs kyi rten dpal ri bo che'i mchod rten chen po'i phyogs re la pho 'dom bzhi bcu yod pa che tshad/ phyogs re la 'dom brgyad yod pa chung tshad byas pa'i mchod rten brgya dang bcu gcig dben gnas thar pa gling la sogs pa 108

gsungs pas/ bzo rigs rnams gros byas/ rgya bod gang na'ang g.yu las bzos pa'i lha sku yod zer ba rna bas ma thos/ mig gis ma mthong bas/ g.yu dang rin po che mang po yod pa'i nor ngom mi mdzad par zhu zer ba la/ yang skyar bzo pa rnams la khyed rnams kyis skyes pa dang bud med kyi rgyan la rdo rje rgya gram nor bu sogs bzo shes/ sku mi shes zer ba nan tar ma 'os gsungs te g.yu rnying drug dkar dmar la grub thob chen po rang gis bcad gtubs dang brdar bsgrigs kyi zhal bkod mdzad pas g.yu'i rdo rje 'chang khru gang tshad ldan pa myur du grub 〉 pa de nas g.yu'i sangs rgyas sman bla/ don yod grub pa/ rje btsun sgrol ma/ dung las grub pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi sku che chung bdun/ byu ru las grub pa'i 'od dpag med dang / tshe dpag med kyi sku sogs bzhengs ba rnam thar nang zhib par 'khod pa'i sku brnyan 'ga' zhig de snga lcags po rir kun gyi 'dren byed kyi yul du gyur pa de dag gis mtshon nus/(2)mdzad pa spyi'i sdom tshig ni/ lcags zam dang gru shan gi grangs 'bor skor gong 'khod ltar dang / sku rten rgyab mtho sum cu so bdun che tshad dang /chung tshad mkhyid gang las byas pa'i rin po che gser dngul byu ru mu men spos shel dung sogs las grub pa brgya phrag du ma/ 'jim pa las grub pa rgyab mtho lnga bcu rtsa lnga nas mtho gsum ma'i bar stong phrag lnga/ gyang ris ras bris bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ 'du khang dang gtsug lag khang brgya dang nyi shu/ gsung gi rten gser las grub pa'i bka' 'gyur zhig gis mgo byas bka' 'gyur bco brgyad/ bstan 'gyur bco lnga/ thugs kyi rten dpal ri bo che'i mchod rten chen po'i phyogs re la pho 'dom bzhi bcu yod pa che tshad/ phyogs re la 'dom brgyad yod pa chung tshad bya/ sdu'i mchod rten brgya dang bcu gcig dben gnas thar pa gling la sogs pa

sgrub sde mang po dang / sems can gyi srog skyob pa/ sbas yul dang mtha' 'khob rnams su gnas sgo 'byed pa sogs dngos yod kyi mdzad 'phrin de dag ni sgro skur dang bral ba don la gnas pa zhig yin pas nga tsho'i mes po bka' drin can grub chen 'di nyed kyi mdzad rjes dus nam yang brjed par mi rigs shing / lhag par sne mi 'dra ba'i rinar che so so 'ba' zhig las bskrun pa'i sku rten dang / gcung ri bo cher bzhugs pa'i sku 'bum mchod rten chen mo'i sku tshad sogs skabs de'i spyi tshogs dar rgyas la dpags na bsam brjod las 'das pa'i mdzad rjes yin la/ bod rigs mi dmangs kyi spobs pa zhig kyang yin snyam mo/de lta bu'i mdzad rjes la brten nas kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir lcags zam gyis mtshon zam bzo'i lag rtsal dang / rin po che'i rigs la bzo bkod 'don pa'i lag rtsal/ gtsug lag khang dang sku 'bum bzhengs pa'i lag rtsal/ gzhan yang lcags 'bor chen bzhu btul dang btso sbyang brdung bzo'i lag rtsal la sogs pa bzo las kyi bya gzhag gang cir spyi lo'i dus rabs bco lnga pa'i skabs la mtshon na bshad rin chog pa'i bya ba mang po zhig gnang yod pa dang / des bod riṭa mi dmangs kyi bzo las bya gzhag 'phel rgyas 'gro bar nus pa chen po thon yod ces bshad na mi 'tsham pa med pa bcas de lta bu'i mdzad pa dpag tu med pa bskyangs mthar dgung lo brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga pa spyi lo 1486bod rab byung brgyad pa'i shing sbrul lor gcung ri bo cher mya ngan 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa bcas so/109

sgrub sde mang po dang / sems can gyi srog skyob pa/ sbas yul dang mtha' 'khob rnams su gnas sgo 'byed pa sogs dngos yod kyi mdzad 'phrin de dag ni sgro skur dang bral ba don la gnas pa zhig yin pas nga tsho'i mes po bka' drin cam grub chen 'di nyed kyi mdzad rjes dus nam yang brjed par mi rigs shing / lhag par sne mi 'dra ba'i rinar che so so 'ba' zhig las bskrun pa'i sku rten dang / gcung ri bo cher bzhugs pa'i sku 'bum mchod rten chen mo'i sku tshad sogs skabs de'i spyi tshogs dar rgyas la dpags na bsam brjod las 'das pa'i mdzad rjes yin la/ bod rigs mi dmangs kyi spobs pa zhig kyang yin snyam mo/de lta bu'i mdzad rjes la brten nas kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir lcags zam gyis mtshon zam bzo'i lag rtsal dang / rin po che'i rigs la bzo bkod 'don pa'i lag rtsal/ gtsug lag khang dang sku 'bum bzhengs pa'i lag rtsal/ gzhan yang lcags 'bor chen bzhu btul dang btso sbyang brdung bzo'i lag rtsal la sogs pa bzo las kyi bya gzhag gang cir spyi lo'i dus rabs bco lnga pa'i skabs la mtshon na bshad rin chog pa'i bya ba mang po zhig gnang yod pa dang / des bod riṭa mi dmangs kyi bzo las bya gzhag 'phel rgyas 'gro bar nus pa chen po thon yod ces bshad na mi 'tsham pa med pa bcas de lta bu'i mdzad pa dpag tu med pa bskyangs mthar dgung lo brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga pa spyi lo 1486bod rab byung brgyad pa'i shing sbrul lor gcung ri bo cher mya ngan 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa bcas so/ 109

le'u brgyad pa/ rin spungs dang gtsang pa sde srid kyi skor/(1618—1642)sgor rin spungs pa ni/ spur rgyal gyi btsan po sku phreng brgyad pa gri gum btsan por sras sha khri dang / bya khri/ nya khri gsum yod rig las/ sha khri'i sku dus kyi blon po zhig yin/ de dag gi gdung rgyud rnams kyis chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i nang blon dang / blo gros rtsal ldan zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyi chos blon mdzad/ de nas mi rabs nyi shu lhag tsam song tshe sger shākya 'bum gyi sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis phag thu'i wang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs la gtugs/ gzhis ka rin spungs kyi rdzong dpon dang / chu mig gi khrims dpon/ sa skya lha khang chen mo'i dpon chen gnang / de'i sras nam mkha' rgyal po sku na chung ba'i dus nas chos srid gnyis ma'i mkhyen rgya shin tu yangs pa zhig byung /rab byung bdun pa'i me sprel(1416)lor/ ming gong ma chen po yung los rin spungs la bkod 'doms pu'u btsugs nas nam mkha' rgyal por sne mo las 'dzin pa bskos gnang ba ma zad/ dpa' ngar can gyi dmag dpon zhes pa'i ming gnang /de yi sras nor bu bzang pos yab kyi go gnas rgyun 'dzin byas pa ma zad/ phag grus 1sdus 'dzin rdzong sdod sogs byas/ der sras u pa si ka dang / kun tu

le'u brgyad pa/ rin spungs dang gtsang pa sde srid kyi skor/(1618—1642)sger rin spungs pa ni/ spur rgyal gyi btsan po sku phreng brgyad pa gri gum btsan por sras sha khri dang / bya khri/ nya khri gsum yod pa las/ sha khri'i sku dus kyi blon po zhig yin/ de dag gi gdung rgyud rnams kyis chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i nang blon dang / blo gros rtsal ldan zla ba rgyal mtshan gyis mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyi chos blon mdzad/ de nas mi rabs nyi shu lhag tsam song tshe sger shākya 'bum gyi sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyis phag gru'i wang grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhabs la gtugs/ gzhis ka rin spungs kyi rdzong dpon dang / chu mig gi khrims dpon/ sa skya lha khang chen mo'i dpon chen gnang / de'i sras nam mkha' rgyal po sku na chung ba'i dus nas chos srid gnyis ma'i mkhyen rgya shin tu yangs pa zhig byung /rab byung bdun pa'i me sprel(1416)lor/ ming gong ma chen po yung los rin spungs la bkod 'doms pu'u btsugs nas nam mkha' rgyal por sne mo las 'dzin pa bskos gnang ba ma zad/ dpa' ngar can gyi dmag dpon zhes pa'i ming gnang /de yi sras nor bu bzang pos yab kyi go gnas rgyun 'dzin byas pa ma zad/ phag gru'i las 'dzin rdzong sdod sogs byas/ der sras u pa si ka dang / kun tu 110

bzang po/ don grub rdo rje/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ shākya rgyal mtshan dang bcas lnga las/ sras bgres ba u pa si ka chung ngu nas dgongs pa 'das/ kun tu bzang pos phag gru'i wang grags pa 'byung gnas sku mched kyi zhabs la gtugs/ yab mes gyi 'ja' sa las 'dzin gnang ste rin spungs rdzong dpon mdzad/ don grub rdo rjes gzhis ka bsam grub rtse'i rdzong dpon gnang / mtsho skyes rdo rjes spyan snga ngag gi dbang po gshegs rjes gdung sras sku na phra bas re zhig ring phag gru'i srid dbang bzung / shākya rgyal mtshan gyis nyang khog gi rdzong gzhis su bzhugs/skabs der rin spungs pa ni phag gru'i sne mo las 'dzin pa zhig yin gshis/'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po dang / tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan sogs wang rgyal po rim byon gyis yab mes kyi byas rjes la gzhigs te rin spungs par dmag dpon dang / blon po/ rdzong dpon sogs bsko gzhag bstsal ba tsam ma zad/phag gru'i gdung rgyud dang / rin spungs pa'i dbar gnyen 'brel btsugs/'on kyang bka' drin la bsam shes med par drin lan log 'jal zhes pa'i dpe ltar/ phag gru'i gdung rgyud nang khul 'gal ba byung ba'i go skabs de dang bstun nas rang nyid kyis bod yongs kyi srid dbang bzung ba'i ham sems bcangs/rab byung bdun pa'i shing yos(1435)lor dngos su rgyab gtod byas nas gzhis ka bsam grub rtse sogs btsan bzung byas te rang nyid kyi srid dbang btsugs/rin spungs pa nor bu bzang po dang / de'i bu kun tu bzang po dang / don grub rdo rje/ mtsho skyes rdo rje/ kun tu bzang po'i bu don yod rdo rje sogs kyis snga rjes su gtsang khul gyi sa cha mang che ba ham bzung byas/ de nas dbus phyogs su dmag drangs nas sne'u rdzong sogs rdzong gzhis mang po btsan bzung byas/ sne'u gdong 111

har gyi len tan rgyal por gsang yig btang bas/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me byi(1636)lor/ phas gong gsal gyi gnas tshul shes 'phral ched mngags mi btang nas ar sa lang dang las rogs dmag dpon mi gsum bkrongs skad/ yang deb ther 'ga' zhig tu pha yis gnas tshul de thos rjes ar sa lang la mgo bskor btang ste lkog bsad gtong dgos pa'i gsang yig 'byor ba ltar de'i blon po tha'i ching gis lkog bsad btang ba red ces 'khod/ ar sa lang lkog bsad btang ba'i phyi lor gu shri han dang hung ji mnyam sbrel gyis dpung dmag khri gcig tsam khrid de cha har gyi chog thu rgyal por rgol byas te dmag rgyag thengs gcig la dmag mi sum stong tsam rtsa med btang bas chog thu rgyal po dpon dmag rnams dbang med du mgo sgur/mtsho sngon gyi sa cha yongs rim bzhin gu shri han gyis bzung / shar mtsho sngon po'i 'gram nas nub bod kyi byang ngos tsho pa sum cu so dgu'i khongs su gtogs pa'i bod sde dang sog lde mtha' dag dbang du 'dus/rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me glang(1637)lor/ gu thi han dpon 'khor dang bcas pa da bus su 'byor/ rgyal mchog lnga pa chen pos bsu ba dang sne len gzab rgyas gnang ba dang 'brel gu shri bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po zhes mtshan gsol ba dang dam kha phul/ de rjes gu shri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis dbus kyi sa gnas gtso bo khag la bskor zhib byas te mtsho sngon du phyir logarab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa yos(1639)lor/ be ri sa 'go don yod rdo rjes gtsang pa sde srid la dpung rogs dmag mi gtong rtsis byas stabs 'di lo'i zla ba lnga par gu shri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal dpung dmag dang bcas pa smar khams su 'byor te be ri sa 'go don yod rdo rje srog thog btang / sde dge dang / dkar 117

mdzes/ ldan khog sogs yul sde mang po btsan bzung thog der 'go gtso bsko bzhag gis lo ltar khral bsdu len byas/ de nas gu shri dpon dmag rnams mtsho sngon du phyir log 'gro tshul gyis glo bur du bod la yong nas gtsang pa sde srid kurma bstan skyong dbang por phar rgol byas te phan tshun dmag 'thab drag po thengs mang byas mthar gzhis ka bsam grub rtse sogs dmag gis mtha' bskor/ gtsang pa sde srid garma bstan skyong dbang po dpon 'khor 'ga' zhig yul gzhan du bros/gtsang dmag rnams dbang med du mgo sgur/ de nas gtsang pa sde srid kyis kurma ba dang / sa skya pas dpang po mdzad de rang nyid srog thog mi gtong bar 'tsho rten phran bu gnang tshe slad phyin bka' gyen log dang mi snyan sbrang skad tsam yang mi 'don par sdod rgyu'i gan rgya bzhag gan rgya'i ma yig de da lta'ang dngos su mthong rgyu yod/ 'on kyang sog dmag gis g.yo thabs la brten nas kho pa tshur bkug ste dmar gsod btang / yang deb ther 'ga' zhig tu gtsang pa sde srid dmag thog nas bzung mthar ko btums brgyab ste gzhis rtse'i gtsang chur bskyur ba red ces 'khod/gtsang pa sde srid kurma bstan skyong dbang pos/ rab byung bcu pa'i sa rta(1618)lor/ phag gru'i srid dbang dngos su mgo rteng bslogs nas bod yongs kyi srid kyi bdag por gyur/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu rta(1642)lor/ sog dmag gis gtsang pa sde srid rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa cham la phab ste bod kyi srid dbang rgyal mchog lnga pa blo bzang rgya mtshor phul nas dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang dngos su btsugs so/118skabs der ming rgyal rabs kyang la kha'i nyi ma ltar nyams gud kyi gnas su

gyar/ 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i gdung rgyud dbar srid dbang 'phrog res byed pa'i 'thab rtsod yang yang byung ba dang / dbang sgyur gral rim nang khul gyi 'gal ba'ang ches rno ngar dang dza drag che bar gyur/ kho pa tshos rgya che'i ngal rtsol mi dmangs la mnar gcod dang / brdabs gsig tshad med btang bar brten rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa 'brug(1628)lor zhing pa'i 'os langs chen po langs/'os langs thog mar hra'an zhi'i byang ngos su byung / gang yin zer na/ dus der hra'an zhi'i byang ngos su dmag 'khrug dang mu ge chen po byung stabs yan an sa gnas sogs bca' sdod gong ma'i dpung dmag rnams la'ang 'bru rigs mi 'dang bas zhing pa dang mnyam 'brel gyis gong mar ngo rgol byas/ me kre'i li tse khring(1606nas1645lo bar)dang yan an gyi krang sha'an krung(1606nas1646lo bar)sogs zhing pa'i 'os langs kyi gtso 'dzin yin/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag(1635)lor/ zhing pa'i 'os langs kyi gtso 'dzin rnams ho nan gyi rung yung sa gnas la tshogs chen 'tshogs/ dus der zhing pa'i 'os langs kyi gtso 'dzin nang nas li tse khring dang krang sha'an krung rnam gnyis mtshan snyan che shos yin pa dang / krang sha'an krung gis dpung dmag sne khred de ho nan nas/ an hud/hu'u sbe/ hu'u nan brgyud si khron sa gnas bu 'byor/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing sbrel(1644)lor/ li tse khring gis dmag dpung rnams khrid de hra'an zhi'i nas chu brgal te byang ngos su bskyod/ thas yon dang tā thung sogs brgyud pe cing du 'byor/ ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma khrung kun(1628nas1644lo bar)bros ma thar bar gong ma'i pho brang gi rgyab ngos cin hran ri bo'i steng du rang srog rang gis lcebs/ de nas ming rgyal rabs 'thor zhig song ste chin rgyal rabs dngos su 119

btsugs/mdor na/ phag gru'i dus skabs su bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang khag dang /chos lugs grub mtha' so so phan tshun gcig la gcig brten thog srid dbang 'phrog res byed pa'i 'thab rtsod mang du byung / 'on kyang phyogs khag so so'i dpon rigs dang bla ma che khag tshos thabs rnam pa sna tshogs la brten nas ming gong ma rim byon gyi cho lo dang 'ja' sa thob pa byas te rang nyid kyi mtshan snyan dang srid dbang che ru btang / 'jam dbyangs gong ma rim byon gyis kyang bod kyi dpon rigs dang /bla ma che gras khag la chos rgyal dang / hran hā wang / wang kwan din gu shi/ gu shri sogs kyi cho lo 'ja' sa dang dam kha gnang / grub mtha' ris med dang zhi ba'i srid byus la brten nas bod kyi chab srid legs par bskyangs/ bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas sogs sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i dar rgyas gong 'phel byung / dper na/ phag gru byang chub rgyal mtshan khri la 'khod ma thag tu sngar yod kyi gzhis ka rnams la nyams gso dang / gong dkar sogs rdzong chen bcu gsum du btsugs/ yul gru so sor skye shing 'dzugs pa dang / zhing las lag rtsal legs bcos thog thon skyed mtho ru gtong ba'i byed thabs 'ga' zhig gtan 'bebs byas pa sogs la brten bod kyi zhing 'brog las sngar dang mi 'dra bar gong du 'phel/'grim 'grul thad/ bod dang mes rgyal nang khul dang / bod sa gnas khag dbar gyi sa tshigs babs tshugs sngar las 'thus sgo tshang ba byung ba ma zad/thang stong rgyal bos(ming dngos khro bo dpal ldan nam brtson 'grus bzang po)bod kyi sa gnas khag la lcags zam lnga bcu nga brgyad dang / gru shan brgya dang bco 120

brgyad/ shing zam drug cu tsam btsugs/ dkar mdzes sa khul du'ang yun ring bzhugs/ da lta sde dger thang stong rgyal po'i mtshams khang dngos su mjal rgyu yod cing / lu'u ting lcags zam yang thang stong rgyal pos btsugs pa yin zer skad/gong du smos pali lcags zam de dag mang che ba gtor zin na'ang / la la da lta dngos su mthong rgyu yod la/ bod kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i gru shan rta mgo can bcings 'grol btang ba'i rjes su'ang lha sa'i skyid chu'i thog tu mthong rgyu yod/thang stong rgyal po ni bzo rig la mkhas pa zhig yin pa ma zad/ gso ba rig pa dang rig rtsal la'ang mchog tu mnga' ba zhig yin/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bod kyi lha mo'i zlos gar de'ang thang stong rgyal pos brtsams pa yin zhes yongs su grags/ de snga lha mo 'khrab ston byed skabs thang stong rgyal po'i 'dra sku zhig 'khyer srol 'dugagong gsal 'di dag gi thog nas skabs der bod kyi bzo rig lag rtsal gyi chu tshad nges can zhig yod pa gsal por mthong thub/de bzhin ar las 'dzugs skrun thad la'ang skabs der dar khyab shugs chen byung / bod kyi ar las 'dzugs skrun ni lo rgyus yun ring yod la thun mong ma yin pa'i mi rigs kyi khyad chos dang ldan pa zhig red/ lo ngo bzhi stong ngam lnga stong gi sngon rol du bod la mtho'i thog khang pa rgyag pa'i lag rtsal dar yod pa dang / da nas rtsis pa'i lo ngo nyis stong brgya lhag tsam gyi sngon du pho brang snga ba yum bu gla mkhar bzhengs/ de nas gri gum btsan po'i dus su grong la snga ba 'bying ba stag rtse zhes pa khang pa mang po brgyab ste grong sde chags/ srong btsan gyi sku dus nas bzung da lta 'dzam gling yongs la grags che ba'i dmar po ri yi pho brang dang / lha ldan gtsug lag khang / rgya stag ra mo che/ khra 'brug dgon pa/ bsam yas dgon pa/121sa

skya dgon pa sogs mdzes shing lta na sdug pa/ brjid chags ldan pa'i pho brang dang /gtsug lag khang du ma bzhengs/ phag gru'i dus skabs su bod kyi ar las 'dzugs skrun sogs kyi lag rtsal sngar dang mi 'dra bar gong 'phel ches cher phyin nas 'jig rten 'di na grags che ba'i gdan sa chen po bzhi bzhengs pa 'di dag gi thog nas bod kyi ar las lag rtsal dang / brkos ris 'jim bzo/ gser bzo/dngul bzo/ lcags bzo/ 'tshem bzo sogs kyi lag rtsal tshad gzhi ni mi rnams ha las dgos pa zhig red/ de thog nas bod kyi ngal rtsol mi dmangs ni las la brtson zhing / dpal bar che ba dang / spyang grung 'dzoms la shes rig ldan pa zhig yin pa'i ra 'phrod gsal po byung /dpal 'byor gong du 'phel ba dang / phyogs mtshungs bod kyi rig gnas la'ang dar rgyas chen po byung / dus der bod kyi mkhas mchog rnams kyis brtsams pa'i deb ther dang / chos 'byung / rnam thar/ rtogs brjod sogs shin tu mang po thon/ dper na/ dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas brtsams pa'i chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston dang / 'gos lo gzhon nu dpal gyis brtsams pa'i deb ther sngon po/ tshal pa kun dga' rdo rjes brtsams pa'i hu lan(sog skad la dmar po'i don yin)deb ther dmar po/ sa skya pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis brtsams pa'i rgyal rabs gsal ba'i me long / bu ston rin chen grub gyis brtsams pa'i bu ston chos 'byung / tā si tu byung chub rgyal mtshan gyis brtsams pa'i rang nyid kyi rnam thar bka' chems mthong ba don ldan sogs lta bu'o/ deb ther dang / chos 'byung / rnam thar de dag nang du sngon byon mkhas dbang rnams kyis 'jig rten chags tshul dang / 'gro ba mi'i rigs ji ltar dar ba'i skor/ gna' rabs 122
