btsan po rim byon gyi lo rgyus/ dus rabs khag gi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas bcas dar tshul/ rgya nag dang rgya gar yul du dam pa'i chos ji ltar dar ba'i tshul/ bod kyi sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi grub mthal khag dar tshul sogs kyi lo rgyus dngos don mang po bkod yod pa dang / lhag par du chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po dang / rgya bza' kong jo mtsho yi padmas btsugs gnang ba'i rgya bod spun zla'i 'brel bar bsngags brjod tshad med mdzad/ deb dmar nang du thang rgyal rabs dang / spun zla mi rigs gzhan gyi lo rgyus mang tsam bkod yod gshes/ de bzhin deb ther dang / chos 'byung de dag nang khyim mtshes rgyal khab kyi lo rgyus dang chos lugs dar tshul skor zhib par bkod yod pas/ khong tsho'i lo rgyus rtsom skabs phan thogs chen po byung ba/ dper na/ rgya gar ba'i lo rgyus che mo rtsom mkhan rgya gar ba'i mkhas pa yan khe shin hā dang / u khe san sna ji rnam gnyis kyis krung go'i dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs la ma brten par rgya gar ba'i gna' rabs kyi lo rgyus cha tshang zhig rtsom thabs bral bas/ de'i thad bod kyi mkhas pas brtsams pa'i chos 'byung gis nga tshor phan thogs chen po byung zhes bsngags brjod yang yang mdzad/tshal pa kun dga' rdo rje dang / bu ston rin chen grub sogs mkhas pa'i dbang po dag gis rig gnas kyi bang mdzod ces pa'i bka' 'gyur dang / bstan 'gyur phyogs bsgrigs gnang ba red/ des 'dzam gling gi rig gnas bang mdzod nang du 'od stong ldan pa'i nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung phul ba ltar yin pas/da lta'ang 'dzam gling yongs kyi gzur gnas mkhas pa rnams kyis bsngags brjod tshad med gnang bas de ni rang cag krung hwa mi rigs kyi gzi brjid cig ma yi/ 2)ma/

btsan po rim byon gyi lo rgyus/ dus rabs khag gi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas bcas dar tshul/ rgya nag dang rgya gar yul du dam pa'i chos ji ltar dar ba'i tshul/ bod kyi sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi grub mthal khag dar tshul sogs kyi lo rgyus dngos don mang po bkod yod pa dang / lhag par du chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po dang / rgya bza' kong jo mtsho yi padmas btsugs gnang ba'i rgya bod spun zla'i 'brel bar bsngags brjod tshad med mdzad/ deb dmar nang du thang rgyal rabs dang / spun zla mi rigs gzhan gyi lo rgyus mang tsam bkod yod gshis/ de bzhin deb ther dang / chos 'byung de dag nang khyim mtshes rgyal khab kyi lo rgyus dang chos lugs dar tshul skor zhib par bkod yod pas/ khong tsho'i lo rgyus rtsom skabs phan thogs chen po byung ba/ dper na/ rgya gar ba'i lo rgyus che mo rtsom mkhan rgya gar ba'i mkhas pa an khe shin hā dang / u khe san sna ji rnam gnyis kyis krung go'i dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs la ma brten par rgya gar ba'i gna' rabs kyi lo rgyus cha tshang zhig rtsom thabs bral bas/ de'i thad bod kyi mkhas pas brtsams pa'i chos 'byung gis nga tshor phan thogs chen po byung zhes bsngags brjod yang yang mdzad/tshal pa kun dga' rdo rje dang / bu ston rin chen grub sogs mkhas pa'i dbang po dag gis rig gnas kyi bang mdzod ces pa'i bka' 'gyur dang / bstan 'gyur phyogs bsgrigs gnang ba red/ des 'dzam gling gi rig gnas bang mdzod nang du 'od stong ldan pa'i nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung phul ba ltar yin pas/da lta'ang 'dzam gling yongs kyi gzur gnas mkhas pa rnams kyis bsngags brjod tshad med gnang bas de ni rang cag krung hwa mi rigs kyi gzi brjid cig ma yin nam/123

bod mi rigs kyi gzi brjid cang yin/phyogs mtshungs sman rtsis dang / sgra/ tshad ma/ sgyu rtsal sogs kyang gong 'phel ches cher phyin/bod kyi rig gnas ni/ krung hwa mi rigs kyi rig gnas bang mdzod nang gi ngo mtshar can gyi nor bu zhig yin stabs da lta phyi nang gi mkhas pa mang pos zhib 'jug dang bsngags brjod yang yang mdzad/ 'on kyang mkhris nad mig can gyis dung dkar ser por mngon pa ltar/ la las bod rig kyi rig gnas ni/ rtsa ba'i cha nas bshad na bla ma'i rig gnas red zer ba dang/ bod rigs kyi rig gnas phyi'i rnam pa dang nang don gang gi thad la'ang / chos lugs kyi shugs rkyen gting zab phog pa zhig red zer ba sogs mang du brjod/ 'on kyang mar le ring lugs kyi lta bar gzhigs na/ mi'i rigs kyi rig gnas ni ngal rtsol pa rnams kyis gsar skrun byas pa zhig yin pas nga tshos rig gnas de dag la dpyad gtam gtong dus/ skabs de'i lo rgyus kyi dngos don dang kha bral te phyogs re ba'i lta ba khyer na mi 'grig snyam// bod kyi rig gnas kyi grub cha gtso bo ni bod rigs mi dmangs dang spun zla mi rigs rnams kyis thun mong thog gsar gtod byas shing /des bod rigs ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi khyad du 'phags pa'i shes rig dang snying stobs mtshon thub/124

bod mi rigs kyi gzi brjid cang yin/phyogs mtshungs sman rtsis dang / sgra/ tshad ma/ sgyu rtsal sogs kyang gong 'phel ches cher phyin/bod kyi rig gnas ni/ krung hwa mi rigs kyi rig gnas bang mdzod nang gi ngo mtshar can gyi nor bu zhig yin stabs da lta phyi nang gi mkhas pa mang pos zhib 'jug dang bsngags brjod yang yang mdzad/ 'on kyang mkhris nad mig can gyis dung dkar ser por mngon pa ltar/ la las bod rig kyi rig gnas ni/ rtsa ba'i cha nas bshad na bla ma'i rig gnas red zer ba dang/ bod rigs kyi rig gnas phyi'i rnam pa dang nang don gang gi thad la'ang / chos lugs kyi shugs rkyen gting zab phog pa zhig red zer ba sogs mang du brjod/ 'on kyang mar le ring lugs kyi lta bar gzhigs na/ mi'i rigs kyi rig gnas ni ngal rtsol pa rnams kyis gsar skrun byas pa zhig yin pas nga tshos rig gnas de dag la dpyad gtam gtong dus/ skabs de'i lo rgyus kyi dngos don dang kha bral te phyogs re ba'i lta ba khyer na mi 'grig snyar// bod kyi rig gnas kyi grub cha gtso bo ni bod rigs mi dmangs dang spun zla mi rigs rnams kyis thun mong thog gsar gtod byas shing /des bod rigs ngal rtsol mi dmangs kyi khyad du 'phags pa'i shes rig dang snying stobs mtshon thub/124

le'u dgu pa/ dga' ldan pho brang dus kyi dpal 'byor skor/(1642—1951)gcig dga' ldan pho brang gisad dbang dngos su btsugs pa/gu shi bstan 'dzin gyi dpung rogs 'og gtsang ba'i srid dbang mjug bsdus shing zhabs 'brang dang bcas pa cham la phab/ chu rta(1642)lor rgyal dbang lnga ba 'bras spungs nas gzhis rtser gdan drangs de bod sog dpon rigs mang bo'i mos 'dun ltar tshogs dbus su srid 'dzin gong ma rnams kyi rten skal dang gna' rdzas khyad par can mang po rgyal mchog la phul ba dang 'brel bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi dbang cha yongs rdzogs phul ba khyab bsgrags mdzad/ phyag mdzod bsod nams rab brtan sde srid du bskos te phyis srid kyi bya ba mtha' dag la 'gan 'khur dgos pa'i re ba bton nas dga' ldan gi srid dbang dngos su btsugs/ dga' ldan pho brang zhes ba ni gtsang bkra shes lhun po'i gdan sa 'dzin mkhan dang po ste paṇa chen dge 'dun grub pa'i(1391—1474)yang sprul dge 'dun rgya mtsho(1475—1542)bkra shes lhun po'i paṇa chen du bzhugs pa'i skabs ngag dbang bkra shis grags pa dang lha rgya ru ba mchod yon/ 'bras spungs/ spyi so sogs kyis gdan 'dren zhus stabs/ me glang(1517)lor 'bras spungs su phebs nas cho~X 2ltar

le'u dgu pa/ dga' ldan pho brang dus kyi dpal 'byor skor/(1642—1951)gcig dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang dngos su btsugs pa/gu shi bstan 'dzin gyi dpung rogs 'og gtsang ba'i srid dbang mjug bsdus shing zhabs 'brang dang bcas pa cham la phab/ chu rta(1642)lor rgyal dbang lnga ba 'bras spungs nas gzhis rtser gdan drangs de bod sog dpon rigs mang bo'i mos 'dun ltar tshogs dbus su srid 'dzin gong ma rnams kyi rten skal dang gna' rdzas khyad par can mang po rgyal mchog la phul ba dang 'brel bod khri skor bcu gsum gyi dbang cha yongs rdzogs phul ba khyab bsgrags mdzad/ phyag mdzod bsod nams rab brtan sde srid du bskos te phyis srid kyi bya ba mtha' dag la 'gan 'khur dgos pa'i re ba bton nas dga' ldan gi srid dbang dngos su btsugs/ dga' ldan pho brang zhes ba ni gtsang bkra shis lhun po'i gdan sa 'dzin mkhan dang po ste paṇa chen dge 'dun grub pa'i(1391/de1474) yang sprul dge 'dun rgya mtsho(1475—1542)bkra shis lhun po'i paṇa chen du bzhugs pa'i skabs ngag dbang bkra shis grags pa dang lha rgya ru ba mchod yon/ 'bras spungaca/ spyi so sogs kyis gdan 'dren zhus stabs/ me glang(1517)lor 'bras spungs su phebs nas chos khrir 125

bzhugs shing bla brang dga' ldan pho brang bzhengs/ rgyal dbang lnga bas bod la dbang bsgyur ba nas bzung dga' ldan pho brang phyogs las rnam rgyal zhes srid gzhung gi mtshan du gyur 'dug rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho nas dge lugs par sprul sku ngos 'dzin pa'i srol thog ma byung / kurma ba la sprul sku ngos 'dzin srol 'di'i sngon nas yod/ khong gi yang srid rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho(1543—1588)yin zhing /khong gis skabs de'i phyi nang gi sde gzar mang por 'dum mdzad cing / chu khyi(1562)lor lha sar chu nyen byung skabs chu rags gsar rgyag mdzad pa dang / de nas bzung smon lam chen mo'i rjes dge 'dun rnams kyi rags rdo skyel ba'i srol bzang btsugs / sog po cha har al than rgyal bos gdan drangs ba ltar me glang(1577)lor 'bras spungs nas chibs bsgyur/ sa stag(1578)lor mtsho sngon lho nub mtshams chab zhes pa'i sar rgyal bo yab yum 'khor khri phrag la mjal kha gnang zhing bsu brgya chen po byas/ mchod yon du 'brel zhing gnas der sa 'dul mdzad nas theg chen chos 'khor gling bzhengs/ chos rgya cher spel nas sngar yod kyi srol ngan yod tshad mtshams bcad cing chos khrims gsar du bcos pa ma zad/ mi su la'ang 'phrog bcom byas mi chog pa'i srid khrims kyang bcos shing dge bcur gnas dgos pa'i khrims mang du bsgrags/ khong al than rgyal bos dbu blar bkur zhing rgyu nor gyi 'bul pa rgya cher phul ba dang tā la'i bla ma badza dhar zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ta la ni sog skad la rgya mtsho zer/ rgya mtsho'i bla ma zhes pa'i don ni thugs rje dang byin rlabs/ mtshan snyan dang 'phrin las sogs rgya mtsho chen po ltar mtha' dang mu med par rgya che ba'i don yin par gsungs/ khong gis kyang al than rgyal bor lha'i tshangs pa chen po zhes mtshan gnang ba ma zad/ rgya nag gong mas kyang rgyal khams thams cad gyi bla ma yin cing gu thi'i mtshan gnang / sog yul du rab byung 126

bzhugs shing bla brang dga' ldan pho brang bzhengs/ rgyal dbang lnga bas bod la dbang bsgyur ba nas bzung dga' ldan pho brang phyogs las rnam rgyal zhes srid gzhung gi mtshan du gyur 'dug rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho nas dge lugs par sprul sku ngos 'dzin pa'i srol thog ma byung / kurma ba la sprul sku ngos 'dzin srol 'di'i sngon nas yod/ khong gi yang srid rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho(1543—1588)yin zhing /khong gis skabs de'i phyi nang gi sde gzar mang por 'dum mdzad cing / chu khyi(1562)lor lha sar chu nyen byung skabs chu rags gsar rgyag mdzad pa dang / de nas bzung smon lam chen mo'i rjes dge 'dun rnams kyi rags rdo skyel ba'i srol bzang btsugs / sog po cha har al than rgyal bos gdan drangs ba ltar me glang(1577)lor 'bras spungs nas chibs bsgyur/ sa stag(1578)lor mtsho sngon lho nub mtshams chab zhes pa'i sar rgyal bo yab yum 'khor khri phrag la mjal kha gnang zhing bsu brgya chen po byas/ mchod yon du 'brel zhing gnas der sa 'dul mdzad nas theg chen chos 'khor gling bzhengs/ chos rgya cher spel nas sngar yod kyi srol ngan yod tshad mtshams bcad cing chos khrims gsar du bcos pa ma zad/ mi su la'ang 'phrog bcom byas mi chog pa'i srid khrims kyang bcos shing dge bcur gnas dgos pa'i khrims mang du bsgrags/ khong al than rgyal bos dbu blar bkur zhing rgyu nor gyi 'bul pa rgya cher phul ba dang tā la'i bla ma badza dhar zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ta la ni sog skad la rgya mtsho zer/ rgya mtsho'i bla ma zhes pa'i don ni thugs rje dang byin rlabs/ mtshan snyan dang 'phrin las sogs rgya mtsho chen po ltar mtha' dang mu med par rgya che ba'i don yin par gsungs/ khong gis kyang al than rgyal bor lha'i tshangs pa chen po zhes mtshan gnang ba ma zad/ rgya nag gong mas kyang rgyal kha/sdu thams cad gyi bla ma yin cing gu thi'i mtshan gnang / sog yul du rab byung

ba'i sde btsugs shing bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don du khams li thang dang sku 'bum/mkhar sngon po sogs su phebs te dam chos rgya cher spel ba ma zad/ sa gnas khag gi rgya bod sog gsum gyi 'khrug rtsod 'dum mdzad de kun bde skyid kyi lam du bkod/rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i yang sprul yon tan rgya mtsho(1589/de1616)sog yul du 'khrungs shing lcags glang(1601)lor 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi gdan khrir 'khod/ bkra shis lhun po'i gdan sa paṇa chen bzhi ba blo bzang chos gyi rgyal mtshan bla mar bsten te mdo sngags kyi bka' chos mang du gsan/ blo bzang chos rgyan sku tshe gang bor bkra shis lhun po'i paṇa chen du bzhugs stabs khong gi sku phreng rim byon la paṇa chen rin po che zhes mtshan de rgyun 'jags su byung /shing stag(1614)lor rgyal dbang rin po ches paṇa chen rin po che'i drung nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ me 'brug(1616)lor ta ming rgyal bos khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang zhes pa'i mtshan gsol zhing lo smad du 'das/gong zhus ltar rgyal dbang lnga ba(1617—1682)mchog gis srid dbang bzung dus/ dbang sgyur ba tshos chos lugs kyi khe phan khar khyer te rang nyid kyi srid dbang sra brtan gtong thabs byas te chab srid kyi 'thab rtsod la chos lugs kyi mdzes rgyan spras nas rang nyid dbang sgyur la ngo rgol byed mkhan lha sde mi sde su yin rung drag gnon dang rgyab skyor byed mkhan rnams la chos gzhis mang po legs skyes su sprad de srid dbang sra brtan yong bar 'bad kyi yod pa red/ dus der mes rgyal nang khul du'ang zhing ba'i 'os langs gcig mjug gnyis mthud byung stabs ta ming rgyal rabs kyi srid dbang mgo rting bslogs nas shing sprel(1644)lor man chen rgyal rabs btsugs/ man ju'i sku drag dpon rigs dang rgya rigs kyi zhing bdag gral rim thun mong gis krung go yongs la dbang bsgyur/127

ba'i sde btsugs shing bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don du khams li thang dang sku 'bum/mkhar sngon po sogs su phebs te dam chos rgya cher spel ba ma zad/ sa gnas khag gi rgya bod sog gsum gyi 'khrug rtsod 'dum mdzad de kun bde skyid kyi lam du bkod/rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i yang sprul yon tan rgya mtsho(1589wa 1616)sog yul du 'khrungs shing lcags glang(1601)lor 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi gdan khrir 'khod/ bkra shes lhun po'i gdan sa paṇa chen bzhi ba blo bzang chos gyi rgyal mtshan bla mar bsten te mdo sngags kyi bka' chos mang du gsan/ blo bzang chos rgyan sku tshe gang bor bkra shes lhun po'i paṇa chen du bzhugs stabs khong gi sku phreng rim byon la paṇa chen rin po che zhes mtshan de rgyun 'jags su byung /shing stag(1614)lor rgyal dbang rin po ches paṇa chen rin po che'i drung nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ me 'brug(1616)lor ta ming rgyal bos khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang zhes pa'i mtshan gsol zhing lo smad du 'das/gong zhus ltar rgyal dbang lnga ba(1617—1682)mchog gis srid dbang bzung dus/ dbang sgyur ba tshos chos lugs kyi khe phan khar khyer te rang nyid kyi srid dbang sra brtan gtong thabs byas te chab srid kyi 'thab rtsod la chos lugs kyi mdzes rgyan spras nas rang nyid dbang sgyur la ngo rgol byed mkhan lha sde mi sde su yin rung drag gnon dang rgyab skyor byed mkhan rnams la chos gzhis mang po legs skyes su sprad de srid dbang sra brtan yong bar 'bad kyi yod pa red/dus der mes rgyal nang khul du'ang zhing ba'i 'os langs gcig mjug gnyis mthud byung stabs ta ming rgyal rabs kyi srid dbang mgo ting bslogs nas shing sprel(1644)lor man chen rgyal rabs btsugs/ man ju'i sku drag dpon rigs dang rgya rigs kyi zhing bdag gral rim thun mong gis krung go yongs la dbang stustar/

skabs der dpal 'byor thad bshu gzhog chen po ma byas par thon skyed gong 'phel gtong ba'i byed thabs 'ga' lag bstar byas pas thon skyed nus shugs gong 'phel dang / sa zhing rgya cher bskyed pa/ dpal 'byor phun tshogs byung ba ma zad/mtha' mtshams kyi srid dbang sra brtan gtong ba'i byed thabs mang bo lag bstar gnang pas mes rgyal gcig gyur la phan nus chen po thob/ dus der rgyal dbang lnga ba dang paṇa chen bzhi ba rnam gnyis kyi thugs bkod ltar se chen chos rje brgyud nas sngar ltar rten 'brel zhu yig dang / legs skyes phul nas man chen krung dbyang srid gzhung btsugs par rten 'brel zhus pa ma zad/ gsar du btsugs pa'i bod dga' ldan srid gzhung la gang ci'i thad gyis bod la 'dzin pa'i rtsa ba'i srid jus dang yongs su mthun stabs gong ma shin kri thug sa shin tu mnyes/ man gong mas zhu ba tshang ma zhal bzhes mdzad de se chen chos rje phyir phebs skabs rgyal ོdbang dang / pan chen/ sa skya chos rgyal/ stag lung chos rgyal/ kurma ba sogs la 'tshams 'dri'i yi ge dang / dar gos sogs legs skyes su phul nas phan tshun bar 'brel ba gsar du byung ngo / / dus der sde srid bsod nams chos 'phel gyis rgyal dbang gi bka' ltar sa gnas khag la bskor zhib tu bskyod nas khral rigs zhib gzhung gsar du bkod/ dus mtshungs su dga' ldan pho brang nas rgyal rong dar mdo lcags la sogs mdo smad du dud tshang grangs len dang /gzhung khral sogs kyi yig khra thel dam can deb lnga bcu nga drug bzos/ sde srid bsod nams chos 'phel gyis rgyal dbang gi dgongs 'dun ltar sa byi(1648)lor dmar po ri'i pho brang dkar bo'i 'dzugs skrun legs 'grub byung / pho brang dmar po rjes su sde srid sangs rgyas rgyas mtshos bzhengs/128

gnyis/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mcho'i skor/de yang sdesrid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho ni rgyal dbang lnga ba'i sku ring la sde srid snga phyi lnga byon pa'i phyi ma ba dang rgyal dbang drug pa chen po'i skabs su byon pa'i bod kyi chos srid thams cad kyi bdag gtso gcig pu yin te/ khong ni rgyal dbang lnga ba chen pos sku chung dus nas thugs brtses skyangs shing chos srid lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas gso skyong dang skyed sring legs par gnang thog ci byed mtha' dag rgyal dbang rang nas byed pa dang khyad med pa'i bka' khyab bstsal yod pa'i sde srid gcig kyang yin stabs khong gis rgyal dbang lnga ba mchog gi rlabs chen dgongs bzhed kyi mdzad 'phrin thams cad lugs bzhin skyangs par ma zad/ rgyal dbang lnga ba sku gshegs nas gsang rgya yun ring dang yang srid drug pa chen po ngos 'dzin zhus pa sogs 'phrin las rgya cher spel te bod khams bde sdug thams cad kyi khur chen rang nyid gcig pu'i phrag tu blangs thog bod sog mchod yon bar gyi 'gal rtsod dang chin gong ma'i bka' lung lci yang bcas spyi tshogs rtog 'dzing gi nang du bod kyi chos srid lugs gnyis kyi bya ba mtha' dag legs par skyong gnang mdzad pa'i sde srid gzhan las lhag pa zhig yin stabs/ bod kyi lo rgyus steng grags snyan 'bar ba'i skyes bu dam pa zhig tu bgrang bar ma zad rgya bod sog gsum gyi lo rgyus nang du'ang shugs rkyen che ba'i bod kyi lo rgyus mi sna grags can zhig kyang yin no/ / khong ni rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu sbrul spyi lo 1633la yab a sug dang yum bu khrid rgyal mo gnyis kyi sras su skyid shod nyang bran grong smad du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo brgyad par rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po dang mjal zhing de nas rgyal dbang mchog dang rang gi khu bo sde srid 'phrin las rgya mtsho dang mkhas dbang dpal ldan phun tshogs/ sdubyer

gnyis/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i skor/ de yang sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho ni rgyal dbang lnga ba'i sku ring la sde srid snga phyi lnga byon pa'i phyi ma ba dang rgyal dbang drug pa chen po'i skabs su byon pa'i bod kyi chos srid thams cad kyi bdag gtso gcig pu yin te/ khong ni rgyal dbang lnga ba chen pos sku chung dus nas thugs brtses skyangs shing chos srid lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas gso skyong dang skyed sring legs par gnang thog ci byed mtha' dag rgyal dbang rang nas byed pa dang khyad med pa'i bka' khyab bstsal yod pa'i sde srid gcig kyang yin stabs khong gis rgyal dbang lnga ba mchog gi rlabs chen dgongs bzhed kyi mdzad 'phrin thams cad lugs bzhin skyangs par ma zad/ rgyal dbang lnga ba sku gshegs nas gsang rgya yun ring dang yang srid drug pa chen po ngos 'dzin zhus pa sogs 'phrin las rgya cher spel te bod khams bde sdug thams cad kyi khur chen rang nyid gcig pu'i phrag tu blangs thog bod sog mchod yon bar gyi 'gal rtsod dang chin gong ma'i bka' lung lci yang bcas spyi tshogs rnyog 'dzing gi nang du bod kyi chos srid lugs gnyis kyi bya ba mtha' dag legs par skyong gnang mdzad pa'i sde srid gzhan las lhag pa zhig yin stabs/ bod kyi lo rgyus steng grags snyan 'bar ba'i skyes bu dam pa zhig tu bgrang bar ma zad rgya bod sog gsum gyi lo rgyus nang du'ang shugs rkyen che ba'i bod kyi lo rgyus mi sna grags can zhig kyang yin no/ / khong ni rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu sbrul spyi lo 1633la yab a sug dang yum bu khrid rgyal mo gnyis kyi sras su skyid shod nyang bran grong smad du sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo brgyad par rgyal dbang lnga ba chen po dang mjal zhing de nas rgyal dbang mchog dang rang gi khu bo sde srid 'phrin las rgya mtsho dang mkhas dbang dpal ldan phun tshogs/ 'dar 129

lo ngag dbang phun tshogs sogs mkhas grub mang po bsten nas rig pa'i gnas kun la gsan bsam phyis phyin pa mdzad de mkhas pa'i yang rtser son/ lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gis mdo sngags zab chos kyi rim pa dang chab srid skyong lugs la sogs pa'i slob ston mang po dgyes bzhin du bstsal thog spyan 'bras bzhin bskyangs par mdzad pa'i bka' drin las chos srid gang thad kyi mkhyen yon phul du byung bar gyur/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing yos spyi lo 1675la dgung grangs nyer gsum steng rgyal dbang mchog gi bka'i 'phrin las kyi byed por dbang skur ba'i cha rkyen yongs su tshang bar brten sdesrid gsar bsko'i skabs dang bstun chab srid kyi 'khur bzhes dgos pa'i bka' phebs par re zhig dgongs zhu bka' 'khrol byung yang /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa lug spyi lo 1679la dgung grangs nyer bdun par sde srid kyi khrir bsko bzhag mdzad/ rgyal dbang mchog gis sde srid 'di par sde srid sngon ma rnams ltar srid don kho na skyong ba ma yin par chos srid kyi bya ba thams cad gang byas rgyal dbang rang nyid nas mdzad pa dang khyad med pas kun gyis ci gsung dang len dgos pa'i bslab ston khrom bsgrags mdzad par gnang / de ltar sde srid kyis lo ngo bco lnga'i ring gsang rgya dam po gnang thog chos srid kyi bya ba mtha' dag rang nyid nas thugs 'gan gtsang mar bzhes shing de'i ring yang srid rin po che ngos 'dzin gyis gdan sar bkod cing / yang srid gdan sar bkod nas kyang lo ngo brgyad tsam ring chos srid kyi gdung 'degs gtso bo gnang ste yongs su mi lo nyer drug gi ring dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang legs par bskyangs shing /de'i ring gi mdzad rjes gtso che ba yongs grags 'ga' ni gsham gsal te/dang po/ rgyal dbang mchog sku gshegs pa gsang rgya yun ring bsdams thog 130

lo ngag dbang phun tshogs sogs mkhas grub mang po bsten nas rig pa'i gnas kun la gsan bsam phyis phyin pa mdzad de mkhas pa'i yang rtser son/ lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gis mdo sngags zab chos kyi rim pa dang chab srid skyong lugs la sogs pa'i slob ston mang po dgyes bzhin du bstsal thog spyan 'bras bzhin bskyangs par mdzad pa'i bka' drin las chos srid gang thad kyi mkhyen yon phul du byung bar gyur/ rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing yos spyi lo 1675la dgung grangs nyer gsum steng rgyal dbang mchog gi bka'i 'phrin las kyi byed por dbang skur ba'i cha rkyen yongs su tshang bar brten sde srid gsar bsko'i skabs dang bstun chab srid kyi 'khur bzhes dgos pa'i bka' phebs par re zhig dgongs zhu bka' 'khrol byung yang /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa lug spyi lo 1679la dgung grangs nyer bdun par sde srid kyi khrir bsko bzhag mdzad/ rgyal dbang mchog gis sde srid 'di par sde srid sngon ma rnams ltar srid don kho na skyong ba ma yin par chos srid kyi bya ba thams cad gang byas rgyal dbang rang nyid nas mdzad pa dang khyad med pas kun gyis ci gsung dang len dgos pa'i bslab ston khrom bsgrags mdzad par gnang / de ltar sde srid kyis lo ngo bco lnga'i ring gsang rgya dam po gnang thog chos srid kyi bya ba mtha' dag rang nyid nas thugs 'gan gtsang mar bzhes shing de'i ring yang srid rin po che ngos 'dzin gyis gdan sar bkod cing / yang srid gdan sar bkod nas kyang lo ngo brgyad tsam ring chos srid kyi gdung 'degs gtso bo gnang ste yongs su mi lo nyer drug gi ring dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang legs par bskyangs shing /de'i ring gi mdzad rjes gtso che ba yongs grags 'ga' ni gsham gsal te/dang po/ rgyal dbang mchog sku gshegs pa gsang rgya yun ring bsdams thog 130

dgongs rdzogs dang gser gdung legs bzhengs ma zad yang srid ngos 'dzin bcas kyi las don rnams gsang stabs kyis legs par sgrub pa yin te/ de yang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po ni bod gcig po ma zad rgyal nang chin rgyal rabs dang sog phyi nang bcas su mtshan snyan dang bkur gzos che bas mi tshad/ khyad par sog po'i dpon khag thams cad sbyin bdag gi gtso bo yin stabs tshang ma rdog rtsa gcig sgril gyis rgyal ba'i dgongs don dang dga' ldan pho brang gi bka' la brtsi bzhin yod pa dang yang sgos dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang btsugs nas gzhi brtan pa tsam las phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen mang po gtsang sel byed med khar/ yul mtha'i 'khrug long kyang 'jags med pa dang / sde srid rang nyid kyang dgung na phra bas bod kyi chos srid las don skor gyi nyams myong dang phyi'i mtshan snyan bcas chags med stabs/ gal srid rgyal dbang mchog sku 'das pa'i tshul gsal bsgrags byas tshe dus 'gyur ram gnas tshul gang byung cha mi 'tshal ba'i phyir rgyal dbang mchog gi zhal chems dang lha bla'i lung bstan la bsten nas mi lo bco lnga'i gsang rgya dam por bsdams shing / de'i ring thog mar dgongs rdzogs legs par bsgrubs te rin thang gzhal du med pa'i gser gtsos rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gdung rten srid gsum na 'gran zla bral ba'i nges pa don gyio'adzam gling rgyan gcig〉〉ces pa gsar bzhengs legs par mdzad cing / ma zad mngon chung brtag dpyad gang legs mdzad yang srid drug pa rin po che'ang gsang stabs kyis sku chung dus nas ngos 'dzin zhus te dgung lo bco lnga'i steng gsal bsgrags dang lhan gdan sar bkod pa sogs rgyal dbang mchog gi thugs bzhed dang zhal chems chud zas su ma song bar las don che phra legs grub byung ba dang bsam yul las 'das pa'i mdzad rjes mig mthong lag zin du bsgrubs pa yin no/ /131

gnyis pa/ rgyal dbang mchod gi mdzad 'phrin dang gangs can chos srid zung gi las don 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi sgo nas rgya cher spel ba yin te/ de yang sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos bod kyi chab srid skyong ba'i dus ni rgyal dbang mchog gis 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa'i dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang btsugs nas dus yun ring tsam ma song bas da dung srid 'dzin gyi sgrig gzhi dang sgrig srol sogs khyon yongs thad legs bcos dang 'thus sgo je tshang gtong dgos pa'i gnas mang tsam yod stabs/ thog mar khong gis rgyal dbang mchog gi slob ston dang sde srid snga ma rnams kyi mdzad rjes bcas mig ltos su bzung ste rang nyid sku dngos dbus gtsang dwags kong dang bcas pa'i yul gru rgya che ba ma zad lha sa'i las khungs dang mi ser la sogs pa'i sar gzigs skor kyis bod spyi tshogs dngos la brtag dpyad zhib 'jug mang po gnang thog bod mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba dngos dang 'brel ba'i srid jus lag bstar phab ste srid dbang lugs mthun gyis bskyangs pa yin la/ ma zad sngar gyi khrims yin rnams yul dus gnas tshul la gzhigs nas 'dor len dag ther gyis 'os 'tsham gyi zhal lce bcu gsum bya ba bcos sgrig gtan 'bebs mdzad pa dang /srid kyi sgrig gzhi dang dpon gnas bsko 'jog thad la'ang sngar gyi las tshan khongs su ma tshud pa mang po gsar 'dzugs bcos sgrig gis gtan la phab cing so so'i byed sgo'i rim pa dang bcas yi ger zhib bkod dang / da dung yul mtha'i rdzong gzhis dang thon zog khral rigs kyi 'bab sdud la sogs pa gsar 'god kyis gtan 'bebs legs par mdzad pa bcas mdor na bod kyi chab srid 'dzin skyong speng gsum gyi sgo nas lugs dang mthun par bskyangs shing der brten chin gong mas kyang sde srid mchog la gser tham dang 'ja' sa'ang sbyor 'jags gnang ba byung ngo / /132gsum pa/ pho brang dmar po rgyas bzhengs dang yul gru du mar dgon sde

gsar 'debs sogs kyi 'phrin las rlabs po che spel ba yin te/ de yang rgyal dbang lnga ba mchog gis bzhengs dbu tshugs pa'i pho brang dkar po gzhi byas de'i steng pho brang dmar por grags pa le lag dang bcas pa thog so bcu gsum can deng 'dzam gling chen po'i rgyan du gyur pa'i rtse pho brang po ta la zhes snyan pa sa gsum na khyab pa de ri po gru 'dzin gyi rtser gsar bzhengs rgyas skrun mdzad pa dang / de'i skor gyi lo rgyus zhib rgyas sde srid rang nyed kyis mdzad pa'i〈mchod sdong 'dzam gling rgyan gcig gi dkar chag〉tu zhib gsal 'khod yod pas 'dir rgyas par mi 'god la/ lar mi lo sum brgya'i sngon du bod la tshan rig lag rtsal ma zad 'byor ba'ang de tsam rgyas med pa'i dus su 'di 'dra'i bod kyi lo rgyus steng gzi 'od 'bar ba'e bzo skrun bkod pa mdzes shing rgyud spus legs pa rgya che zhing brjid rngams ldan pa mi phal ba'i blo las 'das pa zhig yin pa smras ma dgos te/ da lta zhig gso'i las ka tsam yang de 'dra'i tshags che bar bsams na 'di gcig pus kyang sde srid mchog gi mdzad rjes la gdeng 'jogs gang 'dra dgos pa shes sla snyam la/ ma zad da dung lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi bar khang dang dbus gtsang mdo khams bcas su dgon gnas du ma gsar bzhengs gnang ba yin te/ lho mon yul du dga' ldan rnam rgyal gling dang bar khams phyogs su rgyal thang dga' ldan sum rtsen gling / shar dar rtse mdor dga' ldan 'gro phan gling dang go 'jor dga' ldan gsang sngags 'gro 'dren gling sogs kyis mtshon yul mtha' dbus bcas su dgon sde mang po gsar 'debs mdzad pas ma tshad/ de dag la mchod rgyun dang ja tshul gyi gtong thebs kyang mchod gzhis sbyor 'jags gnang ba sogs thabs mkhas de dag la brten nas 'bangs skya ser chab 'og tu bsdu ba dang sngar yod dgon sde mang por yang mchod gzhis rgya cherasbyor 'jags gnang ba bcas kyis bod khams chos bzhin bskyangs pa 133

yin no/ /bzhi pa/ bzo gso skar rtsis rig pas mtshon bod kyi rig gnas rgya cher gong du spel ba yin te/ de'ang sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho mchog ni bod kyi lo rgyus steng skad grags yod pa'i chab srid pa skabs de'i dga' ldan pho brang ba'i gtso skyong chen po chos srid kyi mdzad pa rab tu rgyas pa zhig yin par ma zad/ bod kyi rig gnas spyi dang khyad par bod mi dmangs kyi 'tsho ba dngos dang 'bral thabs med pa'i bzo gso dang skar rtsis rig pa bcas la thun mong ma yin pa'i mdzad rjes 'jog gnang mdzad pa yin te/ spyir sde srid mchog gis sku tshe hril por srid zhor la gsung rtsom pod grangs nyi shur longs pa brtsams par mdzad de da lta'i dus su'ang shes ldan kun gyis gces nor dang tshad mas 'dzin pa'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bur gyur pa lags shing / de dag las tshad ldan grags che ba ni gso rig rgyud bzhi'i dgongs 'grel〈bee sngon 〉dang de'i 〈lhan thabs 〉/ gso rig lo rgyus skor〈khog 'bugs 〉sman thang khyad 'phags can dang / skar rtsis skor la sngon med kyi legs bshad kun btus〈bee dkar 〉dang de'i〈bu dpe 〉dris lan〈g.ya' sel 〉sogs dang /da dung dga' ldan chos 'byung〈bee ser 〉dang〈rnam thar kha skong 〉sogs dang /bzo rig gi bstan bcos〈dpyod ldan yid gsos 〉dang gar gyi bstan bcos〈mig yid rna ba'i dga' ston 〉sogs kyis mtshon gzhung lugs thad kyi rig gnas dar rgyas gong 'phel 'gro bar phyag rjes chen po 'jog gnang mdzad par ma zad/ lag len thad sman rtsis zung 'brel gyi las khungs lcags ri 'gro phan rig byed gling btab pa sogs kyi las kho nas kyang mkhas pa'i yang rtser bgrang 'os shing / de dag ma zad sde srid mchog da dung mda' ring thung 'phen pa dang sgra snyan pi wang thebs 'khrol dang glu gzhas kyi 'gyur khug sogs sgyu rtsal dang rig rtsal gyi gnas la 134 4

shin tu mkhas par ma zad/ tha na sho dang mig mang rdel rtsed bcas la'ang bltas pa tsam gyis mkhyen pa sogs rnam rig gzhan gyis 'gran zla med pa zhig yin 'dug la/ yang khong rten skya bo'i ngang grwa btsun gyi phyag 'bul bzhes pa dang bdag mo gnyis lhag bsten pa bcas la skyon 'dogs dang / sgos su deng sang brtsams pa'i lo rgyus la lar sde srid mchog la gleng brjod sna tshogs dang yang sgos phyi gling mkhas pa la las thugus srus dang rigus srus kyi dbye ba ma mkhyen nas rang snang gang shar gleng ba de la 'ga' res rjes 'brangs e thub kyis skyar gleng byed pa ni rang mtshang mngon pa'i rgyu tsam du zad pas dpyad mi dgos snyam mo/ /gsum/ lcags stag zhib gzhung gsar du bkod pa/tā la'i bla ma bcu pa mchog sku gzhon nu'i tshul bzhes ltar gtso bo mdo sngags gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i gsan bsam la gcig tu 'grus par mdzad pa'i mthu las lung rtogs kyi sku yon zla ba yar ngo'i dpal la 'gran pa bzhin gong 'phel du 'tsho zhing gzhes pa dang / spyi lo 1824bod shing spre zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin/rwa sgreng khri chen rin po che'i yang srid 'os sprul khag gser bum brtag dpyad kyi mdzad sgor mchod yon lhan rgyas dang / bod bzhugs am ban rnam gnyis bcas rtse gzim chung sa gsum rnam rgyal gyi gong ma'i 'dra thang gi mdun du gdan 'dzoms pa'i thog mtshan byang dkrug par dngos grub sdings su 'khrungs pa'i chung srid kyi mtshan byang thon pa'i ngos 'dzin gtan 'khel byung ba/ yang zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin de mo srid skyong gi 'os sprul gser bum dkrug don chab mdo'i chung srid kyi mtshan byang thon 'dug lo de'i nang / rgyal ba mchog gi yongs 'dzin khri chen ngag dbang snyan grags 135

sku na smin cing / yun ring bsnyun bzhes mthar dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i sku tshab tu dga' ldan khri pa ngag dbang chos 'phel bsko 'dzugs mdzad bzhedaphamachod yon dgongs pa gcig mthun gyi thog nas am ban lhan rgyas brgyud gong ma bdag po chen po'i gser snyan du gsol bar de don re 'bras smin pa'i bka' lung bzang po dral rtse'i lam nas phebs pa ltar zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga nyin ’dngos su yongs 'dzin gyi che 'don gnang 'dugade min 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen pa dang / yar lung dbon sprul/ lho brag gsung sprul bcas kyi sku skye 'os sprul khag snga rjes su gser bum dkrug 'don gyi mdzad sgor yang tā la'i bla ma mchog bod bzhugs am ban gnyis dang lhan phebs kyis ngos 'dzin bskyangs 'dug spyi lo 1830bod lcaṭa stag lo'i zla ba dgu pa'iphatshes nyi shu skor la/ snga sor rgya bod kyi bka' 'brel bzhin mnga' 'bangs gyi khral riṭa rkang 'don sogs la snyoms mthar zhib dpyod spyi khyab bka' blon bshad sgra don grub rdo rje dang / phran sku bcar mchod dpon mkhan po/ (rnam thar nor phreng rtsom pa po )rtsis dpon pha lha ba/ sku sger mgron bskal bzang ngag dbang bcas lo snga phyir zhib dpyod kyis mnga' 'bangs skyid sdug mos snyoms dang / gzhung slebs yong chen lcags stag zhib gzhung gtan 'khel la rgya bod zung 'brel gyi tham ga gnang ba bcas kyi 'bru don sor gnas rgyun 'khyongs yong phyir/ gzhung zhabs ser skya mgrin gcig nas rgyal dbang mtshog la snyan zhu'i zhu tho phul bar don smin gyi bka' gsal zhu tho mgo mchan dam 'byar du phebs par/ zhabs pad sogs kyis gtsos pa'i gzhung zhabs drag 'bring dkyus bcas tshang ma dang / sku bcar rnam rgyal gra tshang tshogs yongs/ se 'bras dga' gsum gyi tshogs chen/ gra tshang khag rgyud stod smad 136

kyi bla ma las sne sogs nas thugs rje che zhu'i legs dar dang 'brel ba'i mjal kha rim zhus tshang mar 'dod mos bzhin gyi mjal phyag tshems med du bskyungs/〉 zhes 'khod pa ltar〈lcags stag zhib gzhung 〉ni/ de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi mnga' khongs yongs nas sa khul nyung shas la de rjes bskyar zhib byas te zhib gzhung gsar bkod re zung phud/ de byings rgya khyab tshang mar sa ris bdag dbang dang /khral 'ul sgrub chag 'jags gsum gang ci de rang la rtsa 'dzin byed pa'i yongs grags kyi zhib gzhung spyod go che shos de yin/ bod la dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur ma byas bar mi lo brgya dang nyi shu rtsa dgu tsam ring rtsa ba'i cha nas gzhung sger chos gsum tshang mas de la gzhir bzung byed pas/ bod kyi spyi tshogs rnying pa'i thon skyed bdag dbang lam lugs la zhib 'jug bya rgyu'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha gal chen po zhig yin pa ma zad/ zhib gzhung ngo mar skabs de'i bod sdod am ban gyis kyang tham ga phab yod pa bcas cha tshang da lta bod rang skyong ljongs yig tshags bdag gnyer khang gi khongs su yod do/spyi lo 1831bod lcags yos lo'i zla ba gsum pa'i nang / pha'adi lo pho brang dmar po'i lho brgyud gzim chung sa gsum rnam rgyal sogs nyams gso gnang dgos la/ gong ma bdag po chen po'i 'dra thang bzhugs yul spo shugs dang / gong sa mchog kyang ring min pha bong khar chibs bskyod gnang rgyu'i sgo dod pa bcas la snga 'phros 'di zla'i tshes nyer drug nyin gong ma bdag po chen po'i 'dra thang rin po che gzim chung byams khang du spo shugs mdzad rgyur/ bod bzhugs am ban gnyis phebs pa dang bstun sa gsum du mjal dar rtse sprod dang mtshams 'dri bcas gnang nas/ rol cha dang po btang ba dang gong sa mchog dang / am ban gnyis/ sku zhabs no min han bcas nas 'dra thang la phyag 'tshal grub rjes/ bka' blon 137

bshad sgra nas 'dra thang gdan zhu dang / bka' blon thon pa nas mtshan byang gdan zhus la g.yas phyogs nas rnam grwa nyi shu skor gyis ser sbrengs dang / g.yon phyogs nas mi drag rnams bsgrigs phreng dang bcas rol cha gnyis pa'i skabs byams khang du gdan zhus kyis bzhugs khang gdan zhu grub par rol cha gsum pa dang dus mtshungs su/ gong sa mchog nas 'dra thang la nang mdzod ser po'i snyan shal 'bul gnang dang bcas phyag 'tshal bskyangs rjes/ rnam gra bcu nas rab gnas kyi cho ga tshugs/〉〉 zhes gsal bas skabs der sa gsum rnam rgyal rgyud la nyams gso zhig gnang bar mngon yang gzhi rgya che rigs min 'dug pa ni/ lo de ga'i zla ba bdun pa'i nang / 4rtse'i pho brang gi nyams gso byings dang / nyi 'od kyi yang steng du gzim chung gsar rgyag mdzad pa rnams tshang ma grub ste 'di zla'i tshes dgu nyin dben gnas pha bong kha nas gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal med khang du chibs zhal bsgyur/ ’ ces gsal ba'i ar po'i las rgyun las shes thub cing / lo de'i zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gnyis nyin gong ma'i 'dra thang sogs sngar bzhin gzim chung sa gsum du spo shugs gnang ba'i mdzad sgo gong gsal dang 'dra ba bskyangs 'dug4〈lcags stag zhib gzhung 〉gsar 'god legs bsgrubs byung ba'i skor am ban gnyis nas gong mar gser snyan sgron pa'i phyir phebs dgongs don/ zhib dpyod spyi khyab bka' blon bshad sgra don grub rdo rjer rim pa dang po'i tha'i ji dang /mchod dpon zur pa blo bzang 'phrin las rnam rgyal la dar han mkhan po'i cho lo/rtsis dpon pha lha bar rim pa gsum pa'i tog gnas bcas gzigs bskyangs su bstsal ba'i bka' bsgyur lo 'di'i zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes nyer brgyad nyin phebs 'dugaspyi lo 1834tā kong khri bzhugs bcu bzhi pa/ bod shing rta zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bdun nyin/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho mchog la paṇa 138

chen sku phreng bdun pa bstan pa'i nyi mas mkhan po mdzad de rtse nub rgyud tshoms chen gsar pa'i 'khrungs rabs lha khang gi rten gtso jo bo rin po che'i sku mdun du bsnyen rdzogs kyi bslab sdom cho ga yang dag par 'bul bzhes legs par mdzad grub par gong ma chen po nas/ yab sras gnyis kur bka' bzang gnang skyes bahūṃs bstsal ba'i tshig don snyan sgron zhus par/ rta'o kong khri bzhugs bcu bzhi pa'i zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gcig nyin bka' yig spyi phebs su/ lung 'un can nas gser snyan rin po che sgron don/ 'di lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bdun nyin tā la'i bla ma nas paṇa chen er te nir dge slong gi thugs rdzogs sgrub rgyu phun sum tshogs po byung 'dug pas/ ngos kyang shin tu spro ba skyes/ da dung tā la'i bla ma nas slar sems bskyed de sku yon gsan bzhes sogs la 'bad brtson che skyed thog zhwa ser gyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong thub pa dgos/ 〉’ zhes sogs gsal ba'i yab sras so sor gzigs gzos 'phar ma'i gnang skyes spams mtho ba bcas bstsal 'dug —spyi lo 1836bod me spre lor/ spo bo maḥganam sde pa nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung la sngar lam lo dus kyi bca' khral rnams dus thog tu ma phul ba ma zad/brda 'ded bkod rgya btang bar yar nyan shes ma byas par spo khul sa btsan lam 'phrang dog pa sogs ltag 'khur ngan shed byas par brten/ bka' blon bshad sgra don grub rdo rje ngo las dmag dpung dang bcas rdzongs bda' gnang don/ zhi drag zung 'brel gyi sgo nas zhib dpyod bkod khyab byas par āḥganam dpon 'bangs tshang mas slad phyin spang blang 'dzol med zhu rgyu'i khas len dam bca' bzhag nas re zhig le 'grig byung 'dug de skor rnam thar du'ang / 54'di lo spo dmag lam 'gro byung bar gong ma chen po nas bod kyi bka' blon gyis gtsos mi drag rnams la tog gnas cho lo/ sgro mdongs sogs bdag rkyen 'phar gzigs bstsal ba'e 139

chen sku phreng bdun pa bstan pa'i nyi mas mkhan po mdzad de rtse nub rgyud tshoms chen gsar pa'i 'khrungs rabs lha khang gi rten gtso jo bo rin po che'i sku mdun du bsnyen rdzogs kyi bslab sdom cho ga yang dag par 'bul bzhes legs par mdzad grub par gong ma chen po nas/ yab sras gnyis kor bka' bzang gnang skyes btsug bstsal ba'i tshig don snyan sgron zhus par/ pharta'o kong khri bzhugs bcu bzhi pa'i zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gcig nyin bka' yig spyi phebs su/ lung 'un can nas gser snyan rin po che sgron don/ 'di lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bdun nyin tā la'i bla ma nas paṇa chen er te nir dge slong gi thugs rdzogs sgrub rgyu phun sum tshogs po byung 'dug pas/ ngos kyang shin tu spro ba skyes/ da dung tā la'i bla ma nas slar sems bskyed de sku yon gsan bzhes sogs la 'bad brtson che skyed thog zhwa ser gyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong thub pa dgos/ mi zhes sogs gsal ba'i yab sras so sor gzigs gzos 'phar ma'i gnang skyes spams mtho ba bcas bstsal 'dug cispyi lo 1836bod me spre lor/ spo bo naḥganam sde pa nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung la sngar lam lo dus kyi bca' khral rnams dus thog tu ma phul ba ma zad/brda 'ded bkod rgya btang bar yar nyan shes ma byas par spo khul sa btsan lam 'phrang dog pa sogs ltag 'khur ngan shed byas par brten/ bka' blon bshad sgra don grub rdo rje ngo las dmag dpung dang bcas rdzongs bda' gnang don/ zhi drag zung 'brel gyi sgo nas zhib dpyod bkod khyab byas par āḥganam dpon 'bangs tshang mas slad phyin spang blang 'dzol med zhu rgyu'i khas len dam bca' bzhag nas re zhig le 'grig byung 'dug de skor rnam thar du'ang / 4'di lo spo dmag lam 'gro byung bar gong ma chen po nas bod kyi bka' blon gyis gtsos mi drag rnams la tog gnas cho lo/ sgro mdongs sogs bdag rkyen 'phar gzigs bstsal 171

legs 'bul zhu mi rnams la mjal phyag rim par bstsal/〉 ces 'khod 'dug kyang /de'i phyi lo slar yang khas len dam bcar brtsi srung gis khral 'bul sogs ma byas par sngar bzhin ngan shed byas rkyen dbus gtsang gzhung dmag dang rgya khyab nas dmag bskul sogs rim rdzongs byas pa ma zad/ dpung dmag spyi khyab tu bka' blon pha lha ba ngo las/ dmag dpung 'go 'doms sogs bsko gtong gzhi rgya che tsam gnang dgos byung 'dug pa rnam thar du'ang / me bya zla ba bdun pa'i nang / pha'adi skabs spo don skor bskyar du zings shig la brten dmag bskyar lang gi dpung 'jug tu 'gro mi rtse shod drung 'khor dang / dmag mi'i 'go byed ru brgya lding sogs dang / dbus gtsang dmag mi byings sogs rim thon rnams la phyag dbang skyabs 'jug thon gnang rim par bstsal/ bka' blon pha lha yang khams khul don gcod du bskyod dgos la ngo g.yog las bya dang bcas par thon phyag mjal kha gnang / de skabs spo dmag bskyar lang gis mi ser la brdabs bsig dang /gzhung gnas la yang thugs 'gros ci che bcas byung bar thugs g.yeng dang /thugs yid 'byung ba'i tshul yang bzhes/〉〉 zhes 'khod cing / dpung 'jug byas mthar zing slong byed gte rnams mthar skrod nan po byas thog dpon sde byings nas sngar byas rgyab bskyur dang phyin chad spang blang zhu rgyu'i mtha' 'doms gan rgya blangs te 'khrun gcod legs tsam byung bar grags/bzhi/ bod sa gnas su srid 'dzin gyi byed thabs gsar pa 'ga' byung ba'i skor/rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho dang ser skya dpon rigs che gras 'ga' zhig mes rgyal nang khul dang / phyi sog rgya gar sogs kyi sa gnas mang por dus 140

legs 'bul zhu mi rnams la mjal phyag rim par bstsal/mi ces 'khod 'dug kyang /de'i phyi lo slar yang khas len dam bcar brtsi srung gis khral 'bul sogs ma byas par sngar bzhin ngan shed byas rkyen dbus gtsang gzhung dmag dang rgya khyab nas dmag bskul sogs rim rdzongs byas pa ma zad/ dpung dmag spyi khyab tu bka' blon pha lha ba ngo las/ dmag dpung 'go 'doms sogs bsko gtong gzhi rgya che tsam gnang dgos byung 'dug pa rnam thar du'ang / me bya zla ba bdun pa'i nang /4'di skabs spo don skor bskyar du zings sheg la brten dmag bskyar lang gi dpung 'jug tu 'gro mi rtse shod drung 'khor dang / dmag mi'i 'go byed ru brgya lding sogs dang / dbus gtsang dmag mi byings sogs rim thon rnams la phyag dbang skyabs 'jug thon gnang rim par bstsal/ bka' blon pha lha yang khams khul don gcod du bskyod dgos la ngo g.yog las bya dang bcas par thon phyag mjal kha gnang / de skabs spo dmag bskyar lang gis mi ser la brdabs bsig dang /gzhung gnas la yang thugs 'gros ci che bcas byung bar thugs g.yeng dang /thugs yid 'byung ba'i tshul yang bzhes/mi zhes 'khod cing / dpung 'jug byas mthar zing slong byed gte rnams mthar skrod nan po byas thog dpon sde byings nas sngar byas rgyab bskyur dang phyin chad spang blang zhu rgyu'i mtha' 'doms gan rgya blangs te 'khrun gcod legs tsam byung bar grags/skor/ bzhi/ bod sa gnas su srid 'dzin gyi byed thabs gsar pa 'ga' byung ba'i rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho dang ser skya dpon rigs che gras 'ga' zhig me/ 4/la nang khul dang / phyi sog rgya gar sogs kyi sa gnas mang por dus

yun gang 'tshams bzhugs te sngon thon gyi 'dzugs skrun dang / 'phru'/ chas/tshan rig lag rtsal do dam lam lugs/ dmag don sogs dngos su gzigs stabs dbyin ji dang / rgya gar/ phyi sog mes rgyal nang khul gyi ro dam lam lugs dang tshan rig lag rtsal sogs skor brtag zhib yun ring gnang ste ngo da kyi spyi tshogs dngos 'brel gong spel gtong dgos na deng rabs kyi tshan rig lag rtsal dang / do dam lam lugs/ dmag dpung nges can zhig sogs dgos nges las lha bla ma kho nar gsol ba 'debs bzhin bsdad na mi 'grig pa de gsal por mkhyen/der brten bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas/ dmag don sogs yar rgyas gong 'phel shong ched byed thabs gsar pa 'ga' zhig lag len bstar ba 'di ltar/ shing sta ga(1914)lor sim la'i gros tshogs grol nas yun ring ma song bar bod dmag bcos sgrig dang rgya bskyed btang ste bod dmag dmag sgar gcig la nyi hong gi dmag dpon rnying pa ya su ma ji ya nas nyi hong gi drag po'i lugs srol gyi dmag rtsed dang / dmag sgar gcig la u ru su'i drag po'i slob sbyong thon pa sog po bstan pa rgyal mtshan nas u ru su'i lugs kyi dmag rtsed/dmag sgar gcig la dbyin ji'i lugs kyi dmag rtsed/ sngar yod rgya sbyong dmag rtsed bcas khag so sor slob sbyong byed du bcug ste dmag rtsal 'gran bsdur gyis dmag rtsed gang zhig dge mtshan che ba yod med gzigs zhib dang 'brel bod dmag chig khri tsam 'dzugs rgyu'i 'char 'god gnang / de'i spyi khyab dmag dpon che ba bka' blon tsha rong zla bzang dgra 'dral dang / dmag spyi gzhon pa tha'i ji khri smon nor bu dbang rgyal la bsko gzhag bstsal/ de rjes dmag sgar gsar rnying rnams ka sde'i go rim sde tshan bsgrigs shing / dmag dar dang / dmag spyi las khungs kyi rtsa 'dzugs sgrig gzhi/ dmag khrims sogs gtan 'bebs gsal bsgrags ske gnang / gong gsal dmag sgar khag de rnams la de snga'i rgya sbyong / sgrig gzhi 141

gzhir bzung dmag mi lnga brgya rer mda' dpon re dang / de 'og ru dpon gnyis dang / brgya dpon bzhi/ lding dpon nyi shu/ bcu dpon lnga bcu re bcas rim bzhin bsko gzhag bstsal zhing / de nas dmag don mi sna gso skyong byed ched rgyal rtser dbyin jis dmag dpon gyi slob grwa btsugs te dmag don mi sna khag gcig gso skyong gis rim bzhin dmag sgar so sor khag bgos thog dmag dpon gyi las 'gan 'khur ba red/de nas bod dmag gi mtshon cha'i 'byung khungs thag gcod yag po yong ched grwa bzhi glog 'phrul khang gsar btsugs thog me mda' dang mde'u bzos/ 'on kyang skabs der lag rtsal dang rgyu chas sogs phyi nang gang ci'i rkyen shin tu dman pas me mda' dang mde'u'i 'bor tshad dang spus tshad gnyis ka 'gan srung byed ma thub stabs rjes su grwa bzhi dngul dpar khang du bsgyur nas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dngul lor par 'debs kyi las 'gan 'khur te rim bzhin dngul sgor dang /zangs ṭam shog dngul/ sbrag 'dzin bcas par 'debs bya yul du bsgyur/ lo der dngul lor 'ga' zhig par 'debs 'grems spel gnang /de nas bod du glog las dang / gter las/ sbrag tar las rigs sogs gsar 'dzugs byed ched byang ngos pa rig 'dzin rdo rje dang / smon grong mkhyen rab kun bzang / skyid sbug dbang 'dus nor bu/ sgog mkhar bsod nams rgyal po(yig cha 'ga' zhig tu bsod nams mgon skyabs zhes 'khod )bcas dpon rigs kyi gzhon nu bzhi dbyin ji'i rgyal sa lun tun du glog las dang / sbrag tar/gter las/ dmag don bcas slob sbyong byed par gtong gnang ba dang 'brel kho tsho'i lta skyong 'go 'dzin byed po rtsis pa lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal gtong gnang mdzad/sbel gyis bcoms pa'i〈bod kyi sngon chad dang da lta 〉zhes pa'i nang bkod don mtho ri/ 4snro phru gu bzhi'i nang nas lo na rgan shos sgog mkhar bas dmag las sbyangs pa

dang / dmag sgar du'ang zla ba bcu gcig tsam sbyong bdar byang shing / slob grwa ma thon gong bod la phyir log pa dang / lo chung shos byang ngos pa ni spyang grung 'dzoms la rig pa rno ba zhig yod/ des glog las sbyang ste sbyang 'bras gang legs thon zhing / de min gzhan gnyis slob sbyong la brtson 'grus zhan pas grub 'bras de tsam byung med mi zer/ kho tsho snga rjes su bod la log rjes skyid sbrug dbang 'dus nor bus lha sa'i tar khang btsugs te 'go 'dzin byed po'i 'gan 'khur gnang ba dang / smon grong mkhyen rab kun bzang gis lha sa'i byang ngos nas gser gyi gter kha 'don pa'i las 'go btsams nas gter kha 'don skabs sa 'og nas sbal pa chen po zhig thon pas mi mang pos bkra mi shes pa'i rtags mtshan red ces gter 'don pa'i las mar ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas stabs las mtshams mi 'jog ka med byung / 'on kyang skabs der rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i bka' dgongs bzhin bod kyi sa gnas rdzong gzhis khag la bka' rgya btang ste gter rdo 'tshol zhib byed dgos pa'i bka' phab pa ltar sa gnas khag nas gter rdo'i dpe tshad 'dra min sna tshogs sa gnas srid gzhung la phul te mi mang yongs nas gter rdo 'tshol ba'i bya ba bzang po zhig 'go tshugs pa red/ byang ngos pa rig 'dzin rdo rjes bod du 'phrul 'khor bzo grwa 'dzugs rgya'i 'gan 'khur gnang ba ma zad/ dog sde'i chu shugs glog 'don khang btsugs te glog bzhu yang spar thub pa byung ba red/ sgog mkhar ba bsod nams rgyal po bod la phyir log nas yun ring ma song bar tshe yi 'phen pa rdzogs/ de rjes dpon rigs dang tshong pa che gras khag gi bu phrug mang po rgya gar la slob sbyong du 'gro mkhan byung yod kyang bod kyi 'dzugs skrun la phan pa'i bya ba gang yang ma byung bar mngon/me 'brug(1916)lo'i zla 9nang lha sa bstan rgyas gling gi nye 'dabs su khang pa gsar skrun thog bod lugs sman rtsis khang dngos su btsugs/ dbu 'dzi/ 4/ma

rtsis mkhas dbang 'bras spungs sman sbyin pa mkhyen rab nor bur rtse drung las tshan che ba'i go gnas bsko bzhag mdzad/ dbus gtsang dang / khams/ mnga' ris sogs mnga' khul sa gnas khag nas slob ma mang po bsdu bskong thog bod kyi rig gnas spyi dang / khyad par sman rtsis kyi gzhung lugs la sbyang pa gang legs byas te bod kyi rig gnas gong du spel ba dang / bod mi drag zhan tshang ma'i nad gsor phan pa'i bya ba mang po mdzad pas da lta'ang sman rtsis khang zhes yul gru kun tu grags che bar gyur/gzhan yang bod ljongs kyi zhing nags thon skyed gong 'phel yong thabs dang /thon zog gtso bo bal gyi tshong las skor sogs dpal 'byor yar rgyas 'byung thabs la'ang thugs 'khur che bzhes mdzad yod pa ni/ rnam thar nang 1913bod chu glang lor bod ljongs ser skya yongs la slad kyi blang dor byed sgo'i skor 〉 gyi rtsa tshig sbug dam sbyar ma zhig bstsal pa'i don tshan lnga par/ da nas bzung spyi sa ri klung bed med stong lung ji yod la khyim pa nyams can rtsol ldan nas sa zhing 'dul ba dang /sbyar lcang skye tsher yan gyi phan bde spel ba'i 'debs 'khol gang thub byed par gzhung sger chos bcas sus kyang bkag 'gog nam yang mi chog cing / de dag dge pod lo gsum khral med du spyad rjes rgya khyon dang dge bed la gzhigs pa'i khral bogs gnyis lo 'gel 'os thog 'dzin bdag gtan 'jags su sprad pas gzhung 'bangs gnyis slebs yong ba bya rgyu zhes gsal ba ltar de sngon sa stong bed med rnams kyang srid gzhung dang / dgon sde/ sgor pa khag bcas kyis bkag 'doms byed pa de dag slad zhing pa nyams myong dang 'bad rtsol yod pa tshos sa zhing gsar sbol lam/ sbyar lcang skye tsher sogs 'debs gang thub rang mos ltar byas chog pa gnang zhing / thon skyed byas pa'i dge bed ji byung lo gsum ring khral 'disdu med par so sos longs spyad chog pa dang / de rjes khral lam yang na bogs

ma soṭa gzhung 'bangs gnyis lo gtan 'bebs kyis 'dzin bdag ngal rtsol byed po rang la gtan 'jags byas 'thus gnang ba de ni skabs de'i spyi tshogs la dpags na gsar bcos shig yin pas gzhung 'bangs gnyis gar dge slebs nges can zhig byung yod/de bzhin bod kyi tshong las thon zog drag shos lug bal yin pa de dag sa gnas so so'i dpon po dang tshong pa mnyam 'brel gyis 'brog par rin 'bab sne sel tsam las ma sprad par nyo 'dren gyis rgya gar phyogs btsongs te khe bzang za bar brten gzhung tshong spom mda' tshang la bsko bzhag gnang ste/ 'brog par yul thang gi bal rin gcig gyur sprad de nyo sgrub kyis rgya gar la sdebs tshong byas nas gzhung la khe 'bab / che tsam 'bul gyi yod rung / rgya gar gyi ma rtsa can che khag tshos kha mthun byas te bal gong gcog nas tshong las bya gzhag de rigs la'ang thugs 'khur chen po bzhes kyi yod pa ni/ rnam thar nang 1931bod lcags lug lor/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes gsum nyin/ a me ri ga'i si'i su ye dam/ kha kring la phyag bris bstsal don/ pha'adi ga bod yul nas thon khungs bal rnams bod gzhung gi chab srid dang / mi ser gyi bde thabs 'phel rgyas ched lo gsum ring gzhung tshong spom mda' tshang nas tshong bsgyur chog pa de ltar yang / snga lo'i bal 'bab rnams kyang tshong bsgyur bya rgyu yin rung gong gsal ka yan rnams nas ngan mthun thog bal gong dma' gcog dang / de ga a me ri ka nas bal nyo'i ngo tshab yong skabs gong gsal ka yan rnams nas chang rin sprad de bal nyo rgyu kha bkag gis phyir slog thogabal nyo tshong la gnod rkyen gang thub ngan pa kha 'gril sha stag byas te bal 'dod nyo 'dod tshong byed ma bcug pas gzhung gun che gshis/ da cha gzhung tshung spom mda' tshang gi bal do rnams rgya gar ka yan gyi lag thog 'grim tshong ma dgos par rang re do bdag rnams phan tshun ngo sprad thog nas bal tshong byas 'thus shig byung phyin gnyis 145

ma soṭa gzhung 'bangs gnyis lo gtan 'bebs kyis 'dzin bdag ngal rtsol byed po rang la gtan 'jags byas 'thus gnang ba de ni skabs de'i spyi tshogs la dpags na gsar bcos shig yin pas gzhung 'bangs gnyis mar dge slebs nges can zhig byung yod/de bzhin bod kyi tshong las thon zog drag shos lug bal yin pa de dag sa gnas so so'i dpon po dang tshong pa mnyam 'brel gyis 'brog par rin 'bab sne sel tsam las ma sprad par nyo 'dren gyis rgya gar phyogs btsongs te khe bzang za bar brten gzhung tshong spom mda' tshang la bsko bzhag gnang ste/ 'brog par yul bang gi bal rin gcig gyur sprad de nyo sgrub kyis rgya gar la sdebs tshong byas nas gzhung la khe 'bab / che tsam 'bul gyi yod rung / rgya gar gyi ma rtsa can che khag tshos kha mthun byas te bal gong gcog nas tshong las bya gzhag de rigs la'ang thugs 'khur chen po bzhes kyi yod pa ni/ rnam thar nang 1931bod lcags lug lor/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes gsum nyin/ a me ri ku'i si'i su ye dam/ kha kring la phyag bris bstsal don/ pha'adi ga bod yul nas thon khungs bal rnams bod gzhung gi chab srid dang / mi ser gyi bde thabs 'phel rgyas ched lo gsum ring gzhung tshong spom mda' tshang nas tshong bsgyur chog pa de ltar yang / snga lo'i bal 'bab rnams kyang tshong bsgyur bya rgyu yin rung gong gsal ka yan rnams nas ngan mthun thog bal gong dma' gcog dang / de ga a me ri ka nas bal nyo'i ngo tshab yong skabs gong gsal ka yan rnams nas chang rin sprad de bal nyo rgyu kha bkag gis phyir slog thogabal nyo tshong la gnod rkyen gang thub ngan pa kha 'grel sha stag byas te bal 'dod nyo 'dod tshong byed ma bcug pas gzhung gun che gshes/ da cha gzhung tshung spom mda' tshang gi bal do rnams rgya gar ka yan gyi lag thog 'grim tshong ma dgos par rang re do bdag rnams phan tshun ngo sprad thog nas bal tshong byas 'thus sheg byung phyin /rdos

sman yong rgyu zhes 'khod pa'i phyag bris shig bstsal/〉〉zhes 'khod 'dug pa bcas dpal 'byor gong spel thad kyi zhib phra'i lag bstar bya rim gzhung yig nang 'khod rgyu yang / 'dir rnam thar nang nas dpe mtshon gnyis drangs te bkod pa lags so/ja ni bod mi rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i nang med thabs med pa zhig yin pa dang /skabs der 'grim 'grul stabs mi bde bas 'thung ja yul phyogs gzhan nas 'dren par dka' ngal ha cang che ba'i gnas su gyur cing / ja'i gnad don de thag gcod thub res chu phag(1923)lor ja chu rong du ja shing 'debs las kyi tshod lta gnang / de'i 'go 'dzin byed por ru dpon las tshan byams pa skal bzang bsko gzhag bstsal/ 'on kyang lo mang ring ja shing 'debs las tshod lta'i las kur phan 'bras mngon gsal dod po de tsam ma byung stabs rjes su tshod lta'i las ka de mtshams 'jog gnang dgos byung /chu phag(1923)lo der bod kyi lte ba'i grong khyer lha sa'i spyi tshogs bde 'jags kyi las kur shugs snon yong chedaphapu li si'i 〉〉dmag sgar gsar du btsugs te lha sa'i phyogs bzhir pu li si'i tsho khang re dang / srang lam gtso bo khag laphapu li si 〉〉bzhag ste nyin mtshan kun tu bde srung gi las ku'i 'gan 'khur 'dzugs gnang mdzad cirnga / de'i 'go khrid du legs ldan sa heb(ming gzhan bsod nams legs ldan )dang / rtse drung mkhyen rab kun bzang bsko gzhag gnang ba ma zad/ mdo mkhar sras dang / lcang grong pa sogs la 4pu li si'i ri dmag khrims dang / sgrig gzhi/ sbyong bdar bya thabs sogs zhib 'jug byed rgyu'i bka' bkod kyang gnang ba red/4 de nas shing glang(1925)lor sbrag tarakhang gsar du btsugs pa dang /de'i 'go 'dzin byed por rtse drung grags pa chos rgyal dang / las bya shod drung spel 146

sman yong rgyu zhes 'khod pa'i phyag bris shig bstsal/mi zhes 'khod 'dug pa bcas dpal 'byor gong spel thad kyi zhib phra'i lag bstar bya rim gzhung yig nang 'khod shā yang / 'dir rnam thar nang nas dpe mtshon gnyis drangs te bkod pa lags ja ni bod mi rnams kyi 'tsho ba'i nang med thabs med pa zhig yin pa dang /skabs der 'grim 'grul stabs mi bde bas 'thung ja yul phyogs gzhan nas 'dren par dka' ngal ha cang che ba'i gnas su gyur cing / ja'i gnad don de thag gcod thub res chu phag(1923)lor ja chu rong du ja shing 'debs las kyi tshod lta gnang / de'i 'go 'dzin byed por ru dpon las tshan byams pa skal bzang bsko gzhag bstsal/ 'on kyang lo mang ring ja shing 'debs las tshod lta'i las kur phan 'bras mngon gsal dod po de tsam ma byung stabs rjes su tshod lta'i las ka de rkomatshams 'jog gnang dgos byung /chu phag(1923)lo der bod kyi lte ba'i grong khyer lha sa'i spyi tshogs bde 'jags kyi las mar shugs snon yong ched pu li si'i 7dmag sgar gsar du la btsugs te lha sa'i phyogs bzhir pu li si'i tsho khang re dang / srang lam gtso bo khag la pu li si 〉 bzhag ste nyin mtshan kun tu bde srung gi las ga'i 'gan 'khur 'dzugs gnang mdzad cing / de'i 'go khrid du legs ldan sa heb(ming gzhan bsod nams legs ldan )dang / rtse drung mkhyen rab kun bzang bsko gzhag gnang ba ma zad/ mdo mkhar sras dang / lcang grong pa sogs la pu li si'i 7dmag khrims dang / sgrig gzhi/ sbyong bdar bya thabs sogs zhib 'jug byed rgyu'i bka' bkod kyang gnang ba red/ de nas shing glang(1925)lor sbrag tamakhang gsar du btsugs pa dang /des :go 'dzin byed por rtse drung grags pa chos rgyal dang / las bya shod drung spel

bzhi ba/ tar gtong rtse drung chos ldan bstan dar/ shod drung skyid sbug pa/sbrag drung gnyis bcas bsko gzhag bstsal thog tar yig dang sbrag yig gla cha dngul 'bab ji byung zla ba drug re'i mtshams su rtsis phra khams dngas bka' shag la 'bul dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs gnang / snyede rjes dngul khang gsar du btsugs te thog mar phun khang gung la dngul khang gi 'go 'dzin bsko bstsal dang / de rjes bka' blon tsha rong zla bzang dgra 'dul sogs la 'go 'dzin bsko bzhag gnang nas bod kyi dngul lor lam lugs la bsgyur bcos gnang ba ste/ de snga bod du ṭam dkar sna tshogs 'gro rgyugs byed srol yod/ṭam dkar de rigs nang nas chan lung tsang pa'o zhes pa'i chin gong ma chan lung skabs su gtan 'bebs dang par 'debs gnang ba'i ṭam dkar de 'gro rgyugs gang 'tshams che ba zhig yin pa dang / ṭam dkar de la bod mi rgan rabs rnams kyis ma dag rgyun 'jags kyis tsang chan pa'o lung zhes 'bod/ bod dngul lam lugs la bsgyur bcos gnang rjes bod rang nas zangs kyi pad shag kha gang dang /skar lnga/ skar phye brgyad/ zho gang bcas rigs bzhi dang / de rjes dngul gyi zho lnga'i sgor mo/ srang gang sgor mo/ srang gsum sgor mo sogs dngul par dang /da dung gser ṭam yang par 'debs byas yod/ de rjes 1912lo bzhin bzung bod kyi shog lor thog ma dngul ṭam lnga dang / ṭam bcu/ ṭam bco lnga/ ṭam nyi yu rtsa lnga/ ṭam lnga bcu bcas rigs lnga dpar 'debs byas pa de dag shing par yin la ljang / li/ smug ser/ sngo bcas tshos gcig ma yin pa dang / lo rabs sum cu'i yas mas tsam la ṭam lnga bcu'i shog lor lcags par tshon khra can thog mar brgyab pa dang / de min dngul srang lnga dang / srang bcu/ srang nyi shu rtsa lnga/ srang brgya tham pa bcas kyi shog lor rnams ni tā la'i bla ma bcu gsum pa sku gshegs pa'i rjes su rim bzhin bton pa ma zad/ dngul srang gang zho lngalta 4spyar

bzhi ba/ tar gtong rtse drung chos ldan bstan dar/ shod drung skyid sbug pa/sbrag drung gnyis bcas bsko gzhag bstsal thog tar yig dang sbrag yig gla cha dngul 'bab ji byung zla ba drug re'i mtshams su rtsis phra khams dwangs bka' shag la 'bul dgos pa'i gtan 'bebs gnang /de rjes dngul khang gsar du btsugs te thog mar phun khang gung la dngul khang gi 'go 'dzin bsko bstsal dang / de rjes bka' blon tsha rong zla bzang dgra 'dul sogs la 'go 'dzin bsko bzhag gnang nas bod kyi dngul lor lam lugs la bsgyur bcos gnang ba ste/ de snga bod du ṭam dkar sna tshogs 'gro rgyugs byed srol yod/ṭam dkar de rigs nang nas chan lung tsang pa'o zhes pa'i chin gong ma chan lung skabs su gtan 'bebs dang par 'debs gnang ba'i ṭam dkar de 'gro rgyugs gang 'tshams che ba zhig yin pa dang / ṭam dkar de la bod mi rgan rabs rnams kyis ma dag rgyun 'jags kyis tsang chan pa'o lung zhes 'bod/ bod dngul lam lugs la bsgyur bcos gnang rjes bod rang nas zangs kyi pad shag kha gang dang /skar lnga/ skar phye brgyad/ zho gang bcas rigs bzhi dang / de rjes dngul gyi zho lnga'i sgor mo/ srang gang sgor mo/ srang gsum sgor mo sogs dngul par dang /da dung gser ṭam yang par 'debs byas yod/ de rjes 1912lo bzhin bzung bod kyi shog lor thog ma dngul ṭam lnga dang / ṭam bcu/ ṭam bco lnga/ ṭam nyi yu rtsa lnga/ ṭam lnga bcu bcas rigs lnga dpar 'debs byas pa de dag shing par yin la ljang / li/ smug ser/ sngo bcas tshos gcig ma yin pa dang / lo rabs sum cu'i yas mas tsam la ṭam lnga bcu'i shog lor lcags par tshon khra can thog mar brgyab pa dang / de min dngul srang lnga dang / srang bcu/ srang nyi shu rtsa lnga/ srang brgya tham pa bcas kyi shog lor rnams ni tā la'i bla ma bcu gsum pa sku gshegs pa'i rjes su rim bzhin bton pa ma zad/ dngul srang gang zho lnga'i sgor 147

mo dang / srang gsum sgor mo/ srang bcu'i sgor mo/ srang nyer lnga dang / srang lnga bcu'i sgor mo sogs kyang dpar 'debs byas yod/gong du smos pa'i bod dmag rgya bskyed dang / bzo grwa/ sbrag tar/ slob grwa/ dngul khang sogs 'dzugs gnyer byed pa'i nor srid yong 'bab thag gcod yong ched dpya khral bsdu lugs la bsgyur btsos byas te bal sho dang / tshwa sho/pags sho sogs dpya khral lam lugs gsar du btsugs shing / des bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang / dgon sde khag dbar 'gal ba shugs chen langs pa dang /lhag par du paṇa chen gyi mnga' 'bas bkra shis lhun po dang 'brel ba je sdug tu song zhing / de'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni chin rgyal rabs kyi dus nas bzung paṇa chen gyi mnga' khongs dgon sde khag dang / sger pa sogs kyis sa zhing dang 'brog sde mang po bdag bzung byas kyang bkra shis lhun por dpya khral dang zhing bogs gang 'tshams 'jal dgos pa tsam las/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung la dpya khral che rigs 'jal mi dgos stabs dpya khral lam srol gsar du gtan 'khel gnang ba des kho pa tsho'i khe phan la gnod 'tshe shugs chen phog pas yi mi rangs par gyur/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis bkras lhun bla brang khongs gtogs rnams kyang tā la'i bla ma'i mnga' zhabs spyi mtshungs su bsgyur ched shing stag(1914)lor gzhis ka rtse'i spyi rdzong du mkhan chung blo bzang don grub dang / shod drung mu bya bsko gzhag gnang thog gtsang phyogs rdzong khag bcu drug la do dam byas/ paṇa chen mnga' 'og gi rdzong gzhis tshang ma de'i nang du 'dus pa ma zad/ rdzong gzhis de dag nas bal sho dang /pags sho/ tshwa sho sogs khral rigs sna tshogs bsdu len byas shing / de bzhin lcags bya(1921)lor zhib 'phar las khungs gsar du btsugs te bkra shis lhun por lo re dmag phogs 'bru khal chig khri bsgrub dgos pa'i bka' phab stabs bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang / bkra shis lhun po dbar 'gal ba nyin bzhin je sdug 148

mo dang / srang gsum sgor mo/ srang bcu'i sgor mo/ srang nyer lnga dang / sung lnga bcu'i sgor mo sogs kyang dpar 'debs byas yod/gong du smos pa'i bod dmag rgya bskyed dang / bzo grwa/ sbrag tar/ slob grwa/ dngul khang sogs 'dzugs gnyer byed pa'i nor srid yong 'bab thag gcod yong ched dpya khral bsdu lugs la bsgyur btsos byas te bal sho dang / tshwa sho/pags sho sogs dpya khral lam lugs gsar du btsugs shing / des bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang / dgon sde khag dbar 'gal pa shugs chen langs pa dang /lhag par du paṇa chen gyi mnga' zhabs bkra shes lhun po dang 'brel ba je sdug tu song zhing / de'i rgyu mtshan gtso bo ni chin rgyal rabs kyi dus nas bzung paṇa chen gyi mnga' khongs dgon sde khag dang / sger pa sogs kyis sa zhing dang 'brog sde mang po bdag bzung byas kyang bkra shes lhun por dpya khral dang zhing bogs gang 'tshams 'jal dgos pa tsam las/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung la dpya khral che rigs 'jal mi dgos stabs dpya khral lam srol gsar du gtan 'khel gnang ba des kho pa tsho'i khe phan la gnod 'tshe shugs chen phog pas yi mi rangs par gyur/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis bkras lhun bla brang khongs gtogs rnams kyang tā la'i bla ma'i mnga' zhabs spyi mtshungs su bsgyur ched shing stag(1914)lor gzhis ka rtse'i spyi rdzong du mkhan chung blo bzang don grub dang / shod drung mu bya bsko gzhag gnang thog gtsang phyogs rdzong khag bcu drug la do dam byas/ paṇa chen mnga' 'og gi rdzong gzhis tshang ma de'i nang du 'dus pa ma zad/ rdzong gzhis de dag nas bal sho dang /pags sho/ tshwa sho sogs khral rigs sna tshogs bsdu len byas shing / de bzhin lcags bya(1921)lor zhib 'phar las khungs gsar du btsugs te bkra shes lhun por lo re dmag phogs 'bru khal chig khri bsgrub dgos pa'i bka' phab stabs bod sa ༵༵sa srid gzhung dang / bkra shes lhun po dbar 'gal ba nyin bzhin je sdug

tu song ba dang / mthar chu phag(1923)lo'i zla 11tshes 15nyin gyi mtshan mo paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa blo bzang thub bstan chos kyi nyi ma sku 'khor dang bcas mes rgyal nang khul du bros byol du phebs/ dus der bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang / de'i mnga' khongs dgon sde khag dang sger pa sogs dbar la'ang 'gal ba je mang du phyin pa dang / lhag par du srid blon bskyar du btsugs gnang ba des bka' shag gi dbang cha chung du phyin stabs tā la'i bla ma mchog dang / bka' blon tsho'i dbar gyi 'brel ba'ang nyin bzhin je sdug tu song zhing / skabs der mdo smad khul du bod dmag dang zi khron gyi dmag mi'i dbar zing cha yang yang langs pa sogs mdor na bod nang khul gyi gnas tshul de rnyog 'dzing ha cang che ba'i gnas su gyar bas dbyin jis bod 'di mes rgyal dang kha bral gtong ched spel slar yang bod du btang ste tsha rong zla bzang dgra 'dul sogs kho pa tsho'i rjes 'brangs par shog thag rlung 'tshang gis gsang ba'i sgrig 'dzugs btsugs te tā la'i bla ma'i srid bsgyur bu rgyu'i lkog g.yo'i ngan byus bshams shing / sgrig 'dzugs de'i nang zhugs mkhan mang che ba rgyal rtse dbyin dmag slob grwa nas thon pa'i bod dmag gi dmag dpon gzhon nu rnams yin/ tsha rong zla bzang dgra 'dul gyi khyim du gsang ba'i sgo nas tshogs 'du bskongs te sa gnas srid gzhung gi srid dbang 'phrog thabs skor zhib gsal gros sol dang mna' skyel dam bca' 'jog pa sogs byas/ tshogs zhugs khongs mi bod dmag gi dmag dpon dwags po sbrum pas lkog tu rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho'i sku drung du bskyod de tsha rong sogs nas ngan gros byed pa'i gnas tshul rnams zhib gsal snyan seng zhus stabs tā la'i bla mas gnas tshul 'di ni ha cang tshabs che ba'i lkog g.yo zhig yin pa gsal por mkhyen cing / ring min tsha rong zla bzang dgra 'dul bod dmag gi dmag spyi'i go gnas las phab/ dmag don dbang cha yongs su sdurdon

thub pa'i ched du tā la'i bla ma thub bstan rgya mtsho'i sku tsha dwags po sbrum pa ni dmag don gyi 'jem thang zhan pa dang / sgyid lugs che ba zhig yin stabs don dngos thog dmag don gyi dbang cha tshags su tshud pa zhig ma byung bar brten rtsis dpon lung shar la dmag spyi'i 'tsho 'dzin bsko bzhag bstsal/ spel gyis btsams pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i rnam thar nang spyi lo 1925lor slebs skabs tā la'i bla mas blo brtan 'gyur med gyis dbyin ji rgyal khab dang 'brel ba nyin bzhin rgyang ring du btang ste krung gor phyogs pa red/ lo 'dir khong gis lung shar la bod dmag gi dmag spyir bsko gzhag byas shing / lung shar ni dbyin jir ngo rgol byed mkhan yin pa dngos gsal dod po red/ nga tsho'i grogs po rnying pa de lnga'i bod dmag gi dmag spyi tsha rong ni thog mtha' bar gsum du dbyin jir dga' zhen yod pa zhig red/ skabs der khong gi dbang cha mang che ba shor ba ma zad/ mu mthud go gnas dma' ru btang zhing / 1926lor rgyal rtser btsugs pa'i dbyin ji'i slob grwa mtshams 'jog byas pa red mi ces bkod pa bzhin/ rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtsho ni don dngos thog rang gi mes rgyal la dga' zhen che ba dang / bod mi rigs kyi dpal 'byor dang / rig danas/ dmag don sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad myur du gong spel gtong ba'i dgongs pa rgya che yod stabs dbyin jis zhi drag gnyis kyi thabs la brten nas g.yo sgyu'i sbyor ba ji ltar bshams kyang kho tsho'i dmigs yul ngan pa de gsal por mkhyen pa ma zad/ rgya bod mi rigs dbar gyi spun zla'i 'brel ba gting zab tu gtong rgyu dang / krung dbyang srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung dbar gyi mthun lam legs bcos byed rgyu 'di ni thabs lam bzang shos yin pa lo mang ring gi bya ba dngos kyi nang nas gsal por rtogs te sa 'brug(1928)lo'i dgun dus ma skul dang blangs kyis rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar ba~X sdod bod kyi mkhan po blo bzang pa sangs dang / de rjes pe cing dbyi ho kung

ste dga' ldan byin chags gling gi mkhan po dkon cog 'byung gnas rnam gnyis nan cing du gtong gnang mdzad de go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung la brtsi bkur zhu ba'i rnam pa bstan pa ma zad/ tā la'i bla ma rang nyid la dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs dang mnyam 'brel gyis mes rgyal la 'khon 'dzin byed pa'i dgongs tshul rtsa ba nas med lugs bab med yang yang gnang ba dang / paṇa chen rin po che bod la phyir log gnang rgyur dga' bsu dang brtsi bkur zhu gi yin zhes gsungs/ de rjes lcags rta(1930)lor li'u man chen gyis gnas bskor du yong ba'i tshul byas te mkhan po dkon cog 'byung gnas dang mnyam du bod du yong ste krung dbyang srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung dbar mdza' brtse'i 'brel ba 'dzugs rgyu'i skor 'khod pa'i go min tang gi tsung thung cang ce hre'i phyag bris phyag bstar ma zhig gong sa mchog la phul zhing / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis khong rnam gnyis la bod kyi sngar srol bzhin bsu ba sne len gzab rgyas gnang / le'u man chin skabs der lo nyi shu rtsa gsum la slebs pa dang khong gi ma ni bod rigs shig yin pas thengs 'dir bod du yong don ni krung dbyang dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung dbar gyi 'brel ba bskyar gso yong ched yin zhes gsal bshad yang yang zhus pa ma zad/so min tang bod sog u yon lhan khang gi bsam 'char ltar bod kyi gnad don ji ltar byas te thag gcod byed dgos pa'i skor dri ba don tshan brgyad bton pa 'di ltar/ 44dang po/ bod dang krung dbyang gi 'brel ba ga 'dra byas te bskyar gso byed dgos sam/gnyis pa/ krung dbyang gis bod la dbang bsgyur gyi dbang cha ga 'dra byas te 'dzin dgos sam/gsum pa/ bod sa gnas rang skyong gi dbang cha ga 'dra byas te gtan 'khel 151

byed dgos sam/bzhi pa/ tā la'i dang paṇa chen rnam gnyis krung go go man tang nang zhugs sam/lnga pa/ tā la'i dang paṇa chen gyi bod kyi chab srid kyi go gnas dang dbang cha sngar bzhin byed dam/ yang na gsar du gtan 'bebs bzo dgos sam/drug pa/ paṇa chen bod du phyir log na/ tā la'i mchog nas bsu ba gang 'dra byed dam/bdun pa/ phan tshun 'brel ba byed bde ba'i ched du tā la'i bla ma nas nan cing du don gcod khang 'dzugs sam/brgyad pa/ bod phyogs nas krung dbyang la da dung re ba gang zhig yod dam 7zhes 'khod yod/gong gsal gyi don tshan khag la dris lan zhib gsal phul ba dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis krung dbyang srid gzhung gi bka' la brtsi bkur zhu ba'i rnam pa bstan pa smos ci/ lo de gar mkhan po dkon cog 'byung gnas nan cing du bca' sdod bod kyi spyi khyab 'bus mir bsko gzhag bstsal/de rjes lcab/sa rta(1930)lo'i zla 12par go min tang bod sog u yon lhan khang gis dpon rigs shes go leng dang / drung yig than yun hran rgya gar brgyud bod du gtong gnang mdzad kyang shes go leng chu shur du 'byor rjes glo bur du grongs pa dang de'i sku phung lha sar gdan drangs nas 'das mchod gzab rgyas gnang ba dang / drung yig than yun hran la tā la'i bla ma mchog nas mjal 'phrad gnang ba ma zad/ bsu ba dang sne len gang legs gnang zhing / khong bod du yun ring bzhugs kyang gnad don che ba gang yang thag gcod byed thabs bral bas mthar phyir (4 ga phebs/152
